# aloha-vue: guide for AI agents

> Generated by `npm run build-llms` from the docs (`docs/scripts/build-llms.mjs`, this text: `docs/scripts/AGENTS.template.md`). Do not edit `AGENTS.md` and `llms/` by hand.

**aloha-vue** is an accessible component library for **Vue 3**. Version 3.x.

- Components start with `A`: `AButton` → `<a-button>`. All exports are listed in `src/index.js`.
- CSS classes start with `a_` (`a_btn`, `a_mt_3`), CSS custom properties with `--a_` (`--a_color_primary`).
- Every page of the docs is in `llms/` (list below): props, slots, events, exposes, CSS variables and examples. **Read the page of a component before using it, do not guess props.**
- The sources are in `src/`, the styles in `scss/`.
- Types of all components and their props: `types/aloha-vue.d.ts` (TypeScript, Volar) and `web-types.json` (JetBrains).
- The same docs online: https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms.txt

## Setup

New project with everything configured (Vite, translations, icons, a form and a table):

```bash
npx degit ilia-brykin/aloha/starter my-app
cd my-app
npm install
npm run dev
```

Existing project:

```bash
npm install aloha-vue aloha-svg
```

`main.js`:

```js
import { createApp } from "vue";
import App from "./App.vue";
import "aloha-vue/dist/aloha-vue.css"; // or @use "aloha-vue/scss/aloha-vue"; in your SCSS
import {
  AComponentsPlugin,
  AI18nPlugin,
  AIconPlugin,
  AMobilePlugin,
  i18nDE,
  i18nEN,
} from "aloha-vue";
import Bell from "aloha-svg/dist/js/bootstrap/Bell";
import myDe from "./i18n/de.json";
import myEn from "./i18n/en.json";

const app = createApp(App);

// Translations: dictionaries of the library + own dictionaries, start language
app.use(AI18nPlugin, {
  de: { ...i18nDE, ...myDe },
  en: { ...i18nEN, ...myEn },
}, "de");

// Icons for the props icon, icon-left, icon-right… (name → svg string)
app.use(AIconPlugin, { icons: { Bell } });

// Mobile view below this width (px)
app.use(AMobilePlugin, { breakpoint: 991 });

// Optional: defaults and settings of the components
app.use(AComponentsPlugin, {
  AModal: { props: { closeButtonClass: "a_btn a_btn_link" } },
  ATable: { props: { isStriped: true } },
});

app.mount("#app");
```

Components are imported where they are used:

```js
import { AButton, AModal } from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: { AButton, AModal },
};
```

Other plugins (`AHttpPlugin`, `ADataRetrievePlugin`, `AFormPlugin`, `APageTabTitlePlugin`, `ARemPxPlugin`) are only needed for the features they configure, see `llms/plugins/` and `src/plugins/`.

## Translations

- Text props (`text`, `html`, `safe-html`, `label`, `placeholder`, `title`, `aria-label`…) accept a key of the dictionary, e.g. `text="_SAVE_"`. A text that is not a key is shown as it is.
- Placeholders: `"_HELLO_": "Hello {{ name }}"` + `:extra="{ name: 'Anna' }"`.
- Own texts in templates: `<a-translation tag="p" text="_MY_KEY_" />`, see `llms/components/translation.md`.
- In JavaScript: `getTranslatedText({ placeholder: "_MY_KEY_", extra })`.
- Change the language: `setLanguage("en")`. Add keys later: `updateI18nForLanguage({ language: "en", i18n: { … } })`.
- Dictionaries of the library: `i18nAR`, `i18nDE`, `i18nEN`, `i18nES`, `i18nFR`, `i18nHR`, `i18nIT`, `i18nNL`, `i18nPL`, `i18nRU`, `i18nUK`. Their keys are listed in the section **Translations** of each component page.

## Filters and utils

Pure functions for formatting, also usable outside of components:

```js
import { filterCurrency, filterDate } from "aloha-vue";

filterCurrency(1234.5); // "1.234,50 €"
```

In `setup()` they are also available with `const { filterCurrency } = AFiltersAPI();`. All filters: `llms/functions/`.

## Styles

- Utility classes for spacing, colors, display, text…: `llms/css/`. Prefer them to own CSS.
- Theming with CSS custom properties: `llms/css/theming.md`. Every component page ends with its CSS variables.

## Rules

- In tables a column with `filter` (e.g. `filter: "date"`) also needs `slot: "get"`.
- Use the components and props described in `llms/`. If something is missing, check the props in `src/<Component>/<Component>.js`.
- Keep the accessibility: give buttons with only an icon a `title` or `aria-label`, give form elements a `label`.
- Migration from 2.x: `llms/migrations/migrations-version2-to3.md`.

### Functions

- **Filters**
  - [filterBoolean](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-boolean.md) — The function **filterBoolean** is used to convert a **boolean value** into translated text.
  - [filterCapitalize](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-capitalize.md) — Converts the first character of string to upper case and the remaining to lower case.
  - [filterCurrency](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-currency.md) — The function **filterCurrency** is a specialized extension of the [**filterFloat**](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-float.md) function and serves to format numeric values as currency.
  - [filterDate](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-date.md) — The function **filterDate** uses the [moment.js](https://momentjs.com/docs/#/displaying/format/) library to format dates and times.
  - [filterDateRelative](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-date-relative.md) — The function **filterDateRelative** formats a date relative to now, e.g.
  - [filterDefaultForEmpty](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-default-for-empty.md) — The function **filterDefaultForEmpty** is used to check a value and return a default value if the checked value is considered empty.
  - [filterDuration](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-duration.md) — The function **filterDuration** formats a duration, e.g.
  - [filterEmail](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-email.md) — The function **filterEmail** creates an HTML link for an email address.
  - [filterEscapeHTML](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-escape-html.md) — Escapes HTML special characters in a string to prevent XSS attacks.
  - [filterFileSize](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-file-size.md) — The function **filterFileSize** converts a size from a source unit (e.g., Bytes) to a target size in a specific unit (e.g., Kilobytes, Megabytes) and returns the result as a formatted string.
  - [filterFloat](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-float.md) — The function **filterFloat** formats numeric values according to the specified parameters.
  - [filterInitials](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-initials.md) — The function **filterInitials** returns the initials of a name, e.g.
  - [filterJson](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-json.md) — The function **filterJson** converts a JavaScript object or value into a formatted JSON string.
  - [filterKeyValue](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-key-value.md) — The function **filterKeyValue** creates a formatted string from the key-value pairs of a JavaScript object.
  - [filterLimitTo](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-limit-to.md) — The function **filterLimitTo** is used to limit an input string to a specific maximum length and optionally apply a special logic for ellipses at the end of the string.
  - [filterLink](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-link.md) — The function **filterLink** creates an HTML link based on the provided URL.
  - [filterList](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-list.md) — The function creates a list from an array.
  - [filterLowerCase](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-lower-case.md) — Converts the input string to lowercase.
  - [filterMask](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-mask.md) — Masks a given value, displaying only the last few characters.
  - [filterNumberCompact](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-number-compact.md) — The function **filterNumberCompact** shortens a large number with a unit (thousand, million, billion, trillion), e.g.
  - [filterPercent](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-percent.md) — The function **filterPercent** formats a value as a percentage, e.g.
  - [filterPropertyByValue](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-property-by-value.md) — The function **filterPropertyByValue** allows for mapping values to predefined properties in a mapping object.
  - [filterSearchHighlight](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-search-highlight.md) — The function **filterSearchHighlight** is used to mark a search term in a value by enclosing the search term with **HTML** tags.
  - [filterStripHtml](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-strip-html.md) — The function **filterStripHtml** removes HTML tags from a string and returns its text, e.g.

  - [filterTruncateMiddle](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/filter-truncate-middle.md) — The function **filterTruncateMiddle** shortens a string in the middle and keeps its start and its end, e.g.

- **Utils**
  - [aOrderBy](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/utils-aorder-by.md) — Extends lodash's orderBy with case-insensitive comparison by default while preserving all iteratee and order combinations.
  - [aSortBy](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/utils-asort-by.md) — Extends lodash's sortBy with case-insensitive comparison by default while keeping support for every iteratee shorthand.
  - [getTotalNestedCount](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/utils-get-total-nested-count.md) — Calculates the total count of elements within a nested structure, including all children and sub-children, based on the specified child key.
  - [isArrayOfArrays](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/utils-is-array-of-arrays.md) — Checks if the given input is an array of arrays.
  - [isArrayOfStrings](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/utils-is-array-of-strings.md) — Checks if the given input is an array of strings.
- **Utils math**
  - [isEven](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/utils-math-is-even.md) — Determines if a given number is even.
  - [isOdd](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/functions/utils-math-is-odd.md) — Determines if a given number is odd.

### Rest

- [Scale](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/rest/scale.md)
- [Svg](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/rest/svg.md)

# Quick Start

## Installation

**Aloha-Vue** can be installed using **npm**, **yarn**, or **pnpm**:

```bash
# Using npm
$ npm install aloha-vue

# Using yarn
$ yarn add aloha-vue

# Using pnpm
$ pnpm add aloha-vue
```

## Styles

**Aloha-Vue** provides styles in two formats:

- Precompiled **CSS**: `dist/aloha-vue.css`
- Source **SCSS**: `scss/aloha-vue.scss`

### Example: Adding styles in `main.js`

```javascript
import { createApp } from "vue";
import App from "./App.vue";
import "aloha-vue/dist/aloha-vue.css";

const app = createApp(App);
app.mount("#app");
```

## Usage

### Example: Importing and using a simple component **AButton**

```javascript
import { createApp } from "vue";
import App from "./App.vue";
import { AButton } from "aloha-vue";
import "aloha-vue/dist/aloha-vue.css";

const app = createApp(App);

app.component("AButton", AButton);

app.mount("#app");
```

In your **Vue** template:

```html
<template>
  <div>
    <a-button @click="onClick">Click me</a-button>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
export default {
  methods: {
    onClick() {
      alert("The button is pressed!");
    },
  },
};
</script>
```

# Migration Guide from aloha-vue 2.x to 3.0.x

Version 3.0 changes the styles: all colors, sizes and the focus ring are configured with **CSS** custom properties, the components got a more modern look and are accessible by default. The **JavaScript API** of the components stays compatible, only some defaults changed: class names (section 3), icons (section 4) and accessibility (section 6). A description of the new system and a theme generator are on the page [Theming](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/css/theming.md).

## 1. Configuration

- The **SCSS** configuration was removed: `$aloha-prefix`, all `$a_*` / `$a-*` variables (e.g. `$a_primary`, `$a_spacing_*`, `$a_sizing_*`, `$a_breakpoint_*`, `$a-wizard-*`, `$dp-default-color`, `$dp-primary-color`) and the modules `utils/color_utils`, `utils/funktions`, `utils/vars_global`, `utils/global_variables`, `utils/aloha_prefix`, `utils/utils`.
- Colors are configured as hue / saturation / lightness: `--a_primary_h`, `--a_primary_s`, `--a_primary_l` (the same for `secondary`, `tertiary`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `danger`), the gray scale with `--a_gray_h` and `--a_gray_s`. All variants are derived.
- Radius: one base token `--a_radius`; `--a_border_radius_small`, `_large`, `_xl`, `_2xl` are derived.
- The default palette changed. All default colors reach **WCAG AA**.
- Breakpoints: `$a_breakpoint_mobile`, `_tablet`, `_desktop`, `_desktop_min`, `$a_breakpoints` are now `$mobile`, `$tablet`, `$desktop`, `$desktop_min`, `$all` in `aloha-vue/scss/utils/breakpoint` and no longer `!default`.

```scss
// 2.x: SCSS variables
@use "aloha-vue/scss/utils/color_utils" with (
  $a_primary: #0775b0,
  $a_border_radius: .5rem,
);
```

```css
/* 3.x: CSS custom properties, no rebuild needed */
:root {
  --a_primary_h: 201;
  --a_primary_s: 92%;
  --a_primary_l: 36%;
  --a_radius: .5rem;
}
```

### Cascade layers

All styles are in the cascade layers `aloha.reset`, `aloha.tokens`, `aloha.base`, `aloha.components`, `aloha.utilities`. **CSS** of your application without a layer always wins. Overrides that needed `!important` or a high specificity in 2.x can be simplified.

### New

- Dark theme: `data-a-theme="dark | light | auto"`.
- Density: `data-a-density="compact | comfortable"`.
- Theme for a part of the page with the class `a_theme`.
- Two-colored focus ring for keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`), tokens `--a_focus_width_inside/_outside`, `--a_focus_color_inside/_outside`.
- The icon `AIconClose` is exported.
- In browsers with `color-mix()` it is enough to override `--a_color_primary` on `:root` or `.a_theme`: hover, active and the subtle variants follow. New global tokens `--a_color_surface_translucent`, `--a_z_index_popup`, `--a_shadow_edge_left/_right`.
- New utility classes: `a_focus_ring`, `a_focus_ring_inset`, `a_text_muted`, `a_text_emphasis`, `a_opacity_*`, `a_order_*`, `a_z_index_*`, `a_print_none`, `a_print_block` (page Utilities).
- `ATable`: prop `isStriped` for striped rows (default for all tables: `ATablePlugin` `propsDefault.isStriped`); rows selected with the checkbox get the class `a_table__row_selected`.
- `ARate` is a form element now (label, help text, errors, read-only, `AForm` with `type: "rate"`), can be used with the keyboard (slider) and has new props (thresholds, colors and icons per level, texts, score, `clearable`). Old props still work and are deprecated: `rating` → `max`, `halfIcon` → `allowHalf`, `icon` → `voidIcon`, `iconFill` → `icons`, `color` → `colors`, `size="big"` → `size="large"`, `hoveredColor` → `--a_rate_hover_fill_color`. A double click no longer removes the rating, use `clearable`.
- `AInputFile`: dropzone (`isDropzone`), checks of `accept`, `maxSize` and `maxFiles` with a list of the files that were not added (event `reject`), adding files (`isAppend`), removing files (event `remove`), file size, image preview (`isPreview`), upload status per file (`progress`, `status`, `errorText` in the model) and links (`url`). The default text of the button is translated now (before always «Dateien auswählen»).

## 2. CSS variables

### Removed

- `--a_color_*_rgb` – use `hsl()` with the base tokens (example below).
- `--a_btn_focus_shadow_rgb`, `--a_btn_focus_box_shadow` → `--a_focus_ring`.
- `--a_accordion_btn_focus_border_color`.
- `--a_select_menu_link_focus_color` → `--a_focus_ring_inset`.
- `--a_table_row_focus_shadow_size`, `--a_table_row_focus_shadow_color` → `--a_table_row_focus_shadow`.
- `--a_menu_focus_shadow_color`, `--a_menu_link_focus_size`, `--a_menu_search_link_focus_size` → `--a_menu_link_focus_box_shadow`.
- `--a_tabs_focus_color`, `--a_tabs_botom_hover_color`.
- `--a_wizard_step_focus_shadow_rgb`.
- `--a_btn_box_shadow`, `--a_btn_active_shadow` – buttons have no shadow anymore.
- `--a_btn_focus_color` → `--a_focus_color_outside`.
- `--a_custom_control_radio_input_checked_border_color`, `--a_custom_control_radio_input_checked_border_width` – the radio dot is drawn by a mask, its color is `--a_custom_control_input_checked_color`.
- `--a_progress_box_shadow`, `--a_gradient` – removed without replacement.
- `--a_color_link_50` → `--a_color_primary_50`.
- `--a_accordion_transition`, `--a_dropdown_spacer`, `--a_filters_top_form_width`, `--a_filters_top_label_padding_left`, `--a_menu_btn_toggle_top`, `--a_menu_btn_toggle_margin_left`, `--a_menu_mobile_btn_toggle_margin_left`, `--a_menu_mobile_btn_toggle_margin_top`, `--a_menu_mobile_z_index`, `--a_menu_close_opacity`, `--a_menu_panel_parent_offset`, `--a_select_close_hover_color`, `--a_select_placeholder_color`, `--a_table_draggable_color`, `--a_table_mobile_row_level_icon_width`, `--a_list_group_item_first_border_radius`, `--a_list_group_item_last_border_radius` – they had no effect in 2.x either.
- `--a_tooltip_box_shadow_color` → set the whole shadow with `--a_tooltip_box_shadow`.
- `--a_menu_link_selected_bg`, `--a_menu_link_selected_color` – removed together with the unused class `.a_menu__link_selected`.

```css
/* 2.x */
background-color: rgba(var(--a_color_primary_rgb), .5);

/* 3.x */
background-color: hsl(var(--a_primary_h) var(--a_primary_s) var(--a_primary_l) / .5);
```

### Renamed

2.x  3.x

 `--a__backdrop_bg`  `--a_backdrop_bg`

 `--a__backdrop_opacity`  `--a_backdrop_opacity`

 `--a__backdrop_zindex`  `--a_backdrop_z_index`

 `--a_alert_border-radius`  `--a_alert_border_radius`

 `--a_modal_zindex`  `--a_modal_z_index`

 `--a_flegend_invalid_color`  `--a_legend_invalid_color`

 `--a_rate_empty_color`  `--a_rate_void_color`

### Changed meaning

- `--a_color_focus` is the outer color of the focus ring (dark, contrast at least 3:1). In 2.x it was a light color that was also used as a background.
- `--a_switch_hover_focus_bg` is only the hover background.

## 3. Renamed classes

Classes without the prefix `a_` and size suffixes were unified. `a_element` is also the default of the prop `class` in `AElement`, `AButton` and `ALink`.

 2.x  3.x

 `.a_form_control_lg / _sm`  `.a_form_control_large / _small`

 `.a_pagination__parent_lg / _sm`  `.a_pagination__parent_large / _small`

 `.switch_button*`  `.a_switch*`

 `.aloha_btn*`  `.a_button*`

 `.aloha_element*`  `.a_element*`

 `.aloha_group_btn_dropdown`  `.a_group_btn_dropdown`

 `.pux_datepicker*`  `.a_datepicker*`

 `.pux_datepicker_range`  `.a_datepicker_range_mode`

 `.floating`  `.a_floating`

 `.ui_select_menu`  —

 `.a_menu__link_selected`  —

 `.a_rate_container`  `.a_rate`

 `.a_rate_icon, .el-rate__item`  `.a_rate__item`

 `.a_rate_icon_small / _medium / _big`  `.a_rate_small / — / .a_rate_large`

 `.a_decimal_rate_icon, .a_rate_decimal, .a_rate_icon_decimal`  `.a_rate__icon, .a_rate__item__fill`

 `.a_rate_score`  `.a_rate__score`

 `.a_rate_label`  `.a_rate__text`

 `.a_rate_icon_align`  —

 `.a_file__label`  `.a_input_file__button`

 `.a_file__input`  `.a_input_file__input`

### Changed classes

`a_gap_x_*` now sets the horizontal gap (`column-gap`), `a_gap_y_*` the vertical gap (`row-gap`). In 2.x they were swapped. Swap `a_gap_x_*` and `a_gap_y_*` in your templates.

### Renamed SCSS files

Only relevant if you import single files from `aloha-vue/scss`.

 2.x  3.x

 `scss/utils/acordion.scss`  `scss/utils/accordion.scss`

 `scss/components/AProgressCirle.scss`  `scss/components/AProgressCircle.scss`

 `scss/components/ARate.scss`  `scss/components/ui/ARate.scss`

## 4. Close button

`.a_btn_close` no longer draws the cross as a background image. Use it with an icon. `AModal`, `AAlert` and `ADatepicker` already do this. The default close icon of all components, `AFormElementBtnClear` (`icon`) and `AAlertPlugin` (`btnCloseIcon`) changed from `x-lg` to `AIconClose`.

```javascript
import {
  AButton,
  AIconClose,
} from "aloha-vue";

h(AButton, {
  class: "a_btn_close",
  iconLeft: AIconClose,
  textScreenReader: "_CLOSE_",
});
```

## 5. Visual changes

- Form controls are 40px high (depending on density), have a stronger border (contrast at least 3:1) and the focus ring.
- Outline and transparent buttons use the darker `_text_emphasis` text color. `.a_btn_switch_active` is a selected tile (light primary background with primary border).
- Tooltip: dark neutral background instead of primary. `--a_tooltip_bg: var(--a_color_primary)` restores the old look.
- Table: a frame with rounded corners around the table (`--a_table_border_*`; `borderType="innerBordered"` has no frame), a smaller semibold header in a muted color, sortable headers look like the header text instead of links, the sorted column has the primary text color instead of a background, the sort icons of unsorted columns are faded, more space in the cells (`--a_table_cell_padding_x` 0.75rem, `--a_table_cell_padding_y` 0.625rem), digits of the same width, gray hover, a light primary background for selected rows and for the row with an open preview (also the preview below the row) with a bar on the left, a shadow at the sticky actions column, the text of an empty table is centered and muted. The focus frame is only shown for keyboard focus. Every value is a CSS variable (see «CSS variables» on the ATable page).
- Tabs: underline indicator for the active tab. Menu: light primary background for the current item.
- Checkbox, radio, switch, select, datepicker, dropdown and modal: new shapes, shadows and radii from tokens.
- Wizard: contrast fixes, the warning step has black text.

## 6. Accessibility

The components now have accessible names and valid ARIA attributes by default. If your tests or styles depend on the markup, check these changes:

- New token `--a_color__text`: the theme color with enough contrast for text on the surface (lightness limited by `--a_tone_text_min_l` / `--a_tone_text_max_l`). Error texts (`--a_form_element_error_color`, `--a_custom_control_error_color`, `--a_fieldset_invalid_color`, `--a_switch_button_invalid_color`) and the texts of active and failed wizard steps use it, so they are darker in the light theme and lighter in the dark theme.
- `AElement`, `AButton`, `ALink`: if there is only an icon and a `title`, the title is also rendered as `a_sr_only` text.
- `ADropdown`: a toggle without text and title gets the screen reader text `_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_SCREEN_READER_`.
- `ASelect`: the remove button of a selected value gets the screen reader text `_A_SELECT_REMOVE_`.
- `AProgress`, `AProgressCircle`: new prop `aria-label` (default `_A_PROGRESS_ARIA_LABEL_`).
- `ATabs`: `li.a_tabs__list__item` has `role="presentation"`.
- `AWizard`: `ul.a_wizard__steps` no longer has `role="navigation"`.
- `ADatepicker`: the input has `aria-haspopup="dialog"` and `aria-controls` (only while the calendar is open) instead of `aria-owns`.
- `ASlider`: the handle is labelled by the label (`aria-labelledby`), `aria-valuenow` is always set.
- The text of the progress bar follows the background utility class (`a_bg_warning`, `a_bg_gray_300`, …).
- `AAlert`: the props `role` and `aria-atomic` have no default any more. They are set by the new prop `announce` (`alert`, `alert-changes`, `status`, `status-changes`, `none`, default `alert`), so the default markup is the same as in 2.x (`role="alert"` `aria-atomic="true"`). `role` and `aria-atomic` set as props or attributes win over `announce`. `:aria-atomic="false"` now renders `aria-atomic="false"` instead of removing the attribute. To switch the announcement off, use `announce="none"`.

## 7. Label position

- New prop `labelPosition` with `"float"`, `"inset"` and `"top"` for `AInput`, `ATextarea`, `AInputNumber`, `AInputCurrency`, `ASelect`, `ASelectIcon`, `ASelectStyle`, `ADatepicker`, `AColorPicker` (`AMultiselectOrdered`: `selectLabelPosition`). `"inset"` is new: the label stays inside the field, small above the value.
- `isLabelFloat` is deprecated but still works: `true` → `"float"`, `false` → `"top"`. It will be removed in 4.0.
- **The default is now `"float"` for all form elements.** In 2.x `AInputNumber`, `AInputCurrency`, `ADatepicker` had the label above the field (`isLabelFloat: false`). To keep this: `label-position="top"` on the component or `labelPosition: "top"` in `AComponentsPlugin` (`props`).
- The default for all form elements is set with `AFormPlugin` (`labelPosition`).

```html
<!-- 2.x -->
<a-input label="Name" :is-label-float="true"></a-input>
<a-input label="Name" :is-label-float="false"></a-input>

<!-- 3.x -->
<a-input label="Name" label-position="float"></a-input>
<a-input label="Name" label-position="top"></a-input>
<!-- new: the label stays inside the field, small above the value -->
<a-input label="Name" label-position="inset"></a-input>

// default for all form elements ("float" if not set)
app.use(AFormPlugin, {
  labelPosition: "inset",
});

// 2.x look of AInputNumber, AInputCurrency and ADatepicker (label above the field)
app.use(AComponentsPlugin, {
  AInputNumber: { props: { labelPosition: "top" } },
  AInputCurrency: { props: { labelPosition: "top" } },
  ADatepicker: { props: { labelPosition: "top" } },
});
```

## 8. Settings of the components

- `propsDefault` and the plugins of single components were removed. All settings of the components are set with `AComponentsPlugin`, the key is the name of the component: `propsDefault` → `props`, `icons` → `icons`, `config` → `config`, `cssClasses` → `cssClasses`, `propsDefault.routes` / `excludedPathRoutes` → `ARouterLinkConfig: { routes, excludedPathRoutes }`.
- Removed plugins: `AAlertPlugin`, `AAvatarPlugin`, `ACarouselPlugin`, `ACloakPlugin`, `AFiltersPlugin`, `AGroupButtonDropdownPlugin`, `AInputCurrencyPlugin`, `AInputNumberPlugin`, `ALoadingPlugin`, `AModalPlugin`, `AMultiselectOrderedPlugin`, `ARouterLinkConfigPlugin`, `ASelectPlugin`, `ASelectStylesPlugin`, `ASkeletonPlugin`, `ASpinnerPlugin`, `ATablePlugin`. Removed exports: `AInputCurrencyPluginOptions`, `AInputNumberPluginOptions`, `AMultiselectOrderedPluginOptions`, `ARouterLinkConfigPluginOptions`, `ASelectStylePluginOptions`.
- `config` of `AFiltersPlugin` was not used by any component and was removed without replacement.
- As in 2.x, the prop defaults are shared: `AModalForm`, `AModalWizard` → `AModal`; `ASelectIcon`, `ASelectStyle` → `ASelect`; `ACalendar.firstDayOfWeek` → `ADatepicker`, `ACloak` / `ALoading` `spinnerSafeHtml`, `spinnerTag` → `ASpinner`.
- The class `a_spinner` of `ASpinner` is fixed now (`propsDefault.class`). Add own classes with the attribute `class`.
- `cssClasses` of `ASelectStyle`: in 2.x every `app.use` added the classes to the list, now the last call replaces it. Set all own classes in one call.

```javascript
// 2.x
app.use(AModalPlugin, {
  propsDefault: {
    closeButtonClass: "a_btn a_btn_link",
  },
});
app.use(ASelectPlugin, {
  propsDefault: {
    keyId: "id",
  },
});
app.use(ARouterLinkConfigPlugin, {
  propsDefault: {
    routes: router.getRoutes(),
  },
  excludedPathRoutes: ["/:catchAll(.*)"],
});
app.use(AAlertPlugin, {
  icons: {
    info: CheckLg,
  },
});
app.use(ATablePlugin, {
  propsDefault: {
    isStriped: true,
  },
});

// 3.x
app.use(AComponentsPlugin, {
  // also for AModalForm and AModalWizard
  AModal: {
    props: {
      closeButtonClass: "a_btn a_btn_link",
    },
  },
  // also for ASelectIcon and ASelectStyle
  ASelect: {
    props: {
      keyId: "id",
    },
  },
  ARouterLinkConfig: {
    routes: router.getRoutes(),
    excludedPathRoutes: ["/:catchAll(.*)"],
  },
  AAlert: {
    icons: {
      info: CheckLg,
    },
  },
  ATable: {
    props: {
      isStriped: true,
    },
  },
});
```

# Migration Guide from aloha-vue 1.2.x to 2.0.x

## 1. Removed and Renamed Components

### **AMenu2** → **AMenu**

- The `AMenu2` component has been renamed to `AMenu`
- All **CSS** classes have been renamed:

- `.a_menu_2` → `.a_menu`.
- CSS variables: `--a_menu_2_` → `--a_menu_`.

The component is now imported as follows:

```javascript
import {
  AMenu,
} from "aloha-vue";
```

### **TinyMCE**

- The **TinyMCE** component is no longer supported due to the license change of **TinyMCE** from **MIT** to **GPL-2.0-or-later**.

## 2. Style Changes

### Removed Classes

- The `.a_columns_gab_` styles have been removed (typo). Use `.a_columns_gap_` instead.

### Integration of **aloha-css**

- The styles from `aloha-css` are now integrated into `aloha-vue`.
- `aloha-css` is deprecated and will be removed in the near future.

It is recommended to include styles as follows:

```javascript
import "aloha-vue/dist/aloha-vue.css";
```

## 3. Improved Import System

All entities, such as components, directives, plugins, functions, and translations, can now be imported directly:

```javascript
import {
  ATabs,
  AMobileAPI,
  AAlertPlugin,
} from "aloha-vue";
```

## 4. Dependency Updates

Check for updates in your project to meet the new requirements.

<!-- https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/plugins/components-plugin.md -->

# AComponentsPlugin Plugin

## Introduction

`AComponentsPlugin` holds the settings of all components in one place. The key is the name of the component (for example `AModal`), the value is an object with the default values of the props (`props`) and the other settings of the component. A prop that is passed to the component always wins.

## Connection

Install the plugin before `app.mount()`:

```javascript
import { createApp } from "vue";
import App from "./App.vue";
import router from "./router";
import {
  AComponentsPlugin,
} from "aloha-vue";
import CheckLg from "aloha-svg/dist/js/bootstrap/CheckLg";

const app = createApp(App);

app.use(AComponentsPlugin, {
  // AModalForm and AModalWizard take these props too
  AModal: {
    props: {
      closeButtonClass: "a_btn a_btn_link",
      useEscape: false,
    },
  },
  AModalWizard: {
    props: {
      useEscape: true,
    },
  },
  AAlert: {
    props: {
      closable: true,
    },
    icons: {
      info: CheckLg,
    },
  },
  ASelect: {
    props: {
      keyId: "id",
      keyLabel: "name",
    },
  },
  ASelectStyle: {
    cssClasses: [
      { label: "My style", value: "my_style", group: "my", groupName: "My styles" },
    ],
  },
  ATable: {
    props: {
      isStriped: true,
    },
    config: {
      isHtmlTitleSort: true,
    },
  },
  ARouterLinkConfig: {
    routes: router.getRoutes(),
    excludedPathRoutes: ["/:catchAll(.*)"],
  },
});

app.mount("#app");
```

### Notes

- Several calls of `app.use` are merged per component: objects (`props`, `icons`, `config`) are merged, other values are replaced.
- `undefined` can be set as a default too.
- Objects and arrays are shared by all instances: do not change them in the component.
- The defaults are read when a component is created.

## Settings

 Key  Components  Description

 `props`  all  Default values of the props.

 `icons`  `AAlert` (`success`, `danger`, `info`, `warning`), `ACarousel` (`dots`, `squares`)  Icons for the types. Missing types keep the standard icon.

 `config`  `ATable` (`isHtmlTitleSort`)  Other settings of the table.

 `cssClasses`  `ASelectStyle`  Classes added to the standard classes.

 `routes`, `excludedPathRoutes`  `ARouterLinkConfig`  Routes of the router for the select of the route (only routes with a name, without the excluded paths).

 `extends`  all  Parent for the prop defaults (see below).

## Inheritance

- The prop defaults of these components fall back to the parent: `AModalForm`, `AModalWizard` → `AModal`; `ASelectIcon`, `ASelectStyle` → `ASelect`. A value of the component itself wins.
- `extends` sets the parent of an own component, `extends: null` switches the inheritance off.
- Only `props` are inherited.

## Own components

Own components read their settings with `getPropDefault(componentName, propName, defaultValue)` and `getComponentOption(componentName, key, defaultValue)`:

```javascript
import {
  getComponentOption,
  getPropDefault,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "MyDialog",
  props: {
    size: {
      type: String,
      required: false,
      default: () => getPropDefault("MyDialog", "size", "medium"),
    },
  },
  computed: {
    icons() {
      return getComponentOption("MyDialog", "icons", {});
    },
  },
};

// app.use(AComponentsPlugin, {
//   MyDialog: {
//     extends: "AModal", // the props of AModal are the defaults of MyDialog
//     props: { size: "large" },
//     icons: { close: "<svg>…</svg>" },
//   },
// });
```

<!-- https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/plugins/icons-plugin.md -->

# AIconPlugin Plugin

## Introduction

**AIconPlugin** allows you to connect a set of icons that can be used in **Aloha-Vue** components, such as **AButton** and **AIcon**. We recommend using icons from the [aloha-svg](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aloha-svg) library, which combines up-to-date **SVG** icons from various sources, such as **Bootstrap**, **Flag Icons**, and **Tabler Icons**. Icons are imported as **JavaScript** files.

## Connection

Start by connecting the plugin and icons in your project:

```javascript
import { createApp } from "vue";
import App from "./App.vue";
import "aloha-vue/dist/aloha-vue.css";
import {
  AIconPlugin,
} from "aloha-vue";
import ArrowsCollapse from "aloha-svg/dist/js/bootstrap/ArrowsCollapse";
import Bell from "aloha-svg/dist/js/bootstrap/Bell";

const app = createApp(App);

app.use(AIconPlugin, {
  icons: {
    ArrowsCollapse,
    Bell,
  },
});

app.mount("#app");
```

### Notes

- You can import icons from any library, but we recommend [aloha-svg](https://www.npmjs.com/package/aloha-svg) for convenience and up-to-date icons.
- All registered icons will be available in components that support them through the appropriate prop.

## Usage Examples

### Using in **AButton**

The **AButton** component supports icons through the **icon-left** and **icon-right** props.

```html
<template>
  <div>
    <AButton icon-left="ArrowsCollapse">
      Collapse
    </AButton>
    <AButton icon-right="Bell">
      Notifications
    </AButton>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
import { 
  AButton,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "ButtonExample",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
};
</script>
```

### Using in **AIcon**

The **AIcon** component allows you to directly use registered icons.

```html
<template>
  <div>
    <a-icon icon="ArrowsCollapse" class="icon-large"></a-icon>
    <a-icon icon="Bell" class="icon-small"></a-icon>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
import { 
  AIcon,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "IconExample",
  components: {
    AIcon,
  },
};
</script>
```

# Plugin AMobilePlugin

## Introduction

**AMobilePlugin** provides the ability to set a breakpoint for mobile device widths. This allows components like **ATable** and **AButton** to respond to screen width changes. The plugin also provides a **compositionAPI** called **AMobileAPI**, from which you can import the **ref** **isMobileWidth** and use it in your components to adapt the interface.

## Connection

To connect the plugin, add it to your project:

```javascript
import { createApp } from "vue";
import App from "./App.vue";
import {
  AMobilePlugin,
} from "aloha-vue";

const app = createApp(App);

app.use(AMobilePlugin, {
  breakpoint: 1023,
});

app.mount("#app");
```

### Notes

- The breakpoint value **breakpoint** is set in pixels and defines the maximum screen width for mobile devices.
- The plugin works in conjunction with **aloha-vue** components that support mobile adaptation.

## Example of using **AMobilePlugin**

```html
<template>
  <div>
    <p v-if="isMobileWidth">You are using a mobile device.</p>
    <p v-else>You are using a desktop device.</p>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
import {
  AMobileAPI,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  setup() {
    const {
      isMobileWidth,
    } = AMobileAPI;
    
    return {
      isMobileWidth,
    };
  },
};
</script>
```

<!-- https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/plugins/page-tab-title-plugin.md -->

# Plugin APageTabTitlePlugin

## Introduction

**APageTabTitlePlugin** is used to set a base title **baseTitle** for the **<title>** tag in your project. The base part of the title (e.g., the application name) is set once via the plugin and will automatically be appended at the end of each page title. The unique part of the title, specific to each page, is set using the **APageTabTitle** component via the **title** prop.

## Connection

To connect the plugin, add it to your project:

```javascript
import { createApp } from "vue";
import App from "./App.vue";
import {
  APageTabTitlePlugin,
} from "aloha-vue";

const app = createApp(App);

app.use(APageTabTitlePlugin, "Documentation aloha-vue");

app.mount("#app");
```

### Notes

- The base title **baseTitle** is set during plugin initialization and remains unchanged for the entire application.
- The unique title for each page is added using the **APageTabTitle** component.

## Example of using the **APageTabTitle** component

The **APageTabTitle** component allows you to set the unique part of the title for each page.

```html
<template>
  <div>
    <a-page-tab-title title="Home Page"></a-page-tab-title>
    <h1>Welcome!</h1>
    <p>This is a demo page.</p>
  </div>
</template>

<script>
import { 
  APageTabTitle,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "HomePage",
  components: {
    APageTabTitle,
  },
};
</script>
```

In this example, the full page title will be: **"Home Page - Documentation aloha-vue"**.

## Closable

The parameter **:closable="true"** adds a close function for the component.

*props: `closable`; emits: `close`*

```html
<div>
  <a-button
    v-if="!isAlertVisible"
    text="_A_ALERT_GROUP_CLOSABLE_FROM_OUTSIDE_SHOW_ALERT_"
    @click="showAlert"
  >
  </a-button>
</div>
<a-alert 
  html="Alert success"
  :is-visible="isAlertVisible"
  type="success"
  :closable="true"
  @close="hideAlert"
>
</a-alert>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AAlert,
  AButton,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageAlertClosable",
  components: {
    AAlert,
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const isAlertVisible = ref(true);

    const showAlert = () => {
      isAlertVisible.value = true;
    };

    const hideAlert = () => {
      isAlertVisible.value = false;
    };
    
    return {
      hideAlert,
      isAlertVisible,
      showAlert,
    };
  },
};
```

## Screen reader announcement

The prop `announce` sets how the alert is announced when it appears. Click the button: with a screen reader the red alert is read at once, the green one after the current sentence, the blue one not at all. The live region is always in the page, only the content appears, so the announcement also works when the alert is shown later.

*props: `announce`, `role`, `aria-atomic`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  :text="isAlertVisible ? '_A_ALERT_GROUP_ANNOUNCE_BTN_HIDE_' : '_A_ALERT_GROUP_ANNOUNCE_BTN_SHOW_'"
  @click="toggleAlerts"
/>

<!-- default announce="alert": role="alert" aria-atomic="true" -->
<a-alert
  :is-visible="isAlertVisible"
  type="danger"
  text="_A_ALERT_GROUP_ANNOUNCE_TEXT_ALERT_"
/>

<!-- role="status" aria-atomic="true" -->
<a-alert
  :is-visible="isAlertVisible"
  announce="status"
  type="success"
  text="_A_ALERT_GROUP_ANNOUNCE_TEXT_STATUS_"
/>

<!-- no role and no aria-atomic -->
<a-alert
  :is-visible="isAlertVisible"
  announce="none"
  type="info"
  text="_A_ALERT_GROUP_ANNOUNCE_TEXT_NONE_"
/>

<!-- role and aria-atomic win over announce: role="status" aria-atomic="false" -->
<a-alert
  :is-visible="isAlertVisible"
  announce="alert"
  role="status"
  :aria-atomic="false"
  text="..."
/>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AAlert,
  AButton,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AAlert,
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const isAlertVisible = ref(false);

    const toggleAlerts = () => {
      isAlertVisible.value = !isAlertVisible.value;
    };

    return {
      isAlertVisible,
      toggleAlerts,
    };
  },
};
```

## AAlert component with customizable close button

The AAlert component allows the developer to customize various aspects of the notification, including the close button. By using the "btnCloseAttributes" prop, the properties of the close button can be changed.

*props: `btn-close-attributes`, `closable`*

```html
<a-alert 
  text="Aloha"
  :is-visible="true"
  type="success"
  :btn-close-attributes="{ class: 'a_btn_close a_fs_3' }"
  :closable="true"
></a-alert>
```

## Exposes: Public Properties

*exposes: `close`, `isHidden`*

```html
<div
  class="a_btn_group"
>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_primary"
    text="_A_ALERT_GROUP_EXPOSES_BTN_CLOSE_"
    @click="closeAlert"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_primary"
    text="_A_ALERT_GROUP_EXPOSES_BTN_SHOW_"
    @click="showAlert"
  ></a-button>
</div>
<a-alert 
  ref="alertRef"
  alert-class="a_mt_3"
  html="Alert success"
  :is-visible="true"
  type="success"
  :closable="true"
  :remove-alert-on-close="true"
>
</a-alert>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AAlert,
  AButton,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageAlertExposes",
  components: {
    AAlert,
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const alertRef = ref(undefined);

    const closeAlert = () => {
      alertRef.value.close();
    };

    const showAlert = () => {
      alertRef.value.isHidden = false;
    };
    
    return {
      closeAlert,
      showAlert,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| alert-class | String / Object |  |  | Additional CSS class |
| alert-content-class | String / Object |  |  | Additional CSS class for content |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| announce | String | alert |  | How a screen reader announces the alert when it appears: `alert`, `alert-changes`, `status`, `status-changes`, `none`. `alert` reads it at once (`role="alert"`), `status` after the current sentence (`role="status"`). Without the suffix the whole alert is read (`aria-atomic="true"`), with `-changes` only the changed part (`aria-atomic="false"`). `none` sets neither. The props or attributes `role` and `aria-atomic` win over `announce`. |
| aria-atomic | Boolean / String |  |  | Whether a screen reader reads the whole alert (`true`) or only the changed part (`false`) when the content changes. Without a value it is set by `announce`; a value wins over `announce`. |
| btn-close-attributes | Object | {} |  | An object that defines the properties of the close button. |
| btn-close-icon | String | XLg |  | Icon of the close button. |
| closable | Boolean | false |  | Whether alert can be dismissed |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| html | String |  |  | HTML to be shown inside the component |
| icon | String |  |  | Icon. Any icon available for the **AIcon** component can be used |
| icon-class | String |  |  | Additional CSS class for the icon |
| is-visible | Boolean | false |  | Whether the component is shown |
| removeAlertOnClose | Boolean | false |  | Controlling the closure of an alert from outside a component |
| role | String |  |  | ARIA role of the live region, e.g. `alert` or `status`. Without a value it is set by `announce`; a value wins over `announce`. |
| safe-html | String |  |  | Safe HTML to be shown inside the component |
| show-icon | Boolean | false |  | Whether a type icon is displayed |
| text | String |  |  | Plain Text to be shown inside the component |
| text-close | String | _A_ALERT_CLOSE_ |  | The text for the close button to be read by the screen reader |
| type | String | danger |  | Alert type |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Content of the alert |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| close | Function | Trigger when alert is closed |

## Exposes

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| close | Function | Function: close alert |
| isHidden | Boolean | Is the alert closed? |

## CSS variables (`scss/utils/alert.scss`)

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--a_alert_bg` |  | Background. Set by the color classes (e.g. .a_alert_danger). |
| `--a_alert_padding_x` |  | Horizontal padding. A closable alert has three times this padding on the right for the close button. |
| `--a_alert_padding_y` |  | Vertical padding. |
| `--a_alert_margin_bottom` |  | Space below the alert. |
| `--a_alert_color` |  | Text color. Set by the color classes. |
| `--a_alert_border_color` |  | Border color. Set by the color classes. |
| `--a_alert_border` |  | Border shorthand (width, style, color). |
| `--a_alert_border_radius` |  | Corner radius. |
| `--a_alert_icon_size` |  | Size of the icon. |
| `--a_alert_icon_margin_right` |  | Space between the icon and the text. |
| `--a_alert_text_align` |  | Text alignment. |
| `--a_alert_link_color` |  | Color of a link inside the alert (.a_alert__link). Set by the color classes. |

<!-- https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/avatar.md -->

# AAvatar (Avatar)

The **AAvatar** component shows a person or an organization as a picture, as initials or as an icon. Screen readers read the name and the status.

## Basic usage

From `name` the initials and the color are made. The same name gets always the same color. Without a name an icon is shown.

*props: `name`*

```html
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="Ben Ott"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="Clara Maria Lenz"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="Мария Иванова"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar></a-avatar>
```

## Image

`src` shows an image. If it cannot be loaded, the initials are shown and the event `error` is emitted.

*props: `src`, `alt`*

```html
<a-avatar
  name="Tennis Club"
  src="./assets/Tennis_ball_purple_background.png"
></a-avatar>
<!-- the image is not found: the initials are shown -->
<a-avatar
  name="Tennis Club"
  src="./assets/not-found.png"
></a-avatar>
```

## Sizes

`size`: **small**, **medium**, **large**, **xlarge** or a number in pixels.

*props: `size`*

```html
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker" size="small"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker" size="medium"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker" size="large"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker" size="xlarge"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker" :size="96"></a-avatar>
```

## Shape

`shape="square"` with rounded corners suits organizations and projects.

*props: `shape`*

```html
<a-avatar
  name="Aloha GmbH"
  shape="square"
></a-avatar>
<a-avatar
  name="Tennis Club"
  shape="square"
  size="large"
  src="./assets/Tennis_ball_purple_background.png"
></a-avatar>
```

## Colors

By default `color="auto"` chooses the color by the name. A fixed color is set with `color`. The text has enough contrast in the light and the dark theme.

*props: `color`*

```html
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker"></a-avatar> <!-- color="auto" -->
<a-avatar name="gray" color="gray"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="primary" color="primary"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="secondary" color="secondary"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="tertiary" color="tertiary"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="success" color="success"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="info" color="info"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="warning" color="warning"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="danger" color="danger"></a-avatar>
```

## Status

`status`: **online**, **away**, **busy**, **offline**. The status is part of the accessible name, so it is not shown only by color. `statusText` replaces its text.

*props: `status`, `statusText`*

```html
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker" status="online"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker" status="away"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker" status="busy"></a-avatar>
<a-avatar name="Anna Becker" status="offline"></a-avatar>
```

## Avatar next to the name

If the name is written next to the avatar, set `decorative`. The avatar is then hidden from screen readers and the name is not read twice.

*props: `decorative`*

```html
<ul class="a_list_without_styles">
  <li class="a_d_flex a_gap_2 a_align_items_center">
    <a-avatar
      name="Anna Becker"
      :decorative="true"
      size="small"
    ></a-avatar>
    <span>Anna Becker</span>
  </li>
</ul>
```

## Own content

`initials` replaces the initials, the default slot replaces the whole content. `icon` sets another icon for an avatar without a name.

*props: `initials`, `initialsLimit`, `icon`*

```html
<a-avatar
  name="Assistant"
  initials="AI"
  color="tertiary"
></a-avatar>
<a-avatar
  alt="Home"
  icon="House"
></a-avatar>
<a-avatar
  name="Favorites"
  color="warning"
>
  <a-icon icon="StarFill"></a-icon>
</a-avatar>
```

## Group

**AAvatarGroup** shows the avatars overlapping. With `max` the rest is shown as **+N**. `size` and `shape` apply to all avatars of the group.

*props: `max`, `label`, `size`, `shape`*

```html
<a-avatar-group
  label="Team"
  :max="4"
>
  <a-avatar
    v-for="name in names"
    :key="name"
    :name="name"
  ></a-avatar>
</a-avatar-group>

<a-avatar-group
  label="Team"
  size="small"
>
  <a-avatar name="Anna Becker"></a-avatar>
  <a-avatar name="Ben Ott"></a-avatar>
  <a-avatar name="Clara Lenz"></a-avatar>
  <a-avatar
    name="Tennis Club"
    src="./assets/Tennis_ball_purple_background.png"
  ></a-avatar>
</a-avatar-group>
```

## AAvatar

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| alt | String | undefined |  | Accessible name of the avatar instead of the name. |
| color | String | "auto" |  | auto (by the name), gray, primary, secondary, tertiary, success, info, warning or danger. |
| decorative | Boolean | false |  | Hides the avatar from screen readers, e.g. if the name is written next to it. |
| icon | String \| Object | undefined |  | Icon for an avatar without a name and without an image. |
| initials | String | undefined |  | Own initials instead of the initials of the name. |
| initialsLimit | Number | 2 |  | Maximum number of initials (see filterInitials). |
| name | String | undefined |  | Name of the person or organization: accessible name, initials and color. |
| shape | String | "circle" |  | circle or square. |
| size | String \| Number | "medium" |  | small, medium, large, xlarge or a number in pixels. |
| src | String | undefined |  | URL of the image. |
| status | String | undefined |  | online, away, busy or offline. |
| statusText | String | undefined |  | Own text of the status for screen readers. |
| tag | String | "span" |  | HTML tag of the avatar. |

## AAvatarGroup

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| label | String | undefined |  | Accessible name of the group. |
| max | Number | undefined |  | Maximum number of shown avatars; the rest is shown as +N. |
| moreText | String | "_A_AVATAR_GROUP_MORE_{{count}}_" |  | Accessible name of the +N avatar. |
| shape | String | undefined |  | Shape of all avatars of the group. |
| size | String \| Number | undefined |  | Size of all avatars of the group. |
| tag | String | "div" |  | HTML tag of the group. |

## Events

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| error | The image could not be loaded. Gets **{ $event, src }**. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Own content instead of the image, the initials or the icon. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_AVATAR_ARIA_LABEL_` | Avatar |
| `_A_AVATAR_STATUS_ONLINE_` | online |
| `_A_AVATAR_STATUS_AWAY_` | away |
| `_A_AVATAR_STATUS_BUSY_` | do not disturb |
| `_A_AVATAR_STATUS_OFFLINE_` | offline |
| `_A_AVATAR_GROUP_MORE_{{count}}_` | {{count}} more |

## CSS variables (`scss/components/AAvatar.scss`)

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--a_avatar_size` |  | Size of an avatar (size "medium"). |
| `--a_avatar_size_small` |  | Size of an avatar for size "small". |
| `--a_avatar_size_large` |  | Size of an avatar for size "large". |
| `--a_avatar_size_xlarge` |  | Size of an avatar for size "xlarge". |
| `--a_avatar_square_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of an avatar with shape "square". |
| `--a_avatar_bg` |  | Background of an avatar (set by the prop color). |
| `--a_avatar_color` |  | Color of the initials and of the icon (set by the prop color). |
| `--a_avatar_image_bg` |  | Background behind an image (visible while it loads). |
| `--a_avatar_font_scale` |  | Font size of the initials relative to the size of the avatar. |
| `--a_avatar_font_weight` |  | Font weight of the initials. |
| `--a_avatar_icon_scale` |  | Size of the icon relative to the size of the avatar. |
| `--a_avatar_status_size` |  | Size of the status dot. |
| `--a_avatar_status_ring_width` |  | Width of the ring around the status dot. |
| `--a_avatar_status_online_color` |  | Color of the status "online". |
| `--a_avatar_status_away_color` |  | Color of the status "away". |
| `--a_avatar_status_busy_color` |  | Color of the status "busy". |
| `--a_avatar_status_offline_color` |  | Color of the status "offline". |
| `--a_avatar_ring_color` |  | Color of the rings of the status dot and of the avatars in a group. |
| `--a_avatar_group_overlap` |  | How far the avatars of a group overlap, relative to their size. |
| `--a_avatar_group_ring_width` |  | Width of the ring around the avatars of a group. |
| `--a_avatar_group_more_font_scale` |  | Font size of the "+N" avatar relative to its size. |

<!-- https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/button.md -->

# AButton (Button)

The **AButton** component is a versatile button with extensive customization options via props. It integrates with [AElement](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/element.md) for rendering and allows customization of accessibility, classes, identifiers, loading states, and other parameters. It supports customization of appearance, text, icons, and event handling such as clicks, making it a powerful tool for UI design.

## Basic usage

There are many CSS classes that you can use with the button.

*props: `class`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_link"
    text="link"
    @click="onAlert('link')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    text="primary"
    @click="onAlert('primary')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
    text="secondary"
    @click="onAlert('secondary')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_tertiary"
    text="tertiary"
    @click="onAlert('tertiary')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_success"
    text="success"
    @click="onAlert('success')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_info"
    text="info"
    @click="onAlert('info')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_warning"
    text="warning"
    @click="onAlert('warning')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_danger"
    text="danger"
    @click="onAlert('danger')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_dark"
    text="dark"
    @click="onAlert('dark')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_light"
    text="light"
    @click="onAlert('light')"
  ></a-button>
</div>
```

```js
import { 
  AButton,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageButtonBasic",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const onAlert = type => {
      alert(type);
    };
    
     return {
      onAlert,
    };
  },
};
```

## Outline Buttons

```html
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_primary"
    text="outline-primary"
    @click="onAlert('outline-primary')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_secondary"
    text="outline-secondary"
    @click="onAlert('outline-secondary')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_tertiary"
    text="outline-tertiary"
    @click="onAlert('outline-tertiary')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_success"
    text="outline-success"
    @click="onAlert('outline-success')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_info"
    text="outline-info"
    @click="onAlert('outline-info')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_warning"
    text="outline-warning"
    @click="onAlert('outline-warning')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_danger"
    text="outline-danger"
    @click="onAlert('outline-danger')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_dark"
    text="outline-dark"
    @click="onAlert('outline-dark')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_light"
    text="outline-light"
    @click="onAlert('outline-light')"
  ></a-button>
</div>
```

```js
  AButton,
} from "aloha-vue";
```

## Button group size

Instead of applying button size classes to each button within a group, simply add .a_btn_group_large or .a_btn_group_small to each .a_btn_group, including any nested ones if you have multiple levels of nesting.

```html
    class="a_btn_group a_btn_group_large"

      class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
      text="primary"
      @click="onAlert('primary')"
    ></a-button>
    <a-button
      class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
      text="secondary"
      @click="onAlert('secondary')"
    ></a-button>
    <a-button
      class="a_btn a_btn_success"
      text="success"
      @click="onAlert('success')"
    ></a-button>

      class="a_btn a_btn_info"
      text="info"
      @click="onAlert('info')"
    ></a-button>
  </div>

    class="a_btn_group a_btn_group_small"
    role="group"
  >
    <a-button
      class="a_btn a_btn_outline_primary"
      text="outline-primary"
      @click="onAlert('outline-primary')"
    ></a-button>
    <a-button
      class="a_btn a_btn_outline_secondary"
      text="outline-secondary"
      @click="onAlert('outline-secondary')"
```

## Using icon props

The AButton component allows you to display icons on the left and right side of the button by using the ":icon-left" and ":icon-right" props. You can define different icons for different devices to achieve a customizable display.

*props: `icon-left`, `icon-right`*

```html

  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>

    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    icon-left="Upload"
    title="Upload"
    @click="onAlert('icon-left')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    icon-left="Upload"
    text="Aloha"
    @click="onAlert('icon-left & text')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    icon-right="Upload"
    text="Aloha"
    @click="onAlert('icon-right & text')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    icon-left="Upload"
    icon-right="Upload"
    text="Aloha"
    @click="onAlert('icon-left & text & icon-right')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    icon-left="Upload"
    icon-right="Upload"
    title="Upload"
    @click="onAlert('icon-left & icon-right')"
  ></a-button>
</div>
```

## Button with loading state and loading indicator alignment

The AButton component allows you to display the button with a loading state and a loading indicator. You can also set the alignment of the loading indicator. This can be useful to indicate that a specific operation is running in the background and the user needs to wait for completion.

*props: `loading`, `loading-align`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    :loading="loading"
    loading-align="left"
    text="loading-align="left""
    @click="toggleLoading"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    :loading="loading"
    loading-align="right"
    text="loading-align="right""
    @click="toggleLoading"
  ></a-button>
</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AButton,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageButtonLoading",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const loading = ref(true);

    const toggleLoading = () => {
      loading.value = !loading.value;
    };
    
    return {
      loading,
      toggleLoading,
    };
  },
};
```

## Additional Text Inside the Button

The AButton component allows you to display additional text inside the button. This can be useful for adding predefined text before or after the actual button text.

*props: `text-after`, `text-before`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_SHOW_MORE_MORE_"
  text-after=" €"
  text-before="$ "
></a-button>
```

## Changing the text tag in the "AButton" component

This example shows how to customize the text tag in the "AButton" component in Vue.js. By default, the text is rendered in a "span" tag. However, by using the "text-tag" prop, the text tag can be flexibly customized to use different HTML tags like "strong", "em" or others.

*props: `text-tag`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
  text="Aloha"
  text-tag="strong"
></a-button>
```

## Using Safe HTML Content as a String inside the Button

The AButton component allows you to use safe HTML content as a string inside the button. By enabling the "safe-html" prop and passing an HTML string, the provided HTML content is treated as trusted and directly inserted via the JavaScript "innerHTML" attribute.

*props: `safe-html`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    safe-html="_A_BUTTON_EXAMPLE_HTML_"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    safe-html="<span onclick='alert("Aloha")'>Aloha</button>"
  ></a-button>
</div>
```

## Safely displaying HTML content using DomPurify

The AButton component allows you to safely display HTML content without fully trusting it. By using the "html" prop and the DomPurify library, the provided HTML content is sanitized and securely rendered in the button.

*props: `html`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    html="_A_BUTTON_EXAMPLE_HTML_"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    html="<span onclick='alert("Aloha")'>Aloha</span>"
  ></a-button>
</div>
```

## Customizable Text for Different Devices

The AButton component allows you to customize the button's text for different devices. By using the ":text" prop as an object, you can define different text for mobile and desktop devices.

*props: `text (as object)`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  :text="{ mobile: 'Aloha', desktop: 'Aloha-desktop' }"
></a-button>
```

## Concatenating Titles in a Prop

The AButton component allows you to concatenate multiple titles in a prop. By using the ":title" prop as an array, you can specify multiple elements that will be merged into a single title for the button.

*props: `title (as array)`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  :title="['Aloha', '$(Aloha)']"
  text="Aloha"
></a-button>
```

## Displaying HTML Title and Title Placement

The AButton component allows you to display the title as HTML and control the title placement. By using the ":is-title-html", ":title", and ":title-placement" props, you can use HTML titles and set the positioning of the title.

*props: `is-title-html`, `title`, `title-placement`, `title-attributes`*

```html

  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"

    :is-title-html="true"

    text="placement: top"
    title-placement="top"
    title="_A_BUTTON_EXAMPLE_BIG_TITLE_"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    :is-title-html="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_success"
    text="placement: auto"
    title-placement="auto"
    title="_A_BUTTON_EXAMPLE_BIG_TITLE_"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    :is-title-html="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_success"
    text="placement: auto-start"
    title-placement="auto-start"
    title="_A_BUTTON_EXAMPLE_BIG_TITLE_"
  ></a-button>

    :is-title-html="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_success"
    text="placement: auto-end"

    :is-title-html="true"

    title-placement="left-start"
    title="_A_BUTTON_EXAMPLE_BIG_TITLE_"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    :is-title-html="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_success"
    text="placement: left-end"
    title-placement="left-end"
    title="_A_BUTTON_EXAMPLE_BIG_TITLE_"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    :is-title-html="true"
    :title-attributes="{ maxWidth: 150 }"
    class="a_btn a_btn_success"
    text="placement: auto, html-title max-width 150"
    title-placement="auto"
    title="_A_BUTTON_EXAMPLE_BIG_TITLE_"
  ></a-button>
</div>
```

## In the example below, the title is displayed as translated text with a parameter. The number parameter is passed via the extra attribute.

Display of HTML titles with translation and parameters

*props: `is-title-html`, `title`, `extra`*

```html
<a-button
  :extra="{ number: 2 }"
  :is-title-html="true"
  class="a_btn a_btn_success"
  text="extra"
  title="_A_BUTTON_EXAMPLE_BIG_TITLE_{{number}}_"
></a-button>
```

## Using the "stop" prop to stop event propagation

Setting the "stop" prop to a boolean value can be used to control whether the event should be propagated or not. The example shows two different scenarios: one with "stop" set to "true" and one set to "false".

*props: `stop`*

```html
<div
  @click="showAlert"
>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    text="stopPropagation: :stop=\"true\""
    :stop="true"
  ></a-button>
</div>
<div
  class="a_mt_4"
  @click="showAlert"
>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    text="stopPropagation: :stop=\"false\""
    :stop="false"
  ></a-button>
</div>
```

```js
import { 
  AButton,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageButtonStop",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const showAlert = () => {
      alert("Aloha");
    };

    return {
      showAlert,
    };
  },
};
```

## Using the Default Slot

The AButton component allows you to place custom content inside the button by using the default slot ":slots='default'". The content placed in the slot will be shown inside the button.

*slots: `default`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
>
  <span>(Aloha)</span>
</a-button>
```

## Using the "buttonPrepend" Slot

The AButton component allows you to display additional content before the text inside the button by using the "buttonPrepend" slot. The content placed in the slot will be shown before the text inside the button.

*slots: `buttonPrepend`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="Aloha"
>
  <template
    v-slot:buttonPrepend
  >
    <span>(***)</span>
  </template>
</a-button>
```

## Using the "buttonAppend" Slot

The AButton component allows you to display additional content after the text inside the button by using the "buttonAppend" slot. The content placed in the slot will be shown after the text inside the button.

*slots: `buttonAppend`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="Aloha"
>
  <template
    v-slot:buttonAppend
  >
    <span>(***)</span>
  </template>
</a-button>
```

## Using the "buttonTitle" Slot for HTML Title

The AButton component allows you to define custom HTML content for the button's title by using the "buttonTitle" slot along with the ":is-title-html" prop. The content placed in the slot will be used as an HTML title for the button.

*props: `is-title-html`; slots: `buttonTitle`*

```html
<a-button
  :is-title-html="true"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="Aloha"
>
  <template
    v-slot:buttonTitle
  >
    <strong>(***Aloha***)</strong>
  </template>
</a-button>
```

## Using Button Switch Mode

The AButton component allows you to use the button as a button switch, with two states (active/inactive). By using the ":is-switch" and ":model-switch" props, you can enable the button switch and control the state. The button is rendered as a "button" element with the "aria-pressed" attribute to indicate the state.

*props: `is-switch`, `model-switch`*

```html
<a-button
  :is-switch="true"
  :model-switch="modelSwitch"
  text="(***)"
  @click="toggleModelSwitch"
></a-button>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AButton,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageButtonSwitch",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const modelSwitch = ref(false);

    const toggleModelSwitch = () => {
      modelSwitch.value = !modelSwitch.value;
    };

    return {
      modelSwitch,
      toggleModelSwitch,
    };
  },
};
```

## Using complex props and events

The AButton component allows you to use various complex props and events to customize and control the button with advanced functionality. In the following example, multiple props and an event are used to configure the button and control the loading state.

*props: `class`, `loading`, `loading-align`, `text`, `text-before`, `icon-left`, `icon-right`, `title`, `text-aria-hidden`, `text-screen-reader`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  :icon-left="{ desktop: 'EyeFill', mobile: 'EyeSlash' }"
  :icon-right="{ mobile: 'EyeSlash' }"
  :loading="loading"
  :text-aria-hidden="true"
  :text-before="{ desktop: '$ ' }"
  :text-screen-reader="{ desktop: 'Aloha', mobile: 'Aloha-mobile' }"
  :text="{ desktop: 'Aloha' }"
  :title="{ desktop: 'Aloha' }"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  loading-align="left"
  @click="toggleLoading"
></a-button>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AButton,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageButtonComplex",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const loading = ref(true);

    const toggleLoading = () => {
      loading.value = !loading.value;
    };
    
    return {
      loading,
      toggleLoading,
    };
  },
};
```
