# ACalendar (Calendar)

The **ACalendar** component shows a month, a week or a day with events, like Outlook. Events can last several days and have a color. The names of the months and weekdays come from the current language. The component does not create events: open your own form on the events `day-click` and `time-click`. On paper the buttons are hidden and the whole day is printed.

## Basic usage

`events` is an array of objects with `label`, `start` and `end`. `v-model` is the selected day as `"YYYY-MM-DD"`. The arrow keys move between the days, **Page Up** and **Page Down** change the month.

*props: `events`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-calendar
  v-model="model"
  :events="events"
/>
<p>
  <a-translation
    tag="strong"
    text="_A_CALENDAR_SELECTED_"
  />: {{ model }}
</p>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACalendar,
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ACalendar,
    ATranslation,
  },
  setup() {
    const events = ref([
      { id: 1, label: "Team meeting", start: "2026-03-03T10:00:00", end: "2026-03-03T11:00:00", color: "primary" },
      { id: 2, label: "Vacation", start: "2026-03-08", end: "2026-03-14", color: "success", isAllDay: true },
      { id: 3, label: "Workshop", start: "2026-03-12T09:00:00", end: "2026-03-13T17:00:00", color: "info" },
      { id: 4, label: "Birthday", start: "2026-03-20", color: "#8e44ad", isAllDay: true },
    ]);
    const model = ref(undefined);

    return {
      events,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Multi-day events and colors

An event from `start` to `end` is a bar over several days and continues in the next week or month. `end` is the last day of the event. `color` is a color of the theme (**primary**, **secondary**, **tertiary**, **success**, **info**, **warning**, **danger**, **gray**) or any CSS color. Events with `isAllDay` have no time. `max-events-per-day="0"` shows all events.

*props: `max-events-per-day`, `color-default`*

```html
<a-calendar
  :events="events"
  :max-events-per-day="0"
/>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACalendar,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ACalendar,
  },
  setup() {
    const events = ref([
      // color: a color of the theme
      { id: 1, label: "Vacation", start: "2026-03-08", end: "2026-03-14", color: "success", isAllDay: true },
      // no color: colorDefault ("primary")
      { id: 2, label: "Workshop", start: "2026-03-12T09:00:00", end: "2026-03-13T17:00:00" },
      // any CSS color
      { id: 3, label: "Birthday", start: "2026-03-20", color: "#8e44ad", isAllDay: true },
      // continues in the next month
      { id: 4, label: "Conference", start: "2026-03-26", end: "2026-04-02", color: "tertiary", isAllDay: true },
    ]);

    return {
      events,
    };
  },
};
```

## Recurring events

`recurrence` makes an event a series: `{ frequency, interval, weekdays, until, count, exceptions }`. `frequency` is **daily**, **weekly**, **monthly** or **yearly**, `interval` repeats every n-th time, `weekdays` (0 is Sunday) sets the days of a weekly series. A series ends with `until` (the last day) or after `count` occurrences, `exceptions` are skipped days. The occurrences have the sign ↻. `event-click`, `event-drop` and `event-resize` get the item of the series and `occurrence`: the parent decides whether the series or only this occurrence changes.

*props: `key-recurrence`*

```html
<a-calendar
  :events="events"
  @event-click="onEventClick"
/>
<p v-if="lastClick">
  <a-translation
    tag="strong"
    text="_A_CALENDAR_REC_CLICK_"
  />: {{ lastClick }}
</p>
```

```js
// PageCalendarRecurring.js
import {
  ACalendar,
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";

import RecurringAPI from "./compositionAPI/RecurringAPI";

export default {
  components: {
    ACalendar,
    ATranslation,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      events,
      lastClick,
      onEventClick,
    } = RecurringAPI({
      events: [
        // Monday to Friday, not on the 12th
        { id: 1, label: "Standup", start: "2026-03-02T09:00:00", end: "2026-03-02T09:15:00", color: "info", recurrence: { frequency: "weekly", weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], exceptions: ["2026-03-12"] } },
        // Every second week
        { id: 2, label: "Team meeting", start: "2026-03-05T14:00:00", end: "2026-03-05T15:00:00", color: "primary", recurrence: { frequency: "weekly", interval: 2 } },
        // Every month, six times
        { id: 3, label: "Report", start: "2026-03-15", color: "warning", isAllDay: true, recurrence: { frequency: "monthly", count: 6 } },
        // Every year
        { id: 4, label: "Birthday", start: "2026-03-20", color: "#8e44ad", isAllDay: true, recurrence: { frequency: "yearly" } },
      ],
    });

    return {
      events,
      lastClick,
      onEventClick,
    };
  },
};

// compositionAPI/RecurringAPI.js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

export default function RecurringAPI({ events: eventsStart = [] }) {
  const events = ref(eventsStart);
  const lastClick = ref("");

  // The calendar sends the item of the series and the clicked occurrence
  const onEventClick = ({ event, occurrence }) => {
    lastClick.value = `${ event.label }: ${ occurrence ? occurrence.date : "-" }`;
  };

  return {
    events,
    lastClick,
    onEventClick,
  };
}
```

## Week view

`view="week"` shows a week with the hours, the buttons **Month**, **Week** and **Day** switch the view (`v-model:view`). Events with a time lie in the time grid, overlapping events share the width of the day. All-day events and events over several days are bars above the hours. `hourStart` and `hourEnd` limit the hours, `scrollToHour` is the hour visible at the top. `maxEventsPerDay` limits the all-day row too, the others are counted in "+N".

*props: `view`, `views`, `hour-start`, `hour-end`, `scroll-to-hour`, `time-step`*

```html
<a-calendar
  v-model="model"
  v-model:view="view"
  :events="events"
  :hour-start="6"
  :hour-end="22"
/>
<p>
  <a-translation
    tag="strong"
    text="_A_CALENDAR_VIEW_"
  />: {{ view }}
</p>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACalendar,
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ACalendar,
    ATranslation,
  },
  setup() {
    const events = ref([
      // all day and over several days: in the row above the hours
      { id: 1, label: "Vacation", start: "2026-03-08", end: "2026-03-14", color: "success", isAllDay: true },
      { id: 2, label: "Workshop", start: "2026-03-12T09:00:00", end: "2026-03-13T17:00:00", color: "info" },
      // with a time: in the time grid, overlapping events share the width of the day
      { id: 3, label: "Lunch", start: "2026-03-11T12:00:00", end: "2026-03-11T13:00:00", color: "success" },
      { id: 4, label: "Customer call", start: "2026-03-11T12:30:00", end: "2026-03-11T13:30:00", color: "info" },
      { id: 5, label: "Planning", start: "2026-03-11T12:45:00", end: "2026-03-11T14:00:00", color: "#8e44ad" },
    ]);
    const model = ref("2026-03-11");
    const view = ref("week");

    return {
      events,
      model,
      view,
    };
  },
};
```

## Work week and calendar weeks

`view="workweek"` shows the days of `workWeekDays` (Monday to Friday by default) with the hours, the arrow keys jump over the other days. `isWeekNumbers` shows the calendar week (ISO 8601). `workingHours` shades the hours outside the working hours and the days outside the work week.

*props: `work-week-days`, `is-week-numbers`, `working-hours`*

```html
<a-calendar
  v-model="model"
  view="workweek"
  :views="['month', 'workweek']"
  :events="events"
  :is-week-numbers="true"
  :working-hours="{ start: 8, end: 18 }"
/>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACalendar,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ACalendar,
  },
  setup() {
    const events = ref([
      { id: 1, label: "Team meeting", start: "2026-03-10T10:00:00", end: "2026-03-10T11:00:00", location: "Room 3" },
      { id: 2, label: "Workshop", start: "2026-03-12T09:00:00", end: "2026-03-13T17:00:00", color: "info" },
    ]);
    const model = ref("2026-03-11");

    return {
      events,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Day view

`view="day"` shows one day with the hours, like the week view. The buttons change the day, the arrow keys too. `views` sets the views of the switch, here only **Day** and **Week**.

*props: `view`, `views`*

```html
<a-calendar
  v-model="model"
  v-model:view="view"
  :events="events"
  :views="['day', 'week']"
  :hour-start="7"
  :hour-end="20"
/>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACalendar,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ACalendar,
  },
  setup() {
    const events = ref([
      { id: 1, label: "Lunch", start: "2026-03-11T12:00:00", end: "2026-03-11T13:00:00", color: "success" },
      { id: 2, label: "Customer call", start: "2026-03-11T12:30:00", end: "2026-03-11T13:30:00", color: "info" },
      { id: 3, label: "Planning", start: "2026-03-11T12:45:00", end: "2026-03-11T14:00:00", color: "#8e44ad" },
    ]);
    const model = ref("2026-03-11");
    const view = ref("day");

    return {
      events,
      model,
      view,
    };
  },
};
```

## List

`view="agenda"` lists the days of the month with their events: the time, the title and the place (`keyLocation`). The list suits small screens and screen readers.

*props: `view`, `key-location`*

## Disabled days

`minDate`, `maxDate` and `disabledDates` (an array of dates or a function of the day) disable days: they are hatched and cannot be chosen, they get no event by dragging and no selection. Here the 12th and the 19th are holidays.

*props: `min-date`, `max-date`, `disabled-dates`*

```html
<a-calendar
  v-model="model"
  :min-date="minDate"
  :max-date="maxDate"
  :disabled-dates="isHoliday"
/>
<p>
  <a-translation
    tag="strong"
    text="_A_CALENDAR_SELECTED_"
  />: {{ model }}
</p>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACalendar,
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ACalendar,
    ATranslation,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(undefined);
    const minDate = "2026-03-03";
    const maxDate = "2026-03-25";
    // disabledDates: an array of dates or a function of the day ("YYYY-MM-DD")
    const HOLIDAYS = ["2026-03-12", "2026-03-19"];
    const isHoliday = day => HOLIDAYS.indexOf(day) !== -1;

    return {
      isHoliday,
      maxDate,
      minDate,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Many events in one day

`maxEventsPerDay` limits the events shown in a day (3 by default). The others are counted in a button **+N**, which emits the event `more-click` with all events of the day.

*props: `max-events-per-day`*

```html
<a-calendar
  :events="events"
  :max-events-per-day="2"
  @more-click="onMoreClick"
/>
<div v-if="day">
  <a-translation
    tag="strong"
    text="_A_CALENDAR_MAX_EVENTS_LIST_"
  />: {{ day }}
  <ul>
    <li
      v-for="event in dayEvents"
      :key="event.id"
    >{{ event.label }}</li>
  </ul>
</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACalendar,
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ACalendar,
    ATranslation,
  },

    const events = ref([
      { id: 1, label: "Team meeting", start: "2026-03-03T10:00:00", end: "2026-03-03T11:00:00", color: "primary" },
      { id: 2, label: "Vacation", start: "2026-03-08", end: "2026-03-14", color: "success", isAllDay: true },
      { id: 3, label: "Workshop", start: "2026-03-12T09:00:00", end: "2026-03-13T17:00:00", color: "info" },
      { id: 4, label: "Birthday", start: "2026-03-20", color: "#8e44ad", isAllDay: true },
    ]);
    const dayEvents = ref([]);
    const day = ref(undefined);

    const onMoreClick = ({ date, events: eventsOfDay }) => {

      day,
      dayEvents,
```

## Details by a click

`isEventPopover`: a click on an event opens its details at the event: the time, the place and the description (`keyLocation`, `keyDescription`). The popover gets the focus, Escape closes it and gives the focus back to the event. The slot `popoverActions` adds buttons, `popover` replaces the content.

*props: `is-event-popover`, `key-location`, `key-description`*

```html
<a-calendar
  :events="events"
  :is-event-popover="true"
>
  <template v-slot:popoverActions="{ event, close }">
    <a-button
      class="a_btn a_btn_outline_danger a_btn_small"
      text="_A_CALENDAR_DETAILS_DELETE_"
      @click="deleteEvent({ event })"
    />
    <a-button
      class="a_btn a_btn_primary a_btn_small"
      text="_A_CALENDAR_DETAILS_EDIT_"
      @click="editEvent({ event, close })"
    />
  </template>
</a-calendar>
<p v-if="lastAction">
  <a-translation
    tag="strong"
    text="_A_CALENDAR_DETAILS_LAST_"
  />: {{ lastAction }}
</p>
```

```js
// PageCalendarPopover.js
import {
  AButton,
  ACalendar,
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";

import PopoverAPI from "./compositionAPI/PopoverAPI";

export default {
  components: {
    AButton,
    ACalendar,
    ATranslation,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      deleteEvent,
      editEvent,
      events,
      lastAction,
    } = PopoverAPI({
      events: [
        { id: 1, label: "Team meeting", start: "2026-03-10T10:00:00", end: "2026-03-10T11:00:00", location: "Room 3" },
        { id: 2, label: "Workshop", start: "2026-03-12T09:00:00", end: "2026-03-13T17:00:00", description: "Bring the laptop." },
      ],
    });

    return {
      deleteEvent,
      editEvent,
      events,
      lastAction,
    };
  },
};

// compositionAPI/PopoverAPI.js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

export default function PopoverAPI({ events: eventsStart = [] }) {
  const events = ref(eventsStart);
  const lastAction = ref("");

  const editEvent = ({ event, close }) => {
    lastAction.value = event.label;
    close();
  };

  const deleteEvent = ({ event }) => {
    // The popover closes itself when its event is deleted
    events.value = events.value.filter(item => item.id !== event.id);
  };

  return {
    deleteEvent,
    editEvent,
    events,
    lastAction,
  };
}
```

## Creating events

The form is not part of the component. Here a click on a day opens **AModalForm** to create an event, in the week and the day view a click on a time opens it with this time (`time-click`). **Repeat** makes the event a series. A click on an event opens it (an occurrence opens the series) for editing or deleting. The button **Delete** is added with the slot `modalFooterAppend`. Pulling the mouse over a time or over several days (`isRangeSelectable`) opens the form with this time.

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_BTN_"
  @click="openModalToday"
/>
<a-calendar
  :events="events"
  @day-click="onDayClick"
  @event-click="onEventClick"
  @time-click="onTimeClick"
  :is-range-selectable="true"
  @time-select="onTimeSelect"
  @day-select="onDaySelect"
/>
<a-modal-form
  v-if="isModalVisible"
  v-model="model"
  :data-form="dataForm"
  :header-text="headerText"
  :close="closeModal"
  :save="save"
  :disabled-save="isSaveDisabled"
  class-columns="a_columns a_columns_count_12 a_columns_gap_3"
  class-column-default="a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch"
>
  <template
    v-if="isEditing"
    v-slot:modalFooterAppend
  >
    <a-button
      :id="btnDeleteId"
      class="a_btn a_btn_outline_danger"
      text="_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_DELETE_"
      @click="deleteEvent"
    />
  </template>
</a-modal-form>
```

```js
// PageCalendarCreate.js
import {
  AButton,
  ACalendar,
  AModalForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

import CreateAPI from "./compositionAPI/CreateAPI";

export default {
  components: {
    AButton,
    ACalendar,
    AModalForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      btnDeleteId,
      closeModal,
      dataForm,
      deleteEvent,
      events,
      headerText,
      isEditing,
      isModalVisible,
      isSaveDisabled,
      model,
      onDayClick,
      onEventClick,
      onDaySelect,
      onTimeClick,
      onTimeSelect,
      openModalToday,
      save,
    } = CreateAPI();

    return {
      btnDeleteId,
      closeModal,
      dataForm,
      deleteEvent,
      events,
      headerText,
      isEditing,
      isModalVisible,
      isSaveDisabled,
      model,
      onDayClick,
      onEventClick,
      onDaySelect,
      onTimeClick,
      onTimeSelect,
      openModalToday,
      save,
    };
  },
};

// compositionAPI/CreateAPI.js
import {
  computed,
  nextTick,
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AConfirmAPI,
  filterEscapeHtml,
  setFocusToElement,
} from "aloha-vue";

import moment from "moment";

const DATETIME_FORMAT = "YYYY-MM-DD[T]HH:mm:ss.SSSZ";
const BTN_DELETE_ID = "page_calendar_create_btn_delete";

export default function CreateAPI() {
  const events = ref([]);
  const model = ref({});
  const editedId = ref(undefined);
  const isModalVisible = ref(false);

  const dataForm = [
    { type: "text", id: "label", label: "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_LABEL_", required: true, classColumn: "a_column a_column_12" },
    { type: "datetime", id: "start", label: "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_START_" },
    { type: "datetime", id: "end", label: "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_END_" },
    {
      type: "select",
      id: "color",
      label: "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_COLOR_",
      data: ["primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "success", "info", "warning", "danger", "gray"].map(color => ({ label: color, value: color })),
    },
    { type: "oneCheckbox", id: "isAllDay", label: "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_ALL_DAY_" },
    {
      type: "select",
      id: "repeat",
      label: "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_REPEAT_",
      translateData: true,
      data: ["", "daily", "weekly", "monthly", "yearly"].map(frequency => ({
        label: `_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_REPEAT_${ (frequency || "none").toUpperCase() }_`,
        value: frequency,
      })),
    },
  ];

  const isEditing = computed(() => editedId.value !== undefined);

  const headerText = computed(() => {
    return isEditing.value ? "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_MODAL_EDIT_" : "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_MODAL_NEW_";
  });

  const isSaveDisabled = computed(() => !model.value.label || !model.value.start);

  const openModalNew = ({ start, end }) => {
    editedId.value = undefined;
    model.value = {
      label: "",
      start: moment(start).format(DATETIME_FORMAT),
      end: moment(end).format(DATETIME_FORMAT),
      color: "primary",
      isAllDay: false,
      repeat: "",
    };
    isModalVisible.value = true;
  };

  const openModalForDate = date => {
    const START = moment(date).hours(9).minutes(0);
    openModalNew({ start: START, end: START.clone().add(1, "hour") });
  };

  // Month view and the heads of the days in the week view
  const onDayClick = ({ date }) => {
    openModalForDate(date);
  };

  // Pulling the mouse over a time or over several days (isRangeSelectable)
  const onTimeSelect = ({ start, end }) => {
    openModalNew({ start, end });
  };

  const onDaySelect = ({ start, end }) => {
    openModalNew({ start, end });
    model.value.isAllDay = true;
  };

  // Week view: a click on a time (the event lasts one hour, not one timeStep)
  const onTimeClick = ({ start }) => {
    openModalNew({ start, end: moment(start).add(1, "hour") });
  };

  const openModalToday = () => {
    openModalForDate(new Date());
  };

  // An occurrence of a series opens the whole series
  const onEventClick = ({ event }) => {
    editedId.value = event.id;
    model.value = { ...event, repeat: event.recurrence?.frequency || "" };
    isModalVisible.value = true;
  };

  const closeModal = () => {
    isModalVisible.value = false;
  };

  // "repeat" of the form becomes the rule of the series (recurrence)
  const getEventFromModel = id => {
    const { repeat, ...EVENT } = model.value;
    return {
      ...EVENT,
      id,
      recurrence: repeat ? { ...EVENT.recurrence, frequency: repeat } : undefined,
    };
  };

  const save = () => {
    if (!isEditing.value) {
      events.value = [...events.value, getEventFromModel(Date.now())];
    } else {
      events.value = events.value.map(event => event.id === editedId.value ? getEventFromModel(editedId.value) : event);
    }
    closeModal();
  };

  const {
    closeConfirm,
    openConfirm,
  } = AConfirmAPI();

  // The title is typed by the user and the body of the confirm is HTML
  const deleteEvent = () => {
    openConfirm({
      headerText: "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_DELETE_CONFIRM_HEADER_",
      bodyHtml: "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_DELETE_CONFIRM_BODY_{{label}}_",
      extra: {
        label: filterEscapeHtml(model.value.label),
      },
      saveButtonText: "_A_CALENDAR_CREATE_DELETE_",
      saveButtonClass: "a_btn a_btn_danger",
      save: () => {
        events.value = events.value.filter(event => event.id !== editedId.value);
        closeConfirm();
        closeModal();
      },
      // Cancel: the focus goes back to the button "Delete" of the form
      close: () => {
        closeConfirm();
        nextTick(() => setFocusToElement({ selector: `#${ BTN_DELETE_ID }` }));
      },
    });
  };

  return {
    btnDeleteId: BTN_DELETE_ID,
    closeModal,
    dataForm,
    deleteEvent,
    events,
    headerText,
    isEditing,
    isModalVisible,
    isSaveDisabled,
    model,
    onDayClick,
    onEventClick,
    onDaySelect,
    onTimeClick,
    onTimeSelect,
    openModalToday,
    save,
  };
}
```

## Drag and drop, resizing

With `isDraggable` events can be dragged. In the month and in the all-day row an event moves to another day and keeps its time, in the time grid it gets the day and the time of the place (rounded to `timeStep`). With `isResizable` the edges of an event change its start and its end: the top and the bottom edge in the time grid, the start and the end edge of a bar in the month and in the all-day row. The calendar does not change the events: it emits `event-drop` and `event-resize` with the new start and end, the parent saves them. A function locks single events, here the birthday. Dragging needs a pointer: for the keyboard offer a form, like in the example "Creating events". With the keyboard: Alt and the arrow keys move the focused event, Alt, Shift and the arrow keys change its end. On a touch screen a long press starts the drag. An occurrence of the standup asks: `detachCalendarOccurrence` changes only this occurrence, `moveCalendarSeries` the whole series (`splitCalendarSeries`: this and the following occurrences).

*props: `is-draggable`, `is-resizable`*

```html
<a-calendar
  v-model="model"
  v-model:view="view"
  :events="events"
  :is-draggable="isDraggable"
  :is-resizable="isDraggable"
  @event-drop="onEventChange"
  @event-resize="onEventChange"
/>
<p v-if="lastDrop">
  <a-translation
    tag="strong"
    text="_A_CALENDAR_DRAG_LAST_"
  />: {{ lastDrop }}
</p>
<a-modal
  v-if="seriesChange"
  header-text="_A_CALENDAR_SERIES_QUESTION_HEADER_"
  body-html="_A_CALENDAR_SERIES_QUESTION_BODY_"
  :close="closeSeriesChange"
  :save="changeOnlyThisOccurrence"
  save-button-text="_A_CALENDAR_SERIES_ONLY_THIS_"
>
  <template v-slot:modalFooterAppend>
    <a-button
      class="a_btn a_btn_outline_primary"
      text="_A_CALENDAR_SERIES_ALL_"
      @click="changeWholeSeries"
    />
  </template>
</a-modal>
```

```js
// PageCalendarDragDrop.js
import {
  AButton,
  ACalendar,
  AModal,
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";

import DragDropAPI from "./compositionAPI/DragDropAPI";

export default {
  components: {
    AButton,
    ACalendar,
    AModal,
    ATranslation,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      changeOnlyThisOccurrence,
      changeWholeSeries,
      closeSeriesChange,
      events,
      isDraggable,
      lastDrop,
      model,
      onEventChange,
      seriesChange,
      view,
    } = DragDropAPI({
      events: [
        { id: 1, label: "Team meeting", start: "2026-03-10T10:00:00", end: "2026-03-10T11:00:00" },
        { id: 2, label: "Workshop", start: "2026-03-12T09:00:00", end: "2026-03-13T17:00:00", color: "info" },
        { id: 3, label: "Birthday", start: "2026-03-14", color: "#8e44ad", isAllDay: true, isLocked: true },
        { id: "standup", label: "Standup", start: "2026-03-02T08:30:00", end: "2026-03-02T08:45:00", recurrence: { frequency: "weekly", weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] } },
      ],
      date: "2026-03-11",
    });

    return {
      changeOnlyThisOccurrence,
      changeWholeSeries,
      closeSeriesChange,
      events,
      isDraggable,
      lastDrop,
      model,
      onEventChange,
      seriesChange,
      view,
    };
  },
};

// compositionAPI/DragDropAPI.js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  detachCalendarOccurrence,
  moveCalendarSeries,
} from "aloha-vue";

import moment from "moment";

const DATETIME_FORMAT = "YYYY-MM-DD[T]HH:mm:ss.SSSZ";

export default function DragDropAPI({ events: eventsStart = [], date }) {
  const events = ref(eventsStart);
  const model = ref(date);
  const view = ref("week");
  const lastDrop = ref("");
  // An occurrence of a series was moved: the question "only this occurrence or the whole series"
  const seriesChange = ref(undefined);

  // Events with isLocked cannot be dragged
  const isDraggable = event => !event.isLocked;

  const replaceEvents = (id, items) => {
    events.value = [...events.value.filter(item => item.id !== id), ...items];
  };

  const saveEvent = ({ event, start, end }) => {
    const FORMAT = event.isAllDay ? "YYYY-MM-DD" : DATETIME_FORMAT;
    replaceEvents(event.id, [{ ...event, start: moment(start).format(FORMAT), end: moment(end).format(FORMAT) }]);
    lastDrop.value = `${ event.label }: ${ moment(start).format("DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm") } – ${ moment(end).format("DD.MM.YYYY HH:mm") }`;
  };

  // event-drop and event-resize (also with the keyboard): the calendar does not change the events
  const onEventChange = change => {
    if (change.occurrence) {
      seriesChange.value = change;
      return;
    }
    saveEvent(change);
  };

  const changeOnlyThisOccurrence = () => {
    const { series, event } = detachCalendarOccurrence({ item: seriesChange.value.event, ...seriesChange.value });
    replaceEvents(series.id, [series, event]);
    lastDrop.value = event.label;
    seriesChange.value = undefined;
  };

  const changeWholeSeries = () => {
    const SERIES = moveCalendarSeries({ item: seriesChange.value.event, ...seriesChange.value });
    replaceEvents(SERIES.id, [SERIES]);
    lastDrop.value = SERIES.label;
    seriesChange.value = undefined;
  };

  const closeSeriesChange = () => {
    seriesChange.value = undefined;
  };

  return {
    changeOnlyThisOccurrence,
    changeWholeSeries,
    closeSeriesChange,
    events,
    isDraggable,
    lastDrop,
    model,
    onEventChange,
    seriesChange,
    view,
  };
}
```

## Loading

`range-change` tells the shown days: load their events and set `isLoading` meanwhile. The days are covered and `aria-busy` is set.

*props: `is-loading`*

```html
<a-calendar
  :events="events"
  :is-loading="isLoading"
  @range-change="loadEvents"
/>
```

```js
// PageCalendarLoading.js
import {
  ACalendar,
} from "aloha-vue";

import LoadingAPI from "./compositionAPI/LoadingAPI";

export default {
  components: {
    ACalendar,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      events,
      isLoading,
      loadEvents,
    } = LoadingAPI();

    return {
      events,
      isLoading,
      loadEvents,
    };
  },
};

// compositionAPI/LoadingAPI.js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import moment from "moment";

export default function LoadingAPI() {
  const events = ref([]);
  const isLoading = ref(false);

  // A server would return the events of the shown days: here every day gets an event after a short time
  const loadEvents = ({ start, end }) => {
    isLoading.value = true;
    setTimeout(() => {
      const EVENTS = [];
      for (const DAY = moment(start); DAY.format("YYYY-MM-DD") <= end; DAY.add(3, "days")) {
        EVENTS.push({ id: DAY.format("YYYY-MM-DD"), label: `Loaded ${ DAY.format("DD.MM.") }`, start: DAY.format("YYYY-MM-DD[T]10:00:00") });
      }
      events.value = EVENTS;
      isLoading.value = false;
    }, 800);
  };

  return {
    events,
    isLoading,
    loadEvents,
  };
}
```

## Export (iCal)

`getIcs()` returns the events as an iCalendar file (.ics), `downloadIcs({ fileName })` downloads it. The file opens in Outlook, Google Calendar and Apple Calendar. All events are exported, not only the shown days: single events in UTC, a series in the local time (it keeps its hour in summer time) as `RRULE` with `EXDATE`. Without the component the function `getCalendarIcs({ events })` makes the same file, e.g. on a server.

```html
<div class="a_d_flex a_gap_2">
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    text="_A_CALENDAR_EXPORT_DOWNLOAD_"
    @click="download"
  />
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_secondary"
    text="_A_CALENDAR_EXPORT_PREVIEW_"
    @click="showPreview"
  />
</div>
<a-calendar
  ref="calendarRef"
  :events="events"
/>
<pre v-if="ics">{{ ics }}</pre>
```

```js
// PageCalendarExport.js
import {
  AButton,
  ACalendar,
} from "aloha-vue";

import ExportAPI from "./compositionAPI/ExportAPI";

export default {
  components: {
    AButton,
    ACalendar,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      calendarRef,
      download,
      events,
      ics,
      showPreview,
    } = ExportAPI({
      events: [
        { id: 1, label: "Team meeting", start: "2026-03-03T10:00:00", end: "2026-03-03T11:00:00" },
        { id: 2, label: "Vacation", start: "2026-03-08", end: "2026-03-14", isAllDay: true },
        { id: "standup", label: "Standup", start: "2026-03-02T09:00:00", end: "2026-03-02T09:15:00", recurrence: { frequency: "weekly", weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5], exceptions: ["2026-03-12"] } },
      ],
    });

    return {
      calendarRef,
      download,
      events,
      ics,
      showPreview,
    };
  },
};

// compositionAPI/ExportAPI.js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

export default function ExportAPI({ events: eventsStart = [] }) {
  const events = ref(eventsStart);
  const calendarRef = ref(undefined);
  const ics = ref("");

  // All events, not only the shown days. A series is exported as RRULE.
  const download = () => {
    calendarRef.value.downloadIcs({ fileName: "aloha-calendar.ics", calendarName: "Aloha" });
  };

  const showPreview = () => {
    ics.value = calendarRef.value.getIcs({ calendarName: "Aloha" });
  };

  return {
    calendarRef,
    download,
    events,
    ics,
    showPreview,
  };
}

// Without the component, e.g. on a server:
// import { getCalendarIcs } from "aloha-vue";
// const ICS = getCalendarIcs({ events, calendarName: "Aloha", keyLabel: "title" });
```

## Import (iCal)

`parseCalendarIcs(text)` reads an .ics file into events of the calendar: `{ events, skipped, warnings }`. The calendar does not save them: show them, let the user confirm and save them on the server. Times in UTC and with `TZID` (also the Windows names of Outlook like "W. Europe Standard Time") become the local time, `RRULE` and `EXDATE` become `recurrence`, a changed occurrence (`RECURRENCE-ID`) becomes a single event and an exception of its series, `DESCRIPTION` and `LOCATION` are kept. What the calendar cannot show is reported: a rule like "the second Tuesday" (the event is imported once) or an unknown time zone (the local time is used). `STATUS` (tentative, cancelled) becomes `status`.

```html
<div class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_gap_3 a_align_items_end">
  <a-input-file
    v-model="file"
    :is-dropzone="true"
    accept=".ics,text/calendar"
    label="_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_FILE_"
  />
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_secondary"
    text="_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_SAMPLE_"
    @click="useSample"
  />
</div>
<template v-if="imported.length || skipped.length || warnings.length">
  <div class="a_d_flex a_align_items_center a_gap_3">
    <a-translation
      tag="strong"
      text="_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_READ_{{count}}_"
      :extra="{ count: imported.length }"
    />
    <a-button
      v-if="imported.length"
      class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
      text="_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_SAVE_"
      @click="save"
    />
  </div>
  <div v-if="warnings.length">
    <a-translation
      tag="strong"
      text="_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_WARNINGS_"
    />
    <ul>
      <li
        v-for="(warning, index) in warnings"
        :key="index"
      >
        <a-translation
          tag="span"
          :text="getCodeText(warning.code)"
          :extra="{ label: warning.label, value: warning.value }"
        />
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
  <div v-if="skipped.length">
    <a-translation
      tag="strong"
      text="_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_SKIPPED_"
    />
    <ul>
      <li
        v-for="(item, index) in skipped"
        :key="index"
      >
        <a-translation
          tag="span"
          :text="getCodeText(item.code)"
          :extra="{ label: item.label }"
        />
      </li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</template>
<a-calendar
  :events="calendarEvents"
/>
```

```js
// PageCalendarImport.js
import {
  AButton,
  ACalendar,
  AInputFile,
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";

import ImportAPI from "./compositionAPI/ImportAPI";

export default {
  components: {
    AButton,
    ACalendar,
    AInputFile,
    ATranslation,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      calendarEvents,
      file,
      getCodeText,
      imported,
      save,
      skipped,
      useSample,
      warnings,
    } = ImportAPI({
      getSampleIcs: () => "BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\n...\r\nEND:VCALENDAR",
    });

    return {
      calendarEvents,
      file,
      getCodeText,
      imported,
      save,
      skipped,
      useSample,
      warnings,
    };
  },
};

// compositionAPI/ImportAPI.js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
  watch,
} from "vue";

import {
  parseCalendarIcs,
} from "aloha-vue";

// The codes of parseCalendarIcs and their texts
const CODE_TEXTS = {
  cancelled: "_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_CODE_CANCELLED_",
  noStart: "_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_CODE_NO_START_",
  rruleNotSupported: "_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_CODE_RRULE_NOT_SUPPORTED_",
  timeZoneUnknown: "_A_CALENDAR_IMPORT_CODE_TIME_ZONE_UNKNOWN_",
};

export default function ImportAPI({ getSampleIcs = () => "" } = {}) {
  // The saved events (here only in the page, in an application on the server)
  const events = ref([]);
  const file = ref(undefined);
  const imported = ref([]);
  const skipped = ref([]);
  const warnings = ref([]);

  // The calendar shows the saved events and the read events before they are saved
  const calendarEvents = computed(() => [...events.value, ...imported.value]);

  const readText = text => {
    const RESULT = parseCalendarIcs(text);
    imported.value = RESULT.events;
    skipped.value = RESULT.skipped;
    warnings.value = RESULT.warnings;
  };

  // AInputFile gives { name, size, type, file }
  watch(file, async value => {
    if (value?.file) {
      readText(await value.file.text());
    }
  });

  const useSample = () => {
    readText(getSampleIcs());
  };

  const getCodeText = code => CODE_TEXTS[code] || code;

  // In an application: send imported.value to the server and save it there
  const save = () => {
    events.value = [...events.value, ...imported.value];
    imported.value = [];
    skipped.value = [];
    warnings.value = [];
    file.value = undefined;
  };

  return {
    calendarEvents,
    file,
    getCodeText,
    imported,
    save,
    skipped,
    useSample,
    warnings,
  };
}
```

## ACalendar

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| colorDefault | String | "primary" |  | The color of events without a color. |
| disabledDates | Array \| Function | undefined |  | Days that cannot be chosen: an array of dates or a function that gets the day ("YYYY-MM-DD") and returns true. |
| events | Array | [] |  | The events. An event without a valid start is ignored. |
| firstDayOfWeek | Number | 1 |  | The first day of the week: 0 is Sunday, 1 is Monday. The default can be set with AComponentsPlugin (also for ADatepicker). |
| hourEnd | Number | 24 |  | Week and day view: the hour where the time grid ends (1 to 24). |
| hourStart | Number | 0 |  | Week and day view: the hour where the time grid starts (0 to 23). |
| id | String | uniqueId("a_calendar_") |  | The id of the component. The title has the id `{id}_title`. |
| isDraggable | Boolean \| Function | false |  | Whether the events can be dragged. A function gets the event and returns true or false. |
| isEventPopover | Boolean | false |  | Whether a click on an event opens its details at the event. |
| isLoading | Boolean | false |  | Covers the days while the events are loaded. |
| isRangeSelectable | Boolean | false |  | Whether pulling the mouse selects a time (`time-select`) or several days (`day-select`), e.g. to create an event. |
| isResizable | Boolean \| Function | false |  | Whether the start and the end of the events can be changed by pulling their edges. A function gets the event and returns true or false. |
| isWeekNumbers | Boolean | false |  | Shows the calendar weeks (ISO 8601). |
| keyColor | String \| Function | "color" |  | The key (or a function) of the color of an event. |
| keyDescription | String \| Function | "description" |  | The key (or a function) of the description of an event (popover). |
| keyEnd | String \| Function | "end" |  | The key (or a function) of the end of an event. The end is the last day of the event. Without an end the event lasts one day. |
| keyId | String \| Function | "id" |  | The key (or a function) of the id of an event. |
| keyIsAllDay | String \| Function | "isAllDay" |  | The key (or a function) for events without a time. |
| keyLabel | String \| Function | "label" |  | The key (or a function) of the title of an event. |
| keyLocation | String \| Function | "location" |  | The key (or a function) of the place of an event (popover, list). |
| keyRecurrence | String \| Function | "recurrence" |  | The key (or a function) of the rule of a recurring event: `{ frequency, interval, weekdays, until, count, exceptions }`. |
| keyStart | String \| Function | "start" |  | The key (or a function) of the start of an event: a Date, a timestamp or a string like `"2026-03-10"` or `"2026-03-10T09:00:00"`. |
| keyStatus | String \| Function | "status" |  | The key (or a function) of the status of an event: **tentative** or **cancelled**. |
| maxDate | String \| Date \| Number | undefined |  | The last day that can be chosen. |
| maxEventsPerDay | Number | 3 |  | The maximum number of events shown in a day of the month and in the all-day row of the week. 0 shows all events. |
| minDate | String \| Date \| Number | undefined |  | The first day that can be chosen. |
| modelValue | String \| Date \| Number | undefined |  | The selected day. The calendar shows its month, week or day. |
| scrollToHour | Number | 8 |  | Week and day view: the hour visible at the top of the time grid. |
| timeStep | Number | 30 |  | Week and day view: the minutes to which the start of `time-click` is rounded. |
| view | String | "month" |  | The view: **month**, **week**, **workweek**, **day** or **agenda**. Works with `v-model:view`. |
| views | Array | ["month", "week", "day"] |  | The views of the switch in the header. With one view the switch is hidden. |
| workingHours | Object | undefined |  | The working hours of the time grid, e.g. `{ start: 8, end: 18 }`: the other hours and the days outside `workWeekDays` are shaded. |
| workWeekDays | Array | [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] |  | The days of the work week (0 is Sunday) for `view="workweek"` and `workingHours`. |

## Events

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| day-click | A click on a day: `{ date, events, $event }`. |
| day-select | Several days were selected by pulling the mouse (`isRangeSelectable`): `{ start, end, $event }` as "YYYY-MM-DD". |
| event-click | A click on an event: `{ event, start, end, occurrence, $event }`. `occurrence` (only for a series): `{ date, start, end }` of the clicked occurrence. |
| event-drop | An event was dropped at another place: `{ event, start, end, occurrence, $event }`. The duration stays the same. |
| event-resize | The start or the end of an event was changed by pulling its edge: `{ event, start, end, occurrence, $event }`. |
| more-click | A click on **+N**: `{ date, events, $event }`. |
| range-change | The shown days have changed (also when the calendar is mounted): `{ start, end, month, view }`. Load the events of these days here. |
| time-click | Week and day view, a click on an empty place of the time grid: `{ date, start, end, $event }`. `end` is `start` plus `timeStep`. |
| time-select | A time was selected by pulling the mouse (`isRangeSelectable`): `{ date, start, end, $event }`. |
| update:modelValue | The selected day as `"YYYY-MM-DD"`. |
| update:view | The view has changed: **month**, **week** or **day**. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| day | The content of a day: `{ day, events }`. |
| event | The content of an event: `{ event, start, end, isStart, isEnd, isRecurring }`. `isStart` and `isEnd` are false if the bar continues in another week. |
| header | The header: `{ title, range, view, views, changeView, goToPrevious, goToNext, goToToday }`. |
| popover | The content of the popover: `{ event, occurrence, close }`. |
| popoverActions | Buttons in the popover: `{ event, occurrence, close }`. |

## Exposes

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| changeView | Function | Shows a view: `"month"`, `"week"` or `"day"`. |
| closePopover | Function | Closes the popover. |
| downloadIcs | Function | Downloads the events as an .ics file: `{ fileName = "calendar.ics", calendarName, uidDomain }`. |
| focusDay | Function | Focuses a day (`"YYYY-MM-DD"`) and shows its month. |
| getIcs | Function | Returns the events as the text of an .ics file: `{ calendarName, uidDomain }`. The UID of an event is `id@uidDomain` (default "aloha-vue"). |
| goToDate | Function | Shows the month of a date. |
| goToNext | Function | Shows the next month, week or day. |
| goToNextMonth | Function | The same as `goToNext` (the name of the first version). |
| goToPrevious | Function | Shows the previous month, week or day. |
| goToPreviousMonth | Function | The same as `goToPrevious` (the name of the first version). |
| goToToday | Function | Shows the current month. |

# ACarousel (Carousel)

A carousel is a component for cyclically displaying elements (images, text, etc.) in a limited space. Users can navigate through the elements using navigation buttons or indicators.

## Basic usage

```html
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_12_touch a_column_4">
    <a-carousel
      :data="data"
      aria-label="_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_BALLS_ARIA_LABEL_"
      key-id="id"
    >
      <template
        v-slot:item="{ item }"
      >
        <img 
          :alt="item.alt"
          :src="item.src"
          class="a_height_auto a_width_100"
        >
      </template>
    </a-carousel>
  </div>
  <div class="a_column a_column_12_touch a_column_4">
    <a-carousel
      :data="dataOne"
      aria-label="_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_BALLS_ARIA_LABEL_"
      key-id="id"
    >
      <template
        v-slot:item="{ item }"
      >
        <img 
          :alt="item.alt"
```

## Aria disabled

The carousel component can be marked as disabled for assistive technologies using the aria-disabled attribute.

*props: `aria-disabled`*

```html
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_12_touch a_column_6">
    <a-carousel
      :data="data"
      aria-label="Carousel with balls"
      :aria-disabled="true"
      key-id="id"
    >
      <template v-slot:item="{ item }">
        <img
          class="a_height_auto a_width_100"
          :src="item.src"
          :alt="item.alt"
        />
      </template>
    </a-carousel>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Arrows trigger

The carousel component can display navigation arrows in different ways: always visible, only on hover, only on focus, or on both hover and focus.

*props: `arrows-trigger`*

```html
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_12_touch a_column_4">
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      html="_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ARROWS_TRIGGER_HOVER_"
    ></a-translation>
    <a-carousel
      :data="data"
      aria-label="Carousel with balls"
      arrows-trigger="hover"
      key-id="id"
    >
      <template v-slot:item="{ item }">
        <img
          class="a_height_auto a_width_100"
          :src="item.src"
          :alt="item.alt"
        />
      </template>
    </a-carousel>
  </div>

  <div class="a_column a_column_12_touch a_column_4">
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      html="_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ARROWS_TRIGGER_FOCUS_"
    ></a-translation>
    <a-carousel
      :data="data"
      aria-label="Carousel with balls"
      arrows-trigger="focus"
      key-id="id"
    >
      <template v-slot:item="{ item }">
        <img
          class="a_height_auto a_width_100"
          :src="item.src"
          :alt="item.alt"
        />
      </template>
    </a-carousel>
  </div>

  <div class="a_column a_column_12_touch a_column_4">
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      html="_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ARROWS_TRIGGER_HOVER_FOCUS_"
    ></a-translation>
    <a-carousel
      :arrows-trigger="['hover', 'focus']"
      :data="data"
      aria-label="Carousel with balls"
      key-id="id"
    >
      <template v-slot:item="{ item }">
        <img
          class="a_height_auto a_width_100"
          :src="item.src"
          :alt="item.alt"
        />
      </template>
    </a-carousel>
  </div>

  <div class="a_column a_column_12_touch a_column_4">
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      html="_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ARROWS_TRIGGER_ALWAYS_"
    ></a-translation>
    <a-carousel
      :data="data"
      aria-label="Carousel with balls"
      arrows-trigger="always"
      key-id="id"
    >
      <template v-slot:item="{ item }">
        <img
          class="a_height_auto a_width_100"
          :src="item.src"
          :alt="item.alt"
        />
      </template>
    </a-carousel>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Events

This example demonstrates the **change** and **init** events emitted by the carousel component.

*emits: `change`, `init`*

```html
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_12_touch a_column_6">
    <a-carousel
      :data="data"
      aria-label="_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_BALLS_ARIA_LABEL_"
      key-id="id"
      @change="change"
      @init="init"
    >
      <template v-slot:item="{ item }">
        <img
          class="a_height_auto a_width_100"
          :src="item.src"
          :alt="item.alt"
        />
      </template>
    </a-carousel>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
import {
  computed,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACarousel,
  getTranslatedText,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageCarouselEmits",
  components: {
    ACarousel,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = computed(() => {
      return [
        {
          id: 1,
          src: "./assets/Basketball_ball_red_background.png",
          alt: getTranslatedText({
            placeholder: "_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ALT_BASKETBALL_BALL_",
          }),
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          src: "./assets/Soccer_ball_red_background.png",
          alt: getTranslatedText({
            placeholder: "_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ALT_SOCCER_BALL_",
          }),
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          src: "./assets/Tennis_ball_purple_background.png",
          alt: getTranslatedText({
            placeholder: "_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ALT_TENNIS_BALL_",
          }),
        },
        {
          id: 4,
          src: "./assets/Volleyball_ball_red_background.png",
          alt: getTranslatedText({
            placeholder: "_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ALT_VOLLEY_BALL_",
          }),
        },
      ];
    });
    
    const init = ({ id, item }) => {
      console.log("init", id, item);
    };

    const change = ({ id, item }) => {
      console.log("change", id, item);
    };

    return {
      change,
      data,
      init,
    };
  },
};
```

```html
          :src="item.src"
          :alt="item.alt"

    </a-carousel>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
  name: "PageCarouselDeleteActiveSlide",
  components: {
    ACarousel,
  },
  setup() {
     const showLastSlide = ref(true);

    const data = computed(() => {
      const DATA = [
        {
          id: 1,
          src: "./assets/Basketball_ball_red_background.png",
          alt: getTranslatedText({
            placeholder: "_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ALT_BASKETBALL_BALL_",
          }),
        },
        {
          id: 2,
          src: "./assets/Soccer_ball_red_background.png",
          alt: getTranslatedText({
            placeholder: "_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ALT_SOCCER_BALL_",
          }),
        },
        {
          id: 3,
          src: "./assets/Tennis_ball_purple_background.png",
          alt: getTranslatedText({
            placeholder: "_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ALT_TENNIS_BALL_",
          }),
        },
      ];
      if (showLastSlide.value) {
        DATA.push({
          id: 4,
          src: "./assets/Volleyball_ball_red_background.png",
          alt: getTranslatedText({
            placeholder: "_A_CAROUSEL_COMPONENT_ALT_VOLLEY_BALL_",
          }),
        });
      }

      return DATA;
    });

    const deleteLastSlide = () => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        showLastSlide.value = false;
      }, 2000);
    };
    
    deleteLastSlide();

    return {
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| arrows-show | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether navigation buttons (arrows) should be displayed for navigating between slides |
| arrows-trigger | String / Array | always |  | Determines when navigation buttons should be displayed: always, on hover, or on focus |

| indicators-show | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether slide indicators should be displayed |
| indicators-type | String | dots |  | Determines the type of slide indicators |
| indicator-width | Number | 2.125 |  | Size of one indicator, needed to determine the number of indicators if **indicatorsAutoLimit true** |
| key-id | String |  |  | A unique key identifier for each data item. Used for performance improvement |
| model-value | Number / String |  |  | Index or ID of the currently active slide in the carousel |
| texts | Object | {         nextSlide: "_A_CAROUSEL_NEXT_SLIDE_",         previousSlide: "_A_CAROUSEL_PREVIOUS_SLIDE_",         controlsSlide: "_A_CAROUSEL_CONTROLS_SLIDE_{{number}}_",         controlsSlides: "_A_CAROUSEL_CONTROLS_SLIDES_",         controlsStart: "_A_CAROUSEL_CONTROLS_START_",         controlsStop: "_A_CAROUSEL_CONTROLS_STOP_",         itemAriaLabel: "_A_CAROUSEL_ITEM_ARIA_LABEL_{{number}}_{{count}}_",       } |  | Object with translatable texts used in the component |

# ACloak (Loading screen)

The **ACloak** component displays a loading indicator with text indicating the current loading of the page or a large component. It supports various customization options, including text alignment, size of the indicator, and the ability to change the **HTML** tag for rendering.

## Basic usage

```html
<a-cloak></a-cloak>
```

## Component alignment

This example shows how to use **align**. It allows you to adjust the alignment of the text and spinner to the center, left, or right. For example, the first spinner is aligned to the left, the second to the center, and the third to the right.

*props: `align`*

```html
<a-cloak
  align="left"
></a-cloak>
<a-cloak
  align="center"
></a-cloak>
<a-cloak
  align="right"
></a-cloak>
```

## Text alignment

This example shows how to use **text-align**. This property allows you to align the text accompanying the loading spinner to the left or right. In the first example, the text is aligned to the left, while in the second it is aligned to the right.

*props: `text-align`*

```html
<a-cloak
  text-align="left"
></a-cloak>
<a-cloak
  text-align="right"
></a-cloak>
```

## Sizes

This example shows how to use **size** to control the sizes of both the text and loading indicator. Values range from **1** (largest) to **7** (smallest).

*props: `size`*

```html
<a-cloak
  size="1"
></a-cloak>
<a-cloak
  size="2"
></a-cloak>
<a-cloak
  size="3"
></a-cloak>
<a-cloak
  size="4"
></a-cloak>
<a-cloak
  size="5"
></a-cloak>
<a-cloak
  size="6"
></a-cloak>
<a-cloak
  size="7"
></a-cloak>
```

## Text with **extra** Parameter

This example shows how to use **text** and **extra**. The **extra** parameter allows you to dynamically change the text. In this case, the text displays the message 'Loading 1', where the number **{{ number }}** is taken from the passed **extra** object.

*props: `text`, `extra`*

```html
<a-cloak
  :extra="{ number: 1 }"
  text="_PAGE_CLOAK_TEXT_{{number}}_"
></a-cloak>
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| align | String | center |  | Defines the alignment of the text and spinner within the component. Possible values: **left**, **center**, and **right**. |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| size | String / Number | 6 |  | Defines the size of the text and loading indicator. Valid values range from **1** (largest) to **7** (smallest). |
| spinner-class | String / Number |  |  | **CSS** class for customizing the appearance of the loading indicator. |
| spinner-safe-html | String |  |  | Safe **HTML** content to be displayed inside the loading spinner. Used to customize the spinner's inner content. |
| spinner-tag | String | span |  | The **HTML** tag used for rendering the loading spinner. By default, it is **span**, but it can be changed to any other appropriate tag. |
| tag | String | div |  | **HTML** tag used to render the component. |
| text | String | _A_CLOAK_LOADING_ |  | Text that will be displayed next to the loading indicator. |
| text-align | String | right |  | Defines the alignment of the text relative to the spinner. Possible values: **left** and **right**. By default, the text is right-aligned. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_CLOAK_LOADING_` | Loading |

# AConfirm (Confirm)

AConfirm is a confirmation dialog API built on top of the modal system. Use **AConfirmAPI** to open a confirm window, pass content and button settings, and optionally control loading state, focus return, or external closing.

## Basic usage

The simplest setup: open a confirm dialog with a header, message, and save handler.

*props: `header-text`, `body-html`, `save`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_BASIC_BTN_"
  @click="openConfirmLocal"
></a-button>
```

```js
import {
  AButton,
  AConfirmAPI,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageConfirmBasic",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      closeConfirm,
      openConfirm,
    } = AConfirmAPI();

    const onSave = () => {
      closeConfirm();
    };

    const openConfirmLocal = () => {
      openConfirm({
        headerText: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_BASIC_MODAL_HEADER_",
        bodyHtml: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_BASIC_MODAL_BODY_",
        save: onSave,
      });
    };

    return {
      openConfirmLocal,
    };
  },
};
```

## Custom buttons and size

This example customizes button labels and opens the confirm dialog in a larger size.

*props: `save-button-text`, `close-button-text`, `size`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_BUTTONS_BTN_"
  @click="openConfirmLocal"
></a-button>
```

```js
import {
  AButton,
  AConfirmAPI,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageConfirmButtons",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      closeConfirm,
      openConfirm,
    } = AConfirmAPI();

    const onArchive = () => {
      closeConfirm();
    };

    const openConfirmLocal = () => {
      openConfirm({
        headerText: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_BUTTONS_MODAL_HEADER_",
        bodyHtml: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_BUTTONS_MODAL_BODY_",
        save: onArchive,
        size: "large",
        saveButtonText: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_BUTTONS_SAVE_TEXT_",
        closeButtonText: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_BUTTONS_CLOSE_TEXT_",
      });
    };

    return {
      openConfirmLocal,
    };
  },
};
```

## Returning focus after close

Use **selector-close-ids** to return focus to specific elements after the confirm dialog is closed.

*props: `selector-close-ids`, `save-button-text`*

```html
<div class="a_btn_group">
  <a-button
    id="btn_confirm_focus"
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    text="_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_FOCUS_BTN_"
    @click="openConfirmLocal"
  ></a-button>

  <a-button
    id="btn_confirm_focus_secondary"
    class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
    text="_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_FOCUS_SECONDARY_BTN_"
  ></a-button>
</div>
```

```js
import {
  AButton,
  AConfirmAPI,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageConfirmFocus",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      closeConfirm,
      openConfirm,
    } = AConfirmAPI();

    const onDelete = () => {
      closeConfirm();
    };

    const openConfirmLocal = () => {
      openConfirm({
        headerText: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_FOCUS_MODAL_HEADER_",
        bodyHtml: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_FOCUS_MODAL_BODY_",
        saveButtonText: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_FOCUS_SAVE_TEXT_",
        save: onDelete,
        selectorCloseIds: [
          "btn_confirm_focus",
          "btn_confirm_focus_secondary",
        ],
      });
    };

    return {
      openConfirmLocal,
    };
  },
};
```

## Loading state and external close

AConfirm can update its state after opening. Here the first example toggles **loading** during an async save, while the second closes the dialog from outside through the event bus.

*props: `loading`, `stop`, `selector-close`*

```html
<div class="a_btn_group">
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    text="_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_ASYNC_BTN_"
    @click="openConfirmLoading"
  ></a-button>

  <a-button
    id="btn_confirm_timeout"
    class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
    text="_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_TIMEOUT_BTN_"
    @click="openConfirmTimeout"
  ></a-button>
</div>
```

```js
import {
  AButton,
  AConfirmAPI,
  EventBus,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageConfirmAsync",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const {
      changeConfirmOptions,
      closeConfirm,
      openConfirm,
    } = AConfirmAPI();

    const onSave = () => {
      changeConfirmOptions({
        loading: true,
      });

      setTimeout(() => {
        changeConfirmOptions({
          loading: false,
        });
        closeConfirm();
      }, 1200);
    };

    const openConfirmLoading = () => {
      openConfirm({
        headerText: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_ASYNC_MODAL_HEADER_",
        bodyHtml: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_ASYNC_MODAL_BODY_",
        saveButtonText: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_ASYNC_SAVE_TEXT_",
        save: onSave,
        stop: true,
      });
    };

    const openConfirmTimeout = () => {
      openConfirm({
        headerText: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_TIMEOUT_MODAL_HEADER_",
        bodyHtml: "_A_CONFIRM_EXAMPLE_TIMEOUT_MODAL_BODY_",
        selectorClose: "#btn_confirm_timeout",
      });

      setTimeout(() => {
        EventBus.$emit("closeModalConfirm");
      }, 2500);
    };

    return {
      openConfirmLoading,
      openConfirmTimeout,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| header-text | String |  |  | The text in the modal header. |
| body-html | String | "" |  | The HTML content of the modal window. |
| save | Function |  |  | The function that enables saving in the modal. |
| close | Function |  |  | The function that enables closing the modal. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object with parameters for translations. [(ATranslation)](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/translation.md) |
| save-button-text | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_SAVE_ |  | The text on the save button. |
| close-button-text | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_CANCEL_ |  | The text on the close button. |
| selector-close | String / Array |  |  | The focus selector to ensure that focus is not lost in the browser when the modal is closed. |
| selector-close-ids | String / Array |  |  | The ID or IDs for focus to ensure that focus is not lost in the browser when the modal is closed. |
| size | String |  |  | The size of the modal (small, large, xl, xxl, fullscreen). |
| loading | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the modal is in a loading state. |
| stop | Boolean |  |  | Adds a click event with stopPropagation to the modal window's parent element to prevent the event from propagating further. |

# ADisclosure (Show/hide content)

The component allows users to show or hide text content by clicking on a button. The button toggles between "Show More" and "Show Less," depending on whether the full text content is already displayed or not.

## Basic usage

*props: `text-less`, `text-more`*

```html
<a-disclosure
  :text-less="textLess"
  :text-more="textMore"
></a-disclosure>
```

```js
import { 
  ADisclosure,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageDisclosureBasic",
  components: {
    ADisclosure,
  },
  setup() {
    const textLess = "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus.";
    const textMore = `Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent
per conubia nostra, per inceptos himenaeos. Duis pharetra luctus lacus ut 
vestibulum. Maecenas ipsum lacus, lacinia quis posuere ut, pulvinar vitae dolor.
Integer eu nibh at nisi ullamcorper sagittis id vel leo. Integer feugiat 
faucibus libero, at maximus nisl suscipit posuere. Morbi nec enim nunc. 
Phasellus bibendum turpis ut ipsum egestas, sed sollicitudin elit convallis. 
Cras pharetra mi tristique sapien vestibulum lobortis. Nam eget bibendum metus, 
non dictum mauris. Nulla at tellus sagittis, viverra est a, bibendum metus.`;

    return {
      textLess,
      textMore,
    };
  },
};
```

## Securely Displaying HTML Content

In this example, you will learn how to securely display HTML content in the component using the **html-less** and **html-more** props. These props allow you to use HTML-formatted text while implementing security measures to prevent malicious code. It utilizes the DOMPurify.sanitize() method to clean the content and ensure no harmful code is present in the displayed HTML output.

*props: `html-less`, `html-more`*

```html
<a-disclosure
  :html-less="htmlLess"
  :html-more="htmlMore"
></a-disclosure>
```

```js
import { 
  ADisclosure,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageDisclosureHtml",
  components: {
    ADisclosure,
  },
  setup() {
    const htmlLess = `<p onclick="alert('Aloha')">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna.</p>`;
    const htmlMore = `<p onclick="alert('Aloha')">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent
per conubia nostra, per inceptos himenaeos. Duis pharetra luctus lacus ut 
vestibulum. Maecenas ipsum lacus, lacinia quis posuere ut, pulvinar vitae dolor.
Integer eu nibh at nisi ullamcorper sagittis id vel leo. Integer feugiat 
faucibus libero, at maximus nisl suscipit posuere. Morbi nec enim nunc. 
Phasellus bibendum turpis ut ipsum egestas, sed sollicitudin elit convallis. 
Cras pharetra mi tristique sapien vestibulum lobortis. Nam eget bibendum metus, 
non dictum mauris. Nulla at tellus sagittis, viverra est a, bibendum metus.</p>`;

    return {
      htmlLess,
      htmlMore,
    };
  },
};
```

## Displaying Trusted HTML Content

This example explains how to safely display trusted HTML content in the component using the safe-html-less and safe-html-more props. These props allow direct display of HTML-formatted text when you are confident that the provided HTML code is trustworthy and does not contain harmful elements. Unlike the previous props (html-less and html-more), HTML content is rendered here without using DOMPurify.sanitize().

*props: `safe-html-less`, `safe-html-more`*

```html
<a-disclosure
  :safe-html-less="htmlLess"
  :safe-html-more="htmlMore"
></a-disclosure>
```

```js

    const htmlMore = `<p onclick="alert('Aloha')">Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent
per conubia nostra, per inceptos himenaeos. Duis pharetra luctus lacus ut 
vestibulum. Maecenas ipsum lacus, lacinia quis posuere ut, pulvinar vitae dolor.
Integer eu nibh at nisi ullamcorper sagittis id vel leo. Integer feugiat 
faucibus libero, at maximus nisl suscipit posuere. Morbi nec enim nunc.
```

## Using Slots for Custom Styling

This example demonstrates how to use slots to individually style the different parts of the component. It utilizes three slots: **button**, **less**, and **more** to customize the button and the underlying text sections.

*slots: `button`, `less`, `more`*

```html
<a-disclosure
  btn-text-less=""
  btn-text-more=""
>
  <template
    v-slot:button="{ isButtonVisible, isOpen }"
  >
    <span>{{ isOpen ? "Show less" : "Show more" }}</span>
  </template>
  
  <template
    v-slot:less="{ isButtonVisible, isOpen }"
  >
    <p>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus.</p>
  </template>
  
  <template
    v-slot:more="{ isButtonVisible, isOpen }"
  >
    <p>isButtonVisible: {{ isButtonVisible }}</p>
    <p>isOpen: {{ isOpen }}</p>
    <ul>
      <li>1 aloha</li>
      <li>2 aloha</li>
      <li>3 aloha</li>
      <li>4 aloha</li>
      <li>5 aloha</li>
      <li>6 aloha</li>
      <li>7 aloha</li>
      <li>8 aloha</li>
      <li>9 aloha</li>
      <li>10 aloha</li>
      <li>11 aloha</li>
      <li>12 aloha</li>
    </ul>
  </template>
</a-disclosure>
```

```js
pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent
per conubia nostra, per inceptos himenaeos. Duis pharetra luctus lacus ut 
vestibulum. Maecenas ipsum lacus, lacinia quis posuere ut, pulvinar vitae dolor.
Integer eu nibh at nisi ullamcorper sagittis id vel leo. Integer feugiat
```

## Exposes

*exposes: `buttonRef`, `containerRef`, `isOpen`, `toggleButton`*

```html
<div
  class="a_btn_group"
>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_primary"
    text="_A_DISCLOSURE_TEXT_TOGGLE_WITH_IS_OPEN_"
    @click="toggleShowWithIsOpen"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_primary"
    text="_A_DISCLOSURE_TEXT_TOGGLE_WITH_TOGGLE_BUTTON_"
    @click="toggleShowWithToggleButton"
  ></a-button>
</div>
<a-disclosure
  ref="disclosureRef"
  :text-less="textLess"
  :text-more="textMore"
></a-disclosure>
```

```js
import {
  nextTick,
  onMounted,
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AButton,
  ADisclosure,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageDisclosureExposes",
  components: {
    AButton,
    ADisclosure,
  },
  setup() {
    const textLess = "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus.";
    const textMore = `Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent
per conubia nostra, per inceptos himenaeos. Duis pharetra luctus lacus ut 
vestibulum. Maecenas ipsum lacus, lacinia quis posuere ut, pulvinar vitae dolor.
Integer eu nibh at nisi ullamcorper sagittis id vel leo. Integer feugiat 
faucibus libero, at maximus nisl suscipit posuere. Morbi nec enim nunc. 
Phasellus bibendum turpis ut ipsum egestas, sed sollicitudin elit convallis. 
Cras pharetra mi tristique sapien vestibulum lobortis. Nam eget bibendum metus, 
non dictum mauris. Nulla at tellus sagittis, viverra est a, bibendum metus.`;

    const disclosureRef = ref(undefined);

    const toggleShowWithIsOpen = () => {
      disclosureRef.value.isOpen = !disclosureRef.value.isOpen;
    };

    const toggleShowWithToggleButton = () => {
      disclosureRef.value.toggleButton();
    };

    onMounted(() => {
      disclosureRef.value.containerRef.setAttribute("class", "a_bg_gray_200");
      nextTick().then(
        () => {
          disclosureRef.value.buttonRef.$el.setAttribute("class", "a_btn a_btn_primary");
        }
      );
    });

    return {
      disclosureRef,
      textLess,
      textMore,
      toggleShowWithIsOpen,
      toggleShowWithToggleButton,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| btn-attributes | Object | {} |  | Props or HTML attributes for the "Show More/Show Less" button **(AButton)** |
| btn-class | String / Object | a_btn a_btn_link a_p_0 |  | The CSS classes for the "Show More/Show Less" button. |
| btn-icon-left-less | String |  |  | The icon displayed on the left side of the "Show Less" button. |
| btn-icon-left-more | String |  |  | The icon displayed on the left side of the "Show More" button. |
| btn-icon-right-less | String |  |  | The icon displayed on the right side of the "Show Less" button. |
| btn-icon-right-more | String |  |  | The icon displayed on the right side of the "Show More" button. |
| btn-id | String |  |  | ID for the "Show More/Show Less" button. |
| btn-parent-class | String | a_text_center |  | The CSS class for the parent element of the button. |
| btn-text-less | String | _A_DISCLOSURE_LESS_ |  | The text for the "Show Less" button. |
| btn-text-more | String | _A_DISCLOSURE_MORE_ |  | The text for the "Show More" button. |
| btn-title-less | String |  |  | The title text for the "Show Less" button. |
| btn-title-more | String |  |  | The title text for the "Show More" button. |
| btn-title-placement | String |  |  | The placement of the HTML title. |
| disabled | Boolean | false |  | A boolean value indicating whether the "Show More/Show Less" button should be disabled. |
| html-less | String |  |  | A string containing the shorter HTML-formatted text content to be displayed when the user clicks "Show Less." This content is secured using DOMPurify.sanitize() to prevent malicious code. |
| html-more | String |  |  | A string containing the longer HTML-formatted text content to be displayed when the user clicks "Show More." This content is secured using DOMPurify.sanitize() to prevent malicious code. |
| id | String |  |  | ID for the component. |
| is-btn-title-html | Boolean |  |  | A boolean value indicating whether the provided button titles should be interpreted and rendered as HTML. |
| is-open-default | Boolean | false |  | A boolean value indicating whether the extended text content **(text-more)** should be displayed by default. |
| safe-html-less | String |  |  | A string containing the shorter HTML-formatted text content to be displayed when the user clicks "Show Less." Note that this content is rendered directly and should only be used when you are confident that the HTML code is trustworthy and poses no security risks. |
| safe-html-more | String |  |  | A string containing the longer HTML-formatted text content to be displayed when the user clicks "Show More." Note that this content is rendered directly and should only be used when you are confident that the HTML code is trustworthy and poses no security risks. |
| show-less | Boolean | true |  | A boolean value indicating whether the "Show Less" button should be displayed. |
| show-more | Boolean | true |  | A boolean value indicating whether the "Show More" button should be displayed. |
| text-less | String |  |  | The shorter text content to be displayed when the user clicks "Show Less." |
| text-more | String |  |  | The longer text content to be displayed when the user clicks "Show More." |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| button | Here, you can customize the content of the "Show More/Show Less" button. You have access to the values **isButtonVisible** and **isOpen**, which provide information about the button's visibility and current state. |
| less | This slot allows you to customize the shorter text content displayed when the user clicks "Show Less." You have access to the values **isButtonVisible** and **isOpen**, which provide information about the button's visibility and current state. |
| more | This slot allows you to customize the longer text content displayed when the user clicks "Show More." You have access to the values **isButtonVisible** and **isOpen**, which provide information about the button's visibility and current state. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| toggle | Function | This event is triggered when the user clicks the "Show More/Show Less" button. It returns an object containing information about the current state of the component, including **isOpen**. |

## Exposes

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| buttonRef | Object | A Ref object pointing to the DOM element of the "Show More/Show Less" button in the component. This allows you to manipulate the button element directly or access events such as clicks. |
| containerRef | Object | A Ref object pointing to the DOM element of the container element of the component. This can be useful for controlling the container element or accessing its properties. |
| isOpen | Boolean | A boolean value indicating whether the extended text content is currently displayed (true) or not (false). You can use this value to monitor the state of the component and respond accordingly. |
| toggleButton | Function | A function that can be called to toggle the state of the component, thereby showing or hiding the extended text content. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_DISCLOSURE_MORE_` | Show more |
| `_A_DISCLOSURE_LESS_` | Show less |

# AFilters (Filters)

Allows filtering data by various criteria.

## Filters Component

The Filters component allows users to filter data by various criteria.

*props: `filters`, `v-model:applied-model`, `v-model:unapplied-model`*

```html
<a-filters
  :filters="filters"
  v-model:applied-model="appliedModel"
  v-model:unapplied-model="unappliedModel"
>
</a-filters>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AFilters,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageFiltersExample",
  components: {
    AFilters,
  },
  setup() {
    const filters = [
      {
        type: "text",
        id: "search",
        label: "_A_PAGE_FILTER_SEARCH_",
        main: true,

      {
        type: "text",

        alwaysVisible: true,

        type: "date",
        id: "date",
        label: "_A_PAGE_FILTER_DATE_",
        alwaysVisible: true,
      },
    ];

    const appliedModel = ref({});
    const unappliedModel = ref({});

      appliedModel,
      filters,
      unappliedModel,
    };
  },
};
```

| `--a_filter_hor_max_width` |  | Maximum width of the filter dropdown. |
| `--a_filter_max_height` |  | Maximum height of the filter dropdown. |
| `--a_filter_hor_padding_x` |  | Horizontal padding inside the filter dropdown. |
| `--a_filter_hor_padding_y` |  | Vertical padding inside the filter dropdown. |
| `--a_filter_hor_body_max_height` |  | Maximum height of the scrollable body of the filter dropdown. |
| `--a_filter_hor_footer_bg` |  | Background of the sticky footer of the filter dropdown (translucent). |
| `--a_filter_hor_footer_actions_bg` |  | Background behind the footer buttons. |
| `--a_table_filters_center_padding` |  | Padding of the list of selected filters between the filter panel and the table. |
