# ADropdown (Dropdown)

The ADropdown component is a dropdown component for Vue.js that allows you to display a list of actions in a dropdown menu. This documentation provides information on how to use the component and describes the available props.

## Basic usage

*props: `actions`*

```html
<a-dropdown
  :actions="dropdownActions"
></a-dropdown>
```

```js
import { 
  ADropdown,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageDropdownBasic",
  components: {
    ADropdown,
  },
  setup() {
    const dropdownActions = [
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_0_",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_1_",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
    ];

    return {
      dropdownActions,
    };
  },
};
```

## Customizable Button Text

This documentation describes the **button-text** prop, which allows you to customize the text of the dropdown button.

*props: `button-text`*

```html
<a-dropdown
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_EXAMPLE_"
></a-dropdown>
<a-dropdown
  class="a_ml_2"
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_NUMBER_"
></a-dropdown>
<a-dropdown
  class="a_ml_2"
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  :button-text="{ desktop: '_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_DESKTOP_', mobile: '_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_MOBILE_' }"
></a-dropdown>
```

```js
import { 
  ADropdown,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageDropdownButtonText",
  components: {
    ADropdown,
  },
  setup() {
    const dropdownActions = [
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_0_",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_1_",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
    ];

    return {
      dropdownActions,
    };
  },
};
```

## Customizable Button Class

The class of the dropdown button can be customized using the **button-class** prop.

*props: `button-text`*

```html
<a-dropdown
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
></a-dropdown>
<a-dropdown
  class="a_ml_2"
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-class="a_btn a_btn_success"
></a-dropdown>
<a-dropdown
  class="a_ml_2"
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-class="a_btn a_btn_info"
></a-dropdown>
```

```js
import { 
  ADropdown,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageDropdownButtonClass",
  components: {
    ADropdown,
  },
  setup() {
    const dropdownActions = [
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_0_",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_1_",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
    ];

    return {
      dropdownActions,
    };
  },
};
```

## Hide empty groups

Groups that do not contain visible actions are not rendered. This is useful when actions are hidden dynamically using the **isHidden** flag.

*props: `actions, key-group`*

```html
<a-one-checkbox
  v-model="isDevelopmentVisible"
  :is-width-auto="true"
  label="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_TOGGLE_DEVELOPMENT_"
></a-one-checkbox>

<a-one-checkbox
  v-model="isSettingsVisible"
  :is-width-auto="true"
  label="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_TOGGLE_SETTINGS_"
></a-one-checkbox>

<a-dropdown
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  :key-group="['group', 'section']"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_HIDE_EMPTY_GROUPS_"
></a-dropdown>
```

```js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ADropdown,
} from "aloha-vue";
import AOneCheckbox from "../../../../../../src/ui/AOneCheckbox/AOneCheckbox";

export default {
  name: "PageDropdownGroupHideEmpty",
  components: {
    ADropdown,
    AOneCheckbox,
  },
  setup() {
    const isDevelopmentVisible = ref(true);
    const isSettingsVisible = ref(true);

    const dropdownActions = computed(() => {
      return [
        {
          text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_INVOICES_",
          type: "button",
          group: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_BUSINESS_",
          section: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_FINANCE_",
          callback: () => {},
        },
        {
          text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_MESSAGES_",
          type: "button",
          group: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_COMMUNICATION_",
          section: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_INBOX_",
          callback: () => {},
        },
        {
          text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_FRONTEND_BOARD_",
          type: "button",
          group: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_DEVELOPMENT_",
          section: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_PROJECTS_",
          callback: () => {},
          isHidden: !isDevelopmentVisible.value,
        },
        {
          text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_DEPLOYMENTS_",
          type: "button",
          group: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_DEVELOPMENT_",
          section: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_RELEASE_",
          callback: () => {},
          isHidden: !isDevelopmentVisible.value,
        },
        {
          text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_USERS_",
          type: "button",
          group: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_SETTINGS_",
          section: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_ACCESS_",
          callback: () => {},
          isHidden: !isSettingsVisible.value,
        },
        {
          text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_SECURITY_",
          type: "button",
          group: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_SETTINGS_",
          section: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_WORKSPACE_",
          callback: () => {},
          isHidden: !isSettingsVisible.value,
        },
      ];
    });

    return {
      dropdownActions,
      isDevelopmentVisible,
      isSettingsVisible,
    };
  },
};
```

## Custom group sorting

Use **sort-order-group** to control the order of group headings and **key-group-label-callback** to customize group labels.

*props: `key-group, key-group-label-callback, sort-order-group`*

```html
<a-dropdown
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  :key-group-label-callback="groupLabelCallback"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_ASC_GROUPS_"
  key-group="priority"
  sort-order-group="asc"
></a-dropdown>

<a-dropdown
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  :key-group-label-callback="groupLabelCallback"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_DESC_GROUPS_"
  class="a_ml_4"
  key-group="priority"
  sort-order-group="desc"
></a-dropdown>
```

```js
import {
  ADropdown,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageDropdownGroupSort",
  components: {
    ADropdown,
  },
  setup() {
    const dropdownActions = [
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_DEPLOY_NOW_",
        type: "button",
        priority: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_PRIORITY_MEDIUM_",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_RESTART_WORKER_",
        type: "button",
        priority: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_PRIORITY_CRITICAL_",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_ARCHIVE_REPORT_",
        type: "button",
        priority: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_PRIORITY_LOW_",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_SYNC_CONTACTS_",
        type: "button",
        priority: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_PRIORITY_NORMAL_",
        callback: () => {},
      },
    ];

    const groupLabelCallback = ({ group }) => {
      const labels = {
        _A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_PRIORITY_CRITICAL_: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_LABEL_PRIORITY_CRITICAL_",
        _A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_PRIORITY_LOW_: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_LABEL_PRIORITY_LOW_",
        _A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_PRIORITY_MEDIUM_: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_LABEL_PRIORITY_MEDIUM_",
        _A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_PRIORITY_NORMAL_: "_A_DROPDOWN_GROUP_LABEL_PRIORITY_NORMAL_",
      };

      return labels[group] || group;
    };

    return {
      dropdownActions,
      groupLabelCallback,
    };
  },
};
```

## Close When Trigger Leaves Viewport

Open a dropdown and scroll the container so its button leaves the visible area. With **is-close-by-button-invisible-in-viewport** set to **true**, the dropdown closes automatically; with **false**, it stays open.

*props: `is-close-by-button-invisible-in-viewport`*

```html
<div
  style="max-height: 14rem; overflow: auto; padding: 1rem;"
>
  <div style="height: 26rem;">
    <p>
      <a-translation
        tag="span"
        text="_A_DROPDOWN_SCROLL_HELP_"
      ></a-translation>
    </p>

    <div style="margin-top: 6rem;">
      <a-dropdown
        :actions="dropdownActions"
        :is-close-by-button-invisible-in-viewport="true"
        button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_CLOSE_ON_INVISIBLE_TRUE_"
      ></a-dropdown>
    </div>

    <div style="margin-top: 6rem;">
      <a-dropdown
        :actions="dropdownActions"
        :is-close-by-button-invisible-in-viewport="false"
        button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_CLOSE_ON_INVISIBLE_FALSE_"
      ></a-dropdown>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
import {
  ADropdown,
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageDropdownCloseByButtonInvisibleInViewport",
  components: {
    ADropdown,

  },

        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_0_",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_1_",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "_A_DROPDOWN_ACTION_2_",
        type: "button",

      dropdownActions,
    };
  },
};
```

## Customizable Dropdown Triggers

The ADropdown component for Vue.js provides the ability to customize the triggers for the dropdown. This documentation describes the **triggers** prop, which defines the array of triggers.

*props: `triggers`*

```html
<a-dropdown
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_TRIGGER_CLICK_"
  :triggers="['click']"
></a-dropdown>
<a-dropdown
  class="a_ml_2"
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_TRIGGER_FOCUS_"
  :triggers="['focus']"
></a-dropdown>
<a-dropdown
  class="a_ml_2"
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_TRIGGER_HOVER_"
  :triggers="['hover']"
></a-dropdown>
<a-dropdown
  class="a_ml_2"
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_TRIGGER_CLICK_FOCUS_"
  :triggers="['click', 'focus']"
></a-dropdown>
<a-dropdown
  class="a_ml_2"
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_TRIGGER_CLICK_HOVER_"
  :triggers="['click', 'hover']"
></a-dropdown>
<a-dropdown
  class="a_ml_2"
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_TRIGGER_FOCUS_HOVER_"
  :triggers="['focus', 'hover']"
></a-dropdown>
<a-dropdown
  class="a_ml_2"
  :actions="dropdownActions"
  button-text="_A_DROPDOWN_BUTTON_TEXT_TRIGGER_CLICK_FOCUS_HOVER_"
  :triggers="['click', 'focus', 'hover']"
></a-dropdown>
```

```js
        type: "button",
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| actions | Array | () => [] |  | A list of actions to choose from. |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| button-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Additional attributes for customizing the dropdown button. The attributes are passed as an object containing the names of the desired attributes and their corresponding values. |
| button-class | String / Object | a_btn a_btn_secondary |  | Specifies an additional class for the dropdown button. |
| button-icon-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Additional attributes for the dropdown button icon. The attributes are passed as an object containing the names of the desired attributes and their corresponding values. |
| button-icon-class | String |  |  | Specifies an additional class for the dropdown button icon. |
| button-icon-left | String / Object |  |  | Defines the icon on the left side of the dropdown button. The icon name is passed as a string, or different icons for different devices can be defined as an object. |
| button-icon-right | String / Object |  |  | Defines the icon on the right side of the dropdown button. The icon name is passed as a string, or different icons for different devices can be defined as an object. |
| button-icon-tag | String |  |  | Specifies a custom HTML tag for the dropdown button icon. |
| button-is-title-html | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the tooltip displayed on mouse hover over the link will be in plain text or HTML format. |
| button-loading | Boolean | false |  | Displays a loading indicator on the dropdown button. |
| button-loading-align | String | right |  | CSS positioning of the loading indicator on the dropdown button. |
| button-loading-class | String / Object | a_spinner_small |  | CSS class for the dropdown button loading indicator. |
| button-prevent | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the default behavior of event handlers for the dropdown button will be prevented. |
| button-stop | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether further event propagation for the dropdown button will be stopped. |
| button-tag | String | button |  | Specifies the HTML tag to be used for the dropdown button. |
| button-text | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | A string or object containing the dropdown button text for different devices. The keys 'mobile' and 'desktop' are used to define the appropriate text for each device. |
| button-text-aria-hidden | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the dropdown button text will be hidden from screen readers. |
| button-text-class | String |  |  | CSS class for the dropdown button text. |
| button-text-screen-reader | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Dropdown button text for screen readers. |
| button-title | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | One or more additional pieces of information that will be displayed when hovering over the dropdown button. |
| button-title-placement | String | top |  | The position relative to the dropdown button where the tooltip will be displayed. It only works if is-title-html is set to true. |
| caret-icon | String | ChevronDown |  | Caret icon next to the dropdown button. The default is a downward arrow. |
| class | String / Object |  |  | Additional CSS class for the dropdown menu. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Indicator of a disabled state. |
| dropdown-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Additional dropdown attributes that are not defined as props. |
| dropdown-class | String |  |  | Additional CSS class for the dropdown menu. |
| dropdown-render-default | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the dropdown menu will initially be open. The default value is false. |
| dropdown-tag | String | ul |  | Specifies the HTML tag to be used for dropdown menu elements. The default value is ul. |
| elements-for-arrows | String | a[href]:not([tabindex='-1']), button:not([disabled]):not([tabindex='-1']), area[href]:not([tabindex='-1']), input:not([disabled]):not([tabindex='-1']), select:not([disabled]):not([tabindex='-1']), textarea:not([disabled]):not([tabindex='-1']), iframe:not([tabindex='-1']), [tabindex]:not([tabindex='-1']), [contentEditable=true]:not([tabindex='-1']) |  | Defines the elements that can be navigated with the arrows within the drop-down menu. |
| extra | Object |  |  | Additional values used for insertion into translations. |
| key-group | String / Number / Array |  |  | A field name or an array of field names used to group actions. Arrays create nested groups. |
| key-group-label-callback | Function |  |  | Callback for customizing the displayed label of a group. |
| floating-flip | Object | () => ({}) |  | Configuration for the flip function. It optimizes the visibility of the dropdown menu by changing its position along the x-axis to keep it in view when the preferred position is out of bounds. |
| floating-shift | Object | () => ({ use: true, crossAxis: true, padding: 20 }) |  | Configuration for the shift function. It optimizes the visibility of the dropdown menu by changing its position along the y-axis to keep it in view when the preferred position is out of bounds. |
| has-caret | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether there is an icon next to the dropdown button. The default value is true. |
| id | String | () => uniqueId("a_dropdown_btn_") |  | Specifies a unique ID for the HTML element corresponding to the dropdown menu. |
| in-body | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the content of the dropdown menu is generated in the body or immediately after the dropdown button. |
| is-close-by-click-inside | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the component will close when the user clicks inside it. |
| is-close-by-click-outside | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the component will close when the user clicks outside it. |
| is-close-by-button-invisible-in-viewport | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the dropdown closes automatically when its trigger button leaves the visible viewport of the scrollable area. |
| is-hide-without-action-and-slot | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the dropdown menu will exist at all if there are no selectable options or defined slots. |
| is-list-width-same-with-button | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the width of the dropdown button is the same as the width of the selection list. |
| lock-arrows-navigation | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether arrow key navigation within the dropdown menu is allowed. |
| lock-tab-navigation | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether Tab key navigation within the dropdown menu is allowed. |
| menu-width | Number |  |  | Sets a fixed width for the dropdown menu in pixels. |
| persist | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the dropdown menu will remain open after the user interacts with other elements until explicitly closed. |
| placement | String | bottom-start |  | The position at which the dropdown menu will open. |
| popper-container-id | String | a_tooltip_container |  | ID of the container element that holds the dropdown menu options. |
| readonly | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the dropdown button is in a readonly state without hover or focus effects. |
| sort-order-group | String |  |  | Controls sorting of group labels. Possible values: **asc** and **desc**. |
| triggers | Array | () => ["click"] |  | A list of events that trigger the opening or closing of the dropdown menu. |
| use-escape | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the Esc key can be used to close the dropdown menu. |
| use-rem | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the **menu-width** value should be scaled according to the root font size before being applied. |

| --- | --- | --- |

| `--a_dropdown_bg` |  | Background of the menu. |
| `--a_dropdown_border_color` |  | Border color of the menu. |
| `--a_dropdown_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of the menu. |
| `--a_dropdown_border_width` |  | Border width of the menu. |
| `--a_dropdown_box_shadow` |  | Shadow of the menu. |
| `--a_dropdown_divider_color` |  | Color of a divider between items. |
| `--a_dropdown_divider_margin_y` |  | Space above and below a divider. |
| `--a_dropdown_link_color` |  | Text color of an item. |
| `--a_dropdown_link_hover_color` |  | Text color of a hovered item. |
| `--a_dropdown_link_hover_bg` |  | Background of a hovered item. |
| `--a_dropdown_link_active_color` |  | Text color of the active (selected or pressed) item. |

| `--a_dropdown_link_disabled_color` |  | Text color of a disabled item. |
| `--a_dropdown_item_padding_x` |  | Horizontal padding of an item. |
| `--a_dropdown_item_padding_y` |  | Vertical padding of an item. |
| `--a_dropdown_item_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of an item. |
| `--a_dropdown_header_color` |  | Text color of a header or group label. |

# AElement (Element)

The **AElement** component is a universal element with advanced configuration through props, allowing customization of accessibility, classes, IDs, loading state, and other parameters. It supports styling, text, icons, and event handling such as click, making it a powerful tool for building interfaces.

## Basic usage

There are several types you can use with the element: **button**, **link**, **text**, **submit**, and **reset**.

*props: `type`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>
  <a-element
    :to="{ name: 'PageLink' }"
    class="a_btn a_btn_link"
    text="link"
    type="link"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    text="button"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('button')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :prevent="true"
    :stop="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
    text="submit"
    type="submit"
    @click="onAlert('submit')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_tertiary"
    text="reset"
    type="reset"
    @click="onAlert('reset')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    text="text"
    type="text"
  ></a-element>
</div>
```

```js
import { 
  AElement,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageElementBasic",
  components: {
    AElement,
  },
  setup() {
    const onAlert = type => {
      alert(type);
    };
    
     return {
      onAlert,
    };
  },
};
```

## Outline elements

```html
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_secondary"
    text="outline-secondary"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('outline-secondary')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_tertiary"

    @click="onAlert('outline-tertiary')"
  ></a-element>
```

## Using icon properties

The **AElement** component allows displaying icons to the left and right of the element using the "**:icon-left**" and "**:icon-right**" properties. You can define different icons for different devices to achieve a customized look.

*props: `icon-left`, `icon-right`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    icon-left="Upload"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('icon-left')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    icon-left="Upload"
    text="Aloha"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('icon-left & text')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    icon-right="Upload"
    text="Aloha"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('icon-right & text')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    icon-left="Upload"
    icon-right="Upload"
    text="Aloha"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('icon-left & text & icon-right')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    icon-left="Upload"
    icon-right="Upload"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('icon-left & icon-right')"
  ></a-element>
</div>
```

## Inactive element using **aria-disabled**

The **AElement** component allows rendering an element in an inactive state and setting the appropriate accessibility attributes. To do this, use the "**aria-disabled**" property to indicate the disabled state. This allows events such as focus or hover to work while keeping the element inactive for clicks.

*props: `aria-disabled`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    text="primary"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('primary')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
    text="secondary"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('secondary')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_tertiary"
    text="tertiary"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('tertiary')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_success"
    text="success"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('success')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_info"
    text="info"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('info')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_warning"
    text="warning"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('warning')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_danger"
    text="danger"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('danger')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_dark"
    text="dark"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('dark')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_light"
    text="light"
    type="button"
    @click="onAlert('light')"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    :is-switch="true"
    text="switch"
    type="button"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    :is-switch="true"
    :model-switch="true"
    text="switch active"
    type="button"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    :aria-disabled="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_primary"
```

## Element in loading state and loading indicator alignment

The **AElement** component allows showing the element in a loading state with a loading indicator. You can also specify the alignment of the loading indicator. This is useful for representing a background process that requires the user to wait.

*props: `loading`, `loading-align`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    :loading="loading"
    loading-align="left"
    text="loading-align="left""
    type="button"
    @click="toggleLoading"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    :loading="loading"
    loading-align="right"
    text="loading-align="right""
    type="button"
    @click="toggleLoading"
  ></a-element>
</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AElement,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageElementLoading",
  components: {
    AElement,
  },
  setup() {
    const loading = ref(true);

    const toggleLoading = () => {
      loading.value = !loading.value;
    };
    
    return {
      loading,
      toggleLoading,
    };
  },
};
```

## Additional text inside the element

The **AElement** component allows displaying additional text inside the element. This can be useful for adding predefined text before or after the main text of the element.

*props: `text-after`, `text-before`*

```html
<a-element
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_SHOW_MORE_MORE_"
  text-after=" €"
  text-before="$ "
  type="button"
></a-element>
```

## Changing the text tag in the **AElement** component

This example shows how to configure the tag for the text in the **AElement** component in **Vue.js**. By default, the text is rendered inside a **span** tag. However, using the **text-tag** prop, the tag can be customized to use other **HTML** tags such as **strong**, **em**, or others.

*props: `text-tag`*

```html
<a-element
  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
  text="Aloha"
  text-tag="strong"
  type="button"
></a-element>
```

## Using safe **HTML** content as a string inside the element

The **AElement** component allows using safe **HTML** content as a string inside the element. When the "**safe-html**" property is enabled and an **HTML** string is passed, the provided **HTML** content is trusted and inserted directly using the **JavaScript** "**innerHTML**" attribute.

*props: `safe-html`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    safe-html="_A_ELEMENT_EXAMPLE_HTML_"
    type="button"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    safe-html="<span onclick='alert("Aloha")'>Aloha</button>"
    type="button"
  ></a-element>
</div>
```

## Safe display of **HTML** content using **DomPurify**

The **AElement** component allows safely rendering **HTML** content without fully trusting it. Using the "**html**" property and the **DomPurify** library, the provided **HTML** content is sanitized and safely displayed inside the element.

*props: `html`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_d_flex a_flex_wrap a_align_items_start gap_1"
>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    html="_A_ELEMENT_EXAMPLE_HTML_"
    type="button"
  ></a-element>
  <a-element
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    html="<span onclick='alert("Aloha")'>Aloha</span>"
    type="button"
  ></a-element>
</div>
```

## Configuring text for different devices

The **AElement** component allows you to configure the element text for different devices. Using the "**:text**" prop as an object, you can specify different text for mobile and desktop devices.

*props: `text (as object)`*

```html
<a-element
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  :text="{ mobile: 'Aloha', desktop: 'Aloha-desktop' }"
  type="button"
></a-element>
```

## Combining multiple titles into a single attribute

The **AElement** component allows you to combine multiple titles in one attribute. Using the "**:title**" prop as an array, you can specify multiple elements that will be merged into a single title for the element.

*props: `title (as array)`*

```html
<a-element
  :title="['Aloha', '$(Aloha)']"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="Aloha"
  type="button"
></a-element>
```

## Using the **props** "stop" to stop event propagation

Setting the **props** "stop" to a boolean value can be used to control whether the event should propagate. The example shows two scenarios: one with "stop" set to **true** and the other with **false**.

*props: `stop`*

```html
<div
  @click="showAlert"
>
  <a-element
    :stop="true"
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    text="stopPropagation: :stop="true""
    type="button"
  ></a-element>
</div>
<div
  class="a_mt_4"
  @click="showAlert"
>
  <a-element
    :stop="false"
    class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
    text="stopPropagation: :stop="false""
    type="button"
  ></a-element>
</div>
```

```js
import { 
  AElement,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageElementStop",
  components: {
    AElement,
  },
  setup() {
    const showAlert = () => {
      alert("Aloha");
    };

    return {
      showAlert,
    };
  },
};
```

## Using the default slot

The **AElement** component allows placing custom content inside the element using the default slot "**:slots='default'**". Content placed in this slot will be displayed inside the element.

*slots: `default`*

```html
<a-element
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  type="text"
>
  <span>(Aloha)</span>
</a-element>
```

## Using the "**buttonPrepend**" slot

The **AElement** component allows rendering additional content before the element's text using the "**buttonPrepend**" slot. Content placed in this slot will appear before the element's text.

*slots: `buttonPrepend`*

```html
<a-element
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="Aloha"
  type="text"
>
  <template
    v-slot:buttonPrepend
  >
    <span>(***)</span>
  </template>
</a-element>
```

## Using the "**buttonAppend**" slot

The **AElement** component allows rendering additional content after the element's text using the "**buttonAppend**" slot. Content placed in this slot will appear after the element's text.

*slots: `buttonAppend`*

```html
<a-element
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="Aloha"
  type="text"
>
  <template
    v-slot:buttonAppend
  >
    <span>(***)</span>
  </template>
</a-element>
```

## Using the "**buttonTitle**" slot for the **HTML** title

The **AElement** component allows specifying custom **HTML** content for the element's title using the "**buttonTitle**" slot in combination with the "**:is-title-html**" attribute. Content placed in this slot will be used as the **HTML** title of the element.

*props: `is-title-html`; slots: `buttonTitle`*

```html
<a-element
  :is-title-html="true"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="Aloha"
  type="text"
>
  <template
    v-slot:buttonTitle
  >
    <strong>(***Aloha***)</strong>
  </template>
</a-element>
```

## Using the element in switch mode

The **AElement** component allows using the element as a switch with two states (on/off). Using the "**:is-switch**" and "**:model-switch**" attributes, you can enable switch mode and control the element's state. The element is rendered as a **button** tag with the **aria-pressed** attribute indicating its state.

*props: `is-switch`, `model-switch`*

```html
<a-element
  :is-switch="true"
  :model-switch="modelSwitch"
  text="(***)"
  type="button"
  @click="toggleModelSwitch"
></a-element>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AElement,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageElementSwitch",
  components: {
    AElement,
  },
  setup() {
    const modelSwitch = ref(false);

    const toggleModelSwitch = () => {
      modelSwitch.value = !modelSwitch.value;
    };

    return {
      modelSwitch,
      toggleModelSwitch,
    };
  },
};
```

## Using advanced properties and events

The **AElement** component allows using various advanced properties and events for configuring and managing the element. The following example demonstrates several properties and events used to configure the element and manage its loading state.

*props: `class`, `loading`, `loading-align`, `text`, `text-before`, `icon-left`, `icon-right`, `title`, `text-aria-hidden`, `text-screen-reader`*

```html
<a-element
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  :icon-left="{ desktop: 'EyeFill', mobile: 'EyeSlash' }"
  :icon-right="{ mobile: 'EyeSlash' }"
  :loading="loading"
  :text-aria-hidden="true"
  :text-before="{ desktop: '$ ' }"
  :text-screen-reader="{ desktop: 'Aloha', mobile: 'Aloha-mobile' }"
  :text="{ desktop: 'Aloha' }"
  :title="{ desktop: 'Aloha' }"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  loading-align="left"
  type="button"
  @click="toggleLoading"
></a-element>
```

```js
import {

  AElement,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageElementComplex",

    AElement,
  },

    const loading = ref(true);

    const toggleLoading = () => {
      loading.value = !loading.value;
    };
    
    return {
      loading,
      toggleLoading,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| aria-disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the element is inactive. If set to **true**, the element will appear as inactive, and the "**aria-disabled**" accessibility attribute will be added. |
| aria-label | String / Number / Object |  |  | Defines the **ARIA** label for the element. You can use a string, number, or object as the value to set the desired label. |
| attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Specifies additional attributes for the element. You can use an object to define the required attributes and their values. |
| class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class |
| class-default | String | a_element |  | Sets the default style class for the element, establishing its general visual style. |
| class-default-hidden | String | a_element__hidden |  | Defines the class used to hide the element, used for managing its visibility in different contexts. |
| class-disabled | String | disabled |  | Specifies the **CSS** class applied when the element is disabled. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the element is disabled. If set to **true**, the element will be non-interactive. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | Additional object for translation |
| extraData | Any |  |  | Provides additional data for all slots of the component, allowing you to pass custom data and information for flexible and detailed slot customization. |
| href | String |  |  | Specifies the URL of the page the link goes to. |
| html | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | **HTML** content to be rendered inside the element. |
| html-screen-reader | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Defines **HTML** content for screen reader accessibility. You can use a string, number, or object to specify the desired **HTML** content. |
| icon-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Defines additional attributes for icons. You can use an object to specify the necessary attributes and their values for icons. |
| icon-class | String / Object |  |  | Specifies an additional **CSS** class for the icons. |
| icon-left | String / Object |  |  | Defines the icon displayed to the left of the element. You can specify the icon name as a string or provide different icons for different devices as an object. |
| icon-right | String / Object |  |  | Defines the icon displayed to the right of the element. You can specify the icon name as a string or provide different icons for different devices as an object. |
| icon-tag | String |  |  | Defines a custom **HTML** tag for the icons. |
| id | String | () => uniqueId("a_element_") |  | Defines a unique ID for the element. If not specified, a unique ID will be automatically generated. |
| is-switch | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the element should be used as a switch. If set to **true**, the element will be rendered as a toggle. |
| is-title-html | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the title should be interpreted as **HTML**. If set to **true**, the title will be rendered as **HTML**. |
| loading | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the element is in a loading state. If set to **true**, a loading indicator will be shown. |
| loading-align | String | right |  | Defines the alignment of the loading indicator. Accepts values "**left**" or "**right**". |
| loading-class | String / Object | a_spinner_small |  | Specifies the **CSS** class used when the element is in a loading state. Accepts a string or an object for different state styles. |
| model-switch | Boolean |  |  | The model value that controls the toggle state of the element. If set to **true**, the element is active (**pressed=true**); otherwise, it is inactive (**pressed=false**). |
| prevent-keyboard-repeat | Boolean | false |  | Prevents repeated activation while a keyboard key is held down. When enabled, repeated **Enter** and **Space** key events are ignored after the first press. |
| prevent | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether to prevent the default behavior of event handlers for the element (**preventDefault**). |
| safe-html | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Enables trust for the provided **HTML** string, allowing it to be rendered inside the element. |
| safe-html-screen-reader | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Defines safe **HTML** content for screen reader regions. Accepts a string, number, or object for different states. |
| stop | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether to stop event propagation (**stopPropagation**). |
| tabindex | Number / String |  |  | Defines the **tabindex** value for the element. Can be a number or a string. |
| tag | String |  |  | Specifies the **HTML** tag to be used for rendering the element. |
| target | String |  |  | Specifies where the linked content will be open after clicking the link. |
| text | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | String or object containing text for different devices. Use the keys "**mobile**" and "**desktop**" to set respective texts. |
| text-after | String / Number / Object |  |  | Defines the text to be displayed after the main element text. |
| text-aria-hidden | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the element's text should be marked as **aria-hidden="true"**. |
| text-before | String / Number / Object |  |  | Defines the text to be displayed before the main element text. |
| text-class | String |  |  | Specifies the **CSS** class to be applied to the element’s text. |
| text-screen-reader | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Defines the text to be read by a **screen reader**. |
| text-tag | String | span |  | This prop allows customizing the **HTML** tag used to wrap the text inside the element. |
| title | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | String or array of elements that will be merged into a single title. |
| title-attributes | Object | {} |  | Provides an object for configuring additional **HTML** attributes for the element's title, allowing more detailed control over its behavior and style. |
| title-placement | String | top |  | Positioning of the **HTML** title. |
| title-z-index | String / Number | auto |  | Sets the **z-index** for the element's title to define its stacking order among overlapping elements. |
| to | Object / String |  |  | Internal link to another component by using Vue Router. |
| type | String | text |  | Specifies the element type. Allowed values: **button**, **link**, **text**, **submit**, and **reset**. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| buttonAppend | Slot containing content to be rendered after the element’s text. |
| buttonPrepend | Slot containing content to be rendered before the element’s text. |
| buttonTitle | Slot that contains **HTML** content to be used as the element’s title. |
| default | Default slot that contains content for the element. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| click | Function | Triggered when the component is clicked. |

# ACheckbox (Checkboxes)

The **ACheckbox** component provides an interface for creating a group of checkboxes, allowing users to select multiple options from a list. The component supports various settings such as collapsible groups, button group display, search functionality, and many more.

## Basic usage

*props: `data`, `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  label="Aloha"
></a-checkbox>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ACheckbox,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageCheckboxBasic",
  components: {
    ACheckbox,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        value: "aloha_1",
        label: "Aloha 1",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_2",
        label: "Aloha 2",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_3",
        label: "Aloha 3",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_4",
        label: "Aloha 4",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref([]);
    
    return {
      data,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-checkbox
  :change="changeModel"
  :data="data"
  :model-value="model"
  label="Aloha"
></a-checkbox>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ACheckbox,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageCheckboxChange",
  components: {
    ACheckbox,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        value: "aloha_1",
        label: "Aloha 1",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_2",
        label: "Aloha 2",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_3",
        label: "Aloha 3",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_4",
        label: "Aloha 4",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref([]);
    
    const changeModel = ({ model: _model, id, props }) => {
      model.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel,
      data,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Item grouping

This example demonstrates how to use **key-group** and **key-group-label-callback** to group items and set group names in the component. In the first case, simple grouping by **alohaBR** and **aloha** keys is used. In the second example, the **key-group-label-callback** callback function is additionally applied to dynamically determine group names based on the data.

*props: `key-group`, `key-group-label-callback`*

```html
<a-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :key-group="['alohaBR', 'aloha']"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="key-group"
></a-checkbox>
<a-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :key-group="['alohaBR', 'aloha']"
  :key-group-label-callback="onGroupLabelCallback"
  class="a_mt_3"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="key-group + key-group-callback"
></a-checkbox>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ACheckbox,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageCheckboxGroup",
  components: {
    ACheckbox,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        label: "Aloha 0",
        id: "aloha_0",
        aloha: "",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 1",
        id: "aloha_1",
        aloha: "Buba",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 2",
        id: "aloha_2",
        aloha: "Buba",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 3",
        id: "aloha_3",
        aloha: "Sandra",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 4",
        id: "aloha_4",
        aloha: "Sandra",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 5",
        id: "aloha_5",
        aloha: "Coco",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 6",
        id: "aloha_6",
        aloha: "Coco",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 7",
        id: "aloha_7",
        aloha: "Alex",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 8",
        id: "aloha_8",
        aloha: "Alex",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref(undefined);
    
    const onGroupLabelCallback = ({ group, item }) => {
      if (group === "_not_grouped") {
        return "---";
      }

      if (group === "Alex") {
        return `-${ group }-`;
      }

      return group;
    };

    return {
      data,
      model,
      onGroupLabelCallback,
    };
  },
};
```

## Retrieve invalid entries

```js
import {

} from "vue";

import {
  ACheckbox,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageCheckboxRetrieve",
  components: {
    ACheckbox,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(["aloha_2", "aloha_10", "aloha_11"]);
    const url = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-base.json`;
    const urlRetrieve = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-retrieve.json`;

      model1,

      urlRetrieve,
    };
  },
};
```

## URL template

The value of `file` replaces `{{ file }}` in `url`. Choose another data source to reload the options and clear the selection. The examples load existing local JSON files.

*props: `url`, `url-template-data`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="templateDataBasic.file"
  :data="sources"
  :translate-data="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_"
  type="select"
/>
<a-checkbox
  v-model="modelBasic"
  :url="urlBasic"
  :url-template-data="templateDataBasic"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS_"
/>
<div>model: {{ modelBasic }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACheckbox,
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ACheckbox,
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const sources = [
      { id: "base", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_FIRST_" },
      { id: "retrieve", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_SECOND_" },
    ];
    const modelBasic = ref(undefined);
    const templateDataBasic = ref({ file: "base" });
    const urlBasic = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-{{ file }}.json`;

    return {
      modelBasic,
      sources,
      templateDataBasic,
      urlBasic,
    };
  },
};
```

## Nested paths and reactive data

A placeholder such as `{{ source.file }}` supports nested object paths. Changing the data source changes the resolved URL, reloads the options and clears the selection. Select an option, then edit the note: it is not used in the URL, so the URL watcher does not run, no new request is sent and the selection is preserved. Replacing `urlTemplateData` with another object that produces the same URL has the same effect.

*props: `url`, `url-template-data`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="templateDataReactive.source.file"
  :data="sources"
  :translate-data="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_"
  type="select"
/>
<a-input
  v-model="templateDataReactive.note"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_NOTE_"
/>
<a-checkbox
  v-model="modelReactive"
  :url="urlReactive"
  :url-template-data="templateDataReactive"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS_"
/>
<div>model: {{ modelReactive }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACheckbox,
  AInput,
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ACheckbox,
    AInput,
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const sources = [
      { id: "base", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_FIRST_" },
      { id: "retrieve", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_SECOND_" },
    ];
    const modelReactive = ref(undefined);
    const templateDataReactive = ref({ source: { file: "base" }, note: "" });
    const urlReactive = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-{{ source.file }}.json`;

    return {
      modelReactive,
      sources,
      templateDataReactive,
      urlReactive,
```
```js
    };
  },
};
```

## Select all / Deselect all

The props `is-select-all` and `is-deselect-all` show buttons above the list that select or deselect all items. Disabled items (`key-disabled`) are not changed. While searching (`search`), only the found items are affected. The button texts can be changed with `text-select-all` and `text-deselect-all`.

*props: `is-select-all`*

```html
<a-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :is-deselect-all="true"
  :is-select-all="true"
  key-disabled="isDisabled"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Aloha"
></a-checkbox>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
<a-checkbox
  v-model="modelSearch"
  :data="data"
  :is-deselect-all="true"
  :is-select-all="true"
  :search="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  key-disabled="isDisabled"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Aloha (search)"
></a-checkbox>
<div>modelSearch: {{ modelSearch }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ACheckbox,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageCheckboxSelectAll",
  components: {
    ACheckbox,
  },

    const data = [
      {
        label: "Aloha 0",
        id: "aloha_0",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 1",
        id: "aloha_1",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 2 (disabled)",
        id: "aloha_2",
        isDisabled: true,
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 3",
        id: "aloha_3",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 4",
        id: "aloha_4",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 5",
        id: "aloha_5",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref(["aloha_2"]);
    const modelSearch = ref(["aloha_2"]);

      data,
      model,
      modelSearch,
    };
  },
};
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ACheckbox,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageCheckboxKeyDisabled",
  components: {
    ACheckbox,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        label: "Aloha 0",
        id: "aloha_0",
        aloha: "",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
        disabled: true,
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 1",
        id: "aloha_1",
        aloha: "Buba",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
        disabled: true,
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 2",
        id: "aloha_2",
        aloha: "Buba",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
        disabled: true,
```

## Collapse/expand

This example demonstrates how to use **collapsible** and **is-collapsed** in the component. The **collapsible** property allows the group of items to be collapsible, while **is-collapsed** sets the initial collapsed state. The example also demonstrates the use of the **toggle-collapse** event, which is triggered when the group is collapsed or expanded.

*props: `collapsible`, `is-collapsed`; emits: `toggle-collapse`*

```html
<a-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  :collapsible="true"
  :data="data"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Aloha"
  @toggle-collapse="toggleCollapse"
></a-checkbox>
<a-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  :collapsible="true"
  :data="data"
  :key-group="['alohaBR', 'aloha']"
  class="a_mt_3"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Aloha"
  @toggle-collapse="toggleCollapse"
></a-checkbox>
<a-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  :collapsible="true"
  :data="data"
  :is-collapsed="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Aloha"
  @toggle-collapse="toggleCollapse"
></a-checkbox>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

This example demonstrates how to use **key-label-callback** to dynamically generate labels for items. The function passed as the value receives the item data and returns a string that will be used as the label.

*props: `key-label-callback`*

```html
<a-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :key-label-callback="onKeyLabelCallback"
  key-id="id"
  label="Aloha"
></a-checkbox>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ACheckbox,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageCheckboxKeyLabelCallback",
  components: {
    ACheckbox,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        label: "Aloha 0",
        id: "aloha_0",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 1",
        id: "aloha_1",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 2",
        id: "aloha_2",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 3",
        id: "aloha_3",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 4",
        id: "aloha_4",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 5",
        id: "aloha_5",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 6",
        id: "aloha_6",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 7",
        id: "aloha_7",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 8",
        id: "aloha_8",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref(undefined);
    
    const onKeyLabelCallback = ({ item }) => {
      return `--${ item.label }--`;
    };

    return {
      data,
      model,
      onKeyLabelCallback,
    };
  },
};
```

## Focus and blur

This example shows how the component reacts to gaining and losing focus. The "`focusin`" event is triggered once when the focus enters the component for the first time. The "`focusout`" event is triggered only when the focus fully leaves the component.

*emits: `focusin`, `focusout`*

```html
<a-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :key-group="['alohaBR', 'aloha']"
  :search="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Radio1"
  @focusin="focusin1"
  @focusout="focusout1"
></a-checkbox>
<a-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :key-group="['alohaBR', 'aloha']"
  :is-button-group="true"
  :search="true"
  class="a_mt_5"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Radio2"
  class-button-group-default="a_btn a_btn_outline_secondary a_text_nowrap"
  @focusin="focusin2"
  @focusout="focusout2"
></a-checkbox>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

  },

      {

        aloha: "",
        alohaBR: "Köln",

        label: "Aloha 1",

        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 4",
        id: "aloha_4",
        aloha: "Sandra",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 5",
        id: "aloha_5",
        aloha: "Coco",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 6",
        id: "aloha_6",

        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",

      {
```

## **Readonly** display mode

In this example, the component is used in **readonly** mode, where the value is displayed as text and cannot be modified by the user.

*props: `readonly`, `readonly-default`*

```html
<a-checkbox
  :model-value="model1"
  :data="data"
  :readonly="true"
  label="Checkbox 1"
></a-checkbox>
<a-checkbox
  :model-value="model2"
  :data="data"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Checkbox 2"
></a-checkbox>
<a-checkbox
  :model-value="model2"
  :data="data"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  help-text="Aloha"
  label="Checkbox 3"
  readonly-default="-"
></a-checkbox>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ACheckbox,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageCheckboxReadonly",
  components: {
    ACheckbox,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        value: "aloha_1",
        label: "Aloha 1",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_2",
        label: "Aloha 2",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_3",
        label: "Aloha 3",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_4",
        label: "Aloha 4",
      },
    ];
    const model1 = ref(["aloha_1", "aloha_4"]);
    const model2 = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      data,
      model1,
      model2,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| api-save-id | String |  |  | A unique identifier for saving data retrieved from the **API**. This can be useful for caching or reusing data within a session. |
| attributes-fieldset | Object | () => ({}) |  | **HTML** attributes to be added to the **fieldset** tag. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| class-button-group-default | String / Object / Array | a_btn a_btn_outline_primary |  | Default **CSS** classes that will be applied to the buttons in the group. These classes can be used to style the buttons in the checkbox or radio button group. |
| class-data-parent | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** classes that are applied to the parent data container. This allows customizing the appearance of the container that holds the data items. |
| class-fieldset | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** classes that will be applied to the **fieldset** tag containing the group of controls. This allows customizing the appearance of the group of form elements. |
| collapsible | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether the group of checkboxes can be collapsed and expanded. If set to **true**, the group can be toggled by the user. |
| data | Array |  |  | An array of data used to generate the items. |
| data-extra | Array | () => [] |  | An additional array of items not included in the main data array. Its items support the same grouping configuration as **data** through **key-group** and the related group props. |
| merge-data | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether internally loaded data is merged with the **data** prop. Items are merged by their ID; when both sources contain the same ID, the internally loaded item takes precedence. If set to **false**, internally loaded data replaces the **data** prop. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| has-border | Boolean | true |  | Specifies whether the item should have a border. If set to **true**, a border will be displayed around the item. |
| has-control-checkbox | Boolean |  |  | Adds a control checkbox that allows selecting or deselecting all checkboxes in the group simultaneously. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| id | String / Number | () => uniqueId("a_checkbox_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| inline | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether the checkboxes should be displayed inline. If set to **true**, the checkboxes will be aligned horizontally. |
| is-button-group | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether the checkboxes should be displayed as buttons. If set to **true**, the checkboxes will be displayed as buttons, which can provide a more visually appealing interface. |
| is-collapsed | Boolean |  |  | Specifies the initial collapsed state of the checkbox group. If set to **true**, the group will be collapsed when the page loads. |
| is-data-simple-array | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the data array is a simple array of values. If set to **true**, each element of the array will be treated as a simple value without keys. |
| is-deselect-all | Boolean | false |  | Shows a button that deselects all items that can be changed (not disabled; while searching, only the found ones). |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| is-select-all | Boolean | false |  | Shows a button that selects all items that can be changed (not disabled; while searching, only the found ones). |
| is-width-auto | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether the width of the checkbox group should automatically adjust to its content. If set to **true**, the width will adjust automatically. |
| key-disabled | String |  |  | Specifies the key in the data object that determines whether the item will be disabled (unselectable). |
| key-disabled-callback | Function |  |  | A function to determine whether an item should be disabled. Returns `true` to disable a specific item. Accepts an object with item data: `{ item }`. |
| key-group | String / Number / Array |  |  | A key or array of keys used to group data by specific categories. This property allows grouping items into groups. |
| key-group-label-callback | Function |  |  | A callback function that takes two arguments **({ group, item })** and returns the group name. It is used to dynamically determine group names based on the provided data. |
| key-id | String | value |  | The key in the data object that will be used as the identifier for each item. |
| key-label | String | label |  | The key in the data object that specifies the label text for each item. |
| key-label-callback | Function |  |  | A callback function used to generate the label text based on the item data. This allows dynamically creating labels based on complex logic. |
| key-title | String |  |  | The key in the data object that specifies the title for each item. |
| key-title-callback | Function |  |  | A callback function used to generate the title based on the item data. This allows dynamically creating titles based on complex logic. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| loading | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the item is in a loading state. If set to **true**, the item displays a loading indicator. |
| model-dependencies | Object | () => ({}) |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-value | Array |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| required | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| search | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the search feature is supported. If set to **true**, users will be able to search within the group. |
| search-api | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether item searches will be performed using an **API**. If set to **true**, data will be loaded from the server as the query is entered. |
| search-api-key | String |  |  | The key used to perform the search via **API**. Typically, this is a parameter passed in the server request to filter the data. |
| search-in-group | Boolean |  |  | Enables additional search by group names. |
| search-outside | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the search will be performed outside the component, for example, via **API** or another external data source. |
| search-text-in-html | Boolean |  |  | If set to `true`, the search will be performed on the text extracted from the rendered **HTML**. This allows searching only visible text shown to the user, ignoring tags and attributes. |
| search-timeout | Number | 0 |  | Specifies the delay time in milliseconds before performing the search. Useful for preventing excessive requests during fast text input by the user. |
| slot-append-name | String |  |  | The name of the slot that will be appended after the component's main content. This allows extending the functionality of the component by adding custom content. |
| slot-name | String |  |  | The name of the main slot used to insert custom content into the component. |
| sort-order | String |  |  | Specifies the sort order of items. Possible values: **asc** (ascending) or **desc** (descending). |
| sort-order-group | String |  |  | Specifies the sort order of groups if the items are grouped. Possible values: **asc** (ascending) or **desc** (descending). |
| text-deselect-all | String | _A_CHECKBOX_DESELECT_ALL_ |  | Text of the “Deselect all” button. |
| text-select-all | String | _A_CHECKBOX_SELECT_ALL_ |  | Text of the “Select all” button. |
| texts | Object | () => ({         collapseClose: "_A_FIELDSET_COLLAPSE_CLOSE_",         collapseOpen: "_A_FIELDSET_COLLAPSE_OPEN_",         notElementsWithSearch: "_A_CHECKBOX_HAS_NOT_ELEMENTS_WITH_SEARCH_",         search: "_A_CHECKBOX_SEARCH_",       }) |  | Allows modifying text messages for various actions in the component. Includes texts for collapsing/expanding (**collapseClose** and **collapseOpen**), messages for no elements found during search (**notElementsWithSearch**), and text for the search field (**search**). |
| translate-data | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the data should be translated before display. If set to **true**, text values will be translated according to the current language settings. |
| url | String |  |  | URL used to load the component’s options. Supports `{{ path }}` placeholders resolved from `url-template-data`. |
| url-retrieve | String |  |  | An optional **URL** used specifically to retrieve already selected values that are missing from the main loaded list. |
| url-params | Object |  |  | Parameters that will be added to the **URL** request when loading data from the server. These parameters allow filtering or modifying the data retrieved from the **API**. |
| url-retrieve-params | Object |  |  | Optional parameters that will be added only to the retrieve request used for loading missing selected values. |
| url-template-data | Object |  |  | Object with values for `{{ path }}` placeholders in `url`, including nested paths such as `{{ source.file }}`. Uses the same placeholder syntax as translations. Changing these values reloads the options and clears the selection only when the resolved URL changes. Does not affect URLs without placeholders; query parameters are passed separately via `url-params`. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| focusin | Function | Triggered when the focus enters the component for the first time. |
| focusout | Function | Triggered when the focus leaves the component completely. |
| on-search-outside | Function | An event triggered when the user performs a search outside the component, for example, via **API** or another external data source. This event allows handling the search result and updating the component data. |
| update-data | Function | An event triggered when the component data is updated. It can be used to perform actions after the data has been changed or updated, such as re-sorting or filtering items. |
| toggle-collapse | Function | The event is triggered when the user collapses or expands the group of items. |
| update:model-value | Function | Event triggered when the component's model value is updated. Used to synchronize data between the component and the parent component. |

## Translations

| key | en |

| `_A_CHECKBOX_HAS_NOT_ELEMENTS_WITH_SEARCH_` | [No items available for selection] |

| name | value | description |

| `--a_custom_control_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of the label area (visible on hover). |
| `--a_custom_control_label_padding` |  | Padding of the label area around the box and the text. |
| `--a_custom_control_label_width` |  | Width of the label area. The class a_custom_control_label_width_auto sets it to auto. |
| `--a_custom_control_label_color` |  | Text color of the label. |
| `--a_custom_control_label_disabled_color` |  | Text color of the label of a disabled checkbox or radio. |
| `--a_custom_control_label_text_margin_left` |  | Space between the box and the label text. |
| `--a_custom_control_hover_bg` |  | Background of the label area on hover. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_width` |  | Width and height of the box (checkbox) or circle (radio). |
| `--a_custom_control_input_bg` |  | Background of an unchecked box. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_border_color` |  | Border color of an unchecked box. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_hover_border_color` |  | Border color of the box on hover. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_border_width` |  | Border width of the box. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of the checkbox box. Radio buttons are always round. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_checked_color` |  | Color of the check mark, the indeterminate dash and the radio dot. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_checked_border_color` |  | Border color of a checked or indeterminate box. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_checked_bg` |  | Background of a checked or indeterminate box. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_checked_disabled_bg` |  | Background and border color of a checked box when disabled. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_disabled_bg` |  | Background of an unchecked box when disabled. |
| `--a_custom_control_input_disabled_border_color` |  | Border color of an unchecked box when disabled. |
| `--a_custom_control_error_color` |  | Color of the box border, the checked background and the label when the field has errors. |
| `--a_custom_control_mark_size` |  | Size of the mark inside the box, relative to the box. |
| `--a_custom_control_mark_checkbox` |  | Mask image of the check mark. |

# AColorPicker (Color picker)

The **AColorPicker** component selects a color in a dialog: saturation and brightness area, hue and opacity sliders, a text field for any color format and predefined colors. The field looks like an input that is filled with the selected color; the text color is chosen automatically for the best contrast. The model is changed only with **OK**. In **AForm** the component is used with `type: "colorPicker"`; `type: "color"` stays the native ``.

Accessibility: the field is a button with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`, its name contains the label and the current value. The dialog has `role="dialog"`, the focus stays inside and goes back to the field after closing.

- **Enter**, **Space**, **Arrow down**: open the dialog.
- Saturation and brightness area: **Arrow left/right** saturation, **Arrow up/down** brightness, **Shift** + arrow: steps of 10, **Home** / **End**, **Page up** / **Page down**.
- Hue and opacity: arrows, **Shift** + arrow, **Home** / **End**.
- Text field: **Enter** applies the typed value.
- **Escape** closes the dialog without changes.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-color-picker
  v-model="model"
  label="Color"
></a-color-picker>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AColorPicker,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageColorPickerBasic",
  components: {
    AColorPicker,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("#0775b0");

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Label position

**label-position** sets where the label is shown: `"float"` – inside the empty field, it moves to the border on focus or with a value; `"inset"` – always inside the field, small above the value; `"top"` – above the field. The default for all form elements is set with **AFormPlugin** (`labelPosition`). **is-label-float** still works, but is deprecated.

*props: `label-position`*

```html
<a-color-picker
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: float"
  label-position="float"
></a-color-picker>
<a-color-picker
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: inset"
  label-position="inset"
></a-color-picker>
<a-color-picker
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: top"
  label-position="top"
></a-color-picker>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AColorPicker,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageColorPickerLabelPosition",
  components: {
    AColorPicker,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("#0775b0");

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Opacity

With **show-alpha** the dialog shows an opacity slider. Hex values get the alpha channel as `#rrggbbaa`.

*props: `show-alpha`*

```html
<a-color-picker
  v-model="model"
  label="Color"
  :show-alpha="true"
></a-color-picker>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AColorPicker,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageColorPickerShowAlpha",
  components: {
    AColorPicker,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("#0775b080");

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Color formats

**color-formats** is a format or an array of formats: `hex`, `rgb`, `hsl`, `hsv`. With several formats the dialog has a switch next to the text field that changes the format in the given order. When the dialog opens, the format of the current value is used if it is in the list, otherwise the first format. The model is written in the chosen format.

*props: `color-formats`*

```html
<a-color-picker
  v-model="model"
  label="hex, rgb, hsl, hsv"
  :color-formats="['hex', 'rgb', 'hsl', 'hsv']"
  :show-alpha="true"
></a-color-picker>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
<a-color-picker
  v-model="modelRgb"
  color-formats="rgb"
  label="rgb"
></a-color-picker>
<div>model: {{ modelRgb }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AColorPicker,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageColorPickerColorFormat",
  components: {
    AColorPicker,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("hsl(145, 63%, 29%)");
    const modelRgb = ref("rgb(7, 117, 176)");

    return {
      model,
      modelRgb,
    };
  },
};
```

## Predefined colors

**predefine** shows a list of colors that can be chosen with one click. Invalid values are ignored.

*props: `predefine`*

```js
      "#2f3474",

  },
```


## In a form

In **AForm** and **AGroup** the component is used with `type: "colorPicker"`. `type: "color"` renders the native browser color input.

*props: `type`*

```html
<a-form
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
></a-form>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageColorPickerForm",
  components: {
    AForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({
      brand: "#0775b0",
      native: "#c81e29",
    });
    const data = [
      {
        id: "brand",
        type: "colorPicker",
        label: "colorPicker",
        showAlpha: true,
        predefine: ["#0775b0", "#1b7942", "#c81e29"],
      },
      {
        id: "native",
        type: "color",
        label: "color",
      },
    ];

    return {
      data,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

# ADatepicker (Datepicker)

Allows interactive selection of a date and, depending on the configuration, also time. The component supports different display modes such as date, time, or datetime and offers additional options for limiting the selectable range and controlling the initial calendar focus.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="model1"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_INPUT_1_"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="model2"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_INPUT_2_"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="model3"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_INPUT_3_"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>model3: {{ model3 }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ADatepicker,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageDatepickerBasic",
  components: {
    ADatepicker,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref("2022-10-18");
    const model2 = ref("2023-12-12");
    const model3 = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
};
```
