```js
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref("2022-10-18");
    const model2 = ref("2023-12-12");
    const model3 = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
};
```

## Default placeholders

When **placeholder** is not passed, the component now chooses a default placeholder based on **type** and **time-precision**. You can override these defaults with **placeholders-default**.

*props: `placeholder`, `placeholders-default`, `type`, `time-precision`*

```html
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="modelDate"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_PLACEHOLDER_DEFAULT_DATE_"
      type="date"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>modelDate: {{ modelDate }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="modelTimeHour"
      class="a_mt_3"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_PLACEHOLDER_DEFAULT_TIME_HOUR_"
      time-precision="hour"
      type="time"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>modelTimeHour: {{ modelTimeHour }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="modelTimeMinute"
      class="a_mt_3"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_PLACEHOLDER_DEFAULT_TIME_MINUTE_"
      time-precision="minute"
      type="time"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>modelTimeMinute: {{ modelTimeMinute }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="modelDatetimeSecond"
      class="a_mt_3"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_PLACEHOLDER_DEFAULT_DATETIME_SECOND_"
      time-precision="second"
      type="datetime"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>modelDatetimeSecond: {{ modelDatetimeSecond }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="modelOverride"
      :placeholders-default="placeholdersCustom"
      class="a_mt_3"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_PLACEHOLDER_DEFAULT_OVERRIDE_"
      time-precision="minute"
      type="datetime"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>modelOverride: {{ modelOverride }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ADatepicker,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageDatepickerPlaceholderDefault",
  components: {
    ADatepicker,
  },
  setup() {
    const modelDate = ref(undefined);
    const modelTimeHour = ref(undefined);
    const modelTimeMinute = ref(undefined);
    const modelDatetimeSecond = ref(undefined);
    const modelOverride = ref(undefined);

    const placeholdersCustom = {
      datetimeMinute: "_PAGE_DATEPICKER_PLACEHOLDER_CUSTOM_DATETIME_MINUTE_",
      timeMinute: "_PAGE_DATEPICKER_PLACEHOLDER_CUSTOM_TIME_MINUTE_",
    };
    
    return {
      modelDate,
      modelTimeHour,
      modelTimeMinute,
      modelDatetimeSecond,
      modelOverride,
      placeholdersCustom,
    };
  },
};
```

## Maximum and minimum dates

Use the **max-date** and **min-date** props to limit the selectable date range.

*props: `max-date`, `min-date`*

```html
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="model1"
      :min-date="dateYesterday"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_WITH_MIN_DATE_"
      type="date"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="model2"
      :max-date="dateTomorrow"
      class="a_mt_3"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_WITH_MAX_DATE_"
      type="date"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch">
    <a-datepicker
      v-model="model3"
      :max-date="dateTomorrow"
      :min-date="dateTomorrow"
      class="a_mt_3"
      label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_LBL_WITH_MIN_AND_MAX_DATE_"
      type="date"
    ></a-datepicker>
    <div>model3: {{ model3 }}</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

```js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ADatepicker,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageDatepickerMaxMinDate",
  components: {
    ADatepicker,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(undefined);
    const model2 = ref(undefined);
    const model3 = ref(undefined);

    const dateYesterday = computed(() => {
      const date = new Date();
      date.setDate(date.getDate() - 1);

      return date.toISOString();
    });

    const dateTomorrow = computed(() => {
      const date = new Date();
      date.setDate(date.getDate() + 1);

      return date.toISOString();
    });
    
    return {
      dateTomorrow,
      dateYesterday,
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
};
```

```js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ADatepicker,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageDatepickerStartDate",
  components: {
    ADatepicker,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(undefined);
    const model2 = ref("2025-05-16");
    const model3 = ref("2025-05-16");

    const dateNextYear = computed(() => {
      const date = new Date();
      date.setFullYear(date.getFullYear() + 1);

      return date.toISOString();
    });
    
    return {
      dateNextYear,
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
```

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| append-to-body | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the calendar popover is rendered directly inside the document body. |
| class | String / Object |  |  | CSS class or class object applied to the outer datepicker container. |
| clearable | Boolean | true |  | Displays a clear icon that removes the current value from the field. |
| confirm | Boolean | false |  | Requires explicit confirmation before the selected value is emitted. |
| confirm-text | String | "OK" |  | Label of the confirm button shown inside the calendar panel. |
| date-format | String |  |  | Format used for the date tooltip and time header inside the panel. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| disabled | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| editable | Boolean | true |  | Allows typing directly into the input field. If disabled, the value can only be changed via the panel. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| error-icon | String / Object |  |  | Specifies the icon displayed when the component has validation errors. If the component has an input field, the icon is shown inside it; otherwise, it is displayed next to the control. The icon is shown only when **errors** is present. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| first-day-of-week | Number | 1 |  | Sets which day is shown as the first day of the week in the calendar. Allowed values are 1 to 7. |
| focus-start-date | Boolean |  |  | If set, the initial calendar focus is moved to **start-date** when the panel opens. |
| format | String / Object |  |  | Display format used in the input field and for parsing manually entered values. |
| format-save | String |  |  | Format used when saving or emitting the component value. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| icon-day | String / Number |  |  | Custom icon displayed inside the input field. |
| id | String / Number | () => uniqueId("a_ui_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| input-attr | Object | () => ({}) |  | Attributes applied directly to the internal input element of the datepicker. |
| input-class | String / Number / Boolean / Array / Object / Date / Function / Symbol | "a_datepicker__input" |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the input element. Allows styling the component according to your requirements. |
| input-name | String | "date" |  | Name attribute of the internal input element. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-label-float | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the label of the component should be positioned above the field. If **true**, the label will move above the text field when focused or when content is present. Deprecated, use label-position. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-position | "float" / "inset" / "top" | "float" |  | Position of the label: "float", "inset" or "top". The default comes from the component plugin or AFormPlugin (labelPosition). |
| label-screen-reader | String |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |

Supported keys include **date**, **dateRange**, **timeHour**, **timeMinute**, **timeSecond**, **datetimeHour**, **datetimeMinute**, and **datetimeSecond**. |

# ADatepickerRange (Date range)

Allows interactive selection of a date range by providing two date fields to define 'From' and 'To' values.

## Basic Datepicker Range Usage

A simple datepicker range component allowing the user to select a date range with a clear label.

*props: `v-model`, `label`*

```html
<a-datepicker-range
  v-model="model"
  label="Aloha"
</a-datepicker-range>
<div class="a_mt_3">model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ADatepickerRange,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageDatepickerRangeBasic",
  components: {
    ADatepickerRange,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(undefined);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Customizing the First Day of the Week

Utilizing the 'firstDayOfWeek' prop to set the beginning of the week to Thursday (4) in the Datepicker range component.

*props: `v-model`, `label`, `firstDayOfWeek`*

```html
<a-datepicker-range
  v-model="model"
  label="_PAGE_DATEPICKER_RANGE_CUSTOM_FIRST_DAY_EXAMPLE_"
  first-day-of-week=4
</a-datepicker-range>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ADatepickerRange,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageDatepickerRangeCustomFirstDay",
  components: {
    ADatepickerRange,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(undefined);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Various Disabled States for Datepicker Range

use of 'disabled', 'disabledFrom', and 'disabledUntil' props, each affecting the availability of selections in the Datepicker range component.

*props: `v-model`, `disabled`, `disabledFrom`, `disabledUntil`*

```html
<a-datepicker-range
 v-model="model"
  :disabled="true">
</a-datepicker-range>
<a-datepicker-range
 v-model="model"
  :disabled-from="true">
</a-datepicker-range>
<a-datepicker-range
 v-model="model"
  :disabled-until="true">
</a-datepicker-range>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";
```

## **Readonly** display mode

In this example, the component is used in **readonly** mode, where the value is displayed as text and cannot be modified by the user.

*props: `readonly`, `readonly-default`, `readonly-default-from`, `readonly-default-from`*

```html
<a-datepicker-range
  :model-value="model1"
  :readonly="true"
  label="Input 1"
</a-datepicker-range>
<a-datepicker-range
  :model-value="model2"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Input 2"
  readonly-default-until="-"
</a-datepicker-range>
<a-datepicker-range
  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Input 3"
  readonly-default-from="-"
</a-datepicker-range>
<a-datepicker-range
  :model-value="model4"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Input 4"
</a-datepicker-range>
<a-datepicker-range
  :model-value="model4"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  help-text="Aloha"
  label="Input 5"
  readonly-default="-"
</a-datepicker-range>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ADatepickerRange,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageDatepickerRangeReadonly",
  components: {
    ADatepickerRange,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref({ from: "2025-03-05", until: "2025-03-12" });
    const model2 = ref({ from: "2025-03-05" });
    const model3 = ref({ until: "2025-03-12" });
    const model4 = ref(undefined);

    return {
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
      model4,
    };
  },
};
```

# AFieldset (Fieldset Group)

The **AFieldset** component is used to group form elements into a logical set. It supports various features, such as error display, help text, content collapse/expand, and customization of styles for child elements.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`, `children`*

```html
<a-fieldset
  v-model="model"
  :children="children"
  label="Fieldset"
></a-fieldset>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AFieldset,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageFieldsetBasic",
  components: {
    AFieldset,
  },
  setup() {
    const children = [
      {
        type: "text",
        label: "Text",
        id: "aloha.text",
      },
      {
        type: "oneCheckbox",
        label: "Checkbox",
        id: "aloha.checkbox",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      children,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-fieldset
  :change="changeModel"
  :children="children"
  :model-value="model"
  label="Fieldset"
></a-fieldset>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AFieldset,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageFieldsetChange",
  components: {
    AFieldset,
  },
  setup() {
    const children = [
      {
        type: "text",
        label: "Text",
        id: "aloha.text",
      },
      {
        type: "oneCheckbox",
        label: "Checkbox",
        id: "aloha.checkbox",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref(undefined);
    
    const changeModel = ({ model: _model, id, props }) => {
      model.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props);
    };
    
    return {
      children,
      changeModel,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Collapse/expand

This example demonstrates how to use **collapsible** and **is-collapsed** in the component. The **collapsible** property allows the group of items to be collapsible, while **is-collapsed** sets the initial collapsed state. The example also demonstrates the use of the **toggle-collapse** event, which is triggered when the group is collapsed or expanded.

*props: `collapsible`, `is-collapsed`; emits: `toggle-collapse`*

```html
<a-fieldset
  v-model="model1"
  :children="children1"
  :collapsible="true"
  label="Aloha"
  @toggle-collapse="toggleCollapse"
></a-fieldset>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-fieldset
  v-model="model2"
  :children="children2"
  :collapsible="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Aloha"
  @toggle-collapse="toggleCollapse"
></a-fieldset>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AFieldset,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageFieldsetCollapse",
  components: {
    AFieldset,
  },
  setup() {
    const children1 = [
      {
        type: "text",
        label: "Text",
        id: "aloha1.text",
      },
    ];
    const children2 = [
      {
        type: "text",
        label: "Text",
        id: "aloha2.text",
      },
    ];
    const model1 = ref(undefined);
    const model2 = ref(undefined);
    
    const toggleCollapse = ({ isCollapsed, id, props }) => {
      console.log(isCollapsed, id, props);
    };

    return {
      children1,
      children2,
      model1,
      model2,
      toggleCollapse,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| attributes-fieldset | Object | () => ({}) |  | **HTML** attributes to be added to the **fieldset** tag. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| children | Array | () => [] |  | An array of child elements that will be rendered inside the component. Each element in the array is an object with parameters such as **type**, **label**, **id**, and other properties for configuring and displaying the child element. |
| class-column-default | String / Object | a_column a_column_12 |  | Sets a **CSS** class for all child elements unless a separate **classColumn** is specified for a specific element in the **children** array. This makes it easy to manage the display of all child elements at once. |
| class-columns | String / Object | a_columns a_columns_count_12 |  | **CSS** classes that will be applied to the container where child elements from the **children** prop are placed. These classes control the number of columns, spacing between them, and their responsive behavior. |
| class-fieldset | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** classes that will be applied to the **fieldset** tag containing the group of controls. This allows customizing the appearance of the group of form elements. |
| collapsible | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether the group of checkboxes can be collapsed and expanded. If set to **true**, the group can be toggled by the user. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| errors-all | Object | () => ({}) |  | An object containing errors for all child elements passed through **children**. Each error should be specified for the corresponding element by its **id**. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| has-border | Boolean | true |  | Specifies whether the item should have a border. If set to **true**, a border will be displayed around the item. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| id | String / Number | () => uniqueId("a_fieldset_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| is-collapsed | Boolean |  |  | Specifies the initial collapsed state of the checkbox group. If set to **true**, the group will be collapsed when the page loads. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| model-dependencies | Object | () => ({}) |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-value | Object | () => ({}) |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| required | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| slot-name | String |  |  | The name of the main slot used to insert custom content into the component. |
| texts | Object | () => ({         collapseClose: "_A_FIELDSET_COLLAPSE_CLOSE_",         collapseOpen: "_A_FIELDSET_COLLAPSE_OPEN_",       }) |  | Allows you to customize the text for the collapse and expand actions of the component. By default, **_A_FIELDSET_COLLAPSE_CLOSE_** is used for closing and **_A_FIELDSET_COLLAPSE_OPEN_** for opening. |
| use-flat-errors | Boolean | true |  | When enabled, errors are resolved directly by field ID. Disable it when nested container errors follow the nested model structure. |
| use-flat-model | Boolean | true |  | When enabled, container fields work with the shared flat model. Disable it to store container values in nested objects. |
| use-html-id-as-key | Boolean | false |  | Use **htmlId** instead of the index as the key for form elements |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |

| toggle-collapse | Function | The event is triggered when the user collapses or expands the group of items. |
| update:model-value | Function | Event triggered when the component's model value is updated. Used to synchronize data between the component and the parent component. |

| `--a_legend_padding_x` |  | Horizontal padding of the legend. |
| `--a_legend_color` |  | Text color of the legend. |
| `--a_legend_font_size` |  | Font size of the legend. |
| `--a_legend_invalid_color` |  | Text color of the legend when the fieldset has errors. |
| `--a_legend_font_weight` |  | Font weight of the legend. |

# AFieldset (Child elements **children**)

This page covers the use of **children** in the **AFieldset** component, as well as related properties such as **class-column-default** for customizing the classes of individual child elements, **class-columns** for the parent container, and **errors-all** for displaying child element errors.

## Basic usage

*props: `children`*

```html
<a-fieldset
  v-model="model"
  :children="children"
  label="Fieldset"
></a-fieldset>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AFieldset,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageFieldsetChildrenBasic",
  components: {
    AFieldset,
  },
  setup() {
    const children = [
      {
        type: "text",
        label: "Text",
        id: "aloha.text",
      },
      {
        type: "oneCheckbox",
        label: "Checkbox",
        id: "aloha.checkbox",
      },
      {
        type: "currency",
        label: "Currency",
        id: "aloha.currency",
      },
      {
        type: "date",
        label: "Date",
        id: "aloha.date",
      },
      {
        type: "file",
        label: "File",
        id: "aloha.file",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      children,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Child component dependencies

Use **dependencies** as an object for one condition or as an array when all conditions must match. Inside **AFieldset**, the current model is supplied to child UI components automatically, so **modelDependencies** does not need to be passed manually.

*props: `children`, `dependencies`, `model-dependencies`*

```html
<a-fieldset
  v-model="model"
  :children="children"
  label="Fieldset"
></a-fieldset>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AFieldset,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageFieldsetChildrenDependencies",
  components: {
    AFieldset,
  },
  setup() {
    const children = [
      {
        type: "switch",
        label: "Show details",
        id: "showDetails",
      },
      {
        type: "radio",
        label: "Detail type",
        id: "detailType",
        data: [
          { label: "Basic", value: "basic" },
          { label: "Advanced", value: "advanced" },
        ],
      },
      {
        type: "text",
        label: "Details",
        id: "details",
        dependencies: {
          id: "showDetails",
          value: true,
        },
      },
      {
        type: "dateRange",
        label: "Period",
        id: "period",
        dependencies: {
          id: "showDetails",
          value: true,
        },
      },
      {
        type: "template",
        id: "advancedHint",
        html: "Advanced details are enabled.",
        dependencies: [
          { id: "showDetails", value: true },
          { id: "detailType", value: "advanced" },
        ],
      },
    ];
    const model = ref({
      showDetails: false,
      detailType: "basic",
    });

    return {
      children,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Class for child elements

*props: `class-column-default`*

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| children | Array | () => [] |  | An array of child elements that will be rendered inside the component. Each element in the array is an object with parameters such as **type**, **label**, **id**, and other properties for configuring and displaying the child element. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| class-column-default | String / Object | a_column a_column_12 |  | Sets a **CSS** class for all child elements unless a separate **classColumn** is specified for a specific element in the **children** array. This makes it easy to manage the display of all child elements at once. |
| class-columns | String / Object | a_columns a_columns_count_12 |  | **CSS** classes that will be applied to the container where child elements from the **children** prop are placed. These classes control the number of columns, spacing between them, and their responsive behavior. |
| errors-all | Object | () => ({}) |  | An object containing errors for all child elements passed through **children**. Each error should be specified for the corresponding element by its **id**. |
| model-dependencies | Object |  |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |

<!-- https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/form.md -->

# AForm (Dynamic form)

The **AForm** component builds a complete form from a configuration array. Each item in **data** selects a UI component through its **type**, uses its **id** as the model key, and accepts all props supported by that UI component. The form manages the shared model, validation errors, dependencies, responsive layout, read-only mode, events, and content slots.

## Basic configuration

Pass field configurations through **data** and bind one object with **v-model**. The value of every field is stored under its **id**.

*props: `data`, `model-value`, `class-columns`, `class-column-default`; emits: `update:model-value`*

```html
<a-form
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :show-errors="false"
  :show-required-text="false"
></a-form>
<pre>{{ model }}</pre>
```

```js
import { ref } from "vue";
import { AForm } from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: { AForm },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        type: "text",
        id: "name",
        label: "Name",
        required: true,
        classColumn: "a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch",
      },
      {
        type: "email",
        id: "email",
        label: "Email",
        classColumn: "a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch",
      },
      {
        type: "select",
        id: "country",
        label: "Country",
        data: [
          { label: "Deutschland", value: "de" },
          { label: "France", value: "fr" },
          { label: "Italia", value: "it" },
        ],
        classColumn: "a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch",
      },
      {
        type: "switch",
        id: "notifications",
        label: "Notifications",
        classColumn: "a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref({
      name: "Aloha",
      email: "aloha@example.com",
      country: "de",
      notifications: true,
    });

    return { data, model };
  },
};
```

## Conditional fields

A field can declare one condition as a **dependencies** object or multiple required conditions as an array. **AForm** supplies the current model to every UI component automatically.

*props: `data`, `model-value`, `dependencies`*

```html
<a-form
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :show-errors="false"
  :show-required-text="false"
></a-form>
<pre>{{ model }}</pre>
```

```js
import { ref } from "vue";
import { AForm } from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: { AForm },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        type: "switch",
        id: "hasDetails",
        label: "Show details",
      },
      {
        type: "radio",
        id: "detailsType",
        label: "Detail type",
        data: [
          { label: "Basic", value: "basic" },
          { label: "Advanced", value: "advanced" },
        ],
      },
      {
        type: "text",
        id: "details",
        label: "Details",
        dependencies: { id: "hasDetails", value: true },
      },
      {
        type: "dateRange",
        id: "period",
        label: "Period",
        dependencies: [
          { id: "hasDetails", value: true },
          { id: "detailsType", value: "advanced" },
        ],
      },
    ];
    const model = ref({
      hasDetails: false,
      detailsType: "basic",
    });

    return { data, model };
  },
};
```

## Errors and read-only mode

The **errors** object is keyed by field ID. Form-level error navigation and required-field information can be configured independently, while **readonly** switches every field to its read-only representation.

*props: `errors`, `readonly`, `show-errors`, `show-required-text`, `text-error-header`, `text-required`*

```html
<a-button text="Validate" @click="validate"></a-button>
<a-button text="Clear errors" @click="clearErrors"></a-button>
<a-button :text="readonly ? 'Edit' : 'Read only'" @click="toggleReadonly"></a-button>

<a-form
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :errors="errors"
  :readonly="readonly"
  text-error-header="Please correct the following fields"
  text-required="Required fields are marked"
></a-form>
```

```js
import { ref } from "vue";
import { AButton, AForm } from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: { AButton, AForm },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      { type: "text", id: "name", label: "Name", required: true },
      { type: "email", id: "email", label: "Email", required: true },
      { type: "textarea", id: "notes", label: "Notes" },
    ];
    const model = ref({ name: "", email: "", notes: "" });
    const errors = ref({});
    const readonly = ref(false);

    const validate = () => {
      const errorsLocal = {};
      if (!model.value.name) errorsLocal.name = "This field is required.";
      if (!model.value.email) errorsLocal.email = "This field is required.";
      errors.value = errorsLocal;
    };
    const clearErrors = () => {
      errors.value = {};
    };
    const toggleReadonly = () => {
      readonly.value = !readonly.value;
    };

    return {
      clearErrors,
      data,
      errors,
      model,
      readonly,
      toggleReadonly,
      validate,
    };
  },
};
```

## Events and slots

Listen to **update:modelValue** for the complete model and **change** for details about the changed field. Slots insert content before or after the form and its field container.

*slots: `formPrepend`, `formPrependAfterRequired`, `formDataPrepend`, `formDataAppend`, `formAppend`; emits: `update:model-value`, `change`*

```html
<a-form
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :show-errors="false"
  @update:model-value="onUpdateModelValue"
  @change="onChange"
>
  <template #formPrepend><strong>Before form content</strong></template>
  <template #formPrependAfterRequired><div>After required notice</div></template>
  <template #formDataPrepend><div>Before fields</div></template>
  <template #formDataAppend><div>After fields</div></template>
  <template #formAppend><strong>After form content</strong></template>
</a-form>
<pre>{{ lastEvent }}</pre>
```

```js
import { ref } from "vue";
import { AForm } from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: { AForm },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      { type: "text", id: "title", label: "Title", required: true },
    ];
    const model = ref({ title: "" });
    const lastEvent = ref();

    const onUpdateModelValue = modelUpdated => {
      lastEvent.value = { event: "update:modelValue", model: modelUpdated };
    };
    const onChange = ({ id, model: modelField, fullModel }) => {
      lastEvent.value = {
        event: "change",
        id,
        model: modelField,
        fullModel,
      };
    };

    return {
      data,
      lastEvent,
      model,
      onChange,
      onUpdateModelValue,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| class-column-default | String / Object | a_column a_column_12 |  | Default CSS class applied to each configured field when the item does not define its own **classColumn**. |
| class-columns | String / Object | a_columns a_columns_count_12 a_columns_gap_2 |  | CSS classes applied to the container that holds all fields from **data**. |
| data | Array |  | yes | Required array of field configurations. Every item needs a **type** and **id**, and may contain props supported by the selected UI component. |
| errors | Object | () => ({}) |  | Object containing validation errors keyed by field ID. Values are passed to the corresponding fields and can also be displayed in the form error summary. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| is-required | Boolean |  |  | Explicitly controls whether the form displays required-field information. When omitted, the value is inferred from configured fields. |
| model-value | Object |  |  | The complete form model. Field values are read from and written to keys matching their IDs. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| show-errors | Boolean | true |  | Controls display of the form-level error summary. Field-level errors remain available to individual components. |
| show-required-text | Boolean | true |  | Controls display of the required-fields notice above the fields. |
| tag | String | form |  | HTML tag used for the root element of the form. |
| text-error-header | String |  |  | Custom heading for the form-level error summary. |
| text-required | String |  |  | Custom text for the required-fields notice. |
| use-flat-errors | Boolean | true |  | When enabled, errors are resolved directly by field ID. Disable it when nested container errors follow the nested model structure. |
| use-flat-model | Boolean | true |  | When enabled, container fields work with the shared flat model. Disable it to store container values in nested objects. |
| use-html-id-as-key | Boolean | false |  | Uses each field's resolved HTML ID as its Vue key instead of the array index. |

## Emits

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Function | Event triggered when the component's model value is updated. Used to synchronize data between the component and the parent component. |
| change | Function | Emitted after a field changes. The payload contains the field ID, new and previous values, complete model, item data when available, and reactive props. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| formPrepend | Content rendered at the beginning of the form, before required information and errors. |
| formPrependAfterRequired | Content rendered after the required-fields notice and before the error summary. |
| formDataPrepend | Content rendered inside the field container before configured fields. |
| formDataAppend | Content rendered inside the field container after configured fields. |
| formAppend | Content rendered at the end of the form after the field container. |

# AFormElement (Form element)

A wrapper component for dynamically displaying various form elements based on the provided type. It allows rendering different components (form elements) by passing the required parameters, events, and slots. Simplifies form building based on configuration data.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`, `type`*

```html
<a-form-element
  v-model="model1"
  :required="true"
  label="Input"
  type="text"
></a-form-element>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-form-element
  v-model="model2"
  :required="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Checkbox"
  help-text="Aloha"
  type="oneCheckbox"
></a-form-element>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AFormElement,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageFormElementBasic",
  components: {
    AFormElement,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref("1234");
    const model2 = ref(true);
    
    return {
      model1,
      model2,
    };
  },
};
```

## **Readonly** display mode

In this example, the component is used in **readonly** mode, where the value is displayed as text and cannot be modified by the user.

*props: `readonly`, `readonly-default`*

```html
<a-form-element
  :model-value="model1"
  :readonly="true"
  label="Input"
  type="text"
></a-form-element>
<a-form-element
  :model-value="model2"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Checkbox"
  help-text="Aloha"
  type="oneCheckbox"
></a-form-element>
<a-form-element
  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Textarea"
  readonly-default="-"
  type="textarea"
></a-form-element>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AFormElement,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageFormElementReadonly",
  components: {
    AFormElement,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref("1234");
    const model2 = ref(true);
    const model3 = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| id | String / Number |  |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| model-dependencies | Object | () => ({}) |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-value | String / Number |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| options | Object | () => ({}) |  | An object with additional parameters to be passed to the component specified in the **type** parameter. Useful for passing any **props** not explicitly described in **AFormElement** but supported by the rendered component. |
| required | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| type | String | text |  | The type of component to render. Used to select the appropriate form element, for example: **input**, **select**, **checkbox**, **group**, **fieldset**, etc. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Function | Event triggered when the component's model value is updated. Used to synchronize data between the component and the parent component. |

# AGroup (Group)

AGroup is a component for displaying and managing grouped form elements or options. It supports labels, help text, errors, grouping, sorting, search, and other settings for flexible data presentation.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `children`*

```html
<a-group
  v-model="model"
  :children="childrenGroup"
></a-group>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AGroup,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageGroupBasic",
  components: {
    AGroup,
  },
  setup() {
    const childrenGroup = [
      {
        id: "text1",
        type: "text",
        label: "Input",
        labelClass: "a_column a_column_3 a_column_12_touch a_text_right",
        classColumn: "a_column a_column_5 a_column_12_touch",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref({
      text1: "Aloha",
    });
    
    return {
      childrenGroup,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

# AInput (Text field)

The **AInput** component provides data input functionality with support for various data types such as **text**, **password**, **number**, **email**, and others. The component supports icon display, a clear button, and the ability to show/hide the password.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-input
  v-model="model"
  label="Input"
></a-input>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AInput,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageInputBasic",
  components: {
    AInput,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("Aloha");
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Label position

**label-position** sets where the label is shown: `"float"` – inside the empty field, it moves to the border on focus or with a value; `"inset"` – always inside the field, small above the value; `"top"` – above the field. The default for all form elements is set with **AFormPlugin** (`labelPosition`). **is-label-float** still works, but is deprecated.

*props: `label-position`*

```html
<a-input
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: float"
  label-position="float"
></a-input>
<a-input
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: inset"
  label-position="inset"
></a-input>
<a-input
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: top"
  label-position="top"
></a-input>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInput,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputLabelPosition",
  components: {
    AInput,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("Aloha");

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-input
  :change="changeModel"
  :model-value="model"
  label="Input"
></a-input>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AInput,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageInputChange",
  components: {
    AInput,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("Aloha");
    
    const changeModel = ({ model: _model, id, props }) => {
      model.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Error icon

This example shows how to display a custom error icon when the component has validation errors. If the component has an input field, the icon is shown inside it; otherwise, it is displayed next to the control. The icon is rendered only if both **errors** and **error-icon** are provided.

*props: `errors`, `error-icon`*

```html
<a-input
  v-model="model"
  :error-icon="errorIcon"
  errors="Aloha"
  label="Input"
></a-input>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AInput,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputErrorIcon",
  components: {
    AInput,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("Aloha");
    const errorIcon = "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" fill=\"currentColor\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\"><path d=\"M16 8A8 8 0 1 1 0 8a8 8 0 0 1 16 0M8.93 6.588 8.758 10.042a.5.5 0 0 1-.998 0L7.588 6.588a.5.5 0 1 1 .998 0M8 5.5a.75.75 0 1 0 0-1.5.75.75 0 0 0 0 1.5m0 6a1 1 0 1 0 0-2 1 1 0 0 0 0 2\"/></svg>";

    return {
      errorIcon,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Password input field

This example shows how to use an input field with the type **password** and the ability to toggle password visibility using **show-password**. In the first field, the user can switch between showing and hiding the password, while in the second field this feature is disabled.

*props: `type="password"`, `show-password`*

```html
<a-input
  v-model="model"
  :show-password="true"
  label="Input"
  type="password"
></a-input>
<a-input
  v-model="model"
  :show-password="false"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Input"
  type="password"
></a-input>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AInput,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageInputPassword",
  components: {
    AInput,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("Aloha");
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## **Readonly** fields for password

An example of how **password** input fields are displayed in **readonly** mode. The password value is hidden using a specified symbol, the number of symbols is controlled via **readonly-password-length**, and the symbol itself via **readonly-password-symbol**. The last field shows a variant where **show-password** is enabled and the value is fully visible.

*props: `readonly`, `readonly-password-length`, `readonly-password-symbol`, `show-password`, `type="password"`*

```html
<a-input
  :model-value="model"
  :readonly="true"
  :show-password="false"
  label="Input1"
  type="password"
></a-input>
<a-input
  :model-value="model"
  :readonly-password-length="3"
  :readonly="true"
  :show-password="false"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Input2"
  type="password"
></a-input>
<a-input
  :model-value="model"
  :readonly-password-length="3"
  :readonly="true"
  :show-password="false"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Input3"
  readonly-password-symbol="x"
  type="password"
></a-input>
<a-input
  :model-value="model"
  :readonly="true"
  :show-password="true"
  label="Input4"
  type="password"
></a-input>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";
import { 
  AInput,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageInputReadonlyPassword",
  components: {
    AInput,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref("Aloha");
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| autocomplete | String |  |  | Specifies whether the field should support autocomplete, similar to the **autocomplete** attribute in **HTML**. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| clear-button-class | String / Object |  |  | Specifies the **CSS** class that will be applied to the clear button. This allows customization of the button's appearance according to design requirements. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| error-icon | String / Object |  |  | Specifies the icon displayed when the component has validation errors. If the component has an input field, the icon is shown inside it; otherwise, it is displayed next to the control. The icon is shown only when **errors** is present. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| icon-prepend | String |  |  | Specifies the icon that will be displayed before the input field. This icon can be used to enhance the visual perception or indicate the type of input data. |
| id | String / Number | () => uniqueId("a_input_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| input-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | An object of attributes applied directly to the input element. Allows adding or customizing additional input attributes. |
| input-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the input element. Allows styling the component according to your requirements. |
| is-clear-button | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the clear button should be displayed. If **true**, a button will be shown next to the text field, allowing the user to clear its content. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-label-float | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the label of the component should be positioned above the field. If **true**, the label will move above the text field when focused or when content is present. Deprecated, use label-position. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-position | "float" / "inset" / "top" | "float" |  | Position of the label: "float", "inset" or "top". The default comes from the component plugin or AFormPlugin (labelPosition). |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| maxlength | String / Number |  |  | Sets the maximum number of characters that can be entered into the field. If this limit is exceeded, further input will be prohibited. |
| model-dependencies | Object | () => ({}) |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-undefined | String / Number / Object / Array / Boolean |  |  | The value used to reset the model to an undefined state. Useful for clearing the model value. |
| model-value | String / Number |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| placeholder | String / Number / Object |  |  | Specifies the placeholder text that will be displayed in the input field until the user enters data. The placeholder helps the user understand what data is expected in the field. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| readonly-password-length | Number | 8 |  | The number of characters displayed in read-only mode for the password field. It does not depend on the actual value length. |
| readonly-password-symbol | String | * |  | The symbol used to mask the value of the password field in read-only mode. |
| required | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| show-password | Boolean | true |  | Works when the input type is **password**. Allows toggling the visibility of the entered password, giving the user the option to see the password being typed. |
| step | String / Number |  |  | Used for **number** or **integer** types. Specifies the step for changing the value, for example, when increasing or decreasing the number using keyboard arrows. |
| type | String | text |  | Defines the type of input value. Various data types are supported, such as **text**, **password**, **number**, **integer**, **email**, and others. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Function | Event triggered when the component's model value is updated. Used to synchronize data between the component and the parent component. |
| focus | Function | Event triggered when the component gains focus. Useful for tracking user interaction with the element. |
| blur | Function | Event triggered when the component loses focus. Used to validate or save data when the user leaves the field. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_INPUT_SHOW_PASSWORD_` | Show password |
| `_A_INPUT_HIDE_PASSWORD_` | Hide password |

## CSS variables (`scss/components/ui/ui.scss`)

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--a_form_element_error_color` |  | Color of error texts, error labels and the error icon of form elements. |
| `--a_form_element_label_float_top` |  | Vertical position of a float label while the field is empty and not focused. |
| `--a_form_element_label_float_color` |  | Color of a float label while it is inside the empty field. |
| `--a_form_element_label_float_active_color` |  | Color of a float label after it moved to the border (field focused or filled). |
| `--a_form_element_label_float_bg` |  | Background behind a float label on the border. Set it to the background of the surrounding area. |
| `--a_form_element_label_inset_space` |  | Extra height of the field for an inset label (labelPosition "inset"). |
| `--a_form_element_label_inset_top` |  | Top position of an inset label when the field is focused or filled. |
| `--a_form_element_help_text_color` |  | Color of the help text below the field. |
| `--a_form_element_error_color` |  | Color of error texts, error labels and the error icon of form elements. |
| `--a_form_control_height` |  | Minimum height of the field. |
| `--a_form_control_padding_x` |  | Horizontal padding of the field. |
| `--a_form_control_padding_y` |  | Vertical padding of the field. |
| `--a_form_control_font_size` |  | Font size of the field. |
| `--a_form_control_color` |  | Text color of the field. |
| `--a_form_control_bg` |  | Background of the field. |
| `--a_form_control_border_width` |  | Border width of the field. |
| `--a_form_control_border_color` |  | Border color of the field. |
| `--a_form_control_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of the field. |
| `--a_form_control_hover_border_color` |  | Border color of the field on hover. |
| `--a_form_control_focus_border_color` |  | Border color of the focused field. The focus ring is drawn in addition. |
| `--a_form_control_placeholder_color` |  | Color of the placeholder text. |
| `--a_form_control_disabled_color` |  | Text color of a disabled field. |
| `--a_form_control_disabled_bg` |  | Background of a disabled field. |
| `--a_form_control_disabled_border_color` |  | Border color of a disabled field. |

# AInputCurrency (Currency input field)

The **AInputCurrency** component provides the ability to input and format currency values. The component supports various options, such as currency symbol management, selection of separators, and automatic rounding of numbers.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-input-currency
  v-model="model"
  label="Input"
></a-input-currency>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AInputCurrency,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageInputCurrencyBasic",
  components: {
    AInputCurrency,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(10.02);
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Label position

**label-position** sets where the label is shown: `"float"` – inside the empty field, it moves to the border on focus or with a value; `"inset"` – always inside the field, small above the value; `"top"` – above the field. The default for all form elements is set with **AFormPlugin** (`labelPosition`). **is-label-float** still works, but is deprecated.

*props: `label-position`*

```html
<a-input-currency
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: float"
  label-position="float"
></a-input-currency>
<a-input-currency
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: inset"
  label-position="inset"
></a-input-currency>
<a-input-currency
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: top"
  label-position="top"
></a-input-currency>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInputCurrency,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputCurrencyLabelPosition",
  components: {
    AInputCurrency,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(10.02);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-input-currency
  :change="changeModel"
  :model-value="model"
  label="Input"
></a-input-currency>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AInputCurrency,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageInputCurrencyChange",
  components: {
    AInputCurrency,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(10.02);
    
    const changeModel = ({ model: _model, id, props }) => {
      model.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| autocomplete | String |  |  | Specifies whether the field should support autocomplete, similar to the **autocomplete** attribute in **HTML**. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| clear-button-class | String / Object |  |  | Specifies the **CSS** class that will be applied to the clear button. This allows customization of the button's appearance according to design requirements. |
| controls-type | String | none |  | Defines the type of control elements that will be displayed next to the input field. Possible values are: **plus-minus** (increment and decrement buttons), **arrows** (arrows for changing values), or **none** (no control elements). |
| currency-symbol | String | € |  | Specifies the currency symbol that will be displayed in the input field, such as **$**, **€**, or **₽**. |
| currency-symbol-position | String | right |  | Determines the position of the currency symbol relative to the entered value. Possible values are: **left** (to the left of the value) or **right** (to the right of the value). |
| decimal-divider | String | , |  | Specifies the symbol that will be used as the decimal separator. Possible values are **.** (period) or **,** (comma). |
| decimal-part-length | Number | 2 |  | Defines the number of digits after the decimal separator that will be displayed in the value. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| error-icon | String / Object |  |  | Specifies the icon displayed when the component has validation errors. If the component has an input field, the icon is shown inside it; otherwise, it is displayed next to the control. The icon is shown only when **errors** is present. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| icon-prepend | String |  |  | Specifies the icon that will be displayed before the input field. This icon can be used to enhance the visual perception or indicate the type of input data. |
| id | String / Number | () => uniqueId("a_input_currency_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| input-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | An object of attributes applied directly to the input element. Allows adding or customizing additional input attributes. |
| input-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the input element. Allows styling the component according to your requirements. |
| input-width | String | 200 |  | Sets the width of the input field. The value can be specified in pixels or percentages. |
| integer-part-max-length | Number | 15 |  | Defines the maximum length of the integer part of the value, expressed in the number of digits. |
| is-clear-button | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the clear button should be displayed. If **true**, a button will be shown next to the text field, allowing the user to clear its content. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-label-float | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the label of the component should be positioned above the field. If **true**, the label will move above the text field when focused or when content is present. Deprecated, use label-position. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-position | "float" / "inset" / "top" | "float" |  | Position of the label: "float", "inset" or "top". The default comes from the component plugin or AFormPlugin (labelPosition). |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| max | Number |  |  | Specifies the maximum value that can be entered in the field. |
| min | Number |  |  | Specifies the minimum value that can be entered in the field. |
| model-dependencies | Object | () => ({}) |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-type | String | number |  | Determines the type of data that will be stored in the model. Possible values are **number** (numeric value) or **string** (string value). |
| model-undefined | String / Number / Object / Array / Boolean |  |  | The value used to reset the model to an undefined state. Useful for clearing the model value. |
| model-value | String / Number |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| placeholder | String / Number / Object |  |  | Specifies the placeholder text that will be displayed in the input field until the user enters data. The placeholder helps the user understand what data is expected in the field. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| required | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| step | Number | 1 |  | Used for **number** or **integer** types. Specifies the step for changing the value, for example, when increasing or decreasing the number using keyboard arrows. |
| thousand-divider | String | . |  | Specifies the symbol used for separating thousands in the value. Possible values are **.** (period), **,** (comma), or an empty string (no separator). |
| validation-on-change | Boolean | false |  | If set to **true**, validation of the entered value will be performed with each change in the field. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Function | Event triggered when the component's model value is updated. Used to synchronize data between the component and the parent component. |
| focus | Function | Event triggered when the component gains focus. Useful for tracking user interaction with the element. |
| blur | Function | Event triggered when the component loses focus. Used to validate or save data when the user leaves the field. |

## Label position

**label-position** sets where the label is shown: `"float"` – inside the empty field, it moves to the border on focus or with a value; `"inset"` – always inside the field, small above the value; `"top"` – above the field. The default for all form elements is set with **AFormPlugin** (`labelPosition`). **is-label-float** still works, but is deprecated.

*props: `label-position`*

```html
></a-input-number>
```

# AInputFile (File upload)

The **AInputFile** component chooses files with a button or a dropzone, checks the type, the size and the number of the files, shows them in a list and shows the upload status of every file. The upload itself is done by your application.

Accessibility: the real file input is focusable, its name is the label and the text of the button, the hint with the allowed files is connected with `aria-describedby`. Added, removed and rejected files are announced (aria-live). Every file has a remove button with the file name, after removing the focus moves to the next file or to the input. The dropzone is an addition for the mouse, everything works with the keyboard as well.

## Basic usage

The model is an object with `name`, `size`, `type` and `file`. The list shows the name and the size; a file can be removed.

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-input-file
  v-model="model"
  label="Documents"
></a-input-file>
<div>model: {{ model ? model.name : "" }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInputFile,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputFileBasic",
  components: {
    AInputFile,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(undefined);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Several files

With `is-multiple` the model is an array. A new choice replaces the files; with `is-append` the files are added to the list.

*props: `is-multiple`, `is-append`*

```html
<a-input-file

  class="a_mb_4"
  :is-multiple="true"
  label="is-multiple"
></a-input-file>

  v-model="modelAppend"
  :is-multiple="true"
  :is-append="true"
  label="is-multiple, is-append"
></a-input-file>

```

```js
} from "aloha-vue";
```

## Allowed files

`accept` (extensions and MIME types), `max-size` (bytes) and `max-files` are checked for chosen and for dropped files. They are shown as a hint (`accept-text` replaces the list of types). Files that are not added are listed with the reason and emitted with the event `reject`.

*props: `accept`, `accept-text`, `max-size`, `max-files`, `is-hint`*

```html
<a-input-file
  v-model="model"
  :is-dropzone="true"
  :is-multiple="true"
  :is-append="true"
  accept=".pdf,.docx,image/*"
  accept-text="PDF, Word, images"
  :max-size="1024 * 1024"
  :max-files="3"
  label="Documents"
  @reject="onReject"
></a-input-file>
<div>reject: {{ rejected }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInputFile,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputFileRestrictions",
  components: {
    AInputFile,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref([]);
    const rejected = ref([]);

    const onReject = ({ files }) => {
      rejected.value = files.map(({ name, reason }) => `${ name }: ${ reason }`);
    };

    return {
      model,
      onReject,
      rejected,
    };
  },
};
```

## Upload status

Set `progress` (0–100), `status` (`uploading`, `success`, `error`) and `errorText` in the items of the model, the list shows them. The example simulates the upload; a file with «error» in the name fails.

*props: `model-value`*

```html
<a-input-file
  :model-value="model"
  :is-dropzone="true"
  :is-multiple="true"
  :is-append="true"
  label="Documents"
  @update:model-value="onUpdateModel"
></a-input-file>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInputFile,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputFileUpload",
  components: {
    AInputFile,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref([]);

    // Simulated upload. In a real application send item.file, e.g. with FormData and AHttpAPI,
    // and set progress, status and errorText of the item.
    const upload = item => {
      item.status = "uploading";
      item.progress = 0;
      const TIMER = setInterval(() => {
        item.progress += 20;
        if (item.progress < 100) {
          return;
        }
        clearInterval(TIMER);
        if (/error/i.test(item.name)) {
          item.status = "error";
          item.errorText = "_A_INPUT_FILE_EXAMPLE_SERVER_ERROR_";
          return;
        }
        item.status = "success";
      }, 400);
    };

    const onUpdateModel = files => {
      model.value = files;
      model.value.forEach(item => {
        if (!item.status) {
          upload(item);
        }
      });
    };

    return {
      model,
      onUpdateModel,
    };
  },
};
```

## Existing files and read-only

Files from the server need only `name`, `size` and `url`: the name becomes a link. `is-removable` hides the remove buttons, `readonly` shows only the list.



## Texts and errors

## In AForm

In **AForm** the component is used with `type: "file"`.

*props: `type`*

```html
<a-form
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
></a-form>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputFileForm",
  components: {
    AForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({
      contract: undefined,
      attachments: [],
    });
    const data = [
      {
        id: "contract",
        type: "file",
        label: "_A_INPUT_FILE_EXAMPLE_LABEL_CONTRACT_",
        accept: ".pdf",
        required: true,
      },
      {
        id: "attachments",
        type: "file",
        label: "_A_INPUT_FILE_EXAMPLE_LABEL_ATTACHMENTS_",
        isDropzone: true,
        isMultiple: true,
        isAppend: true,
        maxFiles: 5,
      },
    ];

    return {
      data,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```
