# AInputOtp (One-time code)

The **AInputOtp** component enters a one-time code (OTP), for example a confirmation code from an SMS or an authenticator app. Every character has its own cell, the model is a string.

Accessibility: the cells are a group (`role="group"`) named by the label, every cell has the name «Character 1 of 6». Help text and errors are connected with `aria-describedby`. The first cell has `autocomplete="one-time-code"`, so the browser can fill in a code from an SMS, the code is spread over all cells.

- A typed character moves the focus to the next cell.
- **Backspace**: deletes the character, in an empty cell the character of the previous cell.
- **Delete**: deletes the character of the cell.
- **Arrow left/right**, **Home**, **End**: move between the cells.
- Pasted text is spread over the cells, a whole code always from the first cell. Characters that are not allowed are skipped.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-input-otp
  v-model="model"
  label="Verification code"
></a-input-otp>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInputOtp,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputOtpBasic",
  components: {
    AInputOtp,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("123");

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Length

**length** sets the number of cells (default 6).

*props: `length`*

```html
<a-input-otp
  v-model="modelPin"
  class="a_mb_3"
  :length="4"
  label="PIN"
></a-input-otp>
<a-input-otp
  v-model="modelLong"
  :length="8"
  label="Verification code"
></a-input-otp>
<div>modelPin: {{ modelPin }}</div>
<div>modelLong: {{ modelLong }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInputOtp,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputOtpLength",
  components: {
    AInputOtp,
  },
  setup() {
    const modelPin = ref("");
    const modelLong = ref("");

    return {
      modelLong,
      modelPin,
    };
  },
};
```

## Allowed characters

**char-type**: `numeric` (default, digits and the numeric keyboard), `alphanumeric` (letters and digits) or `any` (all characters except spaces). **is-uppercase** converts letters to upper case.

*props: `char-type`, `is-uppercase`*

```html
<a-input-otp
  v-model="modelNumeric"
  class="a_mb_3"
  label="char-type: numeric"
></a-input-otp>
<a-input-otp
  v-model="modelAlphanumeric"
  class="a_mb_3"
  char-type="alphanumeric"
  :is-uppercase="true"
  label="Voucher code"
></a-input-otp>
<a-input-otp
  v-model="modelAny"
  char-type="any"
  :length="4"
  label="char-type: any"
></a-input-otp>
<div>modelNumeric: {{ modelNumeric }}</div>
<div>modelAlphanumeric: {{ modelAlphanumeric }}</div>
<div>modelAny: {{ modelAny }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInputOtp,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputOtpCharType",
  components: {
    AInputOtp,
  },
  setup() {
    const modelNumeric = ref("");
    const modelAlphanumeric = ref("");
    const modelAny = ref("");

    return {
      modelAlphanumeric,
      modelAny,
      modelNumeric,
    };
  },
};
```

## Custom validation

**validator** is called for every character with `{ char, index }` and returns `true` if the character is allowed. It replaces **char-type**. **inputmode** chooses the keyboard on mobile devices.

*props: `validator`, `inputmode`*

```html
<a-input-otp
  v-model="modelHex"
  class="a_mb_3"
  :validator="validatorHex"
  :is-uppercase="true"
  inputmode="text"
  label="Color (hex)"
></a-input-otp>
<a-input-otp
  v-model="modelLetters"
  :validator="validatorLetters"
  :length="4"
  inputmode="text"
  label="Letters only"
></a-input-otp>
<div>modelHex: {{ modelHex }}</div>
<div>modelLetters: {{ modelLetters }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInputOtp,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputOtpValidator",
  components: {
    AInputOtp,
  },
  setup() {
    const modelHex = ref("");
    const modelLetters = ref("");
    const validatorHex = ({ char }) => /^[\da-f]$/i.test(char);
    const validatorLetters = ({ char }) => /^\p{L}$/u.test(char);

    return {
      modelHex,
      modelLetters,
      validatorHex,
      validatorLetters,
    };
  },
};
```

## Mask and placeholder

*props: `mask`, `placeholder`*

```html

  v-model="modelMask"
  class="a_mb_3"
  :mask="true"
  :length="4"
```

```js
import {
```

## Separator

**separator** is a string between all cells or a function `({ index }) => string` for the gap after the cell with the index, an empty string shows no separator. The slot **separator** gets `{ index }`. Separators are hidden from screen readers.

*props: `separator`*

```html
<a-input-otp
  v-model="model"
  class="a_mb_3"
  :length="4"
  separator="/"
  label="separator: /"
></a-input-otp>
<a-input-otp
  v-model="model"
  class="a_mb_3"
  :separator="separatorMiddle"
  label="separator: function"
></a-input-otp>
<a-input-otp
  v-model="model"
  label="slot separator"
>
  <template v-slot:separator="{ index }">
    <span v-if="index % 2 === 1">•</span>
  </template>
</a-input-otp>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInputOtp,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputOtpSeparator",
  components: {
    AInputOtp,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("");
    const separatorMiddle = ({ index }) => (index === 2 ? "–" : "");

    return {
      model,
      separatorMiddle,
    };
  },
};
```

## Check the code

The event **finish** is emitted when all cells are filled. The example accepts the code `246810`. For another code it shows an error, clears the field and moves the focus to the first cell with the method **focus**.

*props: `finish`, `errors`*

```html
<a-input-otp
  ref="otpRef"
  v-model="model"
  :errors="errors"
  label="Verification code"
  @finish="onFinish"
  @update:model-value="onUpdateModel"
></a-input-otp>
<a-alert
  class="a_mt_3"
  :is-visible="isSuccess"
  type="success"
  text="The code is correct"
></a-alert>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AAlert,
  AInputOtp,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputOtpFinish",
  components: {
    AAlert,
    AInputOtp,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("");
    const errors = ref(undefined);
    const isSuccess = ref(false);
    const otpRef = ref(undefined);

    const onUpdateModel = () => {
      errors.value = undefined;
      isSuccess.value = false;
    };

    const onFinish = ({ model: code }) => {
      if (code === "246810") {
        errors.value = undefined;
        isSuccess.value = true;
        return;
      }
      errors.value = "_A_INPUT_OTP_EXAMPLE_ERROR_";
      model.value = "";
      otpRef.value.focus({ index: 0 });
    };

    return {
      errors,
      isSuccess,
      model,
      onFinish,
      onUpdateModel,
      otpRef,
    };
  },
};
```

## Disabled and read-only

**disabled** disables all cells. **readonly** shows the value as text, with **mask** it shows **readonly-mask-symbol** for every character.

*props: `disabled`, `readonly`, `readonly-mask-symbol`*

```html
<a-input-otp
  v-for="variant in variants"
  :key="variant"
  v-model="model"
  class="a_mb_3"
  :disabled="true"
  :variant="variant"
  :label="`disabled, variant: ${ variant }`"
></a-input-otp>

  class="a_mb_3"
  :readonly="true"
  label="readonly"
></a-input-otp>

  v-model="model"
  :readonly="true"
  :mask="true"
  label="readonly, mask"
></a-input-otp>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInputOtp,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputOtpDisabled",
  components: {
    AInputOtp,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("123456");
    const variants = ["outlined", "filled", "underlined"];

    return {
      model,
      variants,
    };
  },
};
```

## In a form

In **AForm** and **AGroup** the component is used with `type: "otp"`.

*props: `type`*

```html
<a-form
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
></a-form>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageInputOtpForm",
  components: {
    AForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({
      code: "",
      voucher: "",
    });
    const data = [
      {
        id: "code",
        type: "otp",
        label: "_A_INPUT_OTP_EXAMPLE_LABEL_",
        required: true,
      },
      {
        id: "voucher",
        type: "otp",
        label: "_A_INPUT_OTP_EXAMPLE_LABEL_VOUCHER_",
        charType: "alphanumeric",
        isUppercase: true,
        length: 8,
        separator: ({ index }) => (index === 3 ? "-" : ""),
      },
    ];

    return {
      data,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| autocomplete | String | "one-time-code" |  | Value of `autocomplete` of the first cell. `one-time-code` lets the browser fill in a code from an SMS. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| char-type | String | "numeric" |  | Allowed characters: `numeric`, `alphanumeric` or `any` (without spaces). |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | Variables for translations. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| id | String / Number | uniqueId("a_input_otp_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| input-attributes | Object | {} |  | An object of attributes applied directly to the input element. Allows adding or customizing additional input attributes. |
| input-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the input element. Allows styling the component according to your requirements. |
| inputmode | String |  |  | Keyboard on mobile devices (`inputmode` of the cells). By default `numeric` for char-type `numeric`, otherwise `text`. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| is-uppercase | Boolean | false |  | Converts letters to upper case. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| length | Number | 6 |  | Number of cells. |
| mask | Boolean | false |  | Hides the characters (`type="password"`). |
| model-dependencies | Object | {} |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-undefined | String / Number / Object / Array / Boolean | "" |  | The value used to reset the model to an undefined state. Useful for clearing the model value. |
| model-value | String / Number |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| placeholder | String |  |  | Character that is shown in every empty cell. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String | "" |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| readonly-mask-symbol | String | "*" |  | Symbol that is shown in read-only mode for every character if `mask` is set. |
| required | Boolean | false |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| separator | String / Function |  |  | Separator between the cells: a string or a function `({ index }) => string`. |
| size | String |  |  | Size of the cells: `small` or `large`. |
| type | String | "otp" |  | Type of the form element. Used by AForm to choose the component. |
| validator | Function |  |  | Function `({ char, index }) => Boolean` that checks every character. Replaces char-type. |
| variant | String | "outlined" |  | Look of the cells: `outlined`, `filled` or `underlined`. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Function | Event triggered when the component's model value is updated. Used to synchronize data between the component and the parent component. |
| finish | Function | Emitted when all cells are filled. Payload: `{ model }`. |
| focus | Function | Emitted when the focus moves into the component (not when it moves between the cells). |
| blur | Function | Emitted when the focus leaves the component. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| separator | Content of the separator after the cell with the index. Slot props: `{ index }`. |

## Methods

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| focus | `focus({ index })` focuses the cell with the index, without an index the first empty cell. |
| blur | `blur()` removes the focus from the cells. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_INPUT_OTP_CHAR_{{index}}_{{length}}_` | Character {{index}} of {{length}} |

# AJson (JSON Editor)

**AJson** is a Vue.js component designed for displaying and editing **JSON** data. It includes a text area for **JSON** input, buttons for formatting, resetting, and discarding changes, and an area for displaying the current **JSON** value.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-json
  v-model="model"
  label="JSON"
></a-json>
<div>model:</div>
<pre>{{ model }}</pre>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AJson,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageJsonBasic",
  components: {
    AJson,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({});
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-json
  :change="changeModel"
  :model-value="model"
  label="JSON"
></a-json>
<div>model:</div>
<pre>{{ model }}</pre>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AJson,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageJsonChange",
  components: {
    AJson,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({
      glossary: {
        title: "example glossary",
        GlossDiv: {
          title: "S",
          GlossList: {
            GlossEntry: {
              ID: "SGML",
              SortAs: "SGML",
              GlossTerm: "Standard Generalized Markup Language",
              Acronym: "SGML",
              Abbrev: "ISO 8879:1986",
              GlossDef: {
                para: "A meta-markup language, used to create markup languages such as DocBook.",
                GlossSeeAlso: ["GML", "XML"]
              },
              GlossSee: "markup"
            }
          }
        }
      }
    });
    
    const changeModel = ({ model: _model, id, props }) => {
      model.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

```html
  :readonly="true"
```

```js
  ref,

  AJson,
} from "aloha-vue";

        bar: "111",
      },
    });

    const model3 = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
};
```

# AMultiselectOrdered (Ordered Multiselect)

The component allows selecting multiple items with the ability to set their order. Supports sorting, deleting, and moving items within the list.

## Basic usage

*props: `data`, `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-multiselect-ordered
  v-model="model1"
  :data="data"
  key-id="value"
  key-label="label"
  label="Select 1"
></a-multiselect-ordered>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-multiselect-ordered
  v-model="model2"
  :data="data"
  class="a_mt_3"
  key-id="value"
  key-label="label"
  label="Select 2"
></a-multiselect-ordered>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AMultiselectOrdered,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageMultiselectOrderedBasic",
  components: {
    AMultiselectOrdered,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        value: "aloha_1",
        label: "Aloha 1",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_2",
        label: "Aloha 2",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_3",
        label: "Aloha 3",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_4",
        label: "Aloha 4",
      },
    ];
    const model1 = ref(["aloha_4", "aloha_2"]);
    const model2 = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      data,
      model1,
      model2,
    };
  },
};
```

## Grouped extra data

```html
  :search-in-group="true"
```

```js
        value: "extra_2",
        label: "Extra 2",
        group: "Other",
      },
      {
        value: "extra_3",
        label: "Extra 3",
        group: "Other",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref([]);

    return {
      data,
      dataExtra,
```

```js
    };
  },
};
```

## Retrieve invalid entries

Loads ordered multiselect options from local JSON files and renders missing selected values inside a separate invalid entries group.

*props: `url`, `url-retrieve`*

```html
<a-multiselect-ordered
  v-model="model1"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"

  select-label="Add value"
  :url="url"
  :url-retrieve="urlRetrieve"
/>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AMultiselectOrdered,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageMultiselectOrderedRetrieve",
  components: {
    AMultiselectOrdered,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(["aloha_2", "aloha_10", "aloha_11"]);

      model1,
```

## URL template

The value of `file` replaces `{{ file }}` in `url`. Choose another data source to reload the options and clear the selection. The examples load existing local JSON files.

*props: `url`, `url-template-data`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="templateDataBasic.file"
  :data="sources"
  :translate-data="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_"
  type="select"
/>
<a-multiselect-ordered
  v-model="modelBasic"
  :url="urlBasic"
  :url-template-data="templateDataBasic"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS_"
  select-label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_ADD_"
/>
<div>model: {{ modelBasic }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AMultiselectOrdered,
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AMultiselectOrdered,
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const sources = [
      { id: "base", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_FIRST_" },
      { id: "retrieve", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_SECOND_" },
    ];
    const modelBasic = ref(undefined);
    const templateDataBasic = ref({ file: "base" });
    const urlBasic = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-{{ file }}.json`;

    return {
      modelBasic,
      sources,
      templateDataBasic,
      urlBasic,
    };
  },
};
```

## Nested paths and reactive data

A placeholder such as `{{ source.file }}` supports nested object paths. Changing the data source changes the resolved URL, reloads the options and clears the selection. Select an option, then edit the note: it is not used in the URL, so the URL watcher does not run, no new request is sent and the selection is preserved. Replacing `urlTemplateData` with another object that produces the same URL has the same effect.

*props: `url`, `url-template-data`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="templateDataReactive.source.file"
  :data="sources"
  :translate-data="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_"
  type="select"
/>
<a-input
  v-model="templateDataReactive.note"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_NOTE_"
/>
<a-multiselect-ordered
  v-model="modelReactive"
  :url="urlReactive"
  :url-template-data="templateDataReactive"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS_"
  select-label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_ADD_"
/>
<div>model: {{ modelReactive }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInput,
  AMultiselectOrdered,
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AInput,
    AMultiselectOrdered,
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const sources = [
      { id: "base", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_FIRST_" },
      { id: "retrieve", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_SECOND_" },
    ];
    const modelReactive = ref(undefined);
    const templateDataReactive = ref({ source: { file: "base" }, note: "" });
    const urlReactive = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-{{ source.file }}.json`;

    return {
      modelReactive,
      sources,
      templateDataReactive,
      urlReactive,
```
```js
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| api-save-id | String |  |  | A unique identifier for saving data retrieved from the **API**. This can be useful for caching or reusing data within a session. |
| attributes-btn-deselect-all | Object | () => ({}) |  | Attributes and props passed to the **AElement** component used for the “Deselect All” button. They allow customizing the behavior, appearance, and accessibility of the button. |
| attributes-btn-select-all | Object | () => ({}) |  | Attributes and props passed to the **AElement** component used for the “Select All” button. They allow customizing the display, behavior, and accessibility of the button. |
| attributes-fieldset | Object | () => ({}) |  | **HTML** attributes to be added to the **fieldset** tag. |
| btn-delete-class | String / Object | a_btn a_btn_primary |  | **CSS** class for the delete button of an item in the selected list. |
| btn-delete-icon | String | Trash |  | Icon for the item delete button. |
| btn-down-class | String / Object | a_btn a_btn_outline_secondary |  | **CSS** class for the button to move an item closer to the end of the list. |
| btn-down-icon | String | ChevronDown |  | Icon for the button to move an item closer to the end of the list. |
| btn-group-class | String | a_btn_group |  | **CSS** class for the container of the control buttons for the selected item. |
| btn-up-class | String / Object | a_btn a_btn_outline_secondary |  | **CSS** class for the button to move an item closer to the beginning of the list. |
| btn-up-icon | String | ChevronUp |  | Icon for the button to move an item closer to the beginning of the list. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| class-fieldset | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** classes that will be applied to the **fieldset** tag containing the group of controls. This allows customizing the appearance of the group of form elements. |
| class-fieldset | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** classes that will be applied to the **fieldset** tag containing the group of controls. This allows customizing the appearance of the group of form elements. |
| data | Array |  |  | An array of data used to generate the items. |
| data-extra | Array | () => [] |  | An additional array of items not included in the main data array. Its items support the same grouping configuration as **data** through **key-group** and the related group props. |
| merge-data | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether internally loaded data is merged with the **data** prop. Items are merged by their ID; when both sources contain the same ID, the internally loaded item takes precedence. If set to **false**, internally loaded data replaces the **data** prop. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| has-border | Boolean | true |  | Specifies whether the item should have a border. If set to **true**, a border will be displayed around the item. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| id | String / Number | () => uniqueId("a_m_select_ordered_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| is-data-simple-array | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the data array is a simple array of values. If set to **true**, each element of the array will be treated as a simple value without keys. |
| is-deselect-all | Boolean | false |  | Display the button. Clicking it will deselect all items in the list. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| is-select-all | Boolean | false |  | Display the button. Clicking it will automatically select all items from the list. |
| key-disabled | String |  |  | Specifies the key in the data object that determines whether the item will be disabled (unselectable). |
| key-disabled-callback | Function |  |  | A function to determine whether an item should be disabled. Returns `true` to disable a specific item. Accepts an object with item data: `{ item }`. |
| key-group | String / Number / Array |  |  | A key or array of keys used to group data by specific categories. This property allows grouping items into groups. |
| key-group-label-callback | Function |  |  | A callback function that takes two arguments **({ group, item })** and returns the group name. It is used to dynamically determine group names based on the provided data. |
| key-id | String | value |  | The key in the data object that will be used as the identifier for each item. |
| key-label | String | label |  | The key in the data object that specifies the label text for each item. |
| key-label-callback | Function |  |  | A callback function used to generate the label text based on the item data. This allows dynamically creating labels based on complex logic. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| list-item-class | String / Object / Array | a_list_group__item |  | **CSS** class for the list item of selected values. |
| loading | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the item is in a loading state. If set to **true**, the item displays a loading indicator. |
| model-dependencies | Object | () => ({}) |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-value | Array |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| options | Object | () => ({}) |  | Additional data object available within the component, in slots, or custom logic. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| required | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| search | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the search feature is supported. If set to **true**, users will be able to search within the group. |
| search-api | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether item searches will be performed using an **API**. If set to **true**, data will be loaded from the server as the query is entered. |
| search-api-key | String |  |  | The key used to perform the search via **API**. Typically, this is a parameter passed in the server request to filter the data. |
| search-in-group | Boolean |  |  | Enables additional search by group names. |
| search-outside | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the search will be performed outside the component, for example, via **API** or another external data source. |
| search-text-in-html | Boolean |  |  | If set to `true`, the search will be performed on the text extracted from the rendered **HTML**. This allows searching only visible text shown to the user, ignoring tags and attributes. |
| search-timeout | Number | 0 |  | Specifies the delay time in milliseconds before performing the search. Useful for preventing excessive requests during fast text input by the user. |
| select-button-class | String |  |  | Additional CSS class of the button that opens the list. |
| select-button-class-default | String / Object | a_form_control a_select_toggle |  | Default CSS classes of the button that opens the list. Replace them to change the look completely. |
| select-caret-icon | String / Object | ChevronDown |  | Icon next to the button that opens the list. The default is a downward arrow. |
| select-has-caret | Boolean | true |  | Shows the icon next to the button that opens the list. |
| select-in-body | Boolean | true |  | The list is rendered in the container popper-container-id at the end of the body, otherwise directly after the button. |
| select-is-close-by-click | Boolean | false |  | Closes the list after an item is chosen. By default: yes for select, no for multiselect. |
| select-is-label-float | Boolean | true |  | Deprecated, use label-position. true → "float", false → "top". |
| select-is-selection-closeable | Boolean | true |  | Multiselect: all selected items are shown in the button. If false, only the count is shown when there are more than count-multiselect. |
| select-label | String / Number | _A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_LABEL_SELECT_ |  | Label of the field (text or translation key). |
| select-label-class | String / Object |  |  | Additional CSS class of the label. |
| select-label-screenreader | String |  |  | Label that is read only by screen readers. |
| select-menu-class | String / Object |  |  | Additional CSS class of the list. |
| select-menu-width-type | String | as_button |  | Width of the list: "as_button" (as wide as the button) or "by_content" (as wide as its content). |
| select-placeholder | String |  |  | Text in the button when nothing is selected. |
| select-placement | String | bottom-end |  | Position of the list relative to the button. |
| select-popper-container-id | String | a_select_container |  | ID of the container at the end of the body in which the list is rendered (with in-body). |
| slot-name | String |  |  | The name of the main slot used to insert custom content into the component. |
| sort-order | String | asc |  | Specifies the sort order of items. Possible values: **asc** (ascending) or **desc** (descending). |
| sort-order-group | String | asc |  | Specifies the sort order of groups if the items are grouped. Possible values: **asc** (ascending) or **desc** (descending). |
| texts | String | {         btnDeleteTitle: "_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_BTN_DELETE_",         btnDownTitle: "_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_BTN_DOWN_",         btnGroupAriaLabel: "_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_BTN_GROUP_ARIA_LABEL_",         btnUpTitle: "_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_BTN_UP_",         deselectAll: "_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_DESELECT_ALL_",         groupAllAriaLabel: "_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_GROUP_ALL_",         modelEmpty: "_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_MODEL_EMPTY_",         selectAll: "_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_SELECT_ALL_",       } |  | An object with custom texts to replace default labels such as “Select All”, “Deselect All”, “No items selected”, and others. |
| translate-data | Boolean | false |  | Indicates whether the data should be translated before display. If set to **true**, text values will be translated according to the current language settings. |
| url | String |  |  | URL used to load the component’s options. Supports `{{ path }}` placeholders resolved from `url-template-data`. |
| url-retrieve | String |  |  | An optional **URL** used specifically to retrieve already selected values that are missing from the main loaded list. |
| url-params | Object |  |  | Parameters that will be added to the **URL** request when loading data from the server. These parameters allow filtering or modifying the data retrieved from the **API**. |
| url-retrieve-params | Object |  |  | Optional parameters that will be added only to the retrieve request used for loading missing selected values. |
| url-template-data | Object |  |  | Object with values for `{{ path }}` placeholders in `url`, including nested paths such as `{{ source.file }}`. Uses the same placeholder syntax as translations. Changing these values reloads the options and clears the selection only when the resolved URL changes. Does not affect URLs without placeholders; query parameters are passed separately via `url-params`. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_BTN_DELETE_` | Remove from list |
| `_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_BTN_DOWN_` | Move closer to the end of the list |
| `_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_BTN_GROUP_ARIA_LABEL_` | Actions for |
| `_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_BTN_UP_` | Move closer to the beginning of the list |
| `_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_DESELECT_ALL_` | Deselect all |
| `_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_GROUP_ALL_` | Selection control |
| `_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_LABEL_SELECT_` | Select an item |
| `_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_MODEL_EMPTY_` | No items selected |
| `_A_MULTISELECT_ORDERED_SELECT_ALL_` | Select all |

# AOneCheckbox (Single checkbox)

The **AOneCheckbox** component represents a single checkbox with the ability to bind to a data model. The checkbox can display text next to it and supports various states and settings.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-one-checkbox
  v-model="model"
  label="Aloha"
></a-one-checkbox>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AOneCheckbox,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageOneCheckboxBasic",
  components: {
    AOneCheckbox,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-one-checkbox
  :change="changeModel"
  :model-value="model"
  label="Aloha"
></a-one-checkbox>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AOneCheckbox,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageOneCheckboxChange",
  components: {
    AOneCheckbox,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(undefined);
    
    const changeModel = ({ model: _model, id, props }) => {
      model.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |

| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| is-width-auto | Boolean |  |  | Adds a special class to the **label** with the width set to **auto**. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-attributes | Object | {} |  | Additional props and **HTML** attributes for customizing the **label** tag, which is rendered using the **AElement** component. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |

| model-value | Boolean / String / Number |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |

| slot-name | String |  |  | The name of the slot that will be used instead of the default text if a slot with the specified name is passed to the component. |
| true-value | Boolean / String / Number | true |  | The value that will be passed to the model when the checkbox is checked. |

# ARadio (Radio buttons)

The **ARadio** component represents a set of radio buttons, where the user can select only one item from the given options. The component supports various settings such as group collapsing, button group display, search functionality, and many others.

## Basic usage

*props: `data`, `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-radio
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  label="Aloha"
></a-radio>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ARadio,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageRadioBasic",
  components: {
    ARadio,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        value: "aloha_1",
        label: "Aloha 1",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_2",
        label: "Aloha 2",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_3",
        label: "Aloha 3",
      },

        value: "aloha_4",
        label: "Aloha 4",
```

## Item grouping

This example demonstrates how to use **key-group** and **key-group-label-callback** to group items and set group names in the component. In the first case, simple grouping by **alohaBR** and **aloha** keys is used. In the second example, the **key-group-label-callback** callback function is additionally applied to dynamically determine group names based on the data.

*props: `key-group`, `key-group-label-callback`*

```html
<a-radio
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :key-group="['alohaBR', 'aloha']"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="key-group"
></a-radio>
<a-radio
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :key-group="['alohaBR', 'aloha']"
  :key-group-label-callback="onGroupLabelCallback"
  class="a_mt_3"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="key-group + key-group-callback"
></a-radio>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ARadio,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageRadioGroup",
  components: {
    ARadio,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        label: "Aloha 0",
        id: "aloha_0",
        aloha: "",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 1",
        id: "aloha_1",
        aloha: "Buba",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 2",
        id: "aloha_2",
        aloha: "Buba",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 3",
        id: "aloha_3",
        aloha: "Sandra",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 4",
        id: "aloha_4",
        aloha: "Sandra",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 5",
        id: "aloha_5",
        aloha: "Coco",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 6",
        id: "aloha_6",
        aloha: "Coco",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 7",
        id: "aloha_7",
        aloha: "Alex",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 8",
        id: "aloha_8",
        aloha: "Alex",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref(undefined);
    
    const onGroupLabelCallback = ({ group, item }) => {
      if (group === "_not_grouped") {
        return "---";
      }

      if (group === "Alex") {
        return `-${ group }-`;
      }

      return group;
    };

    return {
      data,
      model,
      onGroupLabelCallback,
    };
  },
};
```

## URL template

The value of `file` replaces `{{ file }}` in `url`. Choose another data source to reload the options and clear the selection. The examples load existing local JSON files.

*props: `url`, `url-template-data`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="templateDataBasic.file"
  :data="sources"
  :translate-data="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_"
  type="select"
/>
<a-radio
  v-model="modelBasic"
  :url="urlBasic"
  :url-template-data="templateDataBasic"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS_"
/>
<div>model: {{ modelBasic }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARadio,
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ARadio,
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const sources = [
      { id: "base", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_FIRST_" },
      { id: "retrieve", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_SECOND_" },
    ];
    const modelBasic = ref(undefined);
    const templateDataBasic = ref({ file: "base" });
    const urlBasic = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-{{ file }}.json`;

    return {
      modelBasic,
      sources,
      templateDataBasic,
      urlBasic,
    };
  },
};
```

## Nested paths and reactive data

A placeholder such as `{{ source.file }}` supports nested object paths. Changing the data source changes the resolved URL, reloads the options and clears the selection. Select an option, then edit the note: it is not used in the URL, so the URL watcher does not run, no new request is sent and the selection is preserved. Replacing `urlTemplateData` with another object that produces the same URL has the same effect.

*props: `url`, `url-template-data`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="templateDataReactive.source.file"
  :data="sources"
  :translate-data="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_"
  type="select"
/>
<a-input
  v-model="templateDataReactive.note"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_NOTE_"
/>
<a-radio
  v-model="modelReactive"
  :url="urlReactive"
  :url-template-data="templateDataReactive"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS_"
/>
<div>model: {{ modelReactive }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInput,
  ARadio,
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AInput,
    ARadio,
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const sources = [
      { id: "base", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_FIRST_" },
      { id: "retrieve", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_SECOND_" },
    ];
    const modelReactive = ref(undefined);
    const templateDataReactive = ref({ source: { file: "base" }, note: "" });
    const urlReactive = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-{{ source.file }}.json`;

    return {
      modelReactive,
      sources,
      templateDataReactive,
      urlReactive,
    };
  },
};
```

## Collapse/expand

This example demonstrates how to use **collapsible** and **is-collapsed** in the component. The **collapsible** property allows the group of items to be collapsible, while **is-collapsed** sets the initial collapsed state. The example also demonstrates the use of the **toggle-collapse** event, which is triggered when the group is collapsed or expanded.

*props: `collapsible`, `is-collapsed`; emits: `toggle-collapse`*

```html

  key-label="label"
  label="Aloha"

></a-radio>
<a-radio
  v-model="model"

  key-label="label"
  label="Aloha"
  @toggle-collapse="toggleCollapse"
></a-radio>
<a-radio
  v-model="model"

  :data="data"

></a-radio>
```

## Focus and blur

This example shows how the component reacts to gaining and losing focus. The "`focusin`" event is triggered once when the focus enters the component for the first time. The "`focusout`" event is triggered only when the focus fully leaves the component.

*emits: `focusin`, `focusout`*

```html
<a-radio
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :key-group="['alohaBR', 'aloha']"
  :search="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Radio1"
  @focusin="focusin1"
  @focusout="focusout1"
></a-radio>
<a-radio
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :key-group="['alohaBR', 'aloha']"
  :is-button-group="true"
  :search="true"
  class="a_mt_5"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Radio2"
  class-button-group-default="a_btn a_btn_outline_secondary a_text_nowrap"
  @focusin="focusin2"
  @focusout="focusout2"
></a-radio>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ARadio,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageRadioFocusBlur",
  components: {
    ARadio,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        label: "Aloha 0",
        id: "aloha_0",
        aloha: "",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 1",
        id: "aloha_1",
        aloha: "Buba",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 2",
        id: "aloha_2",
        aloha: "Buba",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 3",
        id: "aloha_3",
        aloha: "Sandra",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 4",
        id: "aloha_4",
        aloha: "Sandra",
        alohaBR: "Köln",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 5",
        id: "aloha_5",
        aloha: "Coco",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 6",
        id: "aloha_6",
        aloha: "Coco",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 7",
        id: "aloha_7",
        aloha: "Alex",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 8",
        id: "aloha_8",
        aloha: "Alex",
        alohaBR: "Düsseldorf",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref(undefined);
    
    const focusin1 = ({ event, props }) => {
      console.log("focusin1", event, props);
    };

    const focusin2 = ({ event, props }) => {
      console.log("focusin2", event, props);
    };
    const focusout1 = ({ event, props }) => {
      console.log("focusout1", event, props);
    };

    const focusout2 = ({ event, props }) => {
      console.log("focusout2", event, props);
    };
    
    return {
      data,
      focusin1,
      focusin2,
      focusout1,
      focusout2,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## **Readonly** display mode

In this example, the component is used in **readonly** mode, where the value is displayed as text and cannot be modified by the user.

```html

  :model-value="model1"

  :readonly="true"
  label="Radio 1"

  :model-value="model2"
  :data="data"
  :is-model-array="true"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Radio 2"
></a-radio>
<a-radio
  :model-value="model3"
  :data="data"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Radio 3"
></a-radio>
<a-radio
  :model-value="model3"
  :data="data"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Radio 4"
  readonly-default="-"
></a-radio>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ARadio,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageRadioReadonly",
  components: {
    ARadio,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        value: "aloha_1",
        label: "Aloha 1",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_2",
        label: "Aloha 2",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_3",
        label: "Aloha 3",
      },
      {
        value: "aloha_4",
        label: "Aloha 4",
      },
    ];
    const model1 = ref("aloha_1");
    const model2 = ref(["aloha_4", "aloha_5"]);
    const model3 = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      data,
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
};
```

# ARate (Rating)

The **ARate** component shows a rating with icons and lets the user choose a value from 1 to **max**. It is a form element: it has a label, help text, errors, read-only mode and works in **AForm**. The model is a number, `0` means «not rated».

Accessibility: the component is one focusable element with `role="slider"`. Its name is the label, `aria-valuetext` contains the value and the text of the value (for example «3 of 5, Okay»). The icons are hidden from screen readers. In read-only mode the icons are an image (`role="img"`) with the same text.

- **Arrow right/up**: higher value, **Arrow left/down**: lower value (with **allow-half** in steps of 0.5, in right-to-left languages the arrows are swapped).
- **Home** / **End**: lowest / highest value.
- Digit keys: set the value directly.
- **Delete** / **Backspace**: remove the rating (only with **clearable**).

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-rate
  v-model="model"
  label="Your rating"
></a-rate>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARate,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageRateBasic",
  components: {
    ARate,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(3);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Number of icons

**max** sets the number of icons and the highest value (default 5).

*props: `max`*

```html
<a-rate
  v-model="model"
  :max="10"
  :show-score="true"
  score-template="{{value}} / {{max}}"
  label="Your rating"
></a-rate>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARate,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageRateMax",
  components: {
    ARate,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(7);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Half values

With **allow-half** the left half of an icon selects a half value. The keyboard changes the value in steps of 0.5.

*props: `allow-half`*

```html
<a-rate
  v-model="model"
  :allow-half="true"
  :show-score="true"
  label="Your rating"
></a-rate>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARate,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageRateAllowHalf",
  components: {
    ARate,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(3.5);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Sizes

**size**: `small`, default or `large`.

*props: `size`*

```html
<a-rate
  v-model="model"
  class="a_mb_3"
  size="small"
  label="size: small"
></a-rate>
<a-rate
  v-model="model"
  class="a_mb_3"
  label="size: default"
></a-rate>
<a-rate
  v-model="model"
  size="large"
  label="size: large"
></a-rate>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARate,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageRateSize",
  components: {
    ARate,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(4);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Colors by level

The value is in one of three levels: up to **low-threshold** (default 2), from **high-threshold** (default 4) and between. **colors** is a color, an array with three colors (low, medium, high) or an object with thresholds as keys. Without **colors** the CSS variables `--a_rate_fill_color_low`, `_medium` and `_high` are used.

*props: `colors`, `low-threshold`, `high-threshold`*

```html
<a-rate
  v-model="modelArray"
  class="a_mb_3"
  :colors="colorsArray"
  :show-text="true"
  label="colors: Array"
></a-rate>
<a-rate
  v-model="modelObject"
  :colors="colorsObject"
  :max="10"
  :low-threshold="3"
  :high-threshold="8"
  :show-score="true"
  label="colors: Object"
></a-rate>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARate,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageRateColors",
  components: {
    ARate,
  },
  setup() {
    const modelArray = ref(2);
    const modelObject = ref(6);
    const colorsArray = ["var(--a_color_danger)", "var(--a_color_warning)", "var(--a_color_success)"];
    const colorsObject = {
      3: "var(--a_color_danger)",
      7: "var(--a_color_warning)",
      10: "var(--a_color_success)",
    };

    return {
      colorsArray,
      colorsObject,
      modelArray,
      modelObject,
    };
  },
};
```

## Icons

**icons** is the filled icon: an icon, an array with three icons (low, medium, high) or an object with thresholds as keys, like **colors**. **void-icon** is the empty icon. Icons are names of registered icons or SVG strings.

*props: `icons`, `void-icon`*

```html
<a-rate
  v-model="modelHeart"
  class="a_mb_3"
  :icons="HeartFill"
  :void-icon="Heart"
  colors="var(--a_color_danger)"
  label="Food"
></a-rate>
<a-rate
  v-model="modelEmoji"
  :icons="iconsEmoji"
  :void-icon="EmojiNeutral"
  :colors="colorsEmoji"
  :show-text="true"
  label="Service"
></a-rate>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARate,
} from "aloha-vue";

import EmojiFrownFill from "aloha-svg/dist/js/bootstrap/EmojiFrownFill";
import EmojiNeutral from "aloha-svg/dist/js/bootstrap/EmojiNeutral";
import EmojiNeutralFill from "aloha-svg/dist/js/bootstrap/EmojiNeutralFill";
import EmojiSmileFill from "aloha-svg/dist/js/bootstrap/EmojiSmileFill";
import Heart from "aloha-svg/dist/js/bootstrap/Heart";
import HeartFill from "aloha-svg/dist/js/bootstrap/HeartFill";

export default {
  name: "PageRateIcons",
  components: {
    ARate,
  },
  setup() {
    const modelHeart = ref(3);
    const modelEmoji = ref(4);
    const iconsEmoji = [EmojiFrownFill, EmojiNeutralFill, EmojiSmileFill];
    const colorsEmoji = ["var(--a_color_danger)", "var(--a_color_warning)", "var(--a_color_success)"];

    return {
      colorsEmoji,
      EmojiNeutral,
      Heart,
      HeartFill,
      iconsEmoji,
      modelEmoji,
      modelHeart,
    };
  },
};
```

## Text

**show-text** shows the text of the value after the icons. **texts** is an array with a text (or a translation key) for every value, by default 5 texts. The text of a half value is the text of the next whole value. The text is also part of `aria-valuetext`.

*props: `show-text`, `texts`*

```html
<a-rate
  v-model="modelDefault"
  class="a_mb_3"
  :show-text="true"
  label="Your rating"
></a-rate>
<a-rate
  v-model="modelCustom"
  :show-text="true"
  :texts="texts"
  label="Service"
></a-rate>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARate,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageRateText",
  components: {
    ARate,
  },
  setup() {
    const modelDefault = ref(3);
    const modelCustom = ref(5);
    const texts = [
      "_A_RATE_EXAMPLE_TEXT_1_",
      "_A_RATE_EXAMPLE_TEXT_2_",
      "_A_RATE_EXAMPLE_TEXT_3_",
      "_A_RATE_EXAMPLE_TEXT_4_",
      "_A_RATE_EXAMPLE_TEXT_5_",
    ];

    return {
      modelCustom,
      modelDefault,
      texts,
    };
  },
};
```

## Disabled and read-only

**disabled** shows the icons, but the value cannot be changed and the component is not focusable. **readonly** shows the rating as an image, also with decimal values like `3.7`.

## Help text and label description

**help-text** and **label-description** are connected to the component with `aria-describedby`.

*props: `help-text`, `label-description`*

```html
<a-rate
  v-model="model"
  label="Service"
  label-description="How satisfied are you with our service?"
  help-text="Click the same icon again to remove the rating"
  :clearable="true"
></a-rate>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARate,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageRateHelpText",
  components: {
    ARate,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(0);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Errors

**errors** shows the error text, colors the empty icons and sets `aria-invalid`.

*props: `errors`, `required`*

```html
<a-rate
  v-model="model"
  :required="true"
  :errors="model ? undefined : 'Please rate the service'"
  label="Service"
></a-rate>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARate,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageRateErrors",
  components: {
    ARate,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(0);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## In a form

In **AForm** and **AGroup** the component is used with `type: "rate"`.

*props: `type`*

```html
<a-form
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
></a-form>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageRateForm",
  components: {
    AForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({
      service: 4,
      food: 0,
    });
    const data = [
      {
        id: "service",
        type: "rate",
        label: "_A_RATE_EXAMPLE_LABEL_SERVICE_",
        showText: true,
        required: true,
      },
      {
        id: "food",
        type: "rate",
        label: "_A_RATE_EXAMPLE_LABEL_FOOD_",
        allowHalf: true,
        clearable: true,
        showScore: true,
      },
    ];

    return {
      data,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Styles with CSS variables

Colors and sizes are CSS variables (table at the end of the page). They can be set for the whole project or for one component, for example with `style` or a class.

*props: `style`*

```html
<a-rate
  v-model="model"
  :style="styleRate"
  :show-score="true"
  label="Your rating"
></a-rate>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARate,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageRateCss",
  components: {
    ARate,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(4);
    const styleRate = {
      "--a_rate_fill_color": "var(--a_color_primary)",
      "--a_rate_icon_size": "2rem",
      "--a_rate_gap": ".5rem",
      "--a_rate_text_font_size": "1.25rem",
    };

    return {
      model,
      styleRate,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| allow-half | Boolean | false |  | Allows half values. |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| clearable | Boolean | false |  | Allows removing the rating: click on the current value, `Delete` or `Backspace`. |
| colors | String / Array / Object |  |  | Color of the filled icons: a color, an array with three colors (low, medium, high) or an object with thresholds as keys. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | Variables for translations. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| high-threshold | Number | 4 |  | From this value the level is high. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| icons | String / Array / Object | StarFill |  | Filled icon: an icon, an array with three icons (low, medium, high) or an object with thresholds as keys. |
| id | String / Number | uniqueId("a_rate_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| low-threshold | Number | 2 |  | Up to this value the level is low. |
| max | Number | 5 |  | Number of icons and highest value. |
| model-dependencies | Object | {} |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-undefined | String / Number / Object / Array / Boolean | 0 |  | The value used to reset the model to an undefined state. Useful for clearing the model value. |
| model-value | Number / String |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String | "" |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| required | Boolean | false |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| score-template | String | "_A_RATE_SCORE_{{value}}_{{max}}_" |  | Text or translation key of the score with `{{value}}` and `{{max}}`. |
| show-score | Boolean | false |  | Shows the value after the icons. |
| show-text | Boolean | false |  | Shows the text of the value after the icons. |
| size | String |  |  | Size of the icons: `small` or `large`. |
| texts | Array | ["_A_RATE_TEXT_1_", …, "_A_RATE_TEXT_5_"] |  | Texts or translation keys for the values 1 to max. |
| type | String | "rate" |  | Type of the form element. Used by AForm to choose the component. |
| void-icon | String | Star |  | Empty icon. |
| color | String |  |  | Deprecated, use `colors`. Will be removed in 4.0. |
| half-icon | Boolean |  |  | Deprecated, use `allow-half`. Will be removed in 4.0. |
| hovered-color | String |  |  | Deprecated, use the CSS variable `--a_rate_hover_fill_color`. Will be removed in 4.0. |
| icon | String |  |  | Deprecated, use `void-icon`. Will be removed in 4.0. |
| icon-fill | String |  |  | Deprecated, use `icons`. Will be removed in 4.0. |
| rating | Number |  |  | Deprecated, use `max`. Will be removed in 4.0. |
| text | String |  |  | Deprecated, use `show-text` and `texts` or `label`. Will be removed in 4.0. |

## Events

| --- | --- | --- |

| focus | Function | Event triggered when the component gains focus. Useful for tracking user interaction with the element. |
| blur | Function | Event triggered when the component loses focus. Used to validate or save data when the user leaves the field. |

# ARouterLinkConfig (Router link config)

The **ARouterLinkConfig** component provides an interface for configuring navigation links with route, query, params, and target values. It is useful when links need to be built dynamically from form data.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-router-link-config
  v-model="model"
  :required="true"
  label="Aloha"
></a-router-link-config>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARouterLinkConfig,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageRouterLinkConfigReadonly",
  components: {
    ARouterLinkConfig,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({
      route: "NotFoundTest",
      query: {
        key: "Aloha",
      },
    });
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Using **label-description**

This example shows how to use **label-description** to add additional description to the component label. This allows providing the user with more detailed information about the purpose of the field.

*props: `label-description`*

```html
<a-router-link-config
  v-model="model"
  label="Router"
  label-description="Aloha"
></a-router-link-config>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARouterLinkConfig,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageRouterLinkConfigLabelDescription",
  components: {
    ARouterLinkConfig,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({
      route: "NotFoundTest",
      query: {
        key: "Aloha",
      },
    });
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Type

This example shows how to use the **type** prop to switch between single-route and multi-route selection modes.

*props: `type`*

```html
<a-router-link-config
  v-model="model1"
  :required="true"
  label="Select"
  type="selectRoute"
></a-router-link-config>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-router-link-config
  v-model="model2"
  :required="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Select"
  type="multiselectRoute"
></a-router-link-config>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARouterLinkConfig,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageRouterLinkConfigType",
  components: {
    ARouterLinkConfig,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(undefined);
    const model2 = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      model1,
      model2,
    };
  },
};
```

## **Readonly** display mode

In this example, the component is used in **readonly** mode, where the value is displayed as text and cannot be modified by the user.

*props: `readonly`, `readonly-default`, `readonly-default-route`, `readonly-default-param`, `readonly-default-query`, `readonly-default-target`*

```html
<a-router-link-config
  :model-value="model1"
  :readonly="true"
  label="Router 1"
  readonly-default-param="-"
></a-router-link-config>
<a-router-link-config
  :model-value="model2"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Router 2"
  readonly-default-query="-"
  readonly-default-target="-"
></a-router-link-config>
<a-router-link-config
  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Router 3"
></a-router-link-config>
<a-router-link-config
  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Router 4"
  readonly-default="-"
></a-router-link-config>
<a-router-link-config
  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  help-text="Aloha"
  label="Router 5"
  readonly-default-route="-"
></a-router-link-config>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ARouterLinkConfig,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageRouterLinkConfigReadonly",
  components: {
    ARouterLinkConfig,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref({
      route: "NotFoundTest",
      param: {
        id: 123,
      },
      query: {
        key: "Aloha",
      },
      target: "_self",
    });
    const model2 = ref({
      route: "PageQuickStart",
    });
    const model3 = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
};
```

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_ROUTER_LINK_CONFIG_HELP_TEXT_PARAM_` | Dynamic parameters are used in routes to pass data within the path. They are denoted by a colon `:` before the parameter name, for example: `/user/:id`. When navigating, this parameter is replaced with a specific value, such as: `/user/123`. |
| `_A_ROUTER_LINK_CONFIG_HELP_TEXT_QUERY_` | URL parameters allow passing additional information in the request. They are added after the `?` symbol in the address bar and follow the format "key=value". For example: `?limit=10&sort=asc`. |
| `_A_ROUTER_LINK_CONFIG_HELP_TEXT_ROUTE_` | The address determines where the link will navigate. It can be static (e.g., `/home`) or contain dynamic parameters (e.g., `/user/:id`). Select the address for navigation. |
| `_A_ROUTER_LINK_CONFIG_HELP_TEXT_TARGET_` | Defines where the link will open. Available options: in the same window (`_self`), in a new window or tab (`_blank`), in the parent frame (`_parent`), or in the outermost frame (`_top`). |
| `_A_ROUTER_LINK_CONFIG_LABEL_PARAM_` | Dynamic parameters |
| `_A_ROUTER_LINK_CONFIG_LABEL_QUERY_` | URL parameters |
| `_A_ROUTER_LINK_CONFIG_LABEL_ROUTE_` | Select address |
| `_A_ROUTER_LINK_CONFIG_LABEL_TARGET_` | target attribute |

# ASelect (Select)

ASelect is a component that allows users to make one or more choices from a predefined list of options.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `data`, `key-id`, `key-label`, `label`, `type`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Aloha"
  type="select"
></a-select>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSelectBasic",
  components: {
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        label: "Aloha 1",
        id: "aloha_1",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 2",
        id: "aloha_2",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 3",
        id: "aloha_3",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 4",
        id: "aloha_4",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 5",
        id: "aloha_5",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref(undefined);

    return {
      data,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Label position

**label-position** sets where the label is shown: `"float"` – inside the empty field, it moves to the border on focus or with a value; `"inset"` – always inside the field, small above the value; `"top"` – above the field. The default for all form elements is set with **AFormPlugin** (`labelPosition`). **is-label-float** still works, but is deprecated.

*props: `label-position`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: float"
  label-position="float"
  :data="data"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
></a-select>
<a-select
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: inset"
  label-position="inset"
  :data="data"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
></a-select>
<a-select
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: top"
  label-position="top"
  :data="data"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
></a-select>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageSelectLabelPosition",
  components: {
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("1");
    const data = [
      {
        id: "1",
        label: "Aloha",
      },
      {
        id: "2",
        label: "Hola",
      },
    ];

    return {
      data,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Error icon

This example shows how to display a custom error icon when the component has validation errors. If the component has an input field, the icon is shown inside it; otherwise, it is displayed next to the control. The icon is rendered only if both **errors** and **error-icon** are provided.

*props: `errors`, `error-icon`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :error-icon="errorIcon"
  errors="Aloha"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Select"
  type="select"
></a-select>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageSelectErrorIcon",
  components: {
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(undefined);
    const errorIcon = "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" fill=\"currentColor\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\"><path d=\"M16 8A8 8 0 1 1 0 8a8 8 0 0 1 16 0M8.93 6.588 8.758 10.042a.5.5 0 0 1-.998 0L7.588 6.588a.5.5 0 1 1 .998 0M8 5.5a.75.75 0 1 0 0-1.5.75.75 0 0 0 0 1.5m0 6a1 1 0 1 0 0-2 1 1 0 0 0 0 2\"/></svg>";
    const data = [
      {
        label: "Aloha 1",
        id: "aloha_1",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 2",
        id: "aloha_2",
      },
      {
        label: "Aloha 3",
        id: "aloha_3",
      },
    ];

    return {
      data,
      errorIcon,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Grouping

Select options in a dropdown can be customized by grouping them by one or multiple keys. This can be useful for cases where one choice overrides all others, like a "None of the above" or "Select All" option.

*props: `key-group`*

```html
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"

  label="Aloha"
  type="select"
></a-select>
```

## Search

Select options values can be filtered based on the search query. This is useful for components with a long list of options, makeing it easier for users for find and choose the needed option.

*props: `search`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :key-group="['alohaBR', 'aloha']"
  :search="true"
  :search-in-group="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
```

## Search in **HTML** text

## Selected options first

With **show-selected-first**, selected options are displayed directly below the search and action buttons. They keep their groups when grouping is enabled, are separated from the remaining options by one divider, and are not duplicated in the main list.

*props: `show-selected-first`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="modelSelect"
  :data="data"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Select"
  :search="true"
  :show-selected-first="true"
  type="select"
></a-select>

<a-select
  v-model="modelMultiselect"
  :data="data"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Multiselect"
  :is-deselect-all="true"
  :is-select-all="true"
  :search="true"
  :show-selected-first="true"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select>

<a-select
  v-model="modelSelectGrouped"
  :data="data"
  key-group="group"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Select grouped"
  :search="true"
  :show-selected-first="true"
  type="select"
></a-select>

<a-select
  v-model="modelMultiselectGrouped"
  :data="data"
  key-group="group"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Multiselect grouped"
  :is-deselect-all="true"
  :is-select-all="true"
  :search="true"
  :show-selected-first="true"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select>
```

## Exclusive option

An exclusive option can be defines as a special choice that, when selected, prevents the selection of any other options or deselects all previously chosen options.

```html
  key-label="label"

  type="multiselect"

  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :exclusive-option-label="exclusiveOptionLabel"

  :is-exclusive-option-enabled="true"
  :is-select-all="true"
  :search="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Aloha 2"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select>
```

## One item per group

With `mode="one_per_group"` and `key-group` a multiselect allows only one item of each group: choosing an item deselects the other item of its group.

*props: `mode='one_per_group'`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="model"
  :data="data"
  :translate-data="true"
  key-group="group"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Aloha"
  mode="one_per_group"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
      },
    ];

    };
  },
};
```
