## Retrieve from local JSON

Loads the base list and retrieve candidates from local JSON files without a backend. Missing selected values are fetched through the retrieve callback and marked as invalid entries when they are not present in the base list.

```html
<a-select
  v-model="model1"
  :show-not-found="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Select with retrieve"
  label-not-found="_A_SELECT_LABEL_NOT_FOUND_"
  type="select"
  :url="url"
  :url-retrieve="urlRetrieve"
/>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>

<a-select
  v-model="model2"
  :show-not-found="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="Multiselect with retrieve"
  label-not-found="_A_SELECT_LABEL_NOT_FOUND_"
  type="multiselect"
  :url="url"
  :url-retrieve="urlRetrieve"
/>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageSelectRetrieve",
  components: {
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref("aloha_10");
    const model2 = ref(["aloha_2", "aloha_10", "aloha_11", "aloha_998", "aloha_999"]);
    const url = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-base.json`;
    const urlRetrieve = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-retrieve.json`;

    return {
      model1,
      model2,
      url,
      urlRetrieve,
    };
  },
};

/*
app.use(ADataRetrievePlugin, {
  callbacks: {
    retrieve: async ({ modelArray = [], url = "" }) => {
      const response = await fetch(url);
      const data = await response.json();

      return data.filter(item => modelArray.includes(item.id));
    },
  },
});
*/
```

## URL template

The value of `file` replaces `{{ file }}` in `url`. Choose another data source to reload the options and clear the selection. The examples load existing local JSON files.

*props: `url`, `url-template-data`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="templateDataBasic.file"
  :data="sources"
  :translate-data="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_"
  type="select"
/>
<a-select
  v-model="modelBasic"
  :url="urlBasic"
  :url-template-data="templateDataBasic"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS_"
  type="select"
/>
<div>model: {{ modelBasic }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const sources = [
      { id: "base", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_FIRST_" },
      { id: "retrieve", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_SECOND_" },
    ];
    const modelBasic = ref(undefined);
    const templateDataBasic = ref({ file: "base" });
    const urlBasic = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-{{ file }}.json`;

    return {
      modelBasic,
      sources,
      templateDataBasic,
      urlBasic,
    };
  },
};
```

## Nested paths and reactive data

A placeholder such as `{{ source.file }}` supports nested object paths. Changing the data source changes the resolved URL, reloads the options and clears the selection. Select an option, then edit the note: it is not used in the URL, so the URL watcher does not run, no new request is sent and the selection is preserved. Replacing `urlTemplateData` with another object that produces the same URL has the same effect.

*props: `url`, `url-template-data`*

```html
<a-select
  v-model="templateDataReactive.source.file"
  :data="sources"
  :translate-data="true"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_"
  type="select"
/>
<a-input
  v-model="templateDataReactive.note"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_NOTE_"
/>
<a-select
  v-model="modelReactive"
  :url="urlReactive"
  :url-template-data="templateDataReactive"
  key-id="id"
  key-label="label"
  label="_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_OPTIONS_"
  type="select"
/>
<div>model: {{ modelReactive }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInput,
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AInput,
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const sources = [
      { id: "base", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_FIRST_" },
      { id: "retrieve", label: "_A_UI_URL_TEMPLATE_SOURCE_SECOND_" },
    ];
    const modelReactive = ref(undefined);
    const templateDataReactive = ref({ source: { file: "base" }, note: "" });
    const urlReactive = `${ import.meta.env.BASE_URL }assets/mock/select-{{ source.file }}.json`;

    return {
      modelReactive,
      sources,
      templateDataReactive,
      urlReactive,
    };
  },
};
```

# ASelectIcon (Icon selector)

A component based on **ASelect** that allows selecting one or multiple icons available in the system. Supports search, grouping, display customization, and icon management.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `type`*

```html
<a-select-icon
  v-model="model1"
  label="Select"
  type="select"
></a-select-icon>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-select-icon
  v-model="model2"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Multiselect"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select-icon>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASelectIcon,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSelectIconBasic",
  components: {
    ASelectIcon,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(undefined);
    const model2 = ref(undefined);

    return {
      model1,
      model2,
    };
  },
};
```

## Label position

**label-position** sets where the label is shown: `"float"` – inside the empty field, it moves to the border on focus or with a value; `"inset"` – always inside the field, small above the value; `"top"` – above the field. The default for all form elements is set with **AFormPlugin** (`labelPosition`). **is-label-float** still works, but is deprecated.

*props: `label-position`*

```html
<a-select-icon
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: float"
  label-position="float"
  type="select"
></a-select-icon>
<a-select-icon
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: inset"
  label-position="inset"
  type="select"
></a-select-icon>
<a-select-icon
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: top"
  label-position="top"
  type="select"
></a-select-icon>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ASelectIcon,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageSelectIconLabelPosition",
  components: {
    ASelectIcon,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(undefined);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-select-icon
  :change="changeModel1"
  :model-value="model1"
  label="Select 1"
></a-select-icon>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-select-icon
  :change="changeModel2"
  :model-value="model2"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Select 2"
  type="multiselect"
></a-a-select-icon>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASelectIcon,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSelectIconChange",
  components: {
    ASelectIcon,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(undefined);
    const model2 = ref(undefined);

    const changeModel1 = ({ model: _model, id, props, item, currentModel }) => {
      model1.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props, item, currentModel);
    };
    const changeModel2 = ({ model: _model, id, props, item, currentModel }) => {
      model2.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props, item, currentModel);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel1,
      changeModel2,
      model1,
      model2,
    };
  },
};
```

## **Readonly** display mode

In this example, the component is used in **readonly** mode, where the value is displayed as text and cannot be modified by the user.

*props: `readonly`, `readonly-default`*

```html

  :model-value="model1"

  label="Select 1"
  type="select"
></a-select-icon>

  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"

  type="multiselect"

  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Select 3"
  type="select"
></a-select-icon>

  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"

  label="Select 4"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select-icon>

  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| button-class | String |  |  | Additional CSS class of the button that opens the list. |
| button-class-default | String / Object | a_form_control a_select_toggle |  | Default CSS classes of the button that opens the list. Replace them to change the look completely. |
| caret-icon | String / Object | ChevronDown |  | Icon next to the button that opens the list. The default is a downward arrow. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| class | String / Object |  |  | CSS class or class object of the outer container of the component. |
| count-multiselect | Number | 4 |  | Multiselect: how many selected items are shown in the button. The others are summarized as "+N more". |
| data | Array |  |  | An array of data used to generate the items. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| deselectable | Boolean | true |  | Select: the selected item can be deselected by clicking it again. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| exceeded-items-deletable | Boolean | true |  | Multiselect: shows a button that removes the selected items beyond count-multiselect. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| has-caret | Boolean | true |  | Shows the icon next to the button that opens the list. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| id | String / Number | () => uniqueId("a_select_icon_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| in-body | Boolean | true |  | The list is rendered in the container popper-container-id at the end of the body, otherwise directly after the button. |
| is-close-by-click | Boolean |  |  | Closes the list after an item is chosen. By default: yes for select, no for multiselect. |
| is-deselect-all | Boolean | false |  | Display the button. Clicking it will deselect all items in the list. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-label-float | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the label of the component should be positioned above the field. If **true**, the label will move above the text field when focused or when content is present. Deprecated, use label-position. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| is-select-all | Boolean | false |  | Display the button. Clicking it will automatically select all items from the list. |
| is-selection-closeable | Boolean | true |  | Multiselect: all selected items are shown in the button. If false, only the count is shown when there are more than count-multiselect. |
| key-disabled | String |  |  | Specifies the key in the data object that determines whether the item will be disabled (unselectable). |
| key-disabled-callback | Function |  |  | A function to determine whether an item should be disabled. Returns `true` to disable a specific item. Accepts an object with item data: `{ item }`. |
| key-group | String / Number / Array | () => ["groupName", "subGroupName"] |  | A key or array of keys used to group data by specific categories. This property allows grouping items into groups. |
| key-group-label-callback | Function |  |  | A callback function that takes two arguments **({ group, item })** and returns the group name. It is used to dynamically determine group names based on the provided data. |
| key-id | String | value |  | The key in the data object that will be used as the identifier for each item. |
| key-label | String | label |  | The key in the data object that specifies the label text for each item. |
| key-label-callback | Function |  |  | A callback function used to generate the label text based on the item data. This allows dynamically creating labels based on complex logic. |
| key-title | String |  |  | The key in the data object that specifies the title for each item. |
| key-title-callback | Function |  |  | A callback function used to generate the title based on the item data. This allows dynamically creating titles based on complex logic. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-position | "float" / "inset" / "top" | "float" |  | Position of the label: "float", "inset" or "top". The default comes from the component plugin or AFormPlugin (labelPosition). |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| max-count-multiselect | Number |  |  | Multiselect: maximum number of items that can be selected. |
| menu-width-type | String | as_button |  | Width of the list: "as_button" (as wide as the button) or "by_content" (as wide as its content). |
| model-dependencies | Object | () => ({}) |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-value | String / Array |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| options | Object | () => ({}) |  | Additional data object available within the component, in slots, or custom logic. |
| placeholder | String |  |  | Specifies the placeholder text that will be displayed in the input field until the user enters data. The placeholder helps the user understand what data is expected in the field. |
| placement | String | bottom-end |  | Position of the list relative to the button. |
| popper-container-id | String | a_select_container |  | ID of the container at the end of the body in which the list is rendered (with in-body). |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| required | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| search | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the search feature is supported. If set to **true**, users will be able to search within the group. |
| search-text-in-html | Boolean |  |  | If set to `true`, the search will be performed on the text extracted from the rendered **HTML**. This allows searching only visible text shown to the user, ignoring tags and attributes. |
| search-timeout | Number | 0 |  | Specifies the delay time in milliseconds before performing the search. Useful for preventing excessive requests during fast text input by the user. |
| select-menu-class | String / Object |  |  | Additional CSS class of the list. |
| slot-name | String | icon |  | The name of the main slot used to insert custom content into the component. |
| sort-order | String | asc |  | Specifies the sort order of items. Possible values: **asc** (ascending) or **desc** (descending). |
| text-deselect-all | String | _A_SELECT_DESELECT_ALL_ |  | Text of the “Deselect all” button. |
| text-select-all | String | _A_SELECT_SELECT_ALL_ |  | Text of the “Select all” button. |
| type | String | select |  | Defines the selector type. Supported values are **select**, **selectIcon**, **multiselect**, and **multiselectIcon**. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Function | Event triggered when the component's model value is updated. Used to synchronize data between the component and the parent component. |
| focus | Function | Event triggered when the component gains focus. Useful for tracking user interaction with the element. |
| blur | Function | Event triggered when the component loses focus. Used to validate or save data when the user leaves the field. |
| open | Function | Emitted when the list is opened. |

# ASelectStyle (Style Selection)

Component for selecting styles from a predefined set of styles

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `type`*

```html
<a-select-style
  v-model="model1"
  label="Select"
  type="select"
></a-select-style>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-select-style
  v-model="model2"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Multiselect"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select-style>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASelectStyle,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSelectStyleBasic",
  components: {
    ASelectStyle,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(undefined);
    const model2 = ref(undefined);

    return {
      model1,
      model2,
    };
  },
};
```

## Label position

**label-position** sets where the label is shown: `"float"` – inside the empty field, it moves to the border on focus or with a value; `"inset"` – always inside the field, small above the value; `"top"` – above the field. The default for all form elements is set with **AFormPlugin** (`labelPosition`). **is-label-float** still works, but is deprecated.

*props: `label-position`*

```html
<a-select-style
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: float"
  label-position="float"
  type="select"
></a-select-style>
<a-select-style
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: inset"
  label-position="inset"
  type="select"
></a-select-style>
<a-select-style
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: top"
  label-position="top"
  type="select"
></a-select-style>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ASelectStyle,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageSelectStyleLabelPosition",
  components: {
    ASelectStyle,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(undefined);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-select-style
  :change="changeModel1"
  :model-value="model1"
  label="Select 1"
></a-select-style>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-select-style
  :change="changeModel2"
  :model-value="model2"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Select 2"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select-style>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASelectStyle,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSelectStyleChange",
  components: {
    ASelectStyle,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(undefined);
    const model2 = ref(undefined);

    const changeModel1 = ({ model: _model, id, props, item, currentModel }) => {
      model1.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props, item, currentModel);
    };
    const changeModel2 = ({ model: _model, id, props, item, currentModel }) => {
      model2.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props, item, currentModel);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel1,
      changeModel2,
      model1,
      model2,
    };
  },
};
```

## **Readonly** display mode

In this example, the component is used in **readonly** mode, where the value is displayed as text and cannot be modified by the user.

*props: `readonly`, `readonly-default`*

```html
<a-select-style
  :model-value="model1"
  :readonly="true"
  label="Select 1"
  type="select"
></a-select-style>
<a-select-style
  :model-value="model2"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Select 2"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select-style>
<a-select-style
  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Select 3"
  type="select"
></a-select-style>
<a-select-style
  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Select 4"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select-style>
<a-select-style
  :model-value="model3"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  help-text="Aloha"
  label="Select 5"
  readonly-default="-"
  type="select"
></a-select-style>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASelectStyle,
} from "aloha-vue";

  name: "PageSelectStyleReadonly",
  components: {
    ASelectStyle,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref("a_color_primary");
    const model2 = ref(["a_d_flex", "a_bg_secondary"]);
    const model3 = ref(undefined);

    return {
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
};
```

| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| button-class | String |  |  | Additional CSS class of the button that opens the list. |
| button-class-default | String / Object | a_form_control a_select_toggle |  | Default CSS classes of the button that opens the list. Replace them to change the look completely. |
| caret-icon | String / Object | ChevronDown |  | Icon next to the button that opens the list. The default is a downward arrow. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| class | String / Object |  |  | CSS class or class object of the outer container of the component. |
| count-multiselect | Number | 4 |  | Multiselect: how many selected items are shown in the button. The others are summarized as "+N more". |
| data | Array |  |  | An array of data used to generate the items. |
| data-extended | Array | () => [] |  | Array of objects with additional styles for the component |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| deselectable | Boolean | true |  | Select: the selected item can be deselected by clicking it again. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| exceeded-items-deletable | Boolean | true |  | Multiselect: shows a button that removes the selected items beyond count-multiselect. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| filter-groups | Array / Object |  |  | Array or object for filtering style groups |
| has-caret | Boolean | true |  | Shows the icon next to the button that opens the list. |

| id | String / Number | () => uniqueId("a_select_styles_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| in-body | Boolean | true |  | The list is rendered in the container popper-container-id at the end of the body, otherwise directly after the button. |
| is-close-by-click | Boolean |  |  | Closes the list after an item is chosen. By default: yes for select, no for multiselect. |
| is-deselect-all | Boolean | false |  | Display the button. Clicking it will deselect all items in the list. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-label-float | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the label of the component should be positioned above the field. If **true**, the label will move above the text field when focused or when content is present. Deprecated, use label-position. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| is-select-all | Boolean | false |  | Display the button. Clicking it will automatically select all items from the list. |
| is-selection-closeable | Boolean | true |  | Multiselect: all selected items are shown in the button. If false, only the count is shown when there are more than count-multiselect. |
| key-disabled | String |  |  | Specifies the key in the data object that determines whether the item will be disabled (unselectable). |
| key-disabled-callback | Function |  |  | A function to determine whether an item should be disabled. Returns `true` to disable a specific item. Accepts an object with item data: `{ item }`. |
| key-group | String / Number / Array | () => ["groupName", "subGroupName"] |  | A key or array of keys used to group data by specific categories. This property allows grouping items into groups. |
| key-group-label-callback | Function |  |  | A callback function that takes two arguments **({ group, item })** and returns the group name. It is used to dynamically determine group names based on the provided data. |
| key-id | String | value |  | The key in the data object that will be used as the identifier for each item. |
| key-label | String | label |  | The key in the data object that specifies the label text for each item. |
| key-label-callback | Function |  |  | A callback function used to generate the label text based on the item data. This allows dynamically creating labels based on complex logic. |
| key-title-callback | Function | ({ item }) => getTranslatedText({         placeholder: item.label,       }) |  | A callback function used to generate the title based on the item data. This allows dynamically creating titles based on complex logic. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-position | "float" / "inset" / "top" | "float" |  | Position of the label: "float", "inset" or "top". The default comes from the component plugin or AFormPlugin (labelPosition). |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| max-count-multiselect | Number |  |  | Multiselect: maximum number of items that can be selected. |
| menu-width-type | String | as_button |  | Width of the list: "as_button" (as wide as the button) or "by_content" (as wide as its content). |
| model-dependencies | Object | () => ({}) |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-value | String / Array |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| options | Object | () => ({}) |  | Additional data object available within the component, in slots, or custom logic. |
| placeholder | String |  |  | Specifies the placeholder text that will be displayed in the input field until the user enters data. The placeholder helps the user understand what data is expected in the field. |
| placement | String | bottom-end |  | Position of the list relative to the button. |
| popper-container-id | String | a_select_container |  | ID of the container at the end of the body in which the list is rendered (with in-body). |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |

| search | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the search feature is supported. If set to **true**, users will be able to search within the group. |
| search-timeout | Number | 0 |  | Specifies the delay time in milliseconds before performing the search. Useful for preventing excessive requests during fast text input by the user. |
| select-menu-class | String / Object |  |  | Additional CSS class of the list. |
| slot-name | String |  |  | The name of the main slot used to insert custom content into the component. |
| sort-order | String | asc |  | Specifies the sort order of items. Possible values: **asc** (ascending) or **desc** (descending). |
| sort-order-group | String | asc |  | Specifies the sort order of groups if the items are grouped. Possible values: **asc** (ascending) or **desc** (descending). |

# ASlider (Slider)

ASlider is a component for selecting a numeric value or a range within a specified interval. It supports minimum and maximum limits, step values, ranges, stop markers, and display customization.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `disabled`*

```html
<a-slider
  v-model="model"
  label="_A_SLIDER_BASIC_LABEL_"
></a-slider>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
<a-slider
  v-model="model"
  :disabled="true"
  label="_A_SLIDER_DISABLED_LABEL_"
></a-slider>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";
import { 
  ASlider,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSliderBasic",
  components: {
    ASlider,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(50);
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-slider
  :change="changeModel"
  :model-value="model"
  label="_A_SLIDER_BASIC_LABEL_"
></a-input>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASlider,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSliderChange",
  components: {
    ASlider,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(30);
    
    const changeModel = ({ model: _model, id, props }) => {
      model.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Help text

This example shows how to use **help-text** to add a help text below the input field. The help text provides additional information to the user about the expected data in this field.

*props: `help-text`*

```html
<a-slider
  v-model="model"
  help-text="Aloha"
  label="_A_SLIDER_BASIC_LABEL_"
></a-slider>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

  ASlider,
} from "aloha-vue";

  name: "PageSliderHelpText",
  components: {
    ASlider,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(20);
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Range selection

This example shows how to use the **range** prop so the slider can select a range between two values.

*props: `range`*

```html
<a-slider
  v-model="model1"
  :range="true"
  label="_A_SLIDER_BASIC_LABEL_"
></a-slider>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-slider
  v-model="model2"
  :range="true"
  label="_A_SLIDER_BASIC_LABEL_"
></a-slider>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
<a-slider
  v-model="model3"
  :range="true"
  label="_A_SLIDER_BASIC_LABEL_"
></a-slider>
<div>model3: {{ model3 }}</div>
<a-slider
  v-model="model4"
  :disabled="true"
  :range="true"
  label="_A_SLIDER_DISABLED_LABEL_"
></a-slider>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASlider,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSliderRange",
  components: {
    ASlider,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref([]);
    const model2 = ref([0]);
    const model3 = ref([0, 20]);
    const model4 = ref([4, 50]);
    
    return {
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
      model4,
    };
  },
};
```

## Minimum, maximum, and step

This example shows how to configure the slider with custom **min**, **max**, and **step** values.

*props: `min`, `max`, `step`*

```html
<a-slider
  v-model="model1"
  :extra="{ max: 40, min: 10, step: 2 }"
  :max="40"
  :min="10"
  :step="2"
  label="_A_SLIDER_BASIC_LABEL_{{max}}_{{min}}_{{step}}_"
></a-slider>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-slider
  v-model="model2"
  :extra="{ max: 50, min: -10, step: 10 }"
  :max="50"
  :min="-10"
  :step="10"
  label="_A_SLIDER_BASIC_LABEL_{{max}}_{{min}}_{{step}}_"
></a-slider>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
<a-slider
  v-model="model3"
  :extra="{ max: 40, min: 20, step: 4 }"
  :max="40"
  :min="20"
  :range="true"
  :step="4"
  label="_A_SLIDER_RANGE_LABEL_{{max}}_{{min}}_{{step}}_"
></a-slider>
<div>model3: {{ model3 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASlider,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSliderMinMax",
  components: {
    ASlider,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(30);
    const model2 = ref(-1);
    const model3 = ref([20, 40]);
    
    return {
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
};
```

## Data-based values

This example shows how to use the **data** prop together with **key-id** so the slider values are derived from predefined data entries.

*props: `data`, `key-id`*

```html
<a-slider
  v-model="model1"
  :data="data"
  key-id="id"
  label="_A_SLIDER_BASIC_LABEL_"
></a-slider>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-slider
  v-model="model2"
  :data="data"
  :extra="{ max: 30, min: 10 }"
  :max="30"
  :min="10"
  key-id="id"
  label="_A_SLIDER_BASIC_LABEL_{{max}}_{{min}}_"
></a-slider>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
<a-slider
  v-model="model3"
  :data="data"
  :extra="{ max: 30, min: 10 }"
  :max="30"
  :min="10"
  :range="true"
  key-id="id"
  label="_A_SLIDER_RANGE_LABEL_{{max}}_{{min}}_"LABEL_{{max}}_{{min}}_{{step}}_"
></a-slider>
<div>model3: {{ model3 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASlider,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSliderData",
  components: {
    ASlider,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      { id: 1 },
      { id: 1 },
      { id: 1 },
      { id: 0 },
      { id: 1 },
      { id: 2 },
      { id: 3 },
      { id: 5 },
      { id: 7 },
      { id: 4 },
      { id: 6 },
      { id: 10 },
      { id: 11 },
      { id: 15 },
      { id: 19 },
      { id: 23 },
      { id: 30 },
      { id: 40 },
      { id: 35 },
      { id: 11 },
    ];
    const model1 = ref(undefined);
    const model2 = ref(11);
    const model3 = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      data,
      model1,
      model2,
      model3,
    };
  },
};
```

## Stop markers

This example shows how to use **show-stops** to display intermediate stop markers on the slider.

*props: `show-stops`*

```html
<a-slider
  v-model="model1"
  :max="20"
  :min="10"
  :show-stops="false"
  label="_A_SLIDER_LABEL_NOT_SHOW_STOPS_"
></a-slider>
<a-slider
  v-model="model2"
  :max="20"
  :min="10"
  :show-stops="true"
  label="_A_SLIDER_LABEL_SHOW_STOPS_"
></a-slider>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASlider,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSliderStops",
  components: {
    ASlider,
  },
  setup() {

  },
```

# ASwitch (Switch)

The **ASwitch** component is a switch with support for various states that can be bound to a data model. The component supports both two-state and three-state modes, as well as the display of custom labels.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`*

```html
<a-switch
  v-model="model"
></a-switch>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASwitch,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSwitchBasic",
  components: {
    ASwitch,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(false);
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-switch
  :change="changeModel"
  :model-value="model"
></a-switch>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASwitch,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSwitchChange",
  components: {
    ASwitch,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(false);
    
    const changeModel = ({ model: _model, id, props }) => {
      model.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Help text

This example shows how to use **help-text** to add a help text below the input field. The help text provides additional information to the user about the expected data in this field.

*props: `help-text`*

```html
  help-text="Aloha"
```

```js
  },
};
```

## Error icon

This example shows how to display a custom error icon when the component has validation errors. If the component has an input field, the icon is shown inside it; otherwise, it is displayed next to the control. The icon is rendered only if both **errors** and **error-icon** are provided.

*props: `errors`, `error-icon`*

```html
<a-switch
  v-model="model"
  :error-icon="errorIcon"
  errors="Aloha"
  label="ASwitch"
></a-switch>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ASwitch,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageSwitchErrorIcon",
  components: {
    ASwitch,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(false);
    const errorIcon = "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" fill=\"currentColor\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\"><path d=\"M16 8A8 8 0 1 1 0 8a8 8 0 0 1 16 0M8.93 6.588 8.758 10.042a.5.5 0 0 1-.998 0L7.588 6.588a.5.5 0 1 1 .998 0M8 5.5a.75.75 0 1 0 0-1.5.75.75 0 0 0 0 1.5m0 6a1 1 0 1 0 0-2 1 1 0 0 0 0 2\"/></svg>";

    return {
      errorIcon,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

```js
} from "aloha-vue";

    ASwitch,
  },
```

```js
    const model = ref(undefined);

    const changeModel = ({ init }) => {
      console.log("changeModel init", init);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Using **true-label** and **false-label**

This example demonstrates how to use **true-label** and **false-label** to set the displayed labels of the switch. When the model value corresponds to the **true** state, the switch displays the label **1**, and when in the **false** state, it displays the label **0**.

*props: `false-label`, `true-label`*

```html
<a-switch
  v-model="model"
  false-label="0"
  true-label="1"
```

```js
  },
};
```

## Using **true-value** and **false-value**

This example demonstrates how to use **true-value** and **false-value** to set the values assigned to the model when switching. When the switch is in the **true** state, the model value becomes '1'. In the **false** state, the model value becomes '0'.

*props: `false-value`, `true-value`*

```html
<a-switch
```

```js
} from "aloha-vue";

    ASwitch,
  },

    const model = ref(0);
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Three-State mode

This example demonstrates how to use a switch in three-state mode using **is-three-state**, **default-value**, and **default-label**. When the switch is in an intermediate state, the model value is set to **default-value** (in this case, **null**), and the label **Default** is displayed. This mode allows the switch to have three states: **true**, **false**, and a default state.

*props: `is-three-state`, `default-value`, `default-label`*

```html
<a-switch
  v-model="model"
  :default-value="null"
  :is-three-state="true"
  default-label="Default"
></a-switch>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASwitch,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageSwitchThreeState",
  components: {
    ASwitch,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(null);
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| default | Boolean / String / Number |  |  | Sets the default value used to initialize the component when **model-value** is undefined. |
| default-label | String | _A_SWITCH_DEFAULT_LABEL_ |  | If the model value does not match **falseValue** and **trueValue**, this label is displayed. |
| default-value | Boolean / String / Number |  |  | Used only when **isThreeState** is set to **true**, for representing the third state of the model. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| error-icon | String / Object |  |  | Specifies the icon displayed when the component has validation errors. If the component has an input field, the icon is shown inside it; otherwise, it is displayed next to the control. The icon is shown only when **errors** is present. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| false-label | String | _A_SWITCH_FALSE_LABEL_ |  | The label displayed when the switch is in the **false** state. |
| false-value | Boolean / String / Number | false |  | The value assigned to the model when the switch is in the **false** state. |
| full-width | Boolean |  |  | If set to **true**, the switch takes up the full available width. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| id | String / Number | () => uniqueId("a_switch_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| input-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | An object of attributes applied directly to the input element. Allows adding or customizing additional input attributes. |
| input-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the input element. Allows styling the component according to your requirements. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| is-three-state | Boolean | false |  | Used for a three-state switch: **trueValue**, **falseValue**, and **defaultValue**. |
| is-title-html | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the tooltip should be interpreted as **HTML**. If set to **true**, the content of the tooltip will be displayed with **HTML** formatting. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| model-dependencies | Object | () => ({}) |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-undefined | String / Number / Object / Array / Boolean |  |  | The value used to reset the model to an undefined state. Useful for clearing the model value. |
| model-value | Boolean / String / Number |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| required | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| title | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Sets the text of the tooltip that will appear when hovering over an element. The tooltip can be presented as plain text or an object for different devices (e.g., desktops and mobile devices). |
| title-placement | String | top |  | Specifies the position of the tooltip relative to the element. Various positions are supported, such as **top**, **bottom**, **left**, **right**, and others. This property only works if **isTitleHtml** is set to **true**. |
| true-label | String | _A_SWITCH_TRUE_LABEL_ |  | The label displayed when the switch is in the **true** state. |
| true-value | Boolean / String / Number | true |  | The value assigned to the model when the switch is in the **true** state. |

# ATemplate (Template)

The **ATemplate** component is used as a universal slot for components such as **[AFieldset](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/fieldset.md)** and **[AForm](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/form.md)**. It extends the functionality of these components by providing flexibility to display custom content using slots and passing data through properties.

## Using **HTML**

This example demonstrates how to use **html** to render **HTML** content inside the **ATemplate** component. The **HTML** code is safely displayed within the component.

*props: `html`*

```html
<a-template
  :html="html"
></a-template>
```

```js
import {
  ATemplate,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTemplateHtml",
  components: {
    ATemplate,
  },
  setup() {
    const html = "<ul><li>Aloha 1</li><li>Aloha 2</li></ul>";
    
    return {
      html,
    };
  },
};
```

## Slot

This example demonstrates how to use **slot-name** and **options** in the **ATemplate** component. The slot receives the **options** parameters, as well as all component props, which can be used to configure the displayed content.

*props: `slot-name`, `options`*

```html
<a-template
  :options="{ id: 'template', text: 'Aloha' }"
  slot-name="aloha"
>
  <template
    v-slot:aloha="{ options, props }"
  >
    <div
      :id="options.id"
    >{{ options.text }}</div>
  </template>
</a-template>
```

## Using a template in **AFieldset**

This example demonstrates how to use the **template** slot in the **AFieldset** component. One of the child elements is a template that is rendered through the **template** slot. In this example, a button with the text **'Aloha'** is displayed inside the template.

```html
<a-fieldset
  v-model="model"
  :children="children"
  label="Fieldset"
>
  <template
    v-slot:template
  >
    <a-element
      class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
      text="Aloha"
      type="button"
    ></a-element>
  </template>
</a-fieldset>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AElement,
  AFieldset,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTemplateFieldset",
  components: {
    AElement,
    AFieldset,
  },
  setup() {
    const children = [
      {
        type: "text",
        label: "Text",
        id: "aloha.text",
      },
      {
        type: "template",
        slotName: "template",
      },
    ];
    const model = ref(undefined);
    
    return {
      children,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| html | String |  |  | **HTML** content that will be safely rendered inside the component. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| options | String / Number / Object / Array / Boolean |  |  | Any data to pass into the slot. |
| slot-name | String |  |  | The name of the slot where the custom content will be passed. |

# ATextarea (Multiline text field)

The **ATextarea** component provides the functionality of a text field with various settings such as scalability, a clear button, and the ability to resize. The component also supports labels, help text, and error display.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `label`*

```html
<a-textarea
  v-model="model"
  label="Textarea"
></a-textarea>
<div>model:</div>
<pre>{{ model }}</pre>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ATextarea,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTextareaBasic",
  components: {
    ATextarea,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("Aloha");
    
    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Label position

**label-position** sets where the label is shown: `"float"` – inside the empty field, it moves to the border on focus or with a value; `"inset"` – always inside the field, small above the value; `"top"` – above the field. The default for all form elements is set with **AFormPlugin** (`labelPosition`). **is-label-float** still works, but is deprecated.

*props: `label-position`*

```html
<a-textarea
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: float"
  label-position="float"
></a-textarea>
<a-textarea
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: inset"
  label-position="inset"
></a-textarea>
<a-textarea
  v-model="model"
  label="label-position: top"
  label-position="top"
></a-textarea>
<div>model: {{ model }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ATextarea,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageTextareaLabelPosition",
  components: {
    ATextarea,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("Aloha");

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Model change function

In this example, the **change** function is responsible for updating the component's model. The function takes three arguments: the model **model**, the component identifier **id**, and all passed **props**. This approach allows flexible handling of model changes and performing additional actions such as logging or validation.

*props: `change`, `model-value`*

```html
<a-textarea
  :change="changeModel"
  :model-value="model"
  label="Textarea"
></a-textarea>
<div>model:</div>
<pre>{{ model }}</pre>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ATextarea,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTextareaChange",
  components: {
    ATextarea,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("Aloha");
    
    const changeModel = ({ model: _model, id, props }) => {
      model.value = _model;
      console.log(id, props);
    };
    
    return {
      changeModel,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Help text

## Error icon

This example shows how to display a custom error icon when the component has validation errors. If the component has an input field, the icon is shown inside it; otherwise, it is displayed next to the control. The icon is rendered only if both **errors** and **error-icon** are provided.

*props: `errors`, `error-icon`*


```js
} from "vue";

  ATextarea,
} from "aloha-vue";

  name: "PageTextareaErrorIcon",
  components: {
    ATextarea,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref("Aloha");
    const errorIcon = "<svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" fill=\"currentColor\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\"><path d=\"M16 8A8 8 0 1 1 0 8a8 8 0 0 1 16 0M8.93 6.588 8.758 10.042a.5.5 0 0 1-.998 0L7.588 6.588a.5.5 0 1 1 .998 0M8 5.5a.75.75 0 1 0 0-1.5.75.75 0 0 0 0 1.5m0 6a1 1 0 1 0 0-2 1 1 0 0 0 0 2\"/></svg>";
    
    return {
      errorIcon,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## **Readonly** display mode

In this example, the component is used in **readonly** mode, where the value is displayed as text and cannot be modified by the user.

*props: `readonly`, `readonly-default`*

```html
<a-textarea
  :model-value="model1"
  :readonly="true"
  label="Textarea 1"
></a-textarea>
<a-textarea
  :model-value="model2"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Textarea 2"
></a-textarea>
<a-textarea
  :model-value="model2"
  :readonly="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
  help-text="Aloha"
  label="Textarea 3"
  readonly-default="-"
></a-textarea>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ATextarea,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTextareaReadonly",
  components: {
    ATextarea,
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| autocomplete | String |  |  | Specifies whether the field should support autocomplete, similar to the **autocomplete** attribute in **HTML**. |
| change | Function | () => {} |  | Function called when the model changes. It accepts the new model value and additional parameters for processing the change. |
| clear-button-class | String / Object |  |  | Specifies the **CSS** class that will be applied to the clear button. This allows customization of the button's appearance according to design requirements. |
| dependencies | Array / Object |  |  | Specifies dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component based on the values of other elements. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component is disabled. If set to **true**, the component becomes inactive and the user cannot interact with it. |
| errors | String / Array |  |  | Contains text or an array of errors that should be displayed to the user. If there are errors, they are displayed below the component. |
| error-icon | String / Object |  |  | Specifies the icon displayed when the component has validation errors. If the component has an input field, the icon is shown inside it; otherwise, it is displayed next to the control. The icon is shown only when **errors** is present. |
| exclude-render-attributes | Array | () => [] |  | Array of attributes that should not be rendered for this component. Useful for excluding unnecessary attributes from the final **DOM**. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| help-text | String |  |  | Help text displayed below the component. Provides the user with additional information or instruction. |
| html-id | String |  |  | Sets the **HTML ID** of the element. Can be used to uniquely identify the component on the page. |
| id | String / Number | () => uniqueId("a_textarea_") |  | The identifier of the component, which can be used to track or refer to the component in the code. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| input-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | An object of attributes applied directly to the input element. Allows adding or customizing additional input attributes. |
| input-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the input element. Allows styling the component according to your requirements. |
| is-clear-button | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the clear button should be displayed. If **true**, a button will be shown next to the text field, allowing the user to clear its content. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-label-float | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the label of the component should be positioned above the field. If **true**, the label will move above the text field when focused or when content is present. Deprecated, use label-position. |
| is-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| is-scalable | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the height of the text field should change based on the content. If this parameter is set to **true**, the height of the text field will automatically adjust as characters are added or removed. |
| label | String / Number |  |  | Label text displayed next to the component. Typically used to describe the purpose of the input element. |
| label-class | String / Object |  |  | **CSS** class(es) applied to the label. Allows customizing the label's style. |
| label-description | String |  |  | Additional description displayed next to the component label. Helps the user better understand the purpose of the field. |
| label-position | "float" / "inset" / "top" | "float" |  | Position of the label: "float", "inset" or "top". The default comes from the component plugin or AFormPlugin (labelPosition). |
| label-screen-reader | String / Number |  |  | Label intended for screen readers. Useful for improving accessibility. |
| maxlength | String / Number |  |  | Sets the maximum number of characters that can be entered into the field. If this limit is exceeded, further input will be prohibited. |
| model-dependencies | Object | () => ({}) |  | Determines model dependencies that may affect the visibility or behavior of the component. |
| model-undefined | String / Number / Object / Array / Boolean |  |  | The value used to reset the model to an undefined state. Useful for clearing the model value. |
| model-value | String / Number |  |  | The current model value associated with the component. Used to manage the data displayed in the component. |
| placeholder | String / Number / Object |  |  | Specifies the placeholder text that will be displayed in the input field until the user enters data. The placeholder helps the user understand what data is expected in the field. |
| readonly | Boolean |  |  | Enables read-only mode, where the value is displayed as text without the possibility of editing. |
| readonly-default | String |  |  | The default text that is shown if the value is missing in read-only mode. |
| required | Boolean |  |  | Indicates whether the component is required. If set to **true**, the component requires user input. |
| resize | String | v |  | Defines how the user can resize the text field. Available options: **'v'** — vertical resizing, **'h'** — horizontal resizing, **'none'** — resizing is disabled, **'auto'** — resizing is automatic. |
| rows | String / Number |  |  | Sets the number of rows for the text field. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Function | Event triggered when the component's model value is updated. Used to synchronize data between the component and the parent component. |
| focus | Function | Event triggered when the component gains focus. Useful for tracking user interaction with the element. |
| blur | Function | Event triggered when the component loses focus. Used to validate or save data when the user leaves the field. |

# AValidatedJson (Validated JSON)

AValidatedJson is a component for editing structured data with validation rules. It supports single-item, list, and JSON modes and helps users manage complex form data safely.

## Basic usage

*props: `model-value`, `type`*

```html
<a-select-icon
  v-model="model1"
  label="Select"
  type="select"
></a-select-icon>
<div>model1: {{ model1 }}</div>
<a-select-icon
  v-model="model2"
  class="a_mt_3"
  label="Multiselect"
  type="multiselect"
></a-select-icon>
<div>model2: {{ model2 }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  ASelectIcon,
} from "aloha-vue";

  name: "PageSelectIconBasic",
```

```js
    ASelectIcon,
  },
  setup() {
    const model1 = ref(undefined);
    const model2 = ref(undefined);

    return {
      model1,
      model2,
    };
  },
};
```

## valueKey: primitive lists

Use `mode="list"` with `value-key="value"` to edit an array of primitive values, such as strings. The child field with `id="value"` defines the editor for each item, while the model remains a simple array, such as `["Aloha", "Vue"]`. The example also shows duplicate validation with `unique-children-ids` and a read-only view of the same data.

*props: `mode`, `value-key`, `children`, `unique-children-ids`*

```html
<a-validated-json
  v-model="model"
  mode="list"
  value-key="value"
  :children="children"
  :unique-children-ids="['value']"
  element-template="{{ value }}"
/>
```

```js
import { ref } from "vue";
import { AValidatedJson } from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: { AValidatedJson },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(["Aloha", "Vue"]);
    const children = [{ id: "value", type: "text", label: "_A_VALIDATED_JSON_COMPONENT_LABEL_VALUE_", required: true }];
    return { model, children };
  },
};
```

# AGroupButtonDropdown (Grouped buttons and links)

This component allows you to flexibly configure a group of buttons and links.

## Basic usage

This example shows three buttons without additional configuration.

*props: `actions`*

```html
<a-group-button-dropdown
  :actions="actions"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
```

```js
import { 
  AGroupButtonDropdown,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageGroupButtonDropdownBasic",
  components: {
    AGroupButtonDropdown,
  },
  setup() {
    const actions = [
      {
        text: "Action 1",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "Action 2",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "Action 3",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
    ];
    
     return {
      actions,
    };
  },
};
```

## Different renderings

The actions can be displayed in different ways: as a simple row, as a dropdown, or as a combination of buttons and a dropdown.

*props: `index-first-dropdown-action`, `index-first-dropdown-action-mobile`, `actions.classButton`*

```html
<a-group-button-dropdown
  :actions="actions"
  :index-first-dropdown-action="-1"
  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="-1"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
<a-group-button-dropdown
  class="a_mt_3"
  :actions="actions"
  :index-first-dropdown-action="0"
  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="0"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
<a-group-button-dropdown
  class="a_mt_3"
  :actions="actions"
  :index-first-dropdown-action="1"
  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="1"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
<a-group-button-dropdown
  class="a_mt_3"
  :actions="actions"
  :index-first-dropdown-action="2"
  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="2"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
<a-group-button-dropdown
  class="a_mt_3"
  :actions="actions"
  :index-first-dropdown-action="3"
  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="3"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
```

```js
import { 
  AGroupButtonDropdown,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageGroupButtonDropdownIndexFirstDropdownAction",

    AGroupButtonDropdown,
  },
  setup() {
    const actions = [
      {
        text: "Action 1",
        type: "button",
        classButton: "a_btn a_btn_primary",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "Action 2",
        type: "button",
        classButton: "a_btn a_btn_secondary",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "Action 3",
        type: "button",
        classButton: "a_btn a_btn_secondary",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "Action 4",
        type: "button",
        classButton: "a_btn a_btn_secondary",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "Action 5",
        type: "button",
        classButton: "a_btn a_btn_secondary",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "Action 6",
        type: "button",
        classButton: "a_btn a_btn_secondary",
        callback: () => {},
      },
    ];
    
     return {
      actions,
    };
  },
};
```

## One or two buttons

The component is rendered differently depending on the number of actions.

*props: `index-first-dropdown-action`, `index-first-dropdown-action-mobile`, `actions.classButton`*

```html

  :index-first-dropdown-action="1"
  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="1"
></a-group-button-dropdown>

  class="a_mt_3"
  :actions="actions2"

  class="a_mt_3"
  :actions="actions6"

  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="1"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
```

## Button classes

```html
></a-group-button-dropdown>
<a-group-button-dropdown
  class="a_mt_3"

  :index-first-dropdown-action="3"
  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="3"
  :actions-classes="['a_btn a_btn_primary', 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', 'a_btn a_btn_primary']"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
```

## Dropdown button configuration

The dropdown button can be configured. All props of **ADropdown** can be used inside the **dropdown-attributes** object.

*props: `dropdown-attributes`*

```html
<a-group-button-dropdown
  :actions="actions"
  :index-first-dropdown-action="2"
  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="2"
  :dropdown-attributes="{ buttonText: '_A_GROUP_BUTTON_DROPDOWN_OTHER_ACTIONS_', buttonClass: 'a_btn a_btn_primary' }"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
<a-group-button-dropdown
  class="a_mt_3"
  :actions="actions"
  :index-first-dropdown-action="1"
  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="1"
  :dropdown-attributes="{ buttonText: '_A_GROUP_BUTTON_DROPDOWN_OTHER_ACTIONS_', buttonIconLeft: 'Gear' }"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
```

```js
import { 
  AGroupButtonDropdown,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageGroupButtonDropdownDropdownAttributes",
  components: {
    AGroupButtonDropdown,
  },
  setup() {
    const actions = [
      {
        text: "Action 1",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "Action 2",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },

        text: "Action 3",
        type: "button",

        text: "Action 4",

        callback: () => {},
      },
      {
        text: "Action 6",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
      },

      actions,
    };

};
```

## Extra classes for actions

Each action can define its own additional CSS class via the **classExtra** field.

*props: `actions.classExtra`*

```html
<a-group-button-dropdown
  :actions="actions"
  :index-first-dropdown-action="2"
  :index-first-dropdown-action-mobile="2"
></a-group-button-dropdown>
```

```js
import { 
  AGroupButtonDropdown,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageGroupButtonDropdownActionsClasses",
  components: {
    AGroupButtonDropdown,
  },
  setup() {
    const actions = [
      {
        text: "Action 1",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
        classExtra: "test_action1",
      },
      {
        text: "Action 2",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
        classExtra: "test_action2",
      },
      {
        text: "Action 3",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
        classExtra: "test_action3",
      },
      {
        text: "Action 4",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
        classExtra: "test_action4",
      },
      {
        text: "Action 5",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
        classExtra: "test_action5",
      },
      {
        text: "Action 6",
        type: "button",
        callback: () => {},
        classExtra: "test_action6",
      },
    ];
    
     return {
      actions,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| actions | Array | () => [] |  | A list of actions to choose from. |
| actions-classes | Array | () => ["a_btn a_btn_primary", "a_btn a_btn_secondary"] |  | An array of CSS classes applied to inline actions by position. |
| actions-ids | Array | () => [] |  | An array of IDs assigned to actions by position when the action itself does not define an `id`. |
| btn-group-class | String / Array / Object | a_btn_group |  | CSS classes for the wrapper that groups inline buttons and links. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Indicator of a disabled state. |
| dropdown-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Additional dropdown attributes that are not defined as props. |
| has-divider-before-dropdown | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether spacing is added before the dropdown part when both inline actions and dropdown actions are rendered. |
| index-first-dropdown-action | Number | 1 |  | The index of the first action that should be moved into the dropdown on desktop. A value of `-1` disables dropdown grouping. |
| index-first-dropdown-action-mobile | Number | 0 |  | The index of the first action that should be moved into the dropdown on mobile. A value of `-1` disables dropdown grouping. |
| inner-flag-has-actions | Boolean |  |  | Internal flag updated via `v-model:inner-flag-has-actions` to indicate whether the component has visible actions after filtering. |
| min-dropdown-actions | Number | 2 |  | Minimum number of actions required to render the dropdown part. If there are fewer actions, they remain inline. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:innerFlagHasActions | Function | Emitted when the internal visibility flag for actions changes after filtering. |

# ALink (Link)

Provides a connection to an internal or external source that the user can access by clicking or keyboard tapping.

## Basic usage

*props: `text`, `href`, `to`*

```html
<a-Link
  text="https://github.com/"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-Link>
<a-Link
  class="a_ml_2"
  text="Aloha"
  :to="{ name: 'PageButton' }"
>
</a-Link>
<a-Link
  class="a_ml_2"
  text="Aloha"
  to="/button"
>
</a-Link>
```

## CSS classes

CSS classes enable different visual representations of the component.

*props: `class`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_link"
  text="link"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>

  text="primary"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>

  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary a_ml_2"
  text="secondary"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_tertiary a_ml_2"
  text="tertiary"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_success a_ml_2"
  text="success"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_info a_ml_2"
  text="info"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_warning a_ml_2"
  text="warning"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>

  class="a_btn a_btn_danger a_ml_2"
  text="danger"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_dark a_ml_2"
  text="dark"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_light a_ml_2"
  text="light"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
```

```html
      href="https://github.com/"
    >
    </a-link>
    <a-link
```
```html
      class="a_btn a_btn_outline_info"
      text="outline-info"
      href="https://github.com/"
    >
    </a-link>
  </div>
```
```html
</div>
```

## Loading

A spinner can be placed on either side of anchor text to indicate a loading state.

*props: `loading`, `loading-align`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  :loading="loading"
  loading-align="left"
  text="loading-align=\"left\""
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary a_ml_2"
  :loading="loading"
  loading-align="right"
  text="loading-align=\"right\""
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary a_ml_5"
  text="a-button toggle"
  @click="toggleLoading"
>
</a-button>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AButton,
  ALink,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageLinkLoading",
  components: {
    AButton,
    ALink,
  },
  setup() {
    const loading = ref(true);

    const toggleLoading = () => {
      loading.value = !loading.value;
    };

    return {
      loading,
      toggleLoading,
    };
  },
};
```

## Text Before/After

A custom character or text can be added before of after the anchor text.

*props: `text-before`, `text-after`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_SHOW_MORE_MORE_"
  text-after=" €"
  text-before="$ "
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
```

## Customizing the Text Tag in the "ALink" Component

This example shows how to customize the text tag in the "ALink" component in Vue.js. By default, the text is rendered in a "span" tag. By using the "text-tag" prop, the text tag can be flexibly customized to use various HTML tags such as "strong", "em", or others.

*props: `text-tag`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
  text="Aloha"
  text-tag="strong"
  href="https://github.com/"
></a-link>
```

## Safe HTML

The anchor text can be specified in HTML format using the safe-html parameter. This content is considered safe and will not be sanitized.

*props: `safe-html`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  safe-html="_A_LINK_EXAMPLE_HTML_"
>
</a-link>
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary a_ml_2"
  safe-html="<span onclick='alert(\"Aloha\")'>Aloha</button>"
>
</a-link>
```

## HTML

The anchor text can be specified in HTML format. The content will be sanitized.

*props: `html`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  html="_A_LINK_EXAMPLE_HTML_"
>
</a-link>
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary a_ml_2"
  html="<span onclick='alert(\"Aloha\")'>Aloha</button>"
>
</a-link>
```

## Responsive

Different anchor texts can be specified for different screen sizes.

*props: `text (as object)`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  :text="{ mobile: 'Aloha', desktop: 'Aloha-desktop' }"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
```

*props: `title (as array)`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  :title="['Aloha', '$(Aloha)']"
  text="Aloha"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
```
