## Default slot

Instead of text parameter,a default slot can be used to define custom anchor content.

*slots: `default`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
  <span>(Aloha)</span>
</a-link>
```

## Prepend slot

A content to be preppended to anchor text can be defined by using prependLink slot.

*slots: `linkPrepend`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="Aloha"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
  <template
    v-slot:linkPrepend
  >
    <span>(***)</span>
  </template>
</a-link>
```

## Append slot

A content to be appended to anchor text can be defined by using appendLink slot.

*slots: `linkAppend`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="Aloha"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
  <template
    v-slot:linkAppend
  >
    <span>(***)</span>
  </template>
</a-link>
```

## Title slot

A custom content can be defined to be shown when a mouse hovers over component by using linkTitle slot.

*slots: `linkTitle`*

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="Aloha"
  :is-title-html="true"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
  <template
    v-slot:linkTitle
  >
    <strong>(***Aloha***)</strong>
  </template>
</a-link>
```

## Complex usage

An example of a more complex usage of  ALink component.

```html
<a-link
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  :text="{ desktop: 'Aloha' }"
  :text-before="{ desktop: '$ ' }"
  :icon-left="{ desktop: 'Gear', mobile: 'Code' }"
  :icon-right="{ mobile: 'Code' }"
  :title="{ desktop: 'Aloha' }"
  :text-aria-hidden="true"
  :text-screen-reader="{ desktop: 'Aloha', mobile: 'Aloha-mobile' }"
  href="https://github.com/"
>
</a-link>
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Non-prop attributes to be passed to component. |
| class | String / Object |  |  | An extra CSS class. |
| class-default | String | a_element |  | Defines the base CSS class for the element, setting a general visual default style. |
| class-default-hidden | String | a_element__hidden |  | Specifies a CSS class to hide the element, used to control the visibility of the element in different contexts. |
| class-disabled | String | disabled |  | Specifies the CSS class applied to the link when it is disabled. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Indicator of disabled state. |
| extra | Object |  |  | Extra values used in translation placeholders. |
| href | String |  |  | Specifies the URL of the page the link goes to. |
| html | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Anchor text in HTML format. |
| html-screen-reader | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Anchor content in HTML format for screen reader. |
| icon-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Non-prop attributes to be passed to icon. |
| icon-class | String / Object |  |  | A CSS class for icon. |
| icon-left | String / Object |  |  | Name of the icon to be shown to the left of anchor text. |
| icon-right | String / Object |  |  | Name of the icon to be shown to the right of anchor text. |
| icon-tag | String |  |  | Tag of the inline HTML element which will then be used to display icon. |
| id | String | () => uniqueId("a_link_") |  | Specifies a unique ID for the HTML element corresponding to link. |
| is-title-html | Boolean |  |  | Specifies if the regular title or HTML tooltip are shown when a mouse hovers over component. |
| loading | Boolean | false |  | Displays spinner next to anchor text that indicates loading. |
| loading-align | String | right |  | A CSS alignment of the loading spinner. |
| loading-class | String / Object | a_spinner_small |  | A CSS class for loading spinner. |
| prevent-keyboard-repeat | Boolean | false |  | Prevents repeated activation while a keyboard key is held down. When enabled, repeated **Enter** and **Space** key events are ignored after the first press. |
| safe-html | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Anchor content in HTML format to be displayed. |
| safe-html-screen-reader | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Anchor content in HTML format for screen reader, without sanitation. |
| target | String |  |  | Specifies where the linked content will be open after clicking the link. |
| text | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Anchor text to be displayed. |
| text-after | String / Number / Object |  |  | Additional character or text displayed to the right of the anchor text. |
| text-aria-hidden | Boolean |  |  | Anchor text hidden from screen readers. |
| text-before | String / Number / Object |  |  | Additional character or text displayed to the left of the anchor text. |
| text-class | String |  |  | Additional CSS class for anchor text. |
| text-screen-reader | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Anchor text for screen reader. |
| text-tag | String | span |  | This prop allows you to customize the HTML tag in which the text within the link is rendered. |
| title | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Additional piece(s) of information to be shown when a mouse hovers over component. |
| title-attributes | Object | {} |  | Provides an object to set additional HTML attributes for the title of the element, allowing detailed customization of its behavior and style. |
| title-placement | String | top |  | A position relative to the link where the title will be displayed. |
| title-z-index | String / Number | auto |  | Sets the "z-index" for the element's title, determining its stacking order in the context of other overlapping elements. |
| to | Object / String |  |  | Internal link to another component by using Vue Router. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| linkAppend | Appends custom content to the anchor text. |
| linkPrepend | Prepends custom content to the anchor text. |
| linkTitle | Displays custom information when a mouse hovers over component. |
| default | Can be used to define the anchor content of the link. |

<!-- https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/link-copy.md -->

# ALinkCopy (Copy Link)

The ALinkCopy component is a Vue.js component that provides a user interface to present a link and offers a button to copy the link text to the clipboard. This allows for easy and convenient sharing of URLs or other references by the users of your application. By clicking on the "Copy to clipboard" button, the text of the link is copied to the user's clipboard for quick and easy sharing.

## Customizing the Link

In this example, it's demonstrated how the component can be used in conjunction with the ALink component to set up links flexibly and copy their text to the clipboard. The ALink component is used to create and define the link itself.

*props: `link-options`*

```html
<a-link-copy
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
></a-link-copy>
```

## CSS Classes

In this example, the use of the component with various CSS classes to customize its appearance is illustrated.

*props: `class`*

```html
<a-link-copy
  class="a_btn_group_small"
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
></a-link-copy>
<a-link-copy
  class="a_btn_group_large a_ml_2"
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
></a-link-copy>
```

## Customizing the Default Grouping Class in the Component

In this example, the option to adjust the default grouping class **class-default** in the component is demonstrated. This class is typically used to style the outer grouping of the component. You can overwrite the default class as needed or leave it blank if you don't want to use the default grouping.

*props: `class-default`*

```html
<a-link-copy
  :button-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary a_ml_3' }"
  class-default=""
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
></a-link-copy>
```

## Disabling Link and Button

In this example, it's shown how the component can be used to disable both the link and the associated button. Disabling ensures that the link can no longer be clicked and the button can't be triggered.

*props: `disabled`*

```html
<a-link-copy
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
  :disabled="true"
></a-link-copy>
```

## Copying Custom Text

In this example, it's shown how the component can be used to copy custom text instead of the default link text. The **text-copy** prop allows you to specify the text to be copied.

*props: `text-copy`*

```html
<a-link-copy
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
  text-copy="github"
></a-link-copy>
<a-link-copy
  class="a_ml_2"
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
  text-copy="Aloha"
></a-link-copy>
```

## Customizing the Button

In this example, it is shown how the component can be used to customize the button that serves to copy the link. The **button-options** prop allows defining properties and HTML attributes for the button using the AButton component.

*props: `button-options`*

```html
<a-link-copy
  :button-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_primary', text: 'copy' }"
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_primary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
  text-copy="github"
></a-link-copy>
<a-link-copy
  class="a_ml_2"
  :button-options="{ iconLeft: 'FloppyDisk' }"
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
></a-link-copy>
```

## Button Position

The position of the button in the component can be adjusted with the **button-position** prop.

*props: `button-position`*

```html
<a-link-copy
  button-position="left"
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
></a-link-copy>
<a-link-copy
  class="a_ml_2"
  button-position="right"
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', text: 'https://github.com/', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
></a-link-copy>
```

## Customizing the Link with the 'link' Slot

In this example, it's shown how you can customize the text of the link in the component using the 'link' slot. The content of the 'link' slot is passed to the contained ALink component.

*slots: `link`*

```html
<a-link-copy
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
>
  <template
    v-slot:link
  >
    <strong>github.com</strong>
  </template>
</a-link-copy>
```

## Customizing the Button with the 'button' Slot

The 'button' slot allows you to define the text of the button according to your own ideas. The content of the 'button' slot is passed to the contained AButton component.

*slots: `button`*

```html
<a-link-copy
  :link-options="{ class: 'a_btn a_btn_secondary', href: 'https://github.com/' }"
>
  <template
    v-slot:button
  >
    <strong>copy</strong>
  </template>
</a-link-copy>
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| button-options | Object | () => ({}) |  | Define properties and HTML attributes for the button using the AButton component. |
| button-position | String | right |  | Position of the button. You can use either **right** or **left**. |
| class | String / Object |  |  | CSS Classes |
| class-default | String | a_btn_group |  | The default CSS class for the outer grouping |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Disabling the component |
| link-options | Object | () => ({}) |  | The appearance and behavior of the link by defining all the properties and HTML attributes used within ALink. |
| textCopy | String |  |  | The text that should be copied in place of the default link text. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| button | The text of the button. The content of this slot is forwarded as button text to the AButton component. |
| link | The text of the link. The content of this slot is forwarded as link text to the ALink component. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_LINK_COPY_BTN_TITLE_` | Copy to clipboard |
| `_A_LINK_COPY_COPIED_TO_CLIPBOARD_` | Copied to clipboard |

# AList (List)

The **AList** component allows easy rendering of lists with flexible configuration options for data presentation.

## Basic usage

*props: `data`, `label`*

```html
<a-list
  :data="items"
  key-label="label"
></a-list>
```

```js
import { 
  AList,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageListBasic",
  components: {
    AList,
  },
  setup() {
    const items = [
      {
        label: "label 1",
      },
      {
        label: "label 2",
      },
      {
        label: "label 3",
      },
      {
        label: "label 4",
      },
    ];

    return {
      items,
    };
  },
};
```

## Dynamic Adjustment of HTML Tag

Using the component to dynamically switch between ordered (**ol**) and unordered (**ul**) lists via the **tag** property.

*props: `tag`*

```html
<a-radio
  v-model="modelTag"
  class="a_mb_4"
  :data="['ol', 'ul']"
  :is-data-simple-array="true"
></a-radio>

<a-list
  :data="items"
  key-label="label"
  :tag="modelTag"
></a-list>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AList,
  ARadio,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageListTag",
  components: {
    AList,
    ARadio,
  },
  setup() {
    const items = [
      {
        label: "label 1",
      },
      {
        label: "label 2",
      },
      {
        label: "label 3",
      },
      {
        label: "label 4",
      },
    ];
    const modelTag = ref("ol");

    return {
      items,
      modelTag,
    };
  },
};
```

## Hierarchical Data Presentation

The **key-children** property allows items to have their own child elements, enabling the presentation of hierarchical data.

*props: `key-children`*

```html
<a-list
  :data="items"
  key-label="label"
  key-children="children"
></a-list>
```

```js
import { 
  AList,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageListKeyChildren",
  components: {
    AList,
  },
  setup() {
    const items = [
      {
        label: "Parent 1",
        children: [
          {
            label: "Child 1" 
          },
          {
            label: "Child 2"
          }
        ],
      },
      {
        label: "Parent 2",
        children: [
          {
            label: "Child 3" 
          },
          {
            label: "Child 4"
          }
        ],
      }
    ];

    return {
      items,
    };
  },
};
```

## Usage with Simple Arrays and Nested Hierarchies

This example demonstrates the use of the **is-data-simple-array** property in the component to handle different data types: simple arrays and nested hierarchies.

*props: `is-data-simple-array`*

```html
<a-list
  :data="items1"
  :is-data-simple-array="true"
></a-list>
<a-list
  class="a_mt_4"
  :data="items2"
  :is-data-simple-array="true"
></a-list>
```

```js
import { 
  AList,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageListIsDataSimpleArray",
  components: {
    AList,
  },
  setup() {
    const items1 = [
      "label 1",
      "label 2",
      "label 3",
      "label 4",
    ];
    const items2 = [
      "Level 1",
      [
        "Level 2",
        [
          "Level 2.1",
          "Level 2.2",
        ],
      ],
      [
        "Level 3",
        [
          "Level 3.1",
          [
            "Level 3.2",
            [
              "Level 3.2.1",
              "Level 3.2.2",
            ],
          ],
        ],
      ],
    ];

    return {
      items1,
      items2,
    };
  },
};
```

## Display of Lists in Text or HTML Format

This example shows the use of the **is-html** property in the component in conjunction with the **a-switch** component to dynamically control the list display between text and HTML format.

*props: `is-html`*

```html
<a-switch
  v-model="modelIsHtml"
  label="_A_LIST_IS_HTML_LABEL_"
></a-switch>

<a-list
  :data="items"
  key-label="label"
  :is-html="modelIsHtml"
></a-list>
<div class="a_mt_4"></div>
<a-list
  :data="itemsWithChildren"
  key-label="label"
  key-children="children"
  :is-html="modelIsHtml"
></a-list>
<div class="a_mt_4"></div>
<a-list
  :data="itemsArrays"
  key-label="label"
  :is-data-simple-array="true"
  :is-html="modelIsHtml"
></a-list>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AList,
  ASwitch, 
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageListIsHtml",
  components: {
    AList,
    ASwitch,
  },
  setup() {
    const items = [
      {
        label: "label 1",
      },
      {
        label: "label 2",
      },
      {
        label: "label 3",
      },
      {
        label: "label 4",
      },
    ];
    const itemsWithChildren = [
      {
        label: "Level 1",
        children: [
          {
            label: "Level 1.1",
            children: [
              {
                label: "Level 1.1.1",
              },
              {
                label: "Level 1.1.2",
              },
            ],
          },
          {
            label: "Level 1.2",
            children: [
              {
                label: "Level 1.2.1",
              },
            ],
          },
        ],
      },
      {
        label: "Level 2",
        children: [
          {
            label: "Level 2.1",
          },
          {
            label: "Level 2.2",
          },
        ],
      },
    ];
    const itemsArrays = [
      "Level 1",
      [
        "Level 2",
        [
          "Level 2.1",
          "Level 2.2",
        ],
      ],
      [
        "Level 3",
        [
          "Level 3.1",
          [
            "Level 3.2",
            [
              "Level 3.2.1",
              "Level 3.2.2",
            ],
          ],
        ],
      ],
    ];
    const modelIsHtml = ref(false);

    return {
      items,
      itemsWithChildren,
      itemsArrays,
      modelIsHtml,
    };
  },
};
```

## Custom Separators Between Items

This example shows the use of the **separator** property in the component to set custom separators between items.

*props: `separator`*

```html

  :is-data-simple-array="true"
  :is-html="false"
  separator=", "

<div class="a_mt_5"></div>
<a-list
  :data="items"
  :is-data-simple-array="true"
  :is-html="true"
  separator=","
></a-list>
<div class="a_mt_4"></div>
<a-list
  :data="items"
  :is-data-simple-array="true"
  :is-html="true"
  separator=";"
></a-list>
```

```js
  AList,
```

## Unique Identification of List Items

This example demonstrates the use of the **key-id** property in the component to assign a unique identifier to each item in the list. This is particularly useful when the list is composed of an array of objects and each object has a unique key (ID).

In the second example, the label key **(label)** is used as an identifier for the list items.

## Slot

```html
<a-list
  :data="items"
```

```js
            label: "label 1.1",
            items: [
              {
                label: "label 1.1.1",
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| class-item | String / Object / Array |  |  | CSS class for each item in the list |
| class-main | String / Object / Array |  |  | CSS class for each parent element |
| data | Array | [] |  | Array with the data to be rendered |
| is-data-simple-array | Boolean | false |  | Indicates whether only a simple array without objects is used |
| is-html | Boolean | true |  | If true, an HTML list (<ul><li>...</li></ul>) is created. Otherwise, a text list is generated (<span>...</span>) |
| key-children | String |  |  | Key for sub-items, if data is an array of objects |
| key-id | String |  |  | Key for unique IDs, if data is an array of objects (for performance improvement) |
| key-label | String |  |  | Key for the label to be displayed, if data is an array of objects |
| key-label-callback | Function |  |  | Function to generate labels with two parameters (**item** and **itemIndex**), if data is an array of objects |
| label-tag | String | span |  | HTML tag for the labels |
| list-item-tag | String | li |  | HTML tag for the items in the list |
| separator | String |  |  | Separator between items in the list. |
| separator-html | String |  |  | Separator between items in HTML format. |
| tag | String | ul |  | HTML tag for the entire list |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| listItem | Custom content for each item in the list |

## CSS variables (`scss/utils/list_group.scss`, `scss/utils/list.scss`, `scss/components/ADivider.scss`)

| `--a_list_group_border_color` |  | Border color of an item. Set by the color classes. |

| `--a_list_group_item_padding_y` |  | Vertical padding of an item. |

| `--a_list_group_item_not_first_border_top_width` |  | Top border width of every item except the first, so borders do not double. 1px with .a_list_group_gap. |
| `--a_list_group_item_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of an item. With .a_list_group_gap every item is rounded like the list. |
| `--a_list_group_action_color` |  | Text color of a clickable item (.a_list_group__item_action). |
| `--a_list_group_action_hover_color` |  | Text color of a hovered clickable item. |
| `--a_list_group_action_hover_bg` |  | Background of a hovered clickable item. |
| `--a_list_group_action_active_color` |  | Text color of a pressed clickable item. |
| `--a_list_group_action_active_bg` |  | Background of a pressed clickable item. |
| `--a_list_group_disabled_color` |  | Text color of a disabled item. |
| `--a_list_group_disabled_bg` |  | Background of a disabled item. |
| `--a_list_group_active_color` |  | Text color of the active item (.active). |
| `--a_list_group_active_bg` |  | Background of the active item. |
| `--a_list_group_active_border_color` |  | Border color of the active item. |
| `--a_list_dl_first_column_width` |  | Width of the term column (dt). The list is as wide as both columns together. |
| `--a_list_dl_last_column_width` |  | Width of the value column (dd). |
| `--a_list_dl_dt_text_align` |  | Text alignment of the terms. right with .a_list_dl_dt_right. |
| `--a_list_dl_item_padding_x` |  | Horizontal padding of a term and of a value. |
| `--a_list_dl_item_padding_y` |  | Vertical padding of a term and of a value. |
| `--a_list_dl_bg` |  | Background of the list. |
| `--a_list_dl_first_column_bg` |  | Background of the terms. |
| `--a_list_dl_last_column_bg` |  | Background of the values. |
| `--a_list_dl_first_column_border_width` |  | Width of the line between the terms. |
| `--a_list_dl_last_column_border_width` |  | Width of the line between the values. |
| `--a_list_dl_first_column_border_color` |  | Color of the line between the terms. |
| `--a_list_dl_last_column_border_color` |  | Color of the line between the values. |
| `--a_divider_margin_y` |  | Space above and below the line. |
| `--a_divider_bg` |  | Color of the line. |

# ALoading (Loading screen over content)

The **ALoading** component displays a loading spinner with text over the content when the **is-loading** property is set to **true**. It is used to block content and show a spinner until the loading process is complete.

## Basic usage

*props: `is-loading`*

```html
<div
  class="a_position_relative"
>
  <a-loading
    :is-loading="true"
  >
    <ul>
      <li>Aloha 1</li>
      <li>Aloha 2</li>
      <li>Aloha 3</li>
    </ul>
  </a-loading>
</div>
```

## Component alignment

This example shows how to use **align**. It allows you to adjust the alignment of the text and spinner to the center, left, or right. For example, the first spinner is aligned to the left, the second to the center, and the third to the right.

*props: `align`*

```html
<div
  class="a_position_relative"
>
  <a-loading
    :is-loading="true"
```


## Text with **extra** Parameter

This example shows how to use **text** and **extra**. The **extra** parameter allows you to dynamically change the text. In this case, the text displays the message 'Loading 1', where the number **{{ number }}** is taken from the passed **extra** object.

*props: `text`, `extra`*

```html
<div
  class="a_position_relative"
>
  <a-loading
    :extra="{ number: 1 }"
    :is-loading="true"
    text="_PAGE_LOADING_TEXT_{{number}}_"
  >
    <ul>
      <li>Aloha 1</li>
      <li>Aloha 2</li>
      <li>Aloha 3</li>
    </ul>
  </a-loading>
</div>
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| align | String | center |  | Defines the alignment of the text and spinner within the component. Possible values: **left**, **center**, and **right**. |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| is-loading | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the loading indicator should be displayed. If set to **true**, the loading indicator will appear over the component's content. |
| size | String / Number | 6 |  | Defines the size of the text and loading indicator. Valid values range from **1** (largest) to **7** (smallest). |
| spinner-class | String / Number |  |  | **CSS** class for customizing the appearance of the loading indicator. |
| spinner-safe-html | String |  |  | Safe **HTML** content to be displayed inside the loading spinner. Used to customize the spinner's inner content. |
| spinner-tag | String | span |  | The **HTML** tag used for rendering the loading spinner. By default, it is **span**, but it can be changed to any other appropriate tag. |
| tag | String | div |  | **HTML** tag used to render the component. |
| text | String | _A_CLOAK_LOADING_ |  | Text that will be displayed next to the loading indicator. |
| text-align | String | right |  | Defines the alignment of the text relative to the spinner. Possible values: **left** and **right**. By default, the text is right-aligned. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_LOADING_LOADING_` | Loading |

## CSS variables (`scss/components/ALoading.scss`)

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--a_loading_bg` |  | Background of the overlay over the loading content (translucent). |
| `--a_loading_z_index` |  | Stacking order of the overlay. |

# (Menu)

AMenu provides navigation with nested panels, search, groups and disabled links.

## Nested menu with search

Open Components → Form controls to explore nested panels, or search for Input. Scroll the menu inside the container, which has a fixed height of 24rem. Use the button above to toggle the menu, including on mobile. The examples do not change body classes or show a mobile backdrop. Set `is-inline` to true to place the menu in the normal document flow and fill the height of its container. Give the container an explicit height.

*props: `is-inline, data, key-children`*

```html
<a-menu-button-toggle
  :can-change-body-class="false"
  :button-toggle-props="{ id: 'docs_menu_nested_toggle' }"
  menu-id="docs_menu_nested"
/>
<div style="height: 24rem; overflow: hidden;">
  <a-menu
    :can-change-body-class="false"
    :data="menuItems"
    :is-inline="true"
    :use-backdrop-mobile="false"
    menu-id="docs_menu_nested"
    key-children="children"
  />
</div>
```

```js
import {
  AMenu,
  AMenuButtonToggle,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AMenu,
    AMenuButtonToggle,
  },
  setup() {
    const menuItems = [
      {
        id: "components",
        label: "Components",
        icon: "MenuAppFill",
        children: [
          {
            id: "accordion",
            label: "Accordion",
            to: { name: "PageAccordion" },
          },
          {
            id: "forms",
            label: "Form controls",
            children: [
              {
                id: "input",
                label: "Input",
                to: { name: "PageInput" },
              },
              {
                id: "select",
                label: "Select",
                to: { name: "PageSelect" },
              },
            ],
          },
        ],
      },
      { id: "alert", label: "Alert", icon: "ExclamationTriangle", to: { name: "PageAlert" } },
      { id: "button", label: "Button", icon: "EjectFill", to: { name: "PageButton" } },
      { id: "collapse", label: "Collapse", icon: "ArrowsCollapse", to: { name: "PageCollapse" } },
      { id: "dropdown", label: "Dropdown", icon: "MenuDown", to: { name: "PageDropdown" } },
      { id: "link", label: "Link", icon: "BoxArrowUpRight", to: { name: "PageLink" } },
      { id: "list", label: "List", icon: "ListUl", to: { name: "PageList" } },
      { id: "modal", label: "Modal", icon: "Window", to: { name: "PageModal" } },
      { id: "tabs", label: "Tabs", icon: "SegmentedNav", to: { name: "PageTabs" } },
      { id: "translation", label: "Translation", icon: "Translate", to: { name: "PageTranslation" } },

      menuItems,
    };
  },
```

## Groups and disabled links

The group field groups links under headings. The Notification link is disabled, and has-search is false. Scroll the menu inside the 24rem container and use the button above to open or close it.

```html
<a-menu-button-toggle

    :can-change-body-class="false"
    :data="menuItems"
    :is-inline="true"
    :use-backdrop-mobile="false"
    menu-id="docs_menu_groups"
    :has-search="false"
  />
</div>
```

## Menu behind a button (only-mobile)

With `only-mobile` the menu works like the mobile menu at every screen width: it is closed and only the button is visible. The button opens the menu; a click on a link, Esc or the backdrop (`use-backdrop-mobile`) closes it. The window width does not matter. Give the toggle button `:only-mobile="true"` as well, otherwise it is hidden on the desktop, and connect both with the same `menu-id`.

*props: `only-mobile`*

```html
<a-menu-button-toggle
  :can-change-body-class="false"
  :button-toggle-props="{ id: 'docs_menu_only_mobile_toggle' }"
  :only-mobile="true"
  menu-id="docs_menu_only_mobile"
/>
<div style="height: 24rem; overflow: hidden;">
  <a-menu
    :can-change-body-class="false"
    :data="menuItems"
    :has-search="false"
    :is-inline="true"
    :only-mobile="true"
    :use-backdrop-mobile="false"
    menu-id="docs_menu_only_mobile"
  />
</div>
```

```js
import {
  AMenu,
  AMenuButtonToggle,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AMenu,
    AMenuButtonToggle,
  },
  setup() {
    const menuItems = [
      { id: "input", label: "Input", icon: "FileEarmarkText", to: { name: "PageInput" } },
      { id: "select", label: "Select", icon: "ListUl", to: { name: "PageSelect" } },
      { id: "checkbox", label: "Checkbox", icon: "CheckLg", to: { name: "PageCheckbox" } },
      { id: "radio", label: "Radio", icon: "CheckLg", to: { name: "PageRadio" } },
      { id: "alert", label: "Alert", icon: "ExclamationTriangle", to: { name: "PageAlert" } },
      { id: "modal", label: "Modal", icon: "Window", to: { name: "PageModal" } },
    ];

    return {
      menuItems,
    };
  },
};
```

## Search translated DOM text

The `search-in-dom` prop defaults to false. When true, search reads the rendered labels in the source menu panels instead of labels in data. Turn on the translation switch, then search for **Eingabe** or **Auswahl**: the data still contains Input and Select. Results, highlighting and parent labels use the DOM text. Text is reread when the search query changes, including in closed submenus. Custom slots should preserve the supplied link id and wrap the label in `.a_menu__link__text`. Turn the switch off to restore the original English labels.

*props: `search-in-dom, is-inline, data, key-children`*

```html
<a-menu-button-toggle
  :can-change-body-class="false"
  :button-toggle-props="{ id: 'docs_menu_dom_toggle' }"
  menu-id="docs_menu_dom"
/>
<a-switch
  v-model="isTranslated"
  label="Translate DOM to German"
  @update:model-value="translateMenu"
/>
<div style="height: 24rem; overflow: hidden;">
  <a-menu
    :can-change-body-class="false"
    :data="menuItems"
    :is-inline="true"
    :search-in-dom="true"
    :use-backdrop-mobile="false"
    key-children="children"
    menu-id="docs_menu_dom"
  />
</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AMenu,
  AMenuButtonToggle,
  ASwitch,
} from "aloha-vue";
import {
  forEach,
} from "lodash-es";

export default {
  components: {
    AMenu,
    AMenuButtonToggle,
    ASwitch,
  },
  setup() {
    const isTranslated = ref(false);

    const menuItems = [
      {
        id: "forms",
        label: "Forms",
        children: [
          { id: "input", label: "Input", to: { name: "PageInput" } },
          { id: "select", label: "Select", to: { name: "PageSelect" } },
          { id: "checkbox", label: "Checkbox", to: { name: "PageCheckbox" }, disabled: true },
        ],
      },
      { id: "button", label: "Button", to: { name: "PageButton" } },
      { id: "alert", label: "Alert", to: { name: "PageAlert" } },
    ];

    const translateMenu = value => {
      forEach({
        forms: ["Forms", "Formulare"],
        input: ["Input", "Eingabe"],
        select: ["Select", "Auswahl"],
        checkbox: ["Checkbox", "Kontrollkästchen"],
        button: ["Button", "Schaltfläche"],
        alert: ["Alert", "Hinweis"],
      }, (labels, id) => {
        const LINK = document.getElementById(`docs_menu_dom_${ id }_link`);
        LINK.querySelector(".a_menu__link__text").textContent = labels[value ? 1 : 0];
      });
    };

    return {
      isTranslated,
      menuItems,
      translateMenu,
    };
  },
};
```

## Custom data keys

Map existing data fields with `key-id`, `key-label`, `key-icon`, `key-group` and `key-children`. This example uses code, title, symbol, section and items without renaming the source fields. Routes still use `to`. Open Form controls or search for Input.

*props: `key-id, key-label, key-icon, key-group, key-children`*

```html
<a-menu-button-toggle
  :can-change-body-class="false"
  :button-toggle-props="{ id: 'docs_menu_keys_toggle' }"
  menu-id="docs_menu_keys"
/>

  <a-menu
    :can-change-body-class="false"
    :data="menuItems"
    :is-inline="true"
    :use-backdrop-mobile="false"
    menu-id="docs_menu_keys"
    key-id="code"
    key-label="title"
    key-icon="symbol"
    key-group="section"
    key-children="items"
  />
</div>
```

```js
import {
```

## Long breadcrumbs and submenu counts

Open Components → Form controls → Text fields. With `is-breadcrumbs-truncated`, parent links that do not fit move into the breadcrumb dropdown. The switch controls `show-count-children` so you can show or hide submenu item counts.

*props: `is-breadcrumbs-truncated, show-count-children`*

```html
<a-menu-button-toggle
  :can-change-body-class="false"
  :button-toggle-props="{ id: 'docs_menu_breadcrumbs_toggle' }"
  menu-id="docs_menu_breadcrumbs"
/>
<a-switch
  v-model="showCountChildren"
  label="Show submenu item counts"
/>
<div style="height: 24rem; overflow: hidden;">
  <a-menu
    :can-change-body-class="false"
    :data="menuItems"
    :is-inline="true"
    :use-backdrop-mobile="false"
    menu-id="docs_menu_breadcrumbs"
    key-children="children"
    :is-breadcrumbs-truncated="true"
    :show-count-children="showCountChildren"
  />
</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AMenu,
  AMenuButtonToggle,
  ASwitch,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AMenu,
    AMenuButtonToggle,
    ASwitch,
  },
  setup() {
    const showCountChildren = ref(true);

    const menuItems = [
      {
        id: "components",
        label: "Components and reusable interface patterns",
        icon: "MenuAppFill",
        children: [
          {
            id: "forms",
            label: "Form controls and data entry components",
            children: [
              {
                id: "text",
                label: "Text fields and numeric input controls",
                children: [
                  { id: "input", label: "Input", to: { name: "PageInput" } },
                  { id: "input-number", label: "Input number", to: { name: "PageInputNumber" } },
                ],
              },
              { id: "select", label: "Select", to: { name: "PageSelect" } },
            ],
          },
          { id: "button", label: "Button", to: { name: "PageButton" } },
        ],
      },
      { id: "alert", label: "Alert", icon: "ExclamationTriangle", to: { name: "PageAlert" } },
    ];

    return {
      menuItems,
      showCountChildren,
    };
  },
};
```

## CSS variables (`scss/components/AMenu.scss`, `scss/components/AVerticalScroll.scss`)

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |

| `--a_menu_submenu_border_width` |  | Width of the left and top border of an open submenu panel. |
| `--a_menu_search_height` |  | Height of the search field in the top bar. |
| `--a_menu_close_panel_width` |  | Width of a submenu panel shown next to the closed menu. |
| `--a_menu_close_panel_max_height` |  | Maximum height of a submenu panel next to the closed menu. Longer content scrolls. |
| `--a_menu_close_panel_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of a submenu panel next to the closed menu. |
| `--a_menu_close_panel_box_shadow_color` |  | Shadow color of a submenu panel next to the closed menu. |
| `--a_menu_close_panel_box_shadow_size` |  | Offsets, blur and spread of the shadow of a submenu panel next to the closed menu. |
| `--a_menu_close_panel_header_color` |  | Text color of the panel header. |
| `--a_menu_close_panel_header_border_bottom_color` |  | Color of the line under the panel header. |
| `--a_menu_close_panel_header_border_bottom_width` |  | Thickness of the line under the panel header. |
| `--a_menu_link_line_horizontal_display` |  | Display of the separator line between list items. Set to block to show it. |
| `--a_menu_btn_toggle_width` |  | Width of the toggle button. |
| `--a_menu_btn_toggle_height` |  | Height of the toggle button. |
| `--a_menu_btn_toggle_bar_width` |  | Width of a bar of the toggle icon. |
| `--a_menu_btn_toggle_bar_height` |  | Thickness of a bar of the toggle icon. |
| `--a_menu_btn_toggle_bar_1_top` |  | Top position of the first bar of the toggle icon. |
| `--a_menu_btn_toggle_bar_2_top` |  | Top position of the middle bar of the toggle icon. The bars of the close icon (×) meet here. |
| `--a_menu_btn_toggle_bar_3_top` |  | Top position of the last bar of the toggle icon. |
| `--a_menu_btn_toggle_bar_bg` |  | Color of the bars of the toggle icon. |
| `--a_vertical_scroll_wrapper_bg` |  | Background of the areas with the scroll up and scroll down buttons. |
| `--a_vertical_scroll_wrapper_height` |  | Height of the areas with the scroll buttons. The content gets the same padding at the top and bottom. |

# AModal (Modal Window)

AModal is a component that enables the implementation of modal windows. It provides a multitude of customization options, including various parameters for content, button behavior, visibility controls, and size adjustments. With customizable slots for header, body, and footer, it allows for flexible styling of modal windows for various use cases.

## Basic usage

*props: `close`, `header-text`*

```html
<a-button
  id="btn_modal_basic"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_MODAL_PAGE_BTN_OPEN_MODAL_"
  @click="openModal"
></a-button>

<a-modal
  v-if="isModalVisible"
  selector-close-ids="btn_modal_basic"
  header-text="Aloha"
  :close="closeModal"
></a-modal>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AButton,
  AModal,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageModalBasic",
  components: {
    AButton,
    AModal,
  },
  setup() {
    const isModalVisible = ref(undefined);

    const openModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const closeModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = false;
    };

    return {
      closeModal,
      isModalVisible,
      openModal,
    };
  },
};
```

## Using **body-html**

The **body-html** prop is used to display custom HTML content in the modal window.

*props: `body-html`*

```html
<a-button
  id="btn_modal_body_html"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_MODAL_PAGE_BTN_OPEN_MODAL_"
  @click="openModal"
></a-button>

<a-modal
  v-if="isModalVisible"
  selector-close-ids="btn_modal_body_html"
  header-text="Aloha"
  :body-html="bodyHtml"
  :close="closeModal"
></a-modal>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

  AButton,
  AModal,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageModalBodyHtml",
  components: {
    AButton,
    AModal,
  },
  setup() {
    const isModalVisible = ref(undefined);
    const bodyHtml = `<ul>
      <li>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetuer adipiscing elit.</li>
      <li>Aliquam tincidunt mauris eu risus.</li>
      <li>Vestibulum auctor dapibus neque.</li>
    </ul>`;

    const openModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const closeModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = false;
    };

    return {
      bodyHtml,
      closeModal,
      isModalVisible,
      openModal,
    };
  },
};
```

## Using the **size** prop to control modal size

This example demonstrates the use of the **size** prop to adjust the size of the modal as needed.

The modal size is based on options such as 'small', 'large', 'xl', 'xxl', and 'fullscreen'.

*props: `size`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_btn_group"
  role="group"
>
  <a-button
    id="btn_modal_size_small"
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_secondary"

  ></a-button>

    @click="openModal('large')"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    id="btn_modal_size_xl"

    @click="openModal('xxl')"

></a-modal>
```

```js
  ref,
} from "vue";

  AButton,
  AModal,
} from "aloha-vue";

  name: "PageModalSize",
  components: {
    AButton,
    AModal,
  },

    const sizeModal = ref(undefined);

      sizeModal.value = size;
```

## Modal inside a modal

This example demonstrates the ability to open one modal window inside another. All modals can be correctly stacked by **z-index** and function independently of each other.

```html
<a-button
  id="btn_modal_in_modal"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_MODAL_PAGE_BTN_OPEN_MODAL_"
  @click="openModal"
></a-button>

<a-modal
  v-if="isModalVisible"
  selector-close-ids="btn_modal_in_modal"
  :close="closeModal"
  header-text="Modal 1"
  size="xl"
>
  <template
    v-slot:modalBody
  >
    <a-button
      id="btn_modal_in_modal_2"
      class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
      text="_A_MODAL_PAGE_BTN_OPEN_MODAL_"
      @click="openModal2"
    ></a-button>
  </template>
</a-modal>

<a-modal
  v-if="isModal2Visible"
  selector-close-ids="btn_modal_in_modal_2"
  :close="closeModal2"
  header-text="Modal 2"
></a-modal>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AButton,
  AModal,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AButton,
    AModal,
  },
  setup() {
    const isModalVisible = ref(undefined);
    const isModal2Visible = ref(undefined);

    const openModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const openModal2 = () => {
      isModal2Visible.value = true;
    };

    const closeModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = false;
    };

    const closeModal2 = () => {
      isModal2Visible.value = false;
    };

    return {
      closeModal,
      closeModal2,
      isModal2Visible,
      isModalVisible,
      openModal,
      openModal2,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| backdrop-z-index | Number |  |  | If set, this prop specifies the CSS z-index for the modal window's backdrop. |
| body-html | Object | "" |  | The HTML content of the modal window. |
| body-html-class | String / Array / Object |  |  | Adds a **CSS** class to the **HTML** that can be used in the modal window. **body-html** |
| class-extra | String / Object | a_modal_class_extra |  | Additional **CSS** class for the modal window, which can be used for automated tests or as an additional selector. |
| close | Function |  | yes | The function that enables closing the modal. |
| close-button-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Attributes for the modal's close button. [(AButton)](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/button.md) |
| close-button-class | String / Array / Object | a_btn a_btn_secondary |  | The class or classes of the close button. [(AButton)](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/button.md) |
| close-button-id | String |  |  | The ID of the close button. |
| close-button-text | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_CANCEL_ |  | The text on the close button. |
| close-button-text-screen-reader-footer | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_TEXT_SCREEN_READER_CLOSE_FOOTER_ |  | Adds screen reader text for the 'Close modal window' button in the footer. |
| close-button-text-screen-reader-header | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_TEXT_SCREEN_READER_CLOSE_HEADER_ |  | Adds screen reader text for the 'Close modal window' button in the header. |
| disabled | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the modal is disabled. |
| disabled-save | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the save button in the modal is disabled. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object with parameters for translations. [(ATranslation)](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/translation.md) |
| focus-start-id | String |  |  | If an **ID** is set, the focus is placed on the element with this **ID** when the modal window opens (if **use-focus-on-start** is set to **true**). |
| header-tag | String | h2 |  | The HTML tag for the modal header. |
| header-text | String |  |  | The text in the modal header. |
| hide-footer | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether to hide the footer in the modal window. |
| hide-header | Boolean |  |  | Hides the header of the modal window. |
| id | String | uniqueId("a_modal_") |  | The ID of the modal. |
| is-close-button-hide | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the close button is visible. |
| is-confirm | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether the modal requires confirmation. (Only for [AConfirm](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/confirm.md)) |
| is-footer-sticky | Boolean | false |  | Determines if the footer is fixed to the bottom of the modal window. |
| is-modal-hidden | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the modal is hidden. (Only for [AConfirm](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/confirm.md)) |
| is-save-button-hide | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the save button is visible. |
| loading | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether the modal is in a loading state. |
| modal-class | String / Object |  |  | The class or classes of the modal. |
| modal-style | String / Object |  |  | The style or styles of the modal window. |
| save | Function |  |  | The function that enables saving in the modal. |
| save-button-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Attributes for the save button in the modal. [(AButton)](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/button.md) |
| save-button-class | String / Array / Object | a_btn a_btn_primary |  | The class or classes of the save button. [(AButton)](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/button.md) |
| save-button-id | String |  |  | The ID of the save button. |
| save-button-text | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_SAVE_ |  | The text on the save button. |
| save-button-text-screen-reader | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_TEXT_SCREEN_READER_SAVE_ |  | Adds screen reader text for the 'Save' button in the modal window. |
| selector-close | String / Array |  |  | The focus selector to ensure that focus is not lost in the browser when the modal is closed. |
| selector-close-ids | String / Array |  |  | The ID or IDs for focus to ensure that focus is not lost in the browser when the modal is closed. |
| show-close-button-header | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether to display the close button ("x") in the header of the modal window. |
| size | String |  |  | The size of the modal (small, large, xl, xxl, fullscreen). |
| stop | Boolean |  |  | Adds a click event with stopPropagation to the modal window's parent element to prevent the event from propagating further. |
| teleport-selector | String | body |  | CSS selector of the element the modal window is moved to (Vue `Teleport`). Default: `body`. |
| use-escape | Boolean | true |  | Specifies whether the Escape key can close the modal. |
| use-focus-on-start | Boolean | true |  | If set to **true** and no **focus-start-id** is set, focus is placed on the first focusable element in the modal window. |
| z-index | Number |  |  | Specifies the CSS z-index for the modal window itself. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| modalHeader | A slot containing the content of the modal header. |
| modalBody | A slot containing the main content of the modal window. |
| modalFooterPrepend | A slot displayed before the save and close buttons in the modal footer. |
| modalFooterAppend | A slot displayed after the save and close buttons in the modal footer. |

## Translations

| --- | --- |

| `_A_MODAL_BTN_SAVE_` | save |

| `_A_MODAL_BTN_TEXT_SCREEN_READER_CLOSE_FOOTER_` | Close modal window (located in the footer) |
| `_A_MODAL_BTN_TEXT_SCREEN_READER_SAVE_` | Save data in the modal window |

# AModalForm (Modal window with a form)

**AModalForm** is a modal window ([AModal](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/modal.md)) with a form ([AForm](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/form.md)) in the body. The form is built from `data-form`, the model is bound with `v-model`. Props with the same name work like in **AModal** and **AForm**.

## AModalForm: form columns

The `class-columns` and `class-column-default` props are passed to the inner `AForm`. In this example, the name and email fields occupy half the width and stack on touch devices. The notes field defines its own `classColumn` and spans the full width. If these props are omitted, the defaults from `AForm` apply.

*props: `class-columns`, `class-column-default`*

```html
<a-button
  id="btn_modal_form_columns"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_MODAL_PAGE_BTN_OPEN_MODAL_"
  @click="openModal"
/>

<a-modal-form
  v-if="isModalVisible"
  selector-close-ids="btn_modal_form_columns"
  v-model="model"
  :data-form="dataForm"
  :close="closeModal"
  :is-save-button-hide="true"
  header-text="_A_MODAL_FORM_COLUMNS_HEADER_"
  size="large"
  class-columns="a_columns a_columns_count_12 a_columns_gap_3"
  class-column-default="a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch"
/>
<pre>{{ model }}</pre>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AButton,
  AModalForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AButton,
    AModalForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({ name: "Aloha", email: "aloha@example.com", notes: "" });
    const dataForm = [
      {
        type: "text",
        id: "name",
        label: "_A_FORM_EXAMPLE_NAME_",
      },
      {
        type: "email",
        id: "email",
        label: "_A_FORM_EXAMPLE_EMAIL_",
      },
      {
        type: "textarea",
        id: "notes",
        label: "_A_FORM_EXAMPLE_NOTES_",
        classColumn: "a_column a_column_12",
      },
    ];
    const isModalVisible = ref(false);

    const openModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const closeModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = false;
    };

    return {
      closeModal,
      dataForm,
      isModalVisible,
      model,
      openModal,
    };
  },
};
```

## AModalForm: different form elements

A large modal window (`size="xl"`) with different form elements: text, email, date, select, currency, radio buttons, checkboxes, switch and textarea. The function `save` shows the save button and is called when it is clicked. Three columns on the desktop, two on the tablet, one on mobile devices.

*props: `data-form`, `save`, `size`*

```html
<a-button
  id="btn_modal_form_elements"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_MODAL_PAGE_BTN_OPEN_MODAL_"
  @click="openModal"
/>

<a-modal-form
  v-if="isModalVisible"
  selector-close-ids="btn_modal_form_elements"
  v-model="model"
  :data-form="dataForm"
  :close="closeModal"
  :save="save"
  header-text="_A_MODAL_FORM_ELEMENTS_HEADER_"
  size="xl"
  class-columns="a_columns a_columns_count_12 a_columns_gap_3"
  class-column-default="a_column a_column_4 a_column_6_tablet a_column_12_mobile"
/>
<pre v-if="modelSaved">{{ modelSaved }}</pre>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AButton,
  AModalForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AButton,
    AModalForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({
      name: "Aloha",
      email: "aloha@example.com",
      birthday: undefined,
      country: "de",
      budget: 1500,
      contact: "email",
      interests: ["music"],
      notifications: true,
      notes: "",
    });
    const modelSaved = ref(undefined);
    const dataForm = [
      {
        type: "text",
        id: "name",
        label: "_A_FORM_EXAMPLE_NAME_",
        required: true,
      },
      {
        type: "email",
        id: "email",
        label: "_A_FORM_EXAMPLE_EMAIL_",
      },
      {
        type: "date",
        id: "birthday",
        label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_BIRTHDAY_",
      },
      {
        type: "select",
        id: "country",
        label: "_A_FORM_EXAMPLE_COUNTRY_",
        data: [
          { label: "Deutschland", value: "de" },
          { label: "France", value: "fr" },
          { label: "Italia", value: "it" },
        ],
      },
      {
        type: "currency",
        id: "budget",
        label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_BUDGET_",
      },
      {
        type: "radio",
        id: "contact",
        label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_CONTACT_",
        data: [
          { label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_CONTACT_EMAIL_", value: "email" },
          { label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_CONTACT_PHONE_", value: "phone" },
        ],
      },
      {
        type: "checkbox",
        id: "interests",
        label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_INTERESTS_",
        data: [
          { label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_INTEREST_MUSIC_", value: "music" },
          { label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_INTEREST_SPORT_", value: "sport" },
          { label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_INTEREST_TRAVEL_", value: "travel" },
        ],
      },
      {
        type: "switch",
        id: "notifications",
        label: "_A_FORM_EXAMPLE_NOTIFICATIONS_",
      },
      {
        type: "textarea",
        id: "notes",
        label: "_A_FORM_EXAMPLE_NOTES_",
        classColumn: "a_column a_column_12",
      },
    ];
    const isModalVisible = ref(false);

    const openModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const closeModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = false;
    };

    const save = () => {
      modelSaved.value = { ...model.value };
      closeModal();
    };

    return {
      closeModal,
      dataForm,
      isModalVisible,
      model,
      modelSaved,
      openModal,
      save,
    };
  },
};
```

## AModalForm: additional button

Besides the save and the cancel button the footer has a delete button. It is added with the slot `modalFooterPrepend` (before the buttons) or `modalFooterAppend` (after the buttons). The form has a date range, a number, a slider and a single checkbox.

*props: `save`, `size`*

```html
<a-button
  id="btn_modal_form_delete"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="_A_MODAL_PAGE_BTN_OPEN_MODAL_"
  @click="openModal"
/>

<a-modal-form
  v-if="isModalVisible"
  selector-close-ids="btn_modal_form_delete"
  v-model="model"
  :data-form="dataForm"
  :close="closeModal"
  :save="save"
  header-text="_A_MODAL_FORM_DELETE_HEADER_"
  size="large"
  class-columns="a_columns a_columns_count_12 a_columns_gap_3"
  class-column-default="a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_mobile"
>
  <template v-slot:modalFooterPrepend>
    <a-button
      class="a_btn a_btn_outline_danger"
      text="_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_BTN_DELETE_"
      @click="remove"
    />
  </template>
</a-modal-form>

<a-translation
  v-if="status"
  class="a_mt_3"
  tag="p"
  role="status"
  :text="status"
/>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AButton,
  AModalForm,
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    AButton,
    AModalForm,
    ATranslation,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref({
      title: "Release 3.0",
      priority: "high",
      period: undefined,
      hours: 8,
      progress: 40,
      done: false,
    });
    const status = ref(undefined);
    const dataForm = [
      {
        type: "text",
        id: "title",
        label: "_A_FORM_EXAMPLE_TITLE_",
        required: true,
      },
      {
        type: "select",
        id: "priority",
        label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_PRIORITY_",
        data: [
          { label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_PRIORITY_LOW_", value: "low" },
          { label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_PRIORITY_MEDIUM_", value: "medium" },
          { label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_PRIORITY_HIGH_", value: "high" },
        ],
      },
      {
        type: "dateRange",
        id: "period",
        label: "_A_FORM_EXAMPLE_PERIOD_",
        classColumn: "a_column a_column_12",
      },
      {
        type: "integerNonNegative",
        id: "hours",
        label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_HOURS_",
      },
      {
        type: "slider",
        id: "progress",
        label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_PROGRESS_",
        step: 10,
      },
      {
        type: "oneCheckbox",
        id: "done",
        label: "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_DONE_",
        classColumn: "a_column a_column_12",
      },
    ];
    const isModalVisible = ref(false);

    const openModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = true;
    };

    const closeModal = () => {
      isModalVisible.value = false;
    };

    const save = () => {
      status.value = "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_STATUS_SAVED_";
      closeModal();
    };

    const remove = () => {
      status.value = "_A_MODAL_FORM_EXAMPLE_STATUS_DELETED_";
      closeModal();
    };

    return {
      closeModal,
      dataForm,
      isModalVisible,
      model,
      openModal,
      remove,
      save,
      status,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| backdrop-z-index | Number |  |  | If set, this prop specifies the CSS z-index for the modal window's backdrop. |
| body-html | Object | "" |  | The HTML content of the modal window. |
| body-html-class | String / Array / Object |  |  | Adds a **CSS** class to the **HTML** that can be used in the modal window. **body-html** |
| class-column-default | String / Object | a_column a_column_12 |  | Default CSS class applied to each configured field when the item does not define its own **classColumn**. |
| class-columns | String / Object | a_columns a_columns_count_12 a_columns_gap_2 |  | CSS classes applied to the container that holds all fields from **data**. |
| class-extra | String / Object | a_modal_class_extra |  | Additional **CSS** class for the modal window, which can be used for automated tests or as an additional selector. |
| close | Function |  | yes | The function that enables closing the modal. |
| close-button-class | String / Array / Object | a_btn a_btn_secondary |  | The class or classes of the close button. [(AButton)](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/button.md) |
| close-button-id | String |  |  | The ID of the close button. |
| close-button-text | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_CANCEL_ |  | The text on the close button. |
| close-button-text-screen-reader-footer | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_TEXT_SCREEN_READER_CLOSE_FOOTER_ |  | Adds screen reader text for the 'Close modal window' button in the footer. |
| close-button-text-screen-reader-header | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_TEXT_SCREEN_READER_CLOSE_HEADER_ |  | Adds screen reader text for the 'Close modal window' button in the header. |
| data-form | Array |  | yes | Required array of field configurations. Every item needs a **type** and **id**, and may contain props supported by the selected UI component. |
| disabled | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the modal is disabled. |
| disabled-save | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the save button in the modal is disabled. |
| errors | Object | () => ({}) |  | Object containing validation errors keyed by field ID. Values are passed to the corresponding fields and can also be displayed in the form error summary. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object with parameters for translations. [(ATranslation)](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/translation.md) |
| focus-start-id | String |  |  | If an **ID** is set, the focus is placed on the element with this **ID** when the modal window opens (if **use-focus-on-start** is set to **true**). |
| header-tag | String | h2 |  | The HTML tag for the modal header. |
| header-text | String |  |  | The text in the modal header. |
| hide-footer | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether to hide the footer in the modal window. |
| hide-header | Boolean |  |  | Hides the header of the modal window. |
| id | String | uniqueId("a_modal_") |  | The ID of the modal. |
| id-prefix | String |  |  | Prefix for the component's **ID**. Used to create a unique identifier based on the specified prefix. |
| is-close-button-hide | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the close button is visible. |
| is-confirm | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether the modal requires confirmation. (Only for [AConfirm](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/confirm.md)) |
| is-data-form-hide | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the component should be hidden. If set to **true**, the component is not displayed on the page. |
| is-data-form-render | Boolean | true |  | Indicates whether the component should be rendered. If set to **false**, the component will not be created in the **DOM**. |
| is-footer-sticky | Boolean | false |  | Determines if the footer is fixed to the bottom of the modal window. |
| is-modal-hidden | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the modal is hidden. (Only for [AConfirm](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/confirm.md)) |
| is-required | Boolean |  |  | Explicitly controls whether the form displays required-field information. When omitted, the value is inferred from configured fields. |
| is-save-button-hide | Boolean | false |  | Determines whether the save button is visible. |
| loading | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether the modal is in a loading state. |
| modal-class | String / Object |  |  | The class or classes of the modal. |
| modal-style | String / Object |  |  | The style or styles of the modal window. |
| model-value | Object |  |  | The complete form model. Field values are read from and written to keys matching their IDs. |
| save | Function |  |  | The function that enables saving in the modal. |
| save-button-class | String / Array / Object | a_btn a_btn_primary |  | The class or classes of the save button. [(AButton)](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/button.md) |
| save-button-id | String |  |  | The ID of the save button. |
| save-button-text | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_SAVE_ |  | The text on the save button. |
| save-button-text-screen-reader | String | _A_MODAL_BTN_TEXT_SCREEN_READER_SAVE_ |  | Adds screen reader text for the 'Save' button in the modal window. |
| selector-close | String / Array |  |  | The focus selector to ensure that focus is not lost in the browser when the modal is closed. |
| selector-close-ids | String / Array |  |  | The ID or IDs for focus to ensure that focus is not lost in the browser when the modal is closed. |
| size | String |  |  | The size of the modal (small, large, xl, xxl, fullscreen). |
| stop | Boolean |  |  | Adds a click event with stopPropagation to the modal window's parent element to prevent the event from propagating further. |
| teleport-selector | String | body |  | CSS selector of the element the modal window is moved to (Vue `Teleport`). Default: `body`. |
| text-error-header | String |  |  | Custom heading for the form-level error summary. |
| text-required | String |  |  | Custom text for the required-fields notice. |
| use-escape | Boolean | true |  | Specifies whether the Escape key can close the modal. |
| use-flat-errors | Boolean | true |  | When enabled, errors are resolved directly by field ID. Disable it when nested container errors follow the nested model structure. |
| use-flat-model | Boolean | true |  | When enabled, container fields work with the shared flat model. Disable it to store container values in nested objects. |
| use-focus-on-start | Boolean | true |  | If set to **true** and no **focus-start-id** is set, focus is placed on the first focusable element in the modal window. |
| use-html-id-as-key | Boolean | false |  | Uses each field's resolved HTML ID as its Vue key instead of the array index. |
| z-index | Number |  |  | Specifies the CSS z-index for the modal window itself. |

## Emits

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Function | Event triggered when the component's model value is updated. Used to synchronize data between the component and the parent component. |
| change | Function | Emitted after a field changes. The payload contains the field ID, new and previous values, complete model, item data when available, and reactive props. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| modalHeader | A slot containing the content of the modal header. |
| modalFooterPrepend | A slot displayed before the save and close buttons in the modal footer. |
| modalFooterAppend | A slot displayed after the save and close buttons in the modal footer. |
| modalBodyPrepend | A slot displayed in the body before the text (`body-html`) and the form. |
| modalBodyAppend | A slot displayed in the body after the form. |
| formPrepend | Content rendered at the beginning of the form, before required information and errors. |
| formPrependAfterRequired | Content rendered after the required-fields notice and before the error summary. |
| formDataPrepend | Content rendered inside the field container before configured fields. |
| formDataAppend | Content rendered inside the field container after configured fields. |
| formAppend | Content rendered at the end of the form after the field container. |

# AProgress (Progress bar)

AProgress component is a customisable progress bar for Vue.js applications. It allows for a visual representation of the progress of an activity or a process.

## Basic usage

*props: `value`*

```html
<a-progress
  :value="50"
></a-progress>
```

## Customizable colors for progress bar

The AProgress component allows for customization of the progress bars in different colors to match your Vue.js application's theme. With the flexibility of the props, you can customize the background colors of the progress bars and visualize the progress. These customizable colors give you easy integration into your projects and allow you to configure the progress bar based on application needs.

*props: `class-progress-bar`*

```html
<a-progress
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_primary"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_secondary"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_tertiary"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_success"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_warning"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_info"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_danger"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
   class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_gray_300"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_gray_400"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_gray_500"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_gray_600"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_gray_700"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_gray_800"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_gray_900"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_black"
></a-progress>
```

## Dynamically customizable progress bars with a class determining function.

The AProgress component allows you to create progress bars with a function that dynamically generates the background class based on the progress value. Instead of a fixed background class, you can associate the **class-progress-bar** prop with a function that returns the desired class value.

*props: `class-progress-bar (as Function)`*

```html
<a-input-number
  v-model="model"
  class="a_mb_4"
  :min="0"
  :max="100"
  :step="5"
  type="integerNonNegative"
></a-input-number>
<a-progress
  :value="model"
  :class-progress-bar="getClassProgressBar"
></a-progress>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AInputNumber,
  AProgress,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageProgressClassProgressBarFunction",
  components: {
    AInputNumber,
    AProgress,
  },
  setup() {    
    const getClassProgressBar = percent => {
      if (percent >= 80) {
        return "a_bg_danger";
      }
      if (percent > 50) {
        return "a_bg_warning";
      }
      return "a_bg_success";
    };
    const model = ref(50);

    return {
      getClassProgressBar,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Dynamically updatable progress bar

The AProgress component allows you to update progress bars in real time by dynamically changing the Props value. Coupled with an integerNonNegative input field, as shown in the example, users can control the progress using the a-input-number component. This allows you to dynamically adjust the progress bar depending on user input or other events and visually represent the current progress.

*props: `value`*

```html
<a-input-number
  v-model="model"
  class="a_mb_4"
  :min="0"
  :max="100"
  :step="5"
  type="integerNonNegative"
></a-input-number>
<a-progress
  :value="model"
></a-progress>
```

```js
import {
  ref,

import {
  AInputNumber,
  AProgress,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageProgressValue",
  components: {
    AInputNumber,
    AProgress,
  },
  setup() {
    const model = ref(20);

    return {
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Dynamic thresholds

The AProgress component allows you to create progress bars with dynamic thresholds. You can use the **min** and **max** props to set the lower and upper bounds of the progress bar. This gives you the flexibility to configure the progress bar for different scenarios and to display progress on different scales.

*props: `min`, `max`*

```html

  :value="-20"
  :min="-100"
  :max="0"
></a-progress>

  class="a_mt_4"
  :min="50"
  :max="100"
  :value="75"

  :max="1000"
  :value="600"

  :max="-100"
  :value="-130"
></a-progress>
```

## Optional display of progress value

The AProgress component allows you to create progress bars with an optional value display. You can use the **showValue** prop to control whether the progress value should be displayed as text within the progress bar.

*props: `show-value`*

```html
<a-progress
  class="a_progress_small"
  :value="20"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4 a_progress_medium"
  :value="20"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4 a_progress_large"
  :value="20"
></a-progress>
```

## Reversed display

The AProgress component allows you to create progress bars with reverse display. When the **reverse** prop is set to true, the progress bar is displayed from right to left instead of left to right.

*props: `reverse`*

```html
<a-progress
  :value="20"
  :reverse="true"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="40"
  :reverse="true"
></a-progress>
```

## Different display of values

The AProgress component allows you to create progress bars with different text formats for the progress value. If the valueTextInteger prop is set to true , the progress value is displayed as an integer percentage (e.g. "20%"). If the valueTextInteger prop is false or not set, the progress value is displayed as a percentage with two decimal places (e.g. "20.00%").

*props: `value-text-integer`*

```html
<a-progress
  :value="20"
  :value-text-integer="true"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="40"
  :value-text-integer="true"
></a-progress>
```

## Indeterminate progress bar with animation

The AProgress component allows you to create indeterminate progress bars with animation. By using the **indeterminate** prop, you can create a progress bar where progress is not represented by a specific value. Instead, a continuous, animated motion is displayed to indicate that an activity is ongoing with no indication of how long it is expected to take.This type of progress bar is particularly useful in situations where a process takes a long time and progress cannot be quantified.

*props: `indeterminate`*

```html
<a-progress
  :value="20"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_primary"
  :indeterminate="true"
  :show-value="false"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="30"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_secondary"
  :indeterminate="true"
  :show-value="false"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="40"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_tertiary"
  :indeterminate="true"
  :show-value="false"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="50"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_success"
  :indeterminate="true"
  :show-value="false"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="60"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_warning"
  :indeterminate="true"
  :show-value="false"

  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="70"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_info"
  :indeterminate="true"
  :show-value="false"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="80"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_danger"
  :indeterminate="true"
  :show-value="false"
></a-progress>
```

## Controlling the duration of the animation

The AProgress component allows you to control the animation duration for progress bars. By using the **duration** prop, you can set the speed of the animation, causing the progress bar to animate slower or faster. The duration is given in seconds and affects the speed at which the progress bar moves for striped or indeterminate progress bar.

*props: `duration`*

```html
<a-progress
  :value="30"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_primary"
  :striped="true"
  :striped-flow="true"
  :duration="2"
  :show-value="false"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="40"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_secondary"
  :striped="true"
  :striped-flow="true"
  :duration="0.5"
  :show-value="false"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="30"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_tertiary"
  :indeterminate="true"
  :duration="5"
  :show-value="false"
></a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="40"
  class-progress-bar="a_bg_success"
  :indeterminate="true"
  :duration="8"
  :show-value="false"
></a-progress>
```

## Custom display of the progress value by using **progressText** slot

The AProgress component provides the ability to customize the displayed progress value by using the **progressText** slot. This slot allows you to create a custom representation of the progress bar value over the default value display.

*slots: `progressText`*

```html
<a-progress
  :value="20"
>
  <template
    v-slot:progressText="{ valuePercent }"
  >
    <span>Aloha {{ valuePercent }}</span>
  </template>
</a-progress>
<a-progress
  class="a_mt_4"
  :value="40"
>
  <template
    v-slot:progressText="{ valuePercent }"
  >
    <span>$$$ {{ valuePercent }}</span>
  </template>
</a-progress>
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| aria-label | String | "_A_PROGRESS_ARIA_LABEL_" | yes | Accessible name of the progress bar for screen readers (aria-label). Can be a translation placeholder. |
| class-progress-bar | String / Object / Function | undefined | yes | One or more classes for the progress bar that can be specified to customize its appearance. |
| duration | Number | undefined | yes | This prop controls the duration of the animation for the progress bar. |
| indeterminate | Boolean | false | yes | Enables the indeterminate mode of the progress bar. When indeterminate is true , the progress bar is animated, showing continuous, indeterminate movement. |
| max | Number | 100 | yes | Upper bound, maximum value for the progress bar. |
| min | Number | 0 | yes | Lower bound, minimum value for the progress bar. |
| reverse | Boolean | false | yes | Specifies whether the progress bar should be displayed from right to left. |
| showValue | Boolean | true | yes | Specifies whether the progress value should be displayed as text inside the progress bar. |
| striped | Boolean | false | yes | Enables the striped progress bar. |
| striped-flow | Boolean | false | yes | Enables the animated display for striped progress bars. |
| value | Number | 0 | yes | The current progress of the progress bar. |
| value-text-integer | Boolean | false | yes | Specifies which text format to use for the progress value. If valueTextInteger is true, the value is displayed as an integer percentage. If valueTextInteger is false or absent, then the value is displayed as a percentage with two decimal places. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| progressText | Allows for customization of how the progress bar value is displayed. valuePercent variable can be accesed in the slot scope to show the current progress percentage. |

## CSS variables (`scss/utils/progress.scss`)

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--a_progress_height` |  | Height of the progress bar. Changed by the size classes (small, medium, large). Also the size of the stripes. |
| `--a_progress_font_size` |  | Font size of the text on the bar. Changed by the size classes. |
| `--a_progress_bg` |  | Background of the track. |
| `--a_progress_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of the track. |
| `--a_progress_bar_color` |  | Text color on the bar. Follows a background class (e.g. .a_bg_success) on the bar. |
| `--a_progress_bar_bg` |  | Color of the bar. |
| `--a_progress_bar_transition` |  | Transition when the value changes. |
| `--a_progress_stripe_color` |  | Color of the stripes of a striped bar. |
