# AProgressCircle (Progress circle)

The **AProgressCircle** component displays progress as a circular indicator. It supports standard and indeterminate states and is useful when you want to visualize completion within a compact area.

## Basic usage

*props: `value`*

```html
<a-progress-circle
  :value="20"
></a-progress-circle>
<a-progress-circle
  class="a_mt_3"
  :value="50"
></a-progress-circle>
```

## Indeterminate circular progress with animation

The **AProgressCircle** component allows you to display an indeterminate circular progress indicator with animation. By using the **indeterminate** prop, you can indicate that an activity is ongoing without showing a specific completion value.

*props: `indeterminate`*

```html
<a-progress-circle
  :value="20"
  :indeterminate="true"
></a-progress-circle>
<a-progress-circle
  class="a_mt_3"
  :value="50"
  :indeterminate="true"
></a-progress-circle>
<a-progress-circle
  class="a_mt_3"
  :value="80"
  :indeterminate="true"
></a-progress-circle>
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| aria-label | String | "_A_PROGRESS_ARIA_LABEL_" | yes | Accessible name of the progress bar for screen readers (aria-label). Can be a translation placeholder. |
| duration | Number | undefined |  | Controls the animation duration of the circular progress indicator. |
| indeterminate | Boolean | false |  | Enables the indeterminate mode of the circular progress indicator. |
| max | Number | 100 |  | Upper bound, maximum value for the circular progress indicator. |
| min | Number | 0 |  | Lower bound, minimum value for the circular progress indicator. |
| rotate | Number | 0 |  | Rotates the circular progress indicator by the specified number of degrees. |
| showValue | Boolean | true |  | Specifies whether the progress value should be displayed inside the circular progress indicator. |
| strokeWidth | Number | 5 |  | Sets the stroke width of the circular progress indicator. |
| value | Number | 0 |  | The current progress value of the circular progress indicator. |
| valueTextClass | String / Object | undefined |  | One or more classes for customizing the displayed progress value text. |
| valueTextInteger | Boolean | false |  | Specifies how to format the displayed progress value. If enabled, the value is shown as an integer percentage. |
| width | Number / String | 125 |  | Sets the width and height of the circular progress indicator. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| progressText | Allows customizing the displayed progress value. The slot scope provides the **valuePercent** value. |

## CSS variables (`scss/components/AProgressCircle.scss`)

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--a_progress_circle_color` |  | Color of the progress arc. |
| `--a_progress_circle_base_color` |  | Color of the full circle behind the arc. |
| `--a_progress_circle_text_color` |  | Color of the text in the middle. |

# AShowMore (Show more)

The 'AShowMore' component makes it possible to hide part of the content of a web page and show it when needed.

## Basic usage

*slots: `default`*

```html
<a-show-more>
  <ul>
    <li>1 aloha</li>
    <li>2 aloha</li>
    <li>3 aloha</li>
    <li>4 aloha</li>
    <li>5 aloha</li>
    <li>6 aloha</li>
    <li>7 aloha</li>
    <li>8 aloha</li>
    <li>9 aloha</li>
    <li>10 aloha</li>
    <li>11 aloha</li>
    <li>12 aloha</li>
  </ul>
</a-show-more>
```

## Disabled

Disabled state of AShowMore. The user is not allowed to interact with the component when it is in a disabled state.

*props: `disabled`*

```html
<a-show-more 
  :disabled="true"
>
  <ul>
    <li>1 aloha</li>
    <li>2 aloha</li>
    <li>3 aloha</li>
    <li>4 aloha</li>
    <li>5 aloha</li>
    <li>6 aloha</li>
    <li>7 aloha</li>
    <li>8 aloha</li>
    <li>9 aloha</li>
    <li>10 aloha</li>
    <li>11 aloha</li>
    <li>12 aloha</li>
  </ul>
</a-show-more>
```

## Slots

You can use slots with parameters: **isButtonVisible**, **isOpen**.

*slots: `button`, `default`*

```html
<a-show-more 
  btn-text-less=""
  btn-text-more=""
>
  <template
    v-slot:button="{ isButtonVisible, isOpen }"
  >
    <span>{{ isOpen ? "Show less" : "Show more" }}</span>
  </template>
  
  <template
    v-slot:default="{ isButtonVisible, isOpen }"
  >
    <p>isButtonVisible: {{ isButtonVisible }}</p>
    <p>isOpen: {{ isOpen }}</p>
    <ul>
      <li>1 aloha</li>
      <li>2 aloha</li>
      <li>3 aloha</li>
      <li>4 aloha</li>
      <li>5 aloha</li>
      <li>6 aloha</li>
      <li>7 aloha</li>
      <li>8 aloha</li>
      <li>9 aloha</li>
      <li>10 aloha</li>
      <li>11 aloha</li>
      <li>12 aloha</li>
    </ul>
  </template>
  
</a-show-more>
```

## Events

Emit toggle allows, when changing the status of the component, to call the method with one argument "isOpen", which is an indicator of the open state of the component.

```html
<a-show-more

  @toggle="onToggle"
></a-show-more>
```

```js
import {
```

## Exposes: Public Properties

This example shows how to work with Exposes (Public Properties).

*exposes: `buttonRef`, `containerRef`, `isOpen`, `toggleButton`*

```html
<div
  class="a_btn_group"
  role="group"
>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_primary"
    text="_A_SHOW_MORE_TEXT_TOGGLE_WITH_IS_OPEN_"
    @click="toggleShowWithIsOpen"
  ></a-button>
  <a-button
    class="a_btn a_btn_outline_primary"
    text="_A_SHOW_MORE_TEXT_TOGGLE_WITH_TOGGLE_BUTTON_"
    @click="toggleShowWithToggleButton"
  ></a-button>
</div>
<a-show-more 
  ref="showMoreRef"
  :html="html"
></a-show-more>
```

```js
import {
  nextTick,
  onMounted,
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AButton,
  AShowMore,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageShowMoreExposes",
  components: {
    AButton,
    AShowMore,
  },
  setup() {
    const html = `<p>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
      pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
      Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
      in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent
      per conubia nostra, per inceptos himenaeos. Duis pharetra luctus lacus ut 
      vestibulum. Maecenas ipsum lacus, lacinia quis posuere ut, pulvinar vitae dolor.
      Integer eu nibh at nisi ullamcorper sagittis id vel leo. Integer feugiat 
      faucibus libero, at maximus nisl suscipit posuere. Morbi nec enim nunc. 
      Phasellus bibendum turpis ut ipsum egestas, sed sollicitudin elit convallis. 
      Cras pharetra mi tristique sapien vestibulum lobortis. Nam eget bibendum metus, 
      non dictum mauris. Nulla at tellus sagittis, viverra est a, bibendum metus.</p>
      <p>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
      pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
      Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
      in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent
      per conubia nostra, per inceptos himenaeos. Duis pharetra luctus lacus ut 
      vestibulum. Maecenas ipsum lacus, lacinia quis posuere ut, pulvinar vitae dolor.
      Integer eu nibh at nisi ullamcorper sagittis id vel leo. Integer feugiat 
      faucibus libero, at maximus nisl suscipit posuere. Morbi nec enim nunc. 
      Phasellus bibendum turpis ut ipsum egestas, sed sollicitudin elit convallis. 
      Cras pharetra mi tristique sapien vestibulum lobortis. Nam eget bibendum metus, 
      non dictum mauris. Nulla at tellus sagittis, viverra est a, bibendum metus.</p>`;
      
    const showMoreRef = ref(undefined);

    const toggleShowWithIsOpen = () => {
      showMoreRef.value.isOpen = !showMoreRef.value.isOpen;
    };

    const toggleShowWithToggleButton = () => {
      showMoreRef.value.toggleButton();
    };

    onMounted(() => {
      showMoreRef.value.containerRef.setAttribute("class", "a_bg_gray_200");
      nextTick().then(
        () => {
          showMoreRef.value.buttonRef.$el.setAttribute("class", "a_btn a_btn_primary");
        }
      );
    });

    return {
      html,
      showMoreRef,
      toggleShowWithIsOpen,
      toggleShowWithToggleButton,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| btn-attributes | Object | {} |  | Button attributes that are not explicitly defined as props. |
| btn-class | String / Object | a_btn a_btn_link a_p_0 |  | CSS button class for showing and hiding more text. |
| btn-icon-left-less | String |  |  | Left side icon for 'Show less' button. |
| btn-icon-left-more | String |  |  | Left side icon for 'Show more' button. |
| btn-icon-right-less | String |  |  | Right side icon for 'Show less' button. |
| btn-icon-right-more | String |  |  | Right side icon for 'Show more' button. |
| btn-id | String |  |  | ID for the button. |
| btn-parent-class | String | a_text_center |  | CSS class for parent button tag. |
| btn-text-less | String | _A_SHOW_MORE_LESS_ |  | Text for 'Show less' button. |
| btn-text-more | String | _A_SHOW_MORE_MORE_ |  | Text for 'Show more' button. |
| btn-title-less | String |  |  | Title for 'Show less' button. |
| btn-title-more | String |  |  | Title for 'Show more' button. |
| btn-title-placement | String |  |  | Title placement for the button, only works when is-btn-title-html is true. |
| disabled | Boolean | false |  | Whether button is disabled |
| height | Number | 200 |  | The height of the HTML block, if this height is exceeded, a button will be shown. |
| html | String |  |  | HTML to be shown inside the component. |
| id | String |  |  | Specifies a unique ID for the HTML element corresponding to the component. |
| is-btn-title-html | Boolean |  |  | If the title in the HTML format. |
| is-open-default | Boolean | false |  | All text is shown by default. |
| safe-html | String |  |  | Component content in safe HTML format. |
| show-less | Boolean | true |  | Is button 'Show less' visible. |
| text | String |  |  | Content of the component in plain text format. |
| text-length | String |  |  | Text block length, in characters. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Content to be displayed within the component. |
| button | Content displayed inside the button. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| toggle | Function | Triggers when a button is pressed, ({ isOpen }) => {}. |

## Exposes

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| buttonRef | Object | Button 'Show more' ref. |
| containerRef | Object | HTML-container ref. |
| isOpen | Boolean | If the 'Show more' button is clicked, and the entire HTML is visible. |
| toggleButton | Function | Function: show more or less. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_SHOW_MORE_MORE_` | Show more |
| `_A_SHOW_MORE_LESS_` | Show less |
| `_A_SHOW_MORE_LESS_SCREEN_READER_` | Show less - Button can be ignored since all content is already readable by screen readers |
| `_A_SHOW_MORE_MORE_SCREEN_READER_` | Show more - Button can be ignored since all content is already readable by screen readers |

# ASkeleton (Skeleton)

The **ASkeleton** component shows gray placeholders in the shape of the content while it is loading. The page does not jump when the content appears. Screen readers announce the loading text, the shapes are hidden from them.

## Basic usage

Without props the skeleton shows a title and three rows.

```html
<a-skeleton></a-skeleton>
```

## Avatar, title and rows

`avatar` adds a circle on the left, `title` turns the title off and `rows` sets the number of rows. The last row is shorter, like the end of a paragraph.

*props: `avatar`, `rows`, `title`*

```html
<a-skeleton
  :avatar="true"
  :rows="2"
></a-skeleton>
<a-skeleton
  class="a_mt_5"
  :title="false"
  :rows="5"
></a-skeleton>
```

## Without animation

`:animated="false"` turns the moving band off. With the system setting “reduce motion” the animation is always off.

*props: `animated`*

```html
<a-skeleton
  :animated="false"
></a-skeleton>
```

## Loading the content

While `loading` is `true`, the skeleton is shown, then the default slot.

*props: `loading`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary a_mb_3"
  text="Reload"
  :disabled="loading"
  @click="load"
></a-button>
<a-skeleton
  :loading="loading"
  :avatar="true"
  :rows="2"
>
  <div class="a_d_flex a_gap_3 a_align_items_start">
    <span class="a_rounded_circle ...">AB</span>
    <div>
      <h3>Anna Becker</h3>
      <p>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</a-skeleton>
```

```js
import {
  AButton,
  ASkeleton,
} from "aloha-vue";
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

export default {
  name: "PageSkeletonLoading",
  components: {
    AButton,
    ASkeleton,
  },
  setup() {
    const loading = ref(true);

    const load = () => {
      loading.value = true;
      setTimeout(() => {
        loading.value = false;
      }, 2000);
    };

    load();

    return {
      load,
      loading,
    };
  },
};
```

## Own layout

The slot `template` replaces the default layout. Build it from **ASkeletonItem** in the shape of the real content, e.g. a card.

```html
<a-skeleton style="max-width: 20rem;">
  <template v-slot:template>
    <a-skeleton-item variant="image"></a-skeleton-item>
    <a-skeleton-item
      class="a_mt_3"
      variant="heading"
      width="70%"
    ></a-skeleton-item>
    <a-skeleton-item class="a_mt_2"></a-skeleton-item>
    <a-skeleton-item
      class="a_mt_2"
      width="80%"
    ></a-skeleton-item>
    <a-skeleton-item
      class="a_mt_3"
      variant="button"
    ></a-skeleton-item>
  </template>
</a-skeleton>
```

## Repeating: table rows

`count` repeats the skeleton, e.g. for list items or table rows. The slot `template` gets the `index` of the repetition.

*props: `count`*

```html
<a-skeleton
  :count="4"
  style="--a_skeleton_group_gap: .75rem;"
>
  <template v-slot:template="{ index }">
    <div class="a_d_flex a_gap_3 a_align_items_center">
      <a-skeleton-item width="25%"></a-skeleton-item>
      <a-skeleton-item :width="`${ 50 - index * 8 }%`"></a-skeleton-item>
      <a-skeleton-item width="15%"></a-skeleton-item>
      <a-skeleton-item
        class="a_ml_auto"
        variant="button"
        width="4rem"
      ></a-skeleton-item>
    </div>
  </template>
</a-skeleton>
```

## Variants of ASkeletonItem

`variant` sets the shape. `width` and `height` change the size; a number is taken as pixels.

*props: `variant`, `width`, `height`*

```html
<a-skeleton-item variant="text"></a-skeleton-item>
<a-skeleton-item variant="heading"></a-skeleton-item>
<a-skeleton-item variant="circle"></a-skeleton-item>
<a-skeleton-item variant="rect"></a-skeleton-item>
<a-skeleton-item variant="button"></a-skeleton-item>
<a-skeleton-item variant="input"></a-skeleton-item>
<a-skeleton-item
  variant="image"
  width="12rem"
></a-skeleton-item>
```

## Without flickering

With `throttle` (ms) the skeleton is shown only if the loading takes longer. A fast answer does not make the skeleton flicker.

*props: `throttle`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
  text="200 ms"
  :disabled="loading"
  @click="load({ duration: 200 })"
></a-button>
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
  text="2 s"
  :disabled="loading"
  @click="load({ duration: 2000 })"
></a-button>
<a-skeleton
  :loading="loading"
  :throttle="500"
>
  <p>Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet...</p>
</a-skeleton>
```

```js
import {
  AButton,
  ASkeleton,
} from "aloha-vue";
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

export default {
  name: "PageSkeletonThrottle",
  components: {
    AButton,
    ASkeleton,
  },
  setup() {
    const loading = ref(false);

    const load = ({ duration }) => {
      loading.value = true;
      setTimeout(() => {
        loading.value = false;
      }, duration);
    };

    return {
      load,
      loading,
    };
  },
};
```

## ASkeleton

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| animated | Boolean | true |  | Shows a moving band over the shapes. |
| avatar | Boolean | false |  | Default layout: shows a circle on the left. |
| count | Number | 1 |  | How often the skeleton is repeated. |
| extra | Object | undefined |  | Values for the placeholders of the loading text. |
| loading | Boolean | true |  | Shows the skeleton. With false the default slot is shown. |
| rows | Number | 3 |  | Default layout: the number of text rows. |
| tag | String | "div" |  | HTML tag of the skeleton. |
| text | String | "_A_SKELETON_LOADING_" |  | Loading text for screen readers. |
| throttle | Number | 0 |  | Delay in milliseconds before the skeleton is shown. |
| title | Boolean | true |  | Default layout: shows a title. |

## ASkeletonItem

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| height | String \| Number | undefined |  | Height of the shape. A number is taken as pixels. |
| tag | String | "span" |  | HTML tag of the shape. |
| variant | String | "text" |  | Shape: **text**, **heading**, **circle**, **rect**, **button**, **input** or **image**. |
| width | String \| Number | undefined |  | Width of the shape. A number is taken as pixels. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| default | The content that is shown when loading is false. |
| template | Own layout of the skeleton instead of the default one. The slot scope provides **index**. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_SKELETON_LOADING_` | Loading |

## CSS variables (`scss/components/ASkeleton.scss`)

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--a_skeleton_bg` |  | Color of the shapes. |
| `--a_skeleton_highlight` |  | Color of the moving band of the animation. |
| `--a_skeleton_duration` |  | Duration of one pass of the animation. |
| `--a_skeleton_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of the shapes. |
| `--a_skeleton_gap` |  | Space between the rows. |
| `--a_skeleton_group_gap` |  | Space between the repeated skeletons (prop count). |
| `--a_skeleton_text_height` |  | Height of a text row (variant "text"). |
| `--a_skeleton_heading_height` |  | Height of a heading (variant "heading"). |
| `--a_skeleton_title_width` |  | Width of the title of the default skeleton. |
| `--a_skeleton_last_row_width` |  | Width of the last row of the default skeleton. |
| `--a_skeleton_avatar_size` |  | Size of the avatar (variant "circle"). |
| `--a_skeleton_rect_height` |  | Height of a block (variant "rect"). |
| `--a_skeleton_control_height` |  | Height of a button and of an input (variants "button" and "input"). |
| `--a_skeleton_control_border_radius` |  | Corner radius of a button and of an input. |
| `--a_skeleton_button_width` |  | Width of a button (variant "button"). |
| `--a_skeleton_image_aspect_ratio` |  | Aspect ratio of an image (variant "image"). |

# ASpinner (Loading indicator)

The **ASpinner** component is used to display a loading indicator. It supports customizable **aria-label** attributes for improved accessibility, as well as the ability to safely display **HTML** content and customize the tag used for rendering.

## Basic usage

```html
<a-spinner></a-spinner>
```

## **Aria-label** with **extra** parameter

This example shows how to use the **aria-label** with additional parameters from **extra** in the **ASpinner** component. The example dynamically adds a number from the **extra** object to the **aria-label** text to provide a more precise description for users with special needs. In this case, the **aria-label** text will change to 'Loading 1', where **{{ number }}** is taken from the passed object.

*props: `aria-label`, `extra`*

```html
<a-spinner
  :extra="{ number: 1 }"
  aria-label="_PAGE_SPINNER_ARIA_LABEL_{{number}}_"
></a-spinner>
```

## Sizes

This example shows how to use **size** to control the size of the loading indicator. Values range from **1** (largest) to **7** (smallest).

*props: `size`*

```html
<a-spinner
  size="1"
></a-spinner>
<a-spinner
  size="2"
></a-spinner>
<a-spinner
  size="3"
></a-spinner>
```

| aria-label | String / Number / Object | _A_SPINNER_LOADING_ |  | The **aria-label** attribute for improving accessibility. It can specify separate text for mobile and desktop devices or pass a string for all devices. |
| extra | Object |  |  | An object that contains variables for substitution in the translation template. It is used for dynamically replacing values in translation strings. For example, if the translation string has placeholders like **"_WELCOME_{{foo}}_{{bar}}_"**, which is translated as **"Welcome {{ foo }}: {{ bar }}"**, you can pass an object like **{ foo: "abc", bar: "123" }**, and the result will be the translation **"Welcome abc: 123"**. |
| safe-html | String |  |  | Safe **HTML** content to be displayed inside the loading spinner. Used to customize the spinner's inner content. |
| size | String / Number |  |  | Defines the size of the loading indicator. Valid values range from **1** (largest) to **7** (smallest). |
| tag | String | span |  | The **HTML** tag used for rendering the loading spinner. By default, it is **span**, but it can be changed to any other appropriate tag. |

# APagination (Pagination)

The **APagination** component renders navigation for large data sets. It combines per-page controls, desktop and mobile layouts, and emits **update:limit** / **update:offset** events so the consuming view can stay in sync with the current page.

## Basic usage

```html
<div 
  class="page_pagination__items"
>
  <div 
    v-for="blockNumber in blockNumbers"
    :key="blockNumber"
    class="page_pagination__item"
  >
    <span class="page_pagination__item_index">{{ blockNumber }}</span>
  </div>
</div>
<a-pagination
  :limit="limit"
  :limits-per-page="limitsPerPage"
  :max-pages="maxPages"
  :offset="offset"
  :rows-length="rowsLength"
  :total-count="totalCount"
  @update:limit="updateLimit"
  @update:offset="updateOffset"
></a-pagination>
```

```js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
} from "vue";
import {
  APagination,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PagePaginationBasic",
  components: {
    APagination,
  },
  setup() {
    const totalCount = ref(87);
    const limit = ref(10);
    const maxPages = ref(5);
    const offset = ref(0);
    
    const limitsPerPage = [
      "10",
      "25",
      "50",
      "100",
    ];
    
    const rowsLength = computed(() => {
      const remaining = totalCount.value - offset.value;
    
      if (remaining <= 0) {
        return 0;
      }
    
      return Math.min(remaining, limit.value);
    });
    
    const blockNumbers = computed(() => Array.from(
      {
        length: rowsLength.value,
      },
      (_, index) => offset.value + index + 1,
    ));
    
    const updateLimit = value => {
      limit.value = value;
      offset.value = 0;
    };
    
    const updateOffset = value => {
      offset.value = value;
    };
    
    return {
      blockNumbers,
      totalCount,
      limit,
      limitsPerPage,
      maxPages,
      offset,
      rowsLength,
      updateLimit,
      updateOffset,
    };
  },
};
```

## Limits per page

Use the ordered multiselect to configure the values passed to **limits-per-page**. The selection controls which per-page limits (5, 10, 25, 50, 75, 100) are available.

*props: `limits-per-page`*

```html
<a-multiselect-ordered
  v-model="limitsPerPageModel"
  :data="limitsPerPageOptions"
  :is-data-simple-array="true"
  class="a_mb_4"
  label="_A_PAGINATION_LIMITS_PER_PAGE_LABEL_"
></a-multiselect-ordered>
<div 
  class="page_pagination__items"
>
  <div 
    v-for="blockNumber in blockNumbers"
    :key="blockNumber"
    class="page_pagination__item"
  >
    <span class="page_pagination__item_index">{{ blockNumber }}</span>
  </div>
</div>
<a-pagination
  :limit="limit"
  :limits-per-page="limitsPerPageModel"
  :max-pages="maxPages"
  :offset="offset"
  :rows-length="rowsLength"
  :total-count="totalCount"
  @update:limit="updateLimit"
  @update:offset="updateOffset"
></a-pagination>
```

```js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
} from "vue";
import {
  AMultiselectOrdered,
  APagination,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PagePaginationLimitsPerPage",
  components: {
    AMultiselectOrdered,
    APagination,
  },
  setup() {
    const totalCount = ref(143);
    const limit = ref(10);
    const maxPages = ref(5);
    const offset = ref(0);
    const limitsPerPageOptions = [
      "5",
      "10",
      "25",
      "50",
      "75",
      "100",
    ];
    const limitsPerPageModel = ref([...limitsPerPageOptions]);

    const rowsLength = computed(() => {
      const remaining = totalCount.value - offset.value;

      if (remaining <= 0) {
        return 0;
      }

      return Math.min(remaining, limit.value);
    });
    
    const blockNumbers = computed(() => Array.from(
      {
        length: rowsLength.value,
      },
      (_, index) => offset.value + index + 1,
    ));
    
    const updateLimit = value => {
      limit.value = value;
      offset.value = 0;
    };
    
    const updateOffset = value => {
      offset.value = value;
    };
    
    return {
      blockNumbers,
      totalCount,
      limit,
      limitsPerPageModel,
      limitsPerPageOptions,
      maxPages,
      offset,
      rowsLength,
      updateLimit,
      updateOffset,
    };
  },
};
```

## Disabled state

This example shows how to toggle the **disabled** prop to block all pagination controls while rows are being refreshed. Use the switch to enable or disable navigation with a single click.

```html

  class="a_mb_4"

  :disabled="isDisabled"
  :limit="limit"
  :limits-per-page="limitsPerPage"
  :max-pages="maxPages"
  :offset="offset"
  :rows-length="rowsLength"
  :total-count="totalCount"
  @update:limit="updateLimit"
  @update:offset="updateOffset"

```

```js
      "10",
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Disables all pagination controls. Useful while rows are being reloaded or when navigation must be blocked. |
| limit | Number |  | yes | Number of rows that should be returned per page. The component emits **update:limit** when the user selects a new value. |
| limits-per-page | Array | () => ["10", "25", "50", "100"] |  | List of options that appear in the per-page selector. Values can be strings or numbers and usually mirror the backend limits. |
| max-pages | Number | 5 |  | Maximum amount of numbered page buttons that may be shown at once before truncation with ellipsis. |
| offset | Number |  | yes | Index of the first row that belongs to the current page. The component emits **update:offset** every time the user navigates. |
| rows-length | Number |  | yes | How many rows are actually rendered on the current page. Needed to correctly display the 'from-to' counter when the last page is incomplete. |
| modes | Object | () => ({   perPage: {     mode: "group",     position: 0,     showTextCountFromTo: true,   },   pagination: {     mode: "normal",     position: 1,   }, }) |  | Configuration for per-page controls and the pager. Use **perPage** and **pagination** to define **mode** (inline/group/select or normal/short/loadMore), **position**, and **showTextCountFromTo**. |
| texts | Object | () => ({   pagesFirstPage: "_A_PAGINATION_FIRST_PAGE_",   pagesLastPage: "_A_PAGINATION_LAST_PAGE_",   pagesMobile: "_A_PAGINATION_MOBILE_{{currentPage}}_{{allPages}}_",   pagesNavigation: "_A_PAGINATION_NAVIGATION_",   pagesNextPage: "_A_PAGINATION_NEXT_PAGE_",   pagesPreviousPage: "_A_PAGINATION_PREVIOUS_PAGE_",   pagesToPage: "_A_PAGINATION_TO_PAGE_{{page}}_",   countFromTo: "_A_COUNT_PER_PAGE_{{start}}_{{current}}_{{count}}_",   countPerPage: "_A_COUNT_PER_PAGE_",   countPerPageItem: "_A_COUNT_PER_PAGE_ITEM_{{count}}_", }) |  | Object with translation keys or custom texts for page navigation labels and per-page counters. |
| total-count | Number |  | yes | Total number of items in the entire data set. This value drives the **from-to** counter and the number of available pages. |

# APaginationPages (Pagination pages)

The **APaginationPages** component renders page navigation only. It emits **update:offset** so the parent can load the next slice of items while keeping the current page in sync.

## Basic usage

```html
<div 
  class="page_pagination__items"
>
  <div 
    v-for="blockNumber in blockNumbers"
    :key="blockNumber"
    class="page_pagination__item"
  >
    <span class="page_pagination__item_index">{{ blockNumber }}</span>
  </div>
</div>
<a-pagination-pages
  :limit="limit"
  :max-pages="maxPages"
  :offset="offset"
  :total-count="totalCount"
  @update:offset="updateOffset"
></a-pagination-pages>
```

```js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
} from "vue";
import {
  APaginationPages,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PagePaginationPagesBasic",
  components: {
    APaginationPages,
  },
  setup() {
    const totalCount = ref(87);
    const limit = ref(10);
    const maxPages = ref(5);
    const offset = ref(0);

    const rowsLength = computed(() => {
      const remaining = totalCount.value - offset.value;

      if (remaining <= 0) {
        return 0;
      }

      return Math.min(remaining, limit.value);
    });

    const blockNumbers = computed(() => Array.from(
      {
        length: rowsLength.value,
      },
      (_, index) => offset.value + index + 1,
    ));

    const updateOffset = value => {
      offset.value = value;
    };

    return {
      blockNumbers,
      limit,
      maxPages,
      offset,
      rowsLength,
      totalCount,
      updateOffset,
    };
  },
};
```

## Navigation mode

Choose between the **short** and **normal** layouts.

*props: `mode`*

```html
<div class="a_columns a_columns_count_12 a_mb_3">
  <div class="a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch">
  <a-select
    v-model="mode"
    :data="modeOptions"
    :deselectable="false"
    :translate-data="true"
    key-id="id"
    key-label="label"
    label="_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_MODE_LABEL_"
    type="select"
  ></a-select>
</div>
</div>

<div 
  class="page_pagination__items"
>
  <div 
    v-for="blockNumber in blockNumbers"
    :key="blockNumber"
    class="page_pagination__item"
  >
    <span class="page_pagination__item_index">{{ blockNumber }}</span>
  </div>
</div>
<a-pagination-pages
  :mode="mode"
  :limit="limit"
  :offset="offset"
  :total-count="totalCount"
  @update:offset="updateOffset"
></a-pagination-pages>
```

```js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
} from "vue";
import {
  APaginationPages,
  ASelect,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PagePaginationPagesMode",
  components: {
    APaginationPages,
    ASelect,
  },
  setup() {
    const totalCount = ref(87);
    const limit = ref(10);
    const offset = ref(0);
    const mode = ref("short");
    const modeOptions = [
      {
        id: "short",
        label: "_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_MODE_SHORT_",
      },
      {
        id: "normal",
        label: "_A_PAGINATION_PAGES_MODE_NORMAL_",
      },
    ];

    const rowsLength = computed(() => {
      const remaining = totalCount.value - offset.value;

      if (remaining <= 0) {
        return 0;
      }

      return Math.min(remaining, limit.value);
    });

    const blockNumbers = computed(() => Array.from(
      {
        length: rowsLength.value,
      },
      (_, index) => offset.value + index + 1,
    ));

    const updateOffset = value => {
      offset.value = value;
    };

    return {
      blockNumbers,
      limit,
      mode,
      modeOptions,
      offset,
      rowsLength,
      totalCount,
      updateOffset,
    };
  },
};
```

## Disabled state

Toggle **disabled** to block all page navigation.

*props: `disabled`*

```html
<a-switch
  v-model="isDisabled"
  class="a_mb_4"
  label="_LBL_DISABLED_"
></a-switch>
<div 
  class="page_pagination__items"
>
  <div 
    v-for="blockNumber in blockNumbers"
    :key="blockNumber"
    class="page_pagination__item"
  >
    <span class="page_pagination__item_index">{{ blockNumber }}</span>
  </div>
</div>
<a-pagination-pages
  :disabled="isDisabled"
  :limit="limit"
  :max-pages="maxPages"
  :offset="offset"
  :total-count="totalCount"
  @update:offset="updateOffset"
></a-pagination-pages>
```

```js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
} from "vue";
import {
  APaginationPages,
  ASwitch,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PagePaginationPagesDisabled",
  components: {
    APaginationPages,
    ASwitch,
  },
  setup() {
    const totalCount = ref(87);
    const limit = ref(10);
    const maxPages = ref(5);
    const offset = ref(0);
    const isDisabled = ref(true);

    const rowsLength = computed(() => {
      const remaining = totalCount.value - offset.value;

      if (remaining <= 0) {
        return 0;
      }

      return Math.min(remaining, limit.value);
    });

    const blockNumbers = computed(() => Array.from(
      {
        length: rowsLength.value,
      },
      (_, index) => offset.value + index + 1,
    ));

    const updateOffset = value => {
      offset.value = value;
    };

    return {
      blockNumbers,
      isDisabled,
      limit,
      maxPages,
      offset,
      rowsLength,
      totalCount,
      updateOffset,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Disables page buttons and navigation controls. |
| limit | Number |  | yes | Number of items per page. Together with **offset** it defines the current page. |
| max-pages | Number | 5 |  | Maximum amount of page buttons that may be shown at once. |
| mode | String | normal |  | Navigation layout mode: **normal**, **short**, or **loadMore**. |
| offset | Number |  | yes | Index of the first item on the current page. The component emits **update:offset** when navigation changes. |
| texts | Object | () => ({   pagesFirstPage: "_A_PAGINATION_FIRST_PAGE_",   pagesLastPage: "_A_PAGINATION_LAST_PAGE_",   pagesMobile: "_A_PAGINATION_MOBILE_{{currentPage}}_{{allPages}}_",   pagesNavigation: "_A_PAGINATION_NAVIGATION_",   pagesNextPage: "_A_PAGINATION_NEXT_PAGE_",   pagesPreviousPage: "_A_PAGINATION_PREVIOUS_PAGE_",   pagesToPage: "_A_PAGINATION_TO_PAGE_{{page}}_", }) |  | Object with translation keys or text labels used by the pager. |
| total-count | Number |  | yes | Total number of items in the data set. Used to calculate the number of pages and the button range. |

## Translations

| key | en |
| --- | --- |
| `_A_PAGINATION_FIRST_PAGE_` | To first page |
| `_A_PAGINATION_LAST_PAGE_` | To last page |
| `_A_PAGINATION_MOBILE_{{currentPage}}_{{allPages}}_` | {{ currentPage }} of {{ allPages }} |
| `_A_PAGINATION_NAVIGATION_` | Pagination navigation |
| `_A_PAGINATION_NEXT_PAGE_` | To next page |
| `_A_PAGINATION_PREVIOUS_PAGE_` | To previous page |
| `_A_PAGINATION_TO_PAGE_{{page}}_` | To page {{ page }} |

# ATable (Table)

The **ATable** component shows data in a table with sorting, pagination, filters, quick search, row and table actions, selection of rows, a preview, hiding and moving of columns, saved views and a mobile view.

## Table with all features

Row, table and multiple actions, quick search, moving of columns, pagination, footer rows, sorting by several columns and saved views in one table.

```html
<a-table
  ref="aloha"
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"
  :is-loading-options="isLoadingOptions"
  label="Example table"
  :row-actions="rowActions"
  :table-actions="tableActions"
  :multiple-actions="multipleActions"
  preview="right"
  :is-quick-search="true"
  :is-action-column-visible="true"
  :is-columns-dnd="true"
  :pagination="{ use: true, limitsPerPage: ['10', '25', '50', '100', '500'] }"
  :is-pagination="true"
  :filter="{ filters }"
  :rows-footer="rowsFooter"
  :is-loading-table="false"
  :is-loading-multiple-actions="false"
  :views="views"
  :model-view="modelView"
  v-model:modelQuickSearch="modelQuickSearch"
  :modelFilters="modelFilters"
  :model-columns-ordering="modelColumnsOrdering"
  :model-columns-visible="modelColumnsVisible"
  @change-columns-ordering="changeColumnsOrdering"
  :update-model-filters-local="updateModelFiltersLocal"
  @toggle-preview="togglePreview"
  @update-model-filters="updateModelFilters"
  @update-view="updateView"
  @update:model-columns-visible="changeModelColumnsVisible"
  @init-table="initTable"
>
</a-table>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import AButton from "aloha-vue/src/AButton/AButton";
    
export default {
  name: "PageButtonComplex",
  components: {
    AButton,
  },
  setup() {
    const loading = ref(true);

    const toggleLoading = () => {
      loading.value = !loading.value;
    };
    
    return {
      loading,
      toggleLoading,
    };
  },
};
```

# ATable (Table with pagination)

## Simple pagination

The pagination can be configured with **:pagination="{ use: true }"**.

*props: `pagination.use`*

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"
  label="_A_TABLE_GROUP_PAGINATION_LABEL_"
  key-id="id"
  :pagination="{ use: true }"
>
</a-table>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { ATable } from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTablePaginationExample",
  components: {
    ATable,
  },
  setup() {
     const columns = [
      {
        id: "column1",
        keyLabel: "id",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_1_",
      },
      {
        id: "column2",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_2_",
      },
      {
        id: "column3",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_3_",
      },
      {
        id: "column4",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_4_",
      },
      {
        id: "column5",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_5_",
      },
    ];

    const data = ref([]);

    const setData = () => {
      const DATA = [];
      times(1001, item => {
        DATA.push({
          id: item,
          aloha: `aloha ${ item }`,
        });
      });
      data.value = DATA;
    };

    setData();
    
    return {
      columns,
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Pagination outside of the component (server-side pagination)

The server-side pagination can be specified by using **:pagination="{ use: true, isOutside: true }"**. The parameter **:count-all-rows="999"** specifies the total number of items in a table. Emit **change-limit** is called when changing the number of items per page. Emit **change-offset** is called when changing the pagination.

*props: `pagination.isOutside`, `count-all-rows`; emits: `change-limit`, `change-offset`*

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"

  key-id="id"
```

# ATable Table

## Simple Table

A component used for straightforward data presentation in a tabular format, without the inclusion of advanced features like sorting, filtering, or additional actions.

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"
  label="_A_TABLE_GROUP_SIMPLE_LABEL_"
  key-id="id"
>
</a-table>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { ATable } from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTableSimpleExample",
  components: {
    ATable,
  },
  setup() {
     const columns = [
      {
        id: "column1",
        keyLabel: "id",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_1_",
      },
      {
        id: "column2",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_2_",
      },
      {
        id: "column3",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
```

## Striped rows

With `is-striped` every second row gets the background `--a_table_row_striped_bg`. Hover, selected rows and the open preview still have their own colors. The default for all tables can be set with `AComponentsPlugin` (`ATable: { props: { isStriped: true } }`).

*props: `is-striped`*

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"
  :is-striped="true"
  label="_A_TABLE_GROUP_SIMPLE_IS_STRIPED_LABEL_"
  key-id="id"
```

# ATable Sortable Table

## Sortable Table

A table that allows users to reorganize its rows based on the values in one or more columns, typically by interacting with column headers.

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"
  label="_A_TABLE_GROUP_SORT_LABEL_"
  key-id="id"
>
</a-table>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { ATable } from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTableSortExample",
  components: {
    ATable,
  },
  setup() {
     const columns = [
      {
        id: "column1",
        keyLabel: "id",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_1_",
        sortId: "id",
      },
      {
        id: "column2",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_2_",
        sortId: "aloha",
      },
      {
        id: "column3",
        keyLabel: "number",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_3_",
        sortId: "number",
      },
      {
        id: "column4",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_4_",
      },
      {
        id: "column5",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_5_",
      },
    ];

    const data = ref([]);

    const setData = () => {
      const COUNT = 10;
      const DATA = [];
      times(COUNT, item => {
        DATA.push({
          id: item + 1,
          aloha: `aloha ${ item }`,
        });
      });
      data.value = DATA;
    };

    setData();
    
    return {
      columns,
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Starting Order

Starting order refers to the predefined arrangement of rows when the table is initially displayed. SortId is to be passed to **model-sort**. Sorting is done by default in an ascending order, to sort the column in descending order, prefix the sortId with a minus sign.

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"
  label="_A_TABLE_GROUP_SORT_START_ASC_LABEL_"
  key-id="id"
  model-sort="number"
>
</a-table>
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"
  label="_A_TABLE_GROUP_SORT_START_DESC_LABEL_"
  key-id="id"
  model-sort="-number"
>
</a-table>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { ATable } from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTableSortStart",
  components: {
    ATable,
  },
  setup() {
     const columns = [
      {
        id: "column1",
        keyLabel: "id",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_1_",
        sortId: "id",
      },
      {
        id: "column2",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_2_",
        sortId: "aloha",
      },
      {
        id: "column3",
        keyLabel: "number",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_3_",
        sortId: "number",
      },
      {
        id: "column4",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_4_",
      },
      {
        id: "column5",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_5_",
      },
    ];

    const data = ref([]);

    const setData = () => {
      const COUNT = 10;
      const DATA = [];
      times(COUNT, item => {
        DATA.push({
          id: item + 1,
          aloha: `aloha ${ item }`,
        });
      });
      data.value = DATA;
    };

    setData();
    
    return {
      columns,
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Disabling Sorting

The parameter **:disabled-sort="true"** can be used to disable sorting functionality across all columns.

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"

  key-id="id"

>
</a-table>
```

```js
import {

        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_1_",
        sortId: "id",
      },
      {
        id: "column2",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_2_",
        sortId: "aloha",
      },
      {
        id: "column3",
        keyLabel: "number",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_3_",
        sortId: "number",
      },
      {
        id: "column4",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_4_",
      },
      {
        id: "column5",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_5_",
      },
    ];

    const data = ref([]);

    const setData = () => {
      const COUNT = 5;
      const DATA = [];
      times(COUNT, item => {
        DATA.push({
          id: item + 1,
          aloha: `aloha ${ item }`,
        });
      });
      data.value = DATA;
    };

      columns,

  },

```

## Multi-Column Ordering

Initial ordering can be based on more then a single column. The list of sortIds can be passed in the desired order to parameter **model-sort**. The numbering is then used to indicate sorting priority.

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"
  label="_A_TABLE_GROUP_SORT_MULTI_COLUMN_LABEL_"
  key-id="id"
  :is-sorting-multi-column="true"
  :model-sort="['-alohaPlus', 'aloha']"
>
</a-table>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { ATable } from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTableSortMultiColumn",
  components: {
    ATable,
  },
  setup() {
     const columns = [
      {
        id: "column1",
        keyLabel: "id",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_1_",
        sortId: "id",
      },
      {
        id: "column2",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_2_",
        sortId: "aloha",
      },
      {
        id: "column3",
        keyLabel: "number",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_3_",
        sortId: "number",
      },
      {
        id: "column4",
        keyLabel: "alohaPlus",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_4_",
        sortId: "alohaPlus",
      },
      {
        id: "column5",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_5_",
      },
    ];

    const data = ref([]);

    const setData = () => {
      const COUNT = 5;
      const DATA = [];
      times(COUNT, item => {
        DATA.push({
          id: item + 1,
          aloha: `aloha ${ item }`,
          alohaPlus: `aloha ${ item % 2 }${ item % 2 }`,
        });
      });
      data.value = DATA;
    };

    setData();
    
    return {
      columns,
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Primary Sorting Column Enumeration

The prop **:show-first-sorting-sequence-number="true"** can be used to display the number next to the primary sorting column, which signifies that the data in the table is currently sorted primarily based on the values in that column.

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"
  label="_A_TABLE_GROUP_SORT_MULTI_COLUMN_FIRST_NUMBER_LABEL_"
  key-id="id"
  :is-sorting-multi-column="true"
  model-sort="alohaPlus"
  :show-first-sorting-sequence-number="true"
>
</a-table>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { ATable } from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTableSortMultiColumnFirstNumber",
  components: {
    ATable,
  },
  setup() {
     const columns = [
      {
        id: "column1",
        keyLabel: "id",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_1_",
        sortId: "id",
      },
      {
        id: "column2",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_2_",
        sortId: "aloha",
      },
      {
        id: "column3",
        keyLabel: "number",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_3_",
        sortId: "number",
      },
      {
        id: "column4",
        keyLabel: "alohaPlus",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_4_",
        sortId: "alohaPlus",
      },
      {
        id: "column5",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_5_",
      },
    ];

    const data = ref([]);

    const setData = () => {
      const COUNT = 5;
      const DATA = [];
      times(COUNT, item => {
        DATA.push({
          id: item + 1,
          aloha: `aloha ${ item }`,
          alohaPlus: `aloha ${ item % 2 }${ item % 2 }`,
        });
      });
      data.value = DATA;
    };

    setData();
    
    return {
      columns,
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Sorting outside of the component (server-side sorting)

Sorting outside of the component is supported, typically on the serverside,  with sorting parameters sent to the server and the sorted data received as a response, allowing for efficient handling of large datasets.

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="dataSorted"
  label="_A_TABLE_GROUP_SORT_OUTSIDE_LABEL_"
  key-id="id"
  :is-sorting-outside="true"
  :model-sort="modelSort"
  @change-sorting="changeSorting"
>
</a-table>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { ATable } from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTableSortOutside",
  components: {
    ATable,
  },
  setup() {
     const columns = [
      {
        id: "column1",
        keyLabel: "id",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_1_",
        sortId: "id",
      },
      {
        id: "column2",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_2_",
        sortId: "aloha",
      },
      {
        id: "column3",
        keyLabel: "number",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_3_",
        sortId: "number",
      },
      {
        id: "column4",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_4_",
      },
      {
        id: "column5",
        keyLabel: "aloha",
        label: "_A_TABLE_COLUMN_5_",
      },
    ];

    const data = ref([]);
    const modelSort = ref(["id"]);

    const sortOptions = computed(() => {
      const OPTIONS = {
        models: [],
        directions: [],
      };
      if (modelSort.value.length) {
        forEach(modelSort.value, model => {
          let directionSort = "asc";
          let modelSortLocal = model;
          if (startsWith(model, "-")) {
            directionSort = "desc";
            modelSortLocal = model.slice(1);
          }
          OPTIONS.models.push(modelSortLocal);
          OPTIONS.directions.push(directionSort);
        });
      }
      return OPTIONS;
    });

    const dataSorted = computed(() => {
      if (modelSort.value.length) {
        return orderBy(data.value, sortOptions.value.models, sortOptions.value.directions);
      }
      return data.value;
    });

    const changeSorting = ({ modelSort: modelSortLocal }) => {
      modelSort.value = modelSortLocal;
    };

    const setData = () => {
      const COUNT = 10;
      const DATA = [];
      times(COUNT, item => {
        DATA.push({
          id: item + 1,
          aloha: `aloha ${ item }`,
        });
      });
      data.value = DATA;
    };

    setData();
    
    return {
      changeSorting,
      columns,
      data,
      dataSorted,
      modelSort,
    };
  },
};
```

# ATable (Tree Table)

## Simple example

This example showcases an interactive tree table designed to visually represent hierarchical data structures. The component allows users to view structured information in a convenient format and dynamically control the display of sub-levels by expanding or collapsing child elements as needed. Ideal for displaying complex data structures like organizational charts, product categories, or hierarchical lists, it provides end-users with flexible exploration and data analysis capabilities.

*props: `is-tree`*

```html
<a-table
  :columns="columns"
  :data="data"
  :is-tree="true"
  key-id="id"
  label="_A_TABLE_GROUP_TREE_LABEL_"
></a-table>
```

## Row editing

The example shows row editing, adding a new row, and deleting rows with confirmation.

*props: `is-addable`, `is-deletable`, `is-deletable-confirm`, `is-editable`, `save-row`, `texts`*

```html
<a-checkbox
  v-model="modelCheckbox"
  :data="dataCheckbox"
  :translate-data="true"
  class="a_mb_4"
  key-id="value"
  key-label="label"
></a-checkbox>
<a-simple-table
  :add-row="addRow"
  :columns="columns"
  :is-addable="modelCheckbox.includes('is-addable')"
  :is-deletable-confirm="modelCheckbox.includes('is-deletable-confirm')"
  :is-deletable="modelCheckbox.includes('is-deletable')"
  :is-edit-on-row-click="modelCheckbox.includes('is-edit-on-row-click')"
  :is-editable="modelCheckbox.includes('is-editable')"
  :rows-footer="rowsFooter"
  :rows="rows"
  :save-row="saveRow"
  :texts="texts"
  key-id="id"
  label="_A_TABLE_FORM_EXAMPLE_LABEL_"
  @delete-row="deleteRow"
/>
```

```js
            },
            {
              label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_TEAM_WEST_",
              value: "west",
            },
            {
              label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_TEAM_SOUTH_",
              value: "south",
            },
            {
              label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_TEAM_EAST_",
              value: "east",
            },
          ],
          keyId: "value",
          keyLabel: "label",
          translateData: true,
          type: "select",
        },
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_COLUMN_TEAM_",
        minWidth: "12rem",
      },
      {
        id: "score",
        footerDefaultValue: "68",
        footerKeyLabel: "score",
        formElement: {
          controlsType: "none",
          min: 0,
          type: "integer",
        },
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_COLUMN_SCORE_",
        maxWidth: 120,
        minWidth: 120,
        width: 120,
      },
    ];

    const rows = ref([
      {
        id: 1,
        name: "Marta Ivanova",
        position: 1,
        score: 18,
        team: "north",
      },
      {
        id: 2,
        name: "Oleg Sidorov",
        position: 2,
        score: 17,
        team: "west",
      },
      {
        id: 3,
        name: "Anna Petrova",
        position: 3,
        score: 16,
        team: "south",
      },
      {
        id: 4,
        name: "Igor Kovalev",
        position: 4,
        score: 17,
        team: "east",
      },
    ]);

    const rowsFooter = [
      {
        name: "_A_TABLE_FORM_FOOTER_TOTAL_",
        score: 68,
      },
    ];

    const saveRow = async({ model, rowIndex }) => {
      await new Promise(resolve => {
        setTimeout(resolve, 300);
      });

      const errors = {};

      if (!model.name?.trim()) {
        errors.name = ["Name ist erforderlich."];
      }

      if (!model.team) {
        errors.team = ["Team ist erforderlich."];
      }

      if (model.score < 18) {
        errors.score = ["Score must be at least 18."];
      }

      if (Object.keys(errors).length) {
        return {
          errors,
        };
      }

      rows.value.splice(rowIndex, 1, model);
    };

    const deleteRow = ({ row, rowIndex }) => {
      rows.value.splice(rowIndex, 1);
      console.log("row", row);
      console.log("rowIndex", rowIndex);
    };

    const addRow = ({ model }) => {
      console.log("model ", model);
      const errors = {};

      if (!model.name?.trim()) {
        errors.name = ["Name ist erforderlich."];
      }

      if (!model.team) {
        errors.team = ["Team ist erforderlich."];
      }

      if (model.score < 18) {
        errors.score = ["Score must be at least 18."];
      }

      if (Object.keys(errors).length) {
        return {
          errors,
        };
      }
      rows.value.push({
        id: rows.value.length + 1,
        ...model,
      });
    };

    return {
      addRow,
      columns,
      dataCheckbox,
      deleteRow,
      modelCheckbox,
      rows,
      rowsFooter,
      saveRow,
      texts,
    };
  },
};
```

## Row-specific form element properties

The example uses formElementEditPropsCallback to disable the score field for a specific row when its current editing status is Locked.

*props: `is-editable`, `save-row`*

```html
<a-table-form
  :columns="columns"
  :is-editable="true"
  :rows="rows"
  :save-row="saveRow"
  key-id="id"
  label="_A_TABLE_FORM_EXAMPLE_LABEL_"
/>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ATableForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ATableForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const columns = [
      {
        id: "name",
        formElement: {
          type: "text",
        },
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_COLUMN_NAME_",
      },
      {
        id: "status",
        formElement: {
          data: [
            { label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_EDIT_PROPS_STATUS_EDITABLE_", value: "editable" },
            { label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_EDIT_PROPS_STATUS_LOCKED_", value: "locked" },
          ],
          keyId: "value",
          keyLabel: "label",
          translateData: true,
          type: "select",
        },
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_EDIT_PROPS_COLUMN_STATUS_",
      },
      {
        id: "score",
        formElement: {
          min: 0,
          type: "integer",
        },
        formElementEditPropsCallback: ({ rowData }) => ({
          disabled: rowData.status === "locked",
        }),
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_COLUMN_SCORE_",
      },
    ];
    const rows = ref([
      { id: 1, name: "Marta Ivanova", score: 18, status: "editable" },
      { id: 2, name: "Oleg Sidorov", score: 17, status: "locked" },
    ]);
    const saveRow = ({ model, rowIndex }) => {
      rows.value.splice(rowIndex, 1, model);
    };

    return {
      columns,
      rows,
      saveRow,
    };
  },
};
```

## List view with nested fieldsets

The example shows the list view, where all column configurations are rendered by AForm inside one wide cell. Nested fieldsets, validation, adding, editing, deleting, and row reordering remain available.

*props: `row-view`*

```html
<a-table-form
  :add-row="addRow"
  :columns="columns"
  :is-addable="true"
  :is-deletable-confirm="true"
  :is-drag-and-drop="true"
  :is-editable="true"
  :rows="rows"
  :save-row="saveRow"
  key-id="id"
  label="_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_LABEL_"
  row-view="list"
  @delete-row="deleteRow"
  @update-rows="updateRows"
/>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ATableForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  components: {
    ATableForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const columns = [
      {
        id: "fundingTypes",
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_FUNDING_TYPES_",
        formElement: {
          classColumn: "a_column a_column_12",
          data: [
            { label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_FUNDING_TYPE_FEES_", value: "fees" },
            { label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_FUNDING_TYPE_TRAVEL_", value: "travel" },
            { label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_FUNDING_TYPE_INVESTMENT_", value: "investment" },
          ],
          keyId: "value",
          keyLabel: "label",
          required: true,
          translateData: true,
          type: "multiselect",
        },
      },
      {
        id: "percentDeviation",
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_PERCENT_DEVIATION_",
        formElement: {
          classColumn: "a_column a_column_4",
          classColumns: "a_columns a_columns_count_12 a_columns_gap_2",
          type: "fieldset",
          children: [
            {
              classColumn: "a_column a_column_6",
              controlsType: "none",
              id: "percentNegative",
              label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_NEGATIVE_",
              type: "integer",
            },
            {
              classColumn: "a_column a_column_6",
              controlsType: "none",
              id: "percentPositive",
              label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_POSITIVE_",
              type: "integer",
            },
          ],
        },
      },
      {
        id: "validationMessage",
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_VALIDATION_MESSAGE_",
        formElement: {
          classColumn: "a_column a_column_12",
          required: true,
          type: "textarea",
        },
      },
    ];

    const rows = ref([
      {
        fundingTypes: ["fees", "travel"],
        id: 1,
        percentNegative: 20,
        percentPositive: 20,
        validationMessage: "The configured deviation threshold was exceeded.",
      },
    ]);

    const validate = model => {
      const errors = {};
      if (!model.fundingTypes?.length) {
        errors.fundingTypes = ["_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_ERROR_REQUIRED_"];
      }
      if (!model.validationMessage?.trim()) {
        errors.validationMessage = ["_A_TABLE_FORM_LIST_ERROR_REQUIRED_"];
      }
      return errors;
    };

    const saveRow = ({ model, rowIndex }) => {
      const errors = validate(model);
      if (Object.keys(errors).length) {
        return { errors };
      }
      rows.value.splice(rowIndex, 1, model);
    };

    const addRow = ({ model }) => {
      const errors = validate(model);
      if (Object.keys(errors).length) {
        return { errors };
      }
      rows.value.push({
        ...model,
        id: Math.max(0, ...rows.value.map(row => row.id)) + 1,
      });
    };

    const deleteRow = ({ rowIndex }) => {
      rows.value.splice(rowIndex, 1);
    };

    const updateRows = ({ rows: rowsUpdated }) => {
      rows.value = rowsUpdated;
    };

    return {
      addRow,
      columns,
      deleteRow,
      rows,
      saveRow,
      updateRows,
    };
  },
};
```

## Sticky actions

The example shows a wide table with a sticky actions column on the right.

*props: `is-actions-sticky`, `is-deletable-confirm`, `is-editable`*

```html
<a-one-checkbox
  v-model="isActionsSticky"
  label="isActionsSticky"
/>
<a-simple-table
  :columns="columns"
  :is-actions-sticky="isActionsSticky"
  :is-deletable-confirm="true"
  :is-editable="true"
  :rows="rows"
  key-id="id"
  label="20 columns"
/>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AOneCheckbox,
  ATableForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageTableFormSticky",
  components: {
    AOneCheckbox,
    ATableForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const isActionsSticky = ref(true);

    const columns = Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, index) => ({
      id: `c${index + 1}`,
      label: `${index + 1}`,
      width: 120,
      formElement: {
        controlsType: "none",
        type: "integer",
      },
    }));

    const rows = ref(Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, rowIndex) => {
      const row = {
        id: rowIndex + 1,
      };

      columns.forEach((column, columnIndex) => {
        row[column.id] = (rowIndex + 1) * 100 + columnIndex + 1;
      });

      return row;
    }));

    return {
      columns,
      isActionsSticky,
      rows,
    };
  },
};
```

## Column grow

The example shows how columns with width and grow share extra table space, including scenarios with actions and drag-and-drop columns.

*props: `is-columns-grow`, `is-deletable`, `is-drag-and-drop`, `is-editable`*

```html
<a-checkbox
  v-model="modelCheckbox"
  :data="dataCheckbox"
  key-id="value"
  key-label="label"
/>

<div style="max-width: 40rem;">
  <a-table-form
    :columns="columns"
    :is-columns-grow="true"
    :is-deletable="modelCheckbox.includes('is-deletable')"
    :is-drag-and-drop="modelCheckbox.includes('is-drag-and-drop')"
    :is-editable="modelCheckbox.includes('is-editable')"
    :rows-footer="rowsFooter"
    :rows="rows"
    :save-row="saveRow"
    key-id="id"
    @delete-row="deleteRow"
  />
</div>

<a-table-form
  :columns="columns"
  :is-columns-grow="true"
  :is-deletable="modelCheckbox.includes('is-deletable')"
  :is-drag-and-drop="modelCheckbox.includes('is-drag-and-drop')"
  :is-editable="modelCheckbox.includes('is-editable')"
  :rows-footer="rowsFooter"
  :rows="rows"
  :save-row="saveRow"
  key-id="id"
  @delete-row="deleteRow"
/>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ATableForm,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {

    ATableForm,
  },
  setup() {
    const columns = [
      {
        id: "position",
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_COLUMN_POSITION_",
        width: 96,
        grow: 1,
      },
      {
        id: "name",
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_COLUMN_NAME_",
        width: "16rem",
        grow: 2,
      },
      {
        id: "team",
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_COLUMN_TEAM_",
        width: "12rem",
        grow: 1,
      },
      {
        id: "score",
        label: "_A_TABLE_FORM_COLUMN_SCORE_",
        width: 120,
        grow: 1,
      },
    ];

    const dataCheckbox = [
      { label: "is-deletable", value: "is-deletable" },
      { label: "is-editable", value: "is-editable" },
      { label: "is-drag-and-drop", value: "is-drag-and-drop" },
    ];
    const modelCheckbox = ref(["is-deletable", "is-editable"]);

      {
        id: 1,
        name: "Marta Ivanova",
        position: 1,
        score: 18,
        team: "north",
      },

    return {
      columns,
      dataCheckbox,
      modelCheckbox,

    };
  },
```

## CSS variables (`scss/components/ATableForm.scss`)

| name | value | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--a_table_form_bg` |  | Background of the table and of the sticky actions column. |
| `--a_table_form_border_color` |  | Color of the cell and table borders. |
| `--a_table_form_drop_indicator_color` |  | Color of the line that shows where a dragged row will be dropped. |
| `--a_table_form_drop_indicator_width` |  | Thickness of the drop indicator line. |
| `--a_table_form_head_bg` |  | Background of the header row. |
| `--a_table_form_head_color` |  | Text color of the header row. |
| `--a_table_form_head_font_weight` |  | Font weight of the header and footer rows. |
| `--a_table_form_row_dragging_bg` |  | Background of the row that is being dragged. |
| `--a_table_form_row_dragging_opacity` |  | Opacity of the row that is being dragged and of the drag preview. |
| `--a_table_form_row_dragging_outline` |  | Outline of the row that is being dragged (shorthand). |
| `--a_table_form_focus_color` |  | Color of the focus frame of a focused row. |
| `--a_table_form_focus_width` |  | Thickness of the focus frame of a focused row. |
| `--a_table_form_focus_box_shadow` |  | Focus ring around the table when the table itself has focus. |
| `--a_table_form_row_hover_bg` |  | Background of a hovered row. |
| `--a_table_form_row_drag_bg` |  | Background of the row under the dragged row and of the dragged row while dragging. |
| `--a_table_form_footer_bg` |  | Background of the footer row. |
| `--a_table_form_cell_padding_y` |  | Vertical padding of a cell. |
| `--a_table_form_cell_padding_x` |  | Horizontal padding of a cell. |
| `--a_table_form_cell_actions_edge_box_shadow` |  | Line on the right edge of the sticky actions column. |
| `--a_table_form_cell_actions_sticky_shadow` |  | Shadow on the left of the sticky actions column that separates it from the scrolled cells. |

# ATabs (Tabs)

The **ATabs** component is used for organizing content through tabs. Each tab contains a title and corresponding content, which is displayed when the tab is activated. Various settings are supported, such as vertical or horizontal layout, disabling tabs, allowing **HTML** in titles, and controlling the behavior of the active tab.

## Basic usage

*props: `data`*

```html
<a-tabs
  :data="data"
></a-tabs>
```

```js
import { 
  ATabs,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTabsBasic",
  components: {
    ATabs,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_1_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_1_",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_2_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_2_",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_3_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_3_",
      },
    ];
    
    return {
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Disabling tabs

This example shows how to use **disabled** to disable all tabs. When set to **true**, users cannot interact with the tabs.

*props: `disabled`*

```html
<a-tabs
  :data="data"
  :disabled="true"
></a-tabs>
```

```js
import { 
  ATabs,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTabsDisabled",
  components: {
    ATabs,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_1_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_1_",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_2_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_2_",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_3_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_3_",
      },
    ];
    
    return {
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Disabling specific tabs

This example shows how to use **key-disabled** to disable specific tabs. Tabs with **disabled** set to **true** will not be interactive.

*props: `key-disabled`*

```html
  :data="data"
  key-disabled="disabled"
></a-tabs>
```

```js
  ATabs,

        disabled: true,

        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_2_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_2_",
      },

        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_3_",

        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_4_",
```

## Key for displaying content

This example shows how to use **key-content** to define which field in the data will be used as the content associated with each tab. Instead of the default **content** key, **aloha** is used to display the content associated with each tab.

## Vertical tabs

This example shows how to use **is-vertical** to arrange the tabs vertically or horizontally. The first two examples demonstrate vertical tabs, while the third shows horizontal tabs.

*props: `is-vertical`*

```html
<a-tabs
  :data="data"
  :is-vertical="true"
></a-tabs>
<a-tabs
  :data="data"
  :is-boxed="true"
  :is-vertical="true"
  class="a_mt_3"
></a-tabs>
<a-tabs
  :data="data"
  :is-vertical="false"
  class="a_mt_3"
></a-tabs>
```

```js
import { 
  ATabs,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTabsIsVertical",
  components: {
    ATabs,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_1_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_1_",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_2_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_2_",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_3_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_3_",
      },
    ];
    
    return {
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Unique identifier for tabs

This example shows how to use **key-id** to improve performance during tab rendering. Using a unique identifier for each tab allows faster determination of the active tab. If **key-id** is not specified, the tab index is used.

*props: `key-id`*

```html
<a-tabs
  :data="data"
  key-id="id"
></a-tabs>
```

```js
import { 
  ATabs,
} from "aloha-vue";

  components: {
    ATabs,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_1_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_1_",
        id: "1",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_2_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_2_",
        id: "2",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_3_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_3_",
        id: "3",
      },
    ];
    
    return {
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Active tab on initialization

## Tab changes only through event

This example shows how to use **is-change-outside**. When set to **true**, clicking on an inactive tab will not automatically activate it. Instead, the **change** event and the **active-tab-id** property must be used to change the active tab.

*props: `is-change-outside`, `active-tab-id`; emits: `change`*

```html
<a-tabs
  :data="data"
  :active-tab-id="activeTabId"
  :is-change-outside="true"
  key-id="id"
  @change="changeTab"
></a-tabs>
```

```js
import { 
  ATabs,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTabsIsChangeOutside",
  components: {
    ATabs,
  },
  setup() {
    const activeTabId = ref("1");
    const data = [
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_1_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_1_",
        id: "1",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_2_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_2_",
        id: "2",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_3_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_3_",
        id: "3",
      },
      {
        label: "_A_TABS_TAB_4_",
        content: "_A_TABS_CONTENT_4_",
        id: "4",
      },
    ];

    const changeTab = ({ $event, tab, tabId, index }) => {
      console.log("$event, tab, tabId, index", $event, tab, tabId, index);
      activeTabId.value = tabId;
    };
    
    return {
      activeTabId,
      changeTab,
      data,
    };
  },
};
```
