## Dynamic slots for tabs and content

This example demonstrates how to use dynamic slots **slotTab** and **slotContent**, where the names are specified in the **data** array. If a name and the corresponding slot are provided, they will replace the default tab and content. Slot arguments provide access to **activeTabId**, **contentId**, **index**, **isActive**, **parentId**, **tab**, **tabId**.

*props: `data`; slots: `slotTab`, `slotContent`*

```html
<a-tabs
  :data="data"
  key-id="slotTab"
>
  <template
    v-slot:tab1="{ activeTabId, contentId, index, isActive, parentId, tab, tabId }"
  >
    <a-translation
      class="a_mr_2"
      tag="span"
      text="_A_TABS_TAB_"
    ></a-translation>
    <span>{{ index + 1 }}</span>
  </template>
  
  <template
    v-slot:tab2="{ activeTabId, contentId, index, isActive, parentId, tab, tabId }"
  >
    <a-translation
      class="a_mr_2"
      tag="span"
      text="_A_TABS_TAB_"
    ></a-translation>
    <span>{{ index + 1 }}</span>
  </template>
  
  <template
    v-slot:tab3="{ activeTabId, contentId, index, isActive, parentId, tab, tabId }"
  >
    <a-translation
      class="a_mr_2"
      tag="span"
      text="_A_TABS_TAB_"
    ></a-translation>
    <span>{{ index + 1 }}</span>
  </template>
  
  <template
    v-slot:content1="{ activeTabId, contentId, index, isActive, parentId, tab, tabId }"
  >
    <span>{{ tabId }}</span>
  </template>
  
  <template
    v-slot:content2="{ activeTabId, contentId, index, isActive, parentId, tab, tabId }"
  >
    <span>{{ tabId }}</span>
  </template>
  
  <template
    v-slot:content3="{ activeTabId, contentId, index, isActive, parentId, tab, tabId }"
  >
    <span>{{ tabId }}</span>
  </template>
</a-tabs>
```

```js
import { 
  ATabs,
} from "aloha-vue";
import ATranslation from "aloha-vue/src/ATranslation/ATranslation";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTabsDynamicSlots",
  components: {
    ATabs,
    ATranslation,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        slotTab: "tab1",
        slotContent: "content1",
      },
      {
        slotTab: "tab2",
        slotContent: "content2",
      },
      {
        slotTab: "tab3",
        slotContent: "content3",
      },
    ];
    
    return {
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Example with settings and tab management

This example demonstrates how to use the **a-tabs** component with various settings, including the ability to add or remove tabs. The form allows changes to parameters such as disabling tabs, arranging them vertically or horizontally, toggling the border around active tabs, and using **HTML** for tab titles. Additionally, it implements dynamic tab addition and deletion.

```html
<a-form
  v-model="model"
  :data="dataForm"
>
  <template
    v-slot:deleteButton
  >
    <div>
      <a-element
        :disabled="!model.deleteTab"
        class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
        text="_A_GLOBAL_DELETE_"
        type="button"
        @click="deleteTab"
      ></a-element>
    </div>
  </template>
  
  <template
    v-slot:deleteButton
  >
    <div>
      <a-element
        :disabled="!model.addTab"
        class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
        text="_A_GLOBAL_ADD_"
        type="button"
        @click="deleteTab"
      ></a-element>
    </div>
  </template>
</a-form>
<a-tabs
  :data="data"
  :disabled="model.disabled"
  :is-boxed="model.isBoxed"
  :is-title-html="model.isTitleHtml"
  :is-vertical="model.isVertical"
  :title-placement="model.titlePlacement"
  key-content="label"
  key-title="label"
></a-tabs>
```

```js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AElement,
  AForm,
  ATabs,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTabsComplex",
  components: {
    AElement,
    AForm,
    ATabs,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = ref([
      {
        id: 1,
        label: "Lorem",
      },
      {
        id: 2,
        label: "ipsum",
      },
      {
        id: 3,
        label: "dolor",
      },
      {
        id: 4,
        label: "sit",
      },
      {
        id: 5,
        label: "amet",
      },
      {
        id: 6,
        label: "consectetur",
      },
      {
        id: 7,
        label: "adipisicing",
      },
      {
        id: 8,
        label: "elit",
      },
      {
        id: 9,
        label: "Maxime",
      },
      {
        id: 10,
        label: "mollitia",
      },
      {
        id: 11,
        label: "molestiae",
      },
      {
        id: 12,
        label: "quas",
      },
      {
        id: 13,
        label: "vel",
      },
      {
        id: 14,
        label: "sint",
      },
    ]);
    const model = ref({
      disabled: false,
      isBoxed: false,
      isTitleHtml: false,
      isVertical: false,
      titlePlacement: "top",
    });

    const dataForm = computed(() => {
      return [
        {
          id: "disabled",
          label: "_A_TABS_LABEL_DISABLED_",
          type: "switch",
          classColumn: "a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch",
        },
        {
          id: "isBoxed",
          label: "_A_TABS_LABEL_IS_BOXED_",
          type: "switch",
          classColumn: "a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch",
        },
        {
          id: "isTitleHtml",
          label: "_A_TABS_LABEL_IS_TITLE_HTML_",
          type: "switch",
          classColumn: "a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch",
        },
        {
          id: "isVertical",
          label: "_A_TABS_LABEL_IS_VERTICAL_",
          type: "switch",
          classColumn: "a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch",
        },
        {
          id: "titlePlacement",
          label: "_A_TABS_LABEL_TITLE_PLACEMENT_",
          type: "select",
          data: placements,
          isDataSimpleArray: true,
          deselectable: false,
          labelPosition: "top",
        },
        {
          id: "deleteTabs",
          label: "_A_TABS_LABEL_DELETE_TABS_",
          type: "fieldset",
          classColumn: "a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch",
          children: [
            {
              id: "deleteTab",
              label: "_A_TABS_TAB_",
              type: "select",
              data: data.value,
              labelPosition: "top",
              keyLabel: "label",
              keyId: "id",
              search: true,
            },
            {
              type: "template",
              slotName: "deleteButton",
            },
          ],
        },
        {
          id: "addTabs",
          label: "_A_TABS_LABEL_ADD_TABS_",
          type: "fieldset",
          classColumn: "a_column a_column_6 a_column_12_touch",
          children: [
            {
              id: "addTab",
              label: "_A_TABS_TAB_",
              type: "text",
              labelPosition: "top",
            },
            {
              type: "template",
              slotName: "addButton",
            },
          ],
        },
      ];
    });

    const deleteTab = () => {
      const TAB_INDEX = findIndex(data.value, ["id", model.value.deleteTab]);
      if (TAB_INDEX !== -1) {
        data.value.splice(TAB_INDEX, 1);
      }
      model.value.deleteTab = undefined;
    };

    const addTab = () => {
      const LAST_ID = data.value[data.value.length - 1]?.id || 0;
      data.value.push({
        label: model.value.addTab,
        id: LAST_ID + 1,
      });

      model.value.addTab = undefined;
    };
    
    return {
      addTab,
      data,
      dataForm,
      deleteTab,
      model,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| active-tab-id | String / Number |  |  | Defines the **ID** or index of the active tab. If **key-id** is not set, the tab index is used. The component tracks changes to this value to update the active tab. |
| data | Array |  | yes | The array of data describing the tabs. Each element in the array is an object with properties for the tab's title, content, and other settings. |
| disabled | Boolean |  |  | Disables tab interaction. If set to **true**, tabs cannot be switched. |
| id | String | () => uniqueId("a_tabs_") |  | Unique identifier for the component |
| is-boxed | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the active tab will be surrounded by a border. If set to **true**, a border will be displayed. |
| is-change-outside | Boolean |  |  | If set to **true**, the tab will not change automatically when clicked. You must use the **change** event to update **active-tab-id**. |
| is-title-html | Boolean |  |  | Determines whether the tooltip should be interpreted as **HTML**. If set to **true**, the content of the tooltip will be displayed with **HTML** formatting. |
| is-vertical | Boolean |  |  | Specifies whether the tabs will be arranged vertically or horizontally. If set to **true**, tabs will be displayed vertically. |
| key-active | String | active |  | Defines the key used to activate a tab when initializing the component. If the field specified by **key-active** is set to **true**, the corresponding tab will be activated. |
| key-content | String | content |  | Allows specifying the key for the data that will be used as the content for each tab. |
| key-disabled | String |  |  | Key to disable individual tabs. If the tab's key value is **true**, the tab will be disabled. |
| key-id | String |  |  | Unique identifier for the tabs. If **key-id** is not specified, the tab index is used. |
| key-label | String | label |  | Key for specifying the field that will be used for the tab labels. |
| key-title | String | title |  | Allows specifying the key for the data that will be used for the tab titles. |
| title-placement | String | top |  | Specifies the position of the tooltip relative to the element. Various positions are supported, such as **top**, **bottom**, **left**, **right**, and others. This property only works if **isTitleHtml** is set to **true**. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| content | Static slot for customizing the tab's content display. Slot arguments include: **activeTabId**, **contentId**, **index**, **isActive**, **parentId**, **tab**, **tabId**. |
| slotContent | Dynamic slot for customizing the tab's content display. The slot name is specified in the **data** array for each tab. Slot arguments include: **activeTabId**, **contentId**, **index**, **isActive**, **parentId**, **tab**, **tabId**. |
| slotTab | Dynamic slot for customizing the tab's display. The slot name is specified in the **data** array for each tab. Slot arguments include: **activeTabId**, **contentId**, **index**, **isActive**, **parentId**, **tab**, **tabId**. |
| tab | Static slot for customizing the tab's display. Slot arguments include: **activeTabId**, **contentId**, **index**, **isActive**, **parentId**, **tab**, **tabId**. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| change | Function | The event triggered when a tab is clicked. Returns an object with the following arguments: **$event** — event information, **tab** — tab data, **tabId** — unique identifier for the tab or its index, **index** — the tab's index in the data array. |

<!-- https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/tooltip.md -->

# ATooltip (Tooltip)

ATooltip displays additional information when the user hovers over or focuses an element.

## Basic usage

*slots: `default`, `title`*

```html
<a-tooltip>
  <span>Aloha</span>
  
  <template
    v-slot:title
  >
    <div>Aloha</div>
  </template>
</a-tooltip>
```

## Custom tag

You can change the HTML tag used for the tooltip trigger element.

*props: `tag`*

```html
<a-tooltip
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  tag="button"
>
  <span>Aloha</span>
  
  <template
    v-slot:title
  >
    <div>{{ title }}</div>
  </template>
</a-tooltip>
```

```js
import { 
  ATooltip,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTooltipTag",
  components: {
    ATooltip,
  },
  setup() {
    const title = `Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent
per conubia nostra, per inceptos himenaeos. Duis pharetra luctus lacus ut 
vestibulum. Maecenas ipsum lacus, lacinia quis posuere ut, pulvinar vitae dolor.
Integer eu nibh at nisi ullamcorper sagittis id vel leo. Integer feugiat 
faucibus libero, at maximus nisl suscipit posuere. Morbi nec enim nunc. 
Phasellus bibendum turpis ut ipsum egestas, sed sollicitudin elit convallis.
```

## Arrow padding callback

Arrow padding can also be calculated dynamically with a callback function.

*props: `arrow-padding`*

```html
<a-tooltip
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  tag="button"
  :arrow-padding="arrowPaddingCallback"
>
  <span>Aloha</span>
  
  <template
    v-slot:title
  >
    <div>{{ title }}</div>
  </template>
</a-tooltip>
```

```js
import { 
  ATooltip,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageTooltipArrowPaddingFunction",
  components: {
    ATooltip,
  },
  setup() {
    const arrowPaddingCallback = ({ popper, reference, placement }) => {
      console.log("placement", placement);
      console.log("popper", popper);
      console.log("reference", reference);
      return popper.width / reference.width + 400;
    };

    const title = `Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus.`;

    return {
      arrowPaddingCallback,
      title,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| arrow-padding | Number / Function |  |  | Minimum distance in px between the arrow and the edges of the tooltip. A function receives the sizes and returns the number. |
| id | String | a_tooltip_{n} |  | ID of the tooltip. The element gets aria-describedby with this ID. |
| is-hide | Boolean |  |  | The tooltip is not shown, only the content of the default slot. |
| max-width | Number |  |  | Maximum width of the tooltip in px. |
| min-width | Number |  |  | Minimum width of the tooltip in px. |
| offset-distance | Number | 6 |  | Distance in px between the tooltip and the element. |
| offset-skidding | Number | 0 |  | Shift in px of the tooltip along the element. |
| placement | String | top |  | Position of the tooltip relative to the element, e.g. top, bottom, left, right, top-start. |
| popper-container-id | String | a_tooltip_container |  | ID of the container at the end of the body in which the tooltip is rendered. |
| show-arrow | Boolean | true |  | Shows the arrow of the tooltip. |
| tag | String | span |  | HTML tag of the element around the default slot. |
| time-close | Number | 100 |  | Time in ms before the tooltip closes after the pointer leaves the element or the tooltip. |
| width | Number |  |  | Fixed width of the tooltip in px. |
| without-aria-describedby | Boolean |  |  | The element does not get aria-describedby, e.g. if the text of the tooltip is already read otherwise. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| default | The element that shows the tooltip on hover and focus. |
| title | Content of the tooltip. |

| `--a_tooltip_padding_y` |  | Vertical padding of the tooltip. |
| `--a_tooltip_font_size` |  | Font size of the tooltip. |
| `--a_tooltip_arrow_width` |  | Width of the arrow. |
| `--a_tooltip_arrow_height` |  | Height of the arrow. |
| `--a_tooltip_arrow_shift` |  | Offset of the arrow from the tooltip edge. |
| `--a_tooltip_max_height` |  | Maximum height of the tooltip. Longer content scrolls. |
| `--a_tooltip_box_shadow` |  | Shadow of the tooltip. |
| `--a_tooltip_arrow_box_shadow` |  | Shadow of the arrow. |

# ATree (Tree)

The **ATree** component shows hierarchical data: nodes can be expanded, selected and checked, searched and loaded lazily. The data is plain JSON with configurable keys; with `json` any JSON value is shown as a tree.

Accessibility: the WAI-ARIA tree pattern (`role="tree"`, `treeitem`, `group` with level, position, expanded, selected and checked state). Only one node is in the tab order, the arrow keys move the focus. The number of found nodes is announced.

- **↑ ↓**: next / previous node
- **→**: open the node or go to the first child
- **←**: close the node or go to the parent
- **Home / End**: first / last node
- **Enter**: select
- **Space**: check (with checkboxes) or select
- *****: open all nodes of the level
- **a–z**: go to the next node starting with the letter

## Basic usage

Nodes are objects with `id`, `label` and `children`. `v-model:selected` is the key of the selected node.

*props: `data`, `selected`, `aria-label`*

```html
<a-tree
  v-model:selected="selected"
  :data="data"
  aria-label="Company structure"
></a-tree>
<div>selected: {{ selected }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ATree,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageTreeBasic",
  components: {
    ATree,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        id: "management",
        label: "Management",
      },
      {
        id: "it",
        label: "IT",
        children: [
          {
            id: "development",
            label: "Development",
            children: [
              { id: "frontend", label: "Frontend" },
              { id: "backend", label: "Backend" },
              { id: "qa", label: "Quality assurance" },
            ],
          },
          { id: "support", label: "Support" },
          { id: "security", label: "Security", disabled: true },
        ],
      },
      {
        id: "sales",
        label: "Sales",
        children: [
          { id: "sales_europe", label: "Europe" },
          { id: "sales_asia", label: "Asia" },
        ],
      },
    ];

    const selected = ref(undefined);

    return {
      data,
      selected,
    };
  },
};
```

## Expanding

`default-expand-level` opens the first levels, `is-expand-all` all nodes. `v-model:expanded` holds the keys of the open nodes, the methods `expandAll` and `collapseAll` change them. `is-accordion` keeps only one node per level open; with `is-expand-on-click-node` `false` only the arrow opens a node.

*props: `default-expand-level`, `is-expand-all`, `is-accordion`, `is-expand-on-click-node`, `expanded`*

```html
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary a_btn_small"
  text="Expand all"
  @click="treeRef.expandAll()"
></a-button>
<a-button
  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary a_btn_small"
  text="Collapse all"
  @click="treeRef.collapseAll()"
></a-button>
<a-tree
  ref="treeRef"
  v-model:expanded="expanded"
  :data="data"
  :default-expand-level="1"
  aria-label="Company structure"
></a-tree>
<div>expanded: {{ expanded }}</div>

<a-tree
  :data="data"
  :is-accordion="true"
  aria-label="Company structure"
></a-tree>

<a-tree
  :data="data"
  :is-expand-on-click-node="false"
  aria-label="Company structure"
></a-tree>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AButton,
  ATree,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageTreeExpand",
  components: {
    AButton,
    ATree,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        id: "management",
        label: "Management",
      },
      {
        id: "it",
        label: "IT",
        children: [
          {
            id: "development",
            label: "Development",
            children: [
              { id: "frontend", label: "Frontend" },
              { id: "backend", label: "Backend" },
              { id: "qa", label: "Quality assurance" },
            ],
          },
          { id: "support", label: "Support" },
          { id: "security", label: "Security", disabled: true },
        ],
      },
      {
        id: "sales",
        label: "Sales",
        children: [
          { id: "sales_europe", label: "Europe" },
          { id: "sales_asia", label: "Asia" },
        ],
      },
    ];

    const expanded = ref(undefined);
    const treeRef = ref(undefined);

    return {
      data,
      expanded,
      treeRef,
    };
  },
};
```

## Checkboxes

`is-checkbox` shows checkboxes, `v-model` holds the checked keys. Checking a node checks its children; a parent is checked when all children are checked, otherwise it is partly checked. Disabled nodes are not changed.

*props: `is-checkbox`, `model-value`, `is-check-on-click-node`*

```html
<a-tree
  ref="treeRef"
  v-model="checked"
  :data="data"
  :is-checkbox="true"
  :default-expand-level="2"
  aria-label="Company structure"
></a-tree>
<div>model-value: {{ checked }}</div>
<div>getCheckedItems({ isLeafOnly: true }): {{ leafLabels }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  computed,
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ATree,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageTreeCheckbox",
  components: {
    ATree,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        id: "management",
        label: "Management",
      },
      {
        id: "it",
        label: "IT",
        children: [
          {
            id: "development",
            label: "Development",
            children: [
              { id: "frontend", label: "Frontend" },
              { id: "backend", label: "Backend" },
              { id: "qa", label: "Quality assurance" },
            ],
          },
          { id: "support", label: "Support" },
          { id: "security", label: "Security", disabled: true },
        ],
      },
      {
        id: "sales",
        label: "Sales",
        children: [
          { id: "sales_europe", label: "Europe" },
          { id: "sales_asia", label: "Asia" },
        ],
      },
    ];

    const checked = ref(["frontend", "backend"]);
    const treeRef = ref(undefined);

    const leafLabels = computed(() => {
      // checked is read here, so the list is updated after every change
      return checked.value && treeRef.value ?
        treeRef.value.getCheckedItems({ isLeafOnly: true }).map(item => item.label) :
        [];
    });

    return {
      checked,
      data,
      leafLabels,
      treeRef,
    };
  },
};
```

## Search

`search-model` shows the matching nodes and their parents and highlights the text. `filter-method` replaces the search: `({ item, label, searchModel }) => boolean`.

*props: `search-model`, `filter-method`*

```html
<a-input
  v-model="searchModel"
  class="a_mb_3"
  label="Search"

  :data="data"

></a-tree>
```

```js
            children: [

            ],

        children: [
```

## Lazy loading

`load` gets `{ item, key, level }` and returns a Promise with the children; while loading the node shows a spinner. A node with `isLeaf` has no children. If the Promise is rejected, the node stays closed, can be opened again and `load-error` is emitted.

*props: `load`, `key-is-leaf`*

```html
<a-tree
  :data="data"
  :load="load"
  aria-label="Folders"
></a-tree>
```

```js
import {
  ATree,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageTreeLazy",
  components: {
    ATree,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      { id: "documents", label: "Documents" },
      { id: "photos", label: "Photos" },
      { id: "readme", label: "readme.txt", isLeaf: true },
    ];

    // Simulated request. Return a Promise with the children; isLeaf marks nodes without children.
    const load = ({ item, level }) => {
      return new Promise(resolve => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          resolve(level < 3 ?
            [
              { id: `${ item.id }_a`, label: `${ item.label } A` },
              { id: `${ item.id }_b`, label: `${ item.label } B` },
              { id: `${ item.id }_file`, label: "file.pdf", isLeaf: true },
            ] :
            []);
        }, 800);
      });
    };

    return {
      data,
      load,
    };
  },
};
```

## Own JSON keys

The data does not need to be converted: `key-id`, `key-label`, `key-children`, `key-disabled` and `key-is-leaf` take a key, a path (`meta.title`) or a function `({ item }) => value`.

*props: `key-id`, `key-label`, `key-children`, `key-disabled`*

```html
<a-tree
  v-model:selected="selected"
  :data="data"
  key-id="uuid"
  key-label="meta.title"
  key-children="subordinates"
  :key-disabled="({ item }) => !item.active"
  :is-expand-all="true"
  aria-label="Employees"
></a-tree>
<div>selected: {{ selected }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  ATree,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageTreeKeys",
  components: {
    ATree,
  },
  setup() {
    // JSON as it comes from an API
    const data = [
      {
        uuid: "7c1e",
        active: true,
        meta: { title: "Anna Becker, CEO" },
        subordinates: [
          { uuid: "9a2f", active: true, meta: { title: "Ben Ott, CTO" } },
          { uuid: "3d8b", active: false, meta: { title: "Clara Lenz, CFO" } },
        ],
      },
    ];
    const selected = ref(undefined);

    return {
      data,
      selected,
    };
  },
};
```

## Own node content

The slot `node` replaces the label and gets `item`, `key`, `label`, `level`, `isExpanded`, `isLeaf`, `checked`, `isSelected` and `searchModel`.

*props: `node`*

```html
<a-tree
  :data="data"
  :is-expand-all="true"
  aria-label="Company structure"
>
  <template v-slot:node="{ item, label, isLeaf }">
    <span class="a_d_flex a_align_items_center a_gap_2">
      <span>{{ label }}</span>
      <span
        v-if="!isLeaf"
        class="a_badge a_badge_secondary a_pill_rounded"
      >{{ item.children.length }}</span>
    </span>
  </template>
</a-tree>
```

```js
import {
  ATree,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageTreeSlot",
  components: {
    ATree,
  },
  setup() {
    const data = [
      {
        id: "management",
        label: "Management",
      },
      {
        id: "it",
        label: "IT",
        children: [
          {
            id: "development",
            label: "Development",
            children: [
              { id: "frontend", label: "Frontend" },
              { id: "backend", label: "Backend" },
              { id: "qa", label: "Quality assurance" },
            ],
          },
          { id: "support", label: "Support" },
          { id: "security", label: "Security", disabled: true },
        ],
      },
      {
        id: "sales",
        label: "Sales",
        children: [
          { id: "sales_europe", label: "Europe" },
          { id: "sales_asia", label: "Asia" },
        ],
      },
    ];

    return {
      data,
    };
  },
};
```

## Any JSON

`json` shows any JSON value, e.g. a response of an API: keys, values by type, the size of objects and arrays. The search finds keys and values, the key of a node is its path (`$.address.geo.lat`).

*props: `json`, `default-expand-level`*

```html
<a-input
  v-model="searchModel"
  class="a_mb_3"
  label="Search"
  type="search"
></a-input>
<a-tree
  v-model:selected="selected"
  :json="json"
  :search-model="searchModel"
  :default-expand-level="1"
  aria-label="JSON"
></a-tree>
<div>selected: {{ selected }}</div>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import {
  AInput,
  ATree,
} from "aloha-vue";

export default {
  name: "PageTreeJson",
  components: {
    AInput,
    ATree,
  },
  setup() {
    const json = {
      id: 42,
      name: "Anna Becker",
      email: "anna.becker@example.com",
      active: true,
      manager: null,
      roles: ["admin", "editor"],
      address: {
        street: "Hauptstraße 1",
        city: "Berlin",
        geo: { lat: 52.52, lng: 13.405 },
      },
    };
    const searchModel = ref("");
    const selected = ref(undefined);

    return {
      json,
      searchModel,
      selected,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| aria-label | String |  |  | Accessible name of the tree (required if there is no aria-labelledby). |
| aria-labelledby | String |  |  | Id of an element that names the tree. |
| data | Array | [] |  | Nodes of the tree. |
| default-expand-level | Number | 0 |  | Levels that are open at the start. |
| empty-text | String | "_A_TREE_EMPTY_" |  | Text without nodes. |
| expanded | Array |  |  | Keys of the open nodes (v-model:expanded). |
| filter-method | Function |  |  | Own search: ({ item, label, searchModel }) => boolean. |
| id | String | uniqueId("a_tree_") |  | Id of the tree. |
| indent | Number / String |  |  | Indent of a level (number in pixels or CSS value). |
| is-accordion | Boolean | false |  | Only one open node per level. |
| is-check-on-click-node | Boolean | false |  | A click on the node changes the checkbox. |
| is-check-strictly | Boolean | false |  | A checkbox changes only its own node. |
| is-checkbox | Boolean | false |  | Shows checkboxes. |
| is-expand-all | Boolean | false |  | All nodes are open at the start. |
| is-expand-on-click-node | Boolean | true |  | A click on the node opens and closes it. |
| is-selectable | Boolean | true |  | Nodes can be selected. |
| json | Any |  |  | Any JSON value that is shown as a tree (instead of data). |
| key-children | String / Function | "children" |  | Key, path or function of the children. |
| key-disabled | String / Function | "disabled" |  | Key, path or function of the disabled state. |
| key-id | String / Function | "id" |  | Key, path or function of the unique key of a node. |
| key-is-leaf | String / Function | "isLeaf" |  | With load: key, path or function that marks a node without children. |
| key-label | String / Function | "label" |  | Key, path or function of the label. |
| load | Function |  |  | Loads children: ({ item, key, level }) => Promise. |
| model-value | Array |  |  | Keys of the checked nodes (v-model). |
| search-model | String | "" |  | Search text. |
| selected | String / Number |  |  | Key of the selected node (v-model:selected). |

## Events

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| update:model-value | Checked keys changed. |
| update:selected | Selected key changed. |
| update:expanded | Keys of the open nodes changed. |
| node-click | A node was selected by click or keyboard: { item, key, $event }. |
| check | A checkbox was changed: { item, key, checked, checkedKeys, $event }. |
| expand | A node was opened: { item, key, $event }. |
| collapse | A node was closed: { item, key, $event }. |
| load-error | load was rejected: { item, key, error }. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| node | Content of a node instead of the label. |
| empty | Content without nodes. |

## Methods

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| expandAll() | Opens all nodes. |
| collapseAll() | Closes all nodes. |
| expandToKey(key) | Opens the parents of a node. |
| focus({ key }) | Focuses a node (by default the node in the tab order). |
| setSelected(key) | Selects a node and opens its parents. |
| checkNode({ key, checked }) | Checks or unchecks a node. |
| setCheckedKeys(keys) | Sets the checked keys. |
| getCheckedItems({ isLeafOnly }) | Returns the checked items, optionally only leaves. |
| getHalfCheckedKeys() | Returns the keys of partly checked nodes. |
| getNode(key) | Returns the item of a key. |

<!-- https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/components/translation.md -->

# ATranslation (Multifunctional Translation Component)

**ATranslation** is a powerful and versatile **Vue.js** component that allows developers to seamlessly integrate translations into **Vue.js** applications. With a variety of supported features such as translating text, **HTML** content, and placeholders, **ATranslation** provides a robust solution for multilingual support in web applications. Supporting both **mobile** and **desktop** displays, as well as concatenation of `Array` data, this component offers a flexible and user-friendly localization solution.

## Basic usage

*props: `text`*

```html
<a-translation
  text="_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_"
></a-translation>
```

## Hiding elements without a translation

Only the first element is displayed: its translation exists. The key `_A_TRANSLATION_EXAMPLE_MISSING_` is absent from the dictionary, and `_A_TRANSLATION_EXAMPLE_EMPTY_` has an empty translation, so both elements are hidden by `hide-without-translation`. They appear automatically when a non-empty translation is provided.

*props: `hide-without-translation`*

```html
<a-translation
  text="_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_"
  hide-without-translation
></a-translation>
<a-translation
  text="_A_TRANSLATION_EXAMPLE_MISSING_"
  hide-without-translation
></a-translation>
<a-translation
  text="_A_TRANSLATION_EXAMPLE_EMPTY_"
  hide-without-translation
></a-translation>
```

## Extending text with `text-after`

This demonstrates how additional text, such as **" *(Aloha)"**, is displayed after the translated main text.

*props: `text-after`*

```html
<a-translation
  text="_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_"
  text-after=" *(Aloha)"
></a-translation>
```

## Extending text with `text-before`

This demonstrates how additional text, such as **"$Aloha$ "**, is displayed before the translated main text.

*props: `text-before`*

```html
<a-translation
  text="_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_"
  text-before="$Aloha$ "
></a-translation>
```

## Extending text with `text-after` and `text-before`

This demonstrates how additional text, such as **" (Text After)"**, is displayed after and **"(Text before) "** before the translated main text to enhance text content flexibility.

*props: `text-after`, `text-before`*

```html
<a-translation
  text="_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_"
  text-after=" (Text After)"
  text-before="(Text before) "
></a-translation>
```

## Text with device-specific translations

This example illustrates the functionality of the `text` prop as an object. By using different texts for the **mobile** and **desktop** views, it shows how `"_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_"` is displayed for **mobile** and `"_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_LESS_"` for **desktop**.

*props: `text (as Object)`*

```html
<a-translation
  :text="{ mobile: '_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_', desktop: '_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_LESS_' }"
></a-translation>
```

## Using `safe-html`

The component allows using safe **HTML** content as a string. By enabling the `safe-html` prop and passing an **HTML** string, the provided **HTML** content is treated as trusted and inserted directly via the **JavaScript** attribute `innerHTML`.

*props: `safe-html`*

```html
<a-translation
  safe-html="_A_TRANSLATION_EXAMPLE_HTML_"
></a-translation>
```

## Safe **HTML** text with `DOMPurify.sanitize`

The displayed **HTML** content `"Aloha"` shows the button without the `onclick` attribute because `DOMPurify.sanitize` is used to prevent potential security risks from unsafe **HTML**.

*props: `html`*

```html
<a-translation
  html="_A_TRANSLATION_EXAMPLE_HTML_"
></a-translation>
```

## Using **HTML** with `text-before` and `text-after`

The output shows the **HTML** content `"_A_TRANSLATION_EXAMPLE_HTML_"` with the additional text `"$ "` before and `" €"` after the **HTML**.

*props: `html`, `text-after`, `text-before`*

```html
<a-translation
  html="_A_TRANSLATION_EXAMPLE_HTML_"
  text-before="$ "
  text-after=" €"
></a-translation>
```

## Using `tag` and `placeholder` for an input field

This example demonstrates the use of the `tag` prop to create an input field in the component. The code shows how the placeholder text `"_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_"` is displayed in the input field.

*props: `tag`, `placeholder`*

```html
<a-translation
  tag="input"
  placeholder="_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_"
></a-translation>
```

## Translation of `aria-label` for a button

Demonstrates the use of `aria-label` for translating the text content of a button.

*props: `aria-label`*

```html
<a-translation
  tag="button"
  class="a_btn a_btn_secondary"
  aria-label="_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_"
>+</a-translation>
```

## Translation of `title`

Demonstrates the use of `title` for translating a tooltip text.

*props: `title`*

```html
<a-translation
  title="_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_"
>Aloha</a-translation>
```

## Device-specific translation of `title`

Demonstrates the use of `title` as an object for device-specific translations. The `title` text is not displayed if the screen width is smaller than the value defined in [AMobilePlugin](https://ilia-brykin.github.io/aloha/llms/plugins/mobile-plugin.md).

*props: `title (as Object)`*

```html
<a-translation
  :title="{ desktop: '_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_' }"
>Aloha</a-translation>
```

## Concatenated translation of `title`

Demonstrates the use of an `Array` for `title` translation. The values are translated and concatenated with a space.

*props: `title (as Array)`*

```html
<a-translation
  :title="['_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_', '_A_TRANSLATION_SHOW_MORE_', 'Aloha']"
>Aloha</a-translation>
```

## Translation with `extra` values

Demonstrates the use of `extra` to replace placeholders in the translation. The translated text is displayed in the browser with the specified values.

*props: `extra`*

```html
<a-translation
  html="_A_TRANSLATION_EXAMPLE_EXTRA_{{aloha}}_{{a}}_{{b}}_"
  :extra="{ aloha: 'ALOHA', a: 10, b: 123 }"
></a-translation>
```

## Using the `default` slot with `text-before` and `text-after`

This example shows how the `default` slot is used in combination with `text-before` and `text-after`. In the browser, the text is displayed as **+ Aloha -**.

*slots: `default`*

```html
<a-translation
  text-before="+ "
  text-after=" -"
>Aloha</a-translation>
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| always-translate | Boolean |  |  | Forces translation regardless of the `is-translate` flag. |
| aria-label | String / Number / Object |  |  | A translatable text for the **ARIA** labeling function. (`Object -> mobile and desktop`) |
| extra | Object |  |  | Variables for translations. |
| hide-without-translation | Boolean | false |  | Hides the entire element if a translation used in its content or attributes is missing, null, undefined, or an empty string. Supports arrays and the current device variant. The element appears automatically when translations are updated. Literal text and numeric zero remain visible. |
| html | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | A translatable content that may contain **HTML** tags is sanitized and rendered. (`Object` -> **mobile** and **desktop**, `Array` -> Concatenation) |
| placeholder | String / Number / Object |  |  | A translatable placeholder text, e.g., for an `input` tag. (`Object` -> **mobile** and **desktop**) |
| safe-html | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | Inserts the provided **HTML** content as is via `innerHTML`. (`Object` -> **mobile** and **desktop**, `Array` -> Concatenation) |
| tag | String | div |  | The **HTML** tag used for the wrapping element. Default value: `div`. |
| text | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | A translatable text. (`Object` -> **mobile** and **desktop**, `Array` -> Concatenation) |
| text-after | String / Number / Object |  |  | A static text appended after the main content without being translated. |
| text-before | String / Number / Object |  |  | A static text prepended before the main content without being translated. |
| title | String / Number / Object / Array |  |  | A translatable `title` text displayed as a tooltip. (`Object` -> **mobile** and **desktop**, `Array` -> Concatenation) |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| default | Default slot for the main content of the component. |

# AWizard (Wizard)

A wizard is a sequential, step-by-step interface designed to guide users through complex tasks or processes by breaking them into manageable steps. It includes clear instructions and often provides users with the ability to navigate forward and backward for a efficient and straightforward user experience.

## Basic usage

*props: `wizard-steps`*

```html
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step1
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step2
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step3
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step4
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
</a-wizard>
```

```js
import {
  ATranslation,
  AWizard,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageWizardBasic",
  components: {
    ATranslation,
    AWizard,
  },
  setup() {
    const wizardSteps = [
      {
        slot: "step1",
        label: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_1_",
        title: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_1_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step2",
        label: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_2_",
        title: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_2_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step3",
        label: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_3_",
        title: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_3_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step4",
        label: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_4_",
        title: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_4_",
      },
    ];
    const text = `Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
        pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
        Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
        in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent`;

    return {
      text,
      wizardSteps,
    };
  },
};
```

## Subtypes for **line** type

These examples demonstrate how to use various subtypes to alter the appearance of active steps when using the **line** type.

*props: `sub-type`, `type`*

```html
<h3 class="a_my_3">type="line", sub-type="square"</h3>
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
  type="line"
  sub-type="square"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step1
  >
```

## Navigation buttons

Navigation buttons allow users to move forward or backward through the steps of the wizard. They can be fully customized by using the listed props.

*props: `back-button-attributes`, `back-button-class`, `back-button-icon-left`, `back-button-icon-right`, `back-button-text`, `back-button-title`, `forward-button-attributes`, `forward-button-class`, `forward-button-icon-left`, `forward-button-icon-right`, `forward-button-text`, `forward-button-title`*

```html
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
  :back-button-attributes="{ stop: true }"
  back-button-class="a_btn a_btn_warning"
  back-button-icon-left="ChevronLeft"
  back-button-icon-right="ChevronLeft"
  back-button-text="_A_WIZARD_PAGE_BACK_BTN_TEXT_"
  back-button-title="_A_WIZARD_PAGE_BACK_BTN_TEXT_"
  :forward-button-attributes="{ stop: true }"
  forward-button-class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  forward-button-icon-left="ChevronRight"
  forward-button-icon-right="ChevronRight"
  forward-button-text="_A_WIZARD_PAGE_FORWARD_BTN_TEXT_"
  forward-button-title="_A_WIZARD_PAGE_FORWARD_BTN_TEXT_"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step1
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step2
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step3
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step4
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
</a-wizard>
```


## Disabling navigation buttons

An alternative way of navigating the wizard is by directly selecting the step in header, rather than relying solely on forward and backward buttons. Both navigations for moving forward or backward and steps in the overview can be disabled when necessary.

*props: `is-back-button-disabled`, `is-back-step-button-disabled`, `is-forward-button-disabled`, `is-forward-step-button-disabled`*

```html
<div
  class="a_columns a_columns_count_12"
>
  <div
    class="a_column.a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch a_mb_5"
  >
    <a-switch
      v-model="isBackButtonDisabled"
      label="is-back-button-disabled"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-switch
      v-model="isBackStepButtonDisabled"
      label="is-back-step-button-disabled"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-switch
      v-model="isForwardButtonDisabled"
      label="is-forward-button-disabled"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-switch
      v-model="isForwardStepButtonDisabled"
      label="is-forward-step-button-disabled"
    ></a-switch>
  </div>
</div>
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
  :is-back-button-disabled="isBackButtonDisabled"
  :is-back-step-button-disabled="isBackStepButtonDisabled"
  :is-forward-button-disabled="isForwardButtonDisabled"
  :is-forward-step-button-disabled="isForwardStepButtonDisabled"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step1
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step2
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step3
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step4
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
</a-wizard>
```

```js

  ref,
} from "vue";

  ASwitch,

    const isForwardStepButtonDisabled = ref(true);

      {
        slot: "step1",
        label: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_",
        title: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step2",
        label: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_",
        title: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step3",
        label: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_",
        title: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step4",
        label: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_",
        title: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_",
      },
    ];

        Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex,

      isBackButtonDisabled,
      isBackStepButtonDisabled,
      isForwardButtonDisabled,
      isForwardStepButtonDisabled,

      wizardSteps,
```

## Hiding navigation buttons

Visibility of both navigation buttons can be controlled separately, including visibility in first and last step, respectively.

```html
<div
  class="a_columns a_columns_count_12"

    class="a_column.a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch a_mb_5"
  >

      v-model="isBackButtonHide"
      label="is-back-button-hide"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-switch
      v-model="isBackFirstButtonHide"
      label="is-back-first-button-hide"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-switch
      v-model="isForwardButtonHide"
      label="is-forward-button-hide"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-switch
      v-model="isForwardLastButtonHide"
      label="is-forward-last-button-hide"
    ></a-switch>
  </div>
</div>

  :is-back-button-hide="isBackButtonHide"
```

## Steps justification

Alignment of the steps in the wizard header can be customized to be left or justified. By justifying, the both edges of the header are aligned with both edges of wizard, and the steps are evenly distributed across the available width, regardless of the total number of steps.

*props: `is-steps-justified`*

```html
<div
  class="a_columns a_columns_count_12"
>
  <div
    class="a_column.a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch a_mb_5"
  >
    <a-switch
      v-model="isStepsJustified"
      label="is-steps-justified"
    ></a-switch>
  </div>
</div>
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
  :is-steps-justified="isStepsJustified"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step1
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step2
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_"
    ></a-translation>
```

## Loading indicator

The **AWizard** component allows for displaying the loading indicator inside navigation buttons. This can be useful to indicate that a specific operation is running in the background and the user needs to wait for completion of the step.

*props: `is-buttons-loading`*

```html
<div
  class="a_columns a_columns_count_12"
>
  <div
    class="a_column.a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch a_mb_5"

      v-model="isButtonsLoading"
      label="is-buttons-loading"
    ></a-switch>
  </div>
</div>
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
  :is-buttons-loading="isButtonsLoading"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step1
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step2
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step3
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>

    v-slot:step4

    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_"

  </template>
</a-wizard>
```

## Positioning of navigation buttons toolbar

The position of the toolbar containing navigation buttons can be customized by using one of the two props. Supported positions are top and bottom.

*props: `is-toolbar-bottom`, `is-toolbar-top`*

## Step error

Each step of the wizard can contain boolean property "error". For value true, the corresponding step will be highlighted as erroneous.

*props: `steps.error`*

```html
<div
  class="a_columns a_columns_count_12"
>
  <div
    class="a_column.a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch a_mb_5"
  >
    <a-select
      v-model="modelType"
      label="_A_WIZARD_LABEL_TYPE_"
      key-id="value"
      key-label="label"
      :data="types"
      :deselectable="false"
      :translate-data="true"
    ></a-select>
    <a-switch
      v-model="wizardSteps[0].error"
      label="_A_WIZARD_STEP_1_"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-switch
      v-model="wizardSteps[1].error"
      label="_A_WIZARD_STEP_2_"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-switch
      v-model="wizardSteps[2].error"
      label="_A_WIZARD_STEP_3_"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-switch
      v-model="wizardSteps[3].error"
```

## Step warning

## Unique Identifier Key

A unique identifier key for each step. Used for performance enhancement. This is the key for each of the objects in the **steps** prop. The value of this key will be found in the object and used as the **key** in the loop. If **key-id** is not specified, the **index** will be used in the loop.

*props: `key-id`*

```html
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
  key-id="id"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step1
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step2
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step3
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_"
    ></a-translation>
```

## Focus jump

When transitioning to different step from the current one in a wizard, a focus jump can be used to direct the user to the relevant content, in contrast to the keeping focus on the navigation button that was interacted with.

*props: `has-focus-jump`*

```html
<div
  class="a_columns a_columns_count_12"
>
  <div
    class="a_column.a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch a_mb_5"
  >
    <a-switch
      v-model="hasFocusJump"
      label="has-focus-jump"
    ></a-switch>
  </div>
</div>
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
  :has-focus-jump="hasFocusJump"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step1
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step2
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step3
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step4
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
</a-wizard>
```

```js

      {
        slot: "step2",

        title: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step3",

```

## External step navigation

External step navigation involves the dynamic control of multi-step process of a wizard using external variables or custom logic, enabling customized progression through the steps based on different needs and factors.

*props: `is-control-outside`, `step-active`, `steps-visited`; emits: `go-step-back`, `go-step-forward`*

```html
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
  :is-control-outside="true"
  :step-active="stepActive"
  :steps-visited="stepsVisited"
  @go-step-back="goStepBack"
  @go-step-forward="goStepForward"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step1
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step2
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step3
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step4
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
</a-wizard>
```

```js
import {
  ATranslation,
  AWizard,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageWizardIsControlOutside",
  components: {
    ATranslation,
    AWizard,
  },
  setup() {    
    const stepActive = ref(0);
    const stepsVisited = ref({
      0: true,
    });
    const wizardSteps = [
      {
        slot: "step1",
        label: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_1_",
        title: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_1_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step2",
        label: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_2_",
        title: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_2_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step3",
        label: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_3_",
        title: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_3_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step4",
        label: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_4_",
        title: "_A_WIZARD_STEP_4_",
      },
    ];
    const text = `Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
        pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
        Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
        in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent`;

    const goStepBack = ({ targetStepIndex, currentStepIndex, step }) => {
      console.log("currentStepIndex", currentStepIndex);
      console.log("step", step);
      stepActive.value = targetStepIndex;
      stepsVisited.value[targetStepIndex] = true;
    };

    const goStepForward = ({ targetStepIndex, currentStepIndex, step }) => {
      console.log("currentStepIndex", currentStepIndex);
      console.log("step", step);
      stepActive.value = targetStepIndex;
      stepsVisited.value[targetStepIndex] = true;
    };

    return {
      goStepBack,
      goStepForward,
      stepActive,
      stepsVisited,
      text,
      wizardSteps,
    };
  },
};
```

## Custom content inside step

A slot **step** can be defined in order to customize content inside a wizard step. slot can be used by a single step or by multiple ones.

*props: `steps.slot`; slots: `slot`*

```html
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step="{ step, stepIndex }"
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h3"
      :text="step.label"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
 
  <template
    v-slot:step4
  >
    <h2>ALOHA</h2>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
</a-wizard>
```

## Show only currently active step (mobile)

Showing only the active step or all steps in a wizard can be customized based on design choices, screen space, and user experience priorities.

*props: `show-only-active-step-mobile`, `is-mobile`*

```html
<div
  class="a_columns a_columns_count_12"
>
  <div
    class="a_column.a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch a_mb_5"
  >
    <a-switch
      v-model="showOnlyActiveStepMobile"
        label="show-only-active-step-mobile"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-select
      v-model="modelType"
      class="a_mt_4"
      label="_A_WIZARD_LABEL_TYPE_"
      key-id="value"
      key-label="label"
      :data="types"
      :deselectable="false"
      :translate-data="true"
    ></a-select>
  </div>
</div>
<a-wizard
  :steps="wizardSteps"
  :is-mobile="true"
  :show-only-active-step-mobile="showOnlyActiveStepMobile"
  :type="modelType"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step="{ step }"
  >
    <h2>{{ step.label }}</h2>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
</a-wizard>
```

## Showcase example

A showcase example of an **AWizard** component.

*props: `steps`, `type`*

```html
<div 
  class="a_columns a_columns_count_12"
>
  <div 
    class="a_column a_column_6 a_columns_count_12_touch a_mb_5"
  >
    <a-switch 
      v-model="isStepsJustified" 
      label="is-steps-justified"
    ></a-switch>
    <a-select 
      v-model="modelType" 
      class="a_mt_4" 
      label="_A_WIZARD_LABEL_TYPE_" 
      key-id="value" 
      key-label="label" 
      :data="types" 
      :deselectable="false" 
      :translate-data="true"
    ></a-select>
    <div 
      class="a_d_flex a_mt_4"
    >
      <a-input 
        v-model="modelStepName" 
        label="_A_WIZARD_STEP_NAME_" 
        :required="true"
      ></a-input>
      <a-button 
        class="a_btn a_btn_primary a_ml_2" 
        :disabled="!modelStepName" 
        text="_A_WIZARD_BTN_ADD_STEP_" 
        @click="addStep"
      ></a-button>
    </div>
    <div 
      class="a_d_flex a_mt_4"
    >
      <a-select 
        v-model="modelStepId" 
        label="_A_WIZARD_LABEL_STEPS_" 
        key-id="id" 
        key-label="label" 
        :data="wizardSteps" 
        :search="true"
      ></a-select>
      <a-button 
        class="a_btn a_btn_primary a_ml_2" 
        :disabled="!modelStepId || wizardSteps.length < 2" 
        text="_A_WIZARD_BTN_DELETE_STEP_" 
        @click="deleteStep"
      ></a-button>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<a-wizard
  key-id="id"
  :is-steps-justified="isStepsJustified"
  :steps="wizardSteps"
  :type="modelType"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step="{ step }"
  >
    <h2>{{ step.label }}</h2>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
</a-wizard>
```

```js
    const text = `Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
        pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
        Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
        in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent`;

    const addStep = () => {
      wizardSteps.value.push({
        id: uniqueId("wizard_demo_"),
        slot: "step",
        label: modelStepName.value,
      });
    };

    const deleteStep = () => {
      const STEP_INDEX = findIndex(wizardSteps.value, ["id", modelStepId.value]);
      wizardSteps.value.splice(STEP_INDEX, 1);
      modelStepId.value = undefined;
    };

    return {
      addStep,
      deleteStep,
      isStepsJustified,
      modelStepId,
      modelStepName,
      modelType,
      text,
      types,
      wizardSteps,
    };
  },
};
```

## Props

| name | type | default | required | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| aria-label | String | _A_WIZARD_ARIA_LABEL_ |  | Translatable aria-label for the main element of the Wizard |
| aria-label-steps | String | _A_WIZARD_STEPS_ARIA_LABEL_ |  | Translatable aria-label for the block with all steps of the Wizard |
| back-button-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Additional attributes for the button navigating to the previous step that are not explicitly defined as props. |
| back-button-class | String / Array / Object | a_btn a_btn_secondary |  | One or more additional CSS-classes for the button navigating to the previous step. |
| back-button-icon-left | String |  |  | Name of the icon to be shown to the left of the label for the button navigating to the previous step. |
| back-button-icon-right | String |  |  | Name of the icon to be shown to the right of the label for the button navigating to the previous step. |
| back-button-text | String | _A_WIZARD_PREVIOUS_ |  | Custom label for the button navigating to the previous step. |
| back-button-title | String |  |  | Custom title for the button navigating to the previous step. |
| class-extra | String / Object | a_wizard_class_extra |  | Additional **CSS** class for the wizard that can be used for automated tests or as an additional selector. |
| extra | Object | () => ({}) |  | Extra values used in wizard. |
| forward-button-attributes | Object | () => ({}) |  | Additional attributes for the button navigating to the next step that are not explicitly defined as props. |
| forward-button-class | String / Array / Object | a_btn a_btn_secondary |  | One or more additional CSS-classes for the button navigating to the next step. |
| forward-button-icon-left | String |  |  | Name of the icon to be shown to the left of the label for the button navigating to the next step. |
| forward-button-icon-right | String |  |  | Name of the icon to be shown to the right of the label for the button navigating to the next step. |
| forward-button-text | String | _A_WIZARD_PREVIOUS_ |  | Custom label for the button navigating to the next step. |
| forward-button-title | String |  |  | Custom title for the button navigating to the next step. |
| has-focus-jump | Boolean | true |  | Is focus jump used when transitioning to a different step in a wizard. |
| id | String | () => uniqueId("a_wizard_") |  | Specifies a unique ID of the wizard. |
| is-back-button-disabled | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the button navigating to the previous step should be disabled. |
| is-back-button-hide | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the button navigating to the previous step should be hidden. |
| is-back-first-button-hide | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the button navigating to the previous step should be hidden in the first step of the wizard. |
| is-back-step-button-disabled | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the transition to one of the previous steps by clicking on it in header is disabled. |
| is-buttons-loading | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the buttons in the navigation toolbar are in the loading state. |
| is-control-outside | Boolean | false |  | Specifies weather the external logic is for step navigation in wizard. |
| is-forward-button-disabled | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the button navigating to the next step should be disabled. |
| is-forward-button-hide | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the button navigating to the next step should be hidden. |
| is-forward-last-button-hide | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the button navigating to the next step should be hidden in the last step of the wizard. |
| is-forward-step-button-disabled | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the transition to one of the next steps by clicking on it in header is disabled. |
| is-mobile | Boolean | false |  | Indicator whether the wizard is being displayed on a mobile device or not. |
| is-step-number-visible | Boolean | true |  | Specifies weather the steps are sequentially enumerated in steps header. |
| is-steps-justified | Boolean | true |  | Specifies weather the alignment of the steps is justified. |
| is-toolbar-bottom | Boolean | true |  | Specifies weather the wizard navigation toolbar will be placed at the bottom, under the content of the currently active step. This is the default placement. |
| is-toolbar-top | Boolean | false |  | Specifies weather the wizard navigation toolbar will be placed at the top, above the content of the currently active step. |
| key-id | String |  |  | A unique identifier key for each step. Used for performance enhancement. |
| show-only-active-step-mobile | Boolean | true |  | Show only the currently active step in a wizard. |
| step-active | Number |  |  | Index of the currently active step in the wizard. |
| steps-icon-error | String | AlertDanger |  | Icon displayed in case of an error in the step |
| steps-icon-error-text | String | _A_WIZARD_STEP_ERROR_ |  | Text and title for the screen reader for the error icon |
| steps-icon-warning | String | AlertWarning |  | Icon displayed in case of a warning in the step |
| steps-icon-warning-text | String | _A_WIZARD_STEP_WARNING_ |  | Text and title for the screen reader for the warning icon |
| steps | Array | () => [] |  | An array of objects containing information about each step in a wizard. |
| steps-progressbar-text | String | _A_WIZARD_STEPS_PROGRESSBAR_TEXT_{{stepActive}}_{{stepsCount}}_{{stepActiveLabel}}_ |  | Text indicating the user's progress within the wizard. Variables available inside placeholder are **stepActive** (currently active step), **stepsCount** (total number of steps) **stepActiveLabel** (label of the currently active step). |
| steps-visited | Object |  |  | Represents an object where each key corresponds to a step index, and the associated boolean value indicates whether the respective step has been visited or not. |
| sub-type | String |  |  | The **subType** property is used to define the style of active steps in the **line** type. It allows choosing between square and round shapes, with or without an additional border. |
| toolbar-bottom-teleport-id | String |  |  | Id for teleport (dynamic movement) of the navigation toolbar to the bottom of the wizard. |
| type | String | basic |  | Customizes visual representation of steps in header. |

## Slots

| name | description |
| --- | --- |
| toolbar | A slot containing navigation buttons toolbar. |
| slot | A slot containing a step in wizard. |
| slotLabel | A slot containing the labels of the steps in wizard header. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| change-step | Function | Emitted after the active wizard step changes. The payload contains **step**, **stepIndex**, and **previousStepIndex**. |
| go-step-back | Function | A function responsible for moving the user back to the previous step of the wizard and any additional logic relevant to transition. |
| go-step-forward | Function | A function responsible for moving the user to the next step of the wizard and any additional logic relevant to transition. |

# AModalWizard (Wizard in a modal window)

This component is a combination of a modal window (AModal) and a wizard (AWizard). You can use almost all props from AModal and AWizard.

## Basic usage

*props: `steps`*

```html
<a-button
  id="wizard_basic"
  class="a_btn a_btn_primary"
  text="open"
  @click="openModalWizard"
></a-button>
<a-modal-wizard
  v-if="isModalWizardVisible"
  size="xxl"
  selector-close-ids="wizard_basic"
  header-text="Wizard"
  :close="closeModalWizard"
  :steps="wizardSteps"
>
  <template
    v-slot:step1
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h2"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step2
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h2"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step3
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h2"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
  <template
    v-slot:step4
  >
    <a-translation
      tag="h2"
      text="_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_"
    ></a-translation>
    <p>{{ text }}</p>
  </template>
</a-modal-wizard>
```

```js
import {
  ref,
} from "vue";

import { 
  AButton, 
  AModalWizard, 
  ATranslation,
} from "aloha-vue";
    
export default {
  name: "PageModalWizardBasic",
  components: {
    AButton,
    AModalWizard,
    ATranslation,
  },
  setup() {
    const isModalWizardVisible = ref(undefined);

    const wizardSteps = [
      {
        slot: "step1",
        label: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_",
        title: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_1_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step2",
        label: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_",
        title: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_2_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step3",
        label: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_",
        title: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_3_",
      },
      {
        slot: "step4",
        label: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_",
        title: "_A_MODAL_WIZARD_STEP_4_",
      },
    ];
    const text = `Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Quisque nisl eros, 
        pulvinar facilisis justo mollis, auctor consequat urna. Morbi a bibendum metus. 
        Donec scelerisque sollicitudin enim eu venenatis. Duis tincidunt laoreet ex, 
        in pretium orci vestibulum eget. Class aptent taciti sociosqu ad litora torquent`;

    const openModalWizard = () => {
      isModalWizardVisible.value = true;
    };

    const closeModalWizard = () => {
      isModalWizardVisible.value = false;
    };

    return {
      closeModalWizard,
      isModalWizardVisible,
      openModalWizard,
      text,
      wizardSteps,
    };
  },
};
```

| is-back-step-button-disabled | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the transition to one of the previous steps by clicking on it in header is disabled. |
| is-buttons-loading | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the buttons in the navigation toolbar are in the loading state. |
| is-control-outside | Boolean | false |  | Specifies weather the external logic is for step navigation in wizard. |
| is-forward-button-disabled | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the button navigating to the next step should be disabled. |
| is-forward-button-hide | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the button navigating to the next step should be hidden. |
| is-forward-last-button-hide | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the button navigating to the next step should be hidden in the last step of the wizard. |
| is-forward-step-button-disabled | Boolean | false |  | Specifies whether the transition to one of the next steps by clicking on it in header is disabled. |
| is-mobile | Boolean | false |  | Indicator whether the wizard is being displayed on a mobile device or not. |
| is-step-number-visible | Boolean | true |  | Specifies weather the steps are sequentially enumerated in steps header. |
| is-steps-justified | Boolean | true |  | Specifies weather the alignment of the steps is justified. |
| key-id | String |  |  | A unique identifier key for each step. Used for performance enhancement. |
| scroll-to-top-on-step-change | Boolean | true |  | Determines whether the modal body scrolls to the top when the active wizard step changes. |
| show-only-active-step-mobile | Boolean | true |  | Show only the currently active step in a wizard. |
| step-active | Number |  |  | Index of the currently active step in the wizard. |
| steps-icon-error | String | AlertDanger |  | Icon displayed in case of an error in the step |
| steps-icon-error-text | String | _A_WIZARD_STEP_ERROR_ |  | Text and title for the screen reader for the error icon |
| steps-icon-warning | String | AlertWarning |  | Icon displayed in case of a warning in the step |
| steps-icon-warning-text | String | _A_WIZARD_STEP_WARNING_ |  | Text and title for the screen reader for the warning icon |
| steps | Array | () => [] |  | An array of objects containing information about each step in a wizard. |
| steps-progressbar-text | String | _A_WIZARD_STEPS_PROGRESSBAR_TEXT_{{stepActive}}_{{stepsCount}}_{{stepActiveLabel}}_ |  | Text indicating the user's progress within the wizard. Variables available inside placeholder are **stepActive** (currently active step), **stepsCount** (total number of steps) **stepActiveLabel** (label of the currently active step). |
| sub-type | String |  |  | The **subType** property is used to define the style of active steps in the **line** type. It allows choosing between square and round shapes, with or without an additional border. |
| steps-visited | Object |  |  | Represents an object where each key corresponds to a step index, and the associated boolean value indicates whether the respective step has been visited or not. |
| type | String | basic |  | Customizes visual representation of steps in header. |

## Events

| name | type | description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| change-step | Function | Emitted after the active wizard step changes. The payload contains **step**, **stepIndex**, and **previousStepIndex**. |
| go-step-back | Function | A function responsible for moving the user back to the previous step of the wizard and any additional logic relevant to transition. |
| go-step-forward | Function | A function responsible for moving the user to the next step of the wizard and any additional logic relevant to transition. |

# Theming

All styles of **aloha-vue** are configured with **CSS** custom properties (tokens). They change at runtime, without rebuilding **SCSS**.

- **Base tokens** – the few values a project usually changes: colors as hue / saturation / lightness, gray tint, `--a_radius`, focus ring widths, `--a_density`.
- **Derived tokens** – calculated from the base tokens: hover, active, subtle and text variants of each color, gray scale, surfaces, all radii, spacing, focus ring. You never have to define them, but you can override each one.
- **Component tokens** – `--a_btn_*`, `--a_table_*`, … They reference the derived tokens and allow fine tuning of one component.

## Quick start

Define the base tokens in your own **CSS**. Theme colors: `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `danger`. Each color has `--a__h`, `_s` and `_l`.

```css
:root {
  /* brand color as hue / saturation / lightness */
  --a_primary_h: 201;
  --a_primary_s: 92%;
  --a_primary_l: 36%;

  /* gray scale tint */
  --a_gray_h: 228;
  --a_gray_s: 14%;

  /* one radius, all others are derived */
  --a_radius: .5rem;
}

/* Browsers with color-mix(): a single color is enough for hover, active
   and the subtle variants. Text contrast (_contrast, _text, _text_emphasis)
   is still calculated from --a_primary_h / _s / _l. */
.a_theme.my_brand {
  --a_color_primary: #e60000;
}
```

## Theme generator

Choose colors, radius, focus ring, theme and density. The preview updates immediately and the generated **CSS** can be copied into your project. The contrast column shows the ratio of the text color (white or black) on the chosen color; **WCAG AA** requires at least 4.5:1.

### Preview

This is an alert. All colors follow the base tokens.

This is an alert. All colors follow the base tokens.

Text field

### Generated CSS

```css
:root {
  --a_primary_h: 0;
  --a_primary_s: 0%;
  --a_primary_l: 0%;
  --a_primary_contrast_threshold: 101%;
  --a_secondary_h: 0;
  --a_secondary_s: 0%;
  --a_secondary_l: 0%;
  --a_secondary_contrast_threshold: 101%;
  --a_tertiary_h: 0;
  --a_tertiary_s: 0%;
  --a_tertiary_l: 0%;
  --a_tertiary_contrast_threshold: 101%;
  --a_success_h: 0;
  --a_success_s: 0%;
  --a_success_l: 0%;
  --a_success_contrast_threshold: 101%;
  --a_info_h: 0;
  --a_info_s: 0%;
  --a_info_l: 0%;
  --a_info_contrast_threshold: 101%;
  --a_warning_h: 0;
  --a_warning_s: 0%;
  --a_warning_l: 0%;
  --a_warning_contrast_threshold: 101%;
  --a_danger_h: 0;
  --a_danger_s: 0%;
  --a_danger_l: 0%;
  --a_danger_contrast_threshold: 101%;
  --a_gray_h: 0;
  --a_gray_s: 0%;
  --a_radius: 0.375rem;
  --a_focus_width_inside: 2px;
  --a_focus_width_outside: 2px;
}
```

## Dark theme

Set `data-a-theme` on `` or on any element. Only the tones and the gray scale change, all colors are recalculated. `auto` follows the operating system setting (`prefers-color-scheme`).

```html
<!-- always dark -->
<html data-a-theme="dark">

<!-- follows the operating system -->
<html data-a-theme="auto">
```

## Density

`data-a-density` scales control heights and paddings with `--a_density` (`compact` = 0.75, `comfortable` = 1.25). Font sizes stay the same.

```html
<html data-a-density="compact">
<!-- or -->
<html data-a-density="comfortable">
```

## Theme for a part of the page

Derived tokens are calculated on `:root`, on elements with the class `a_theme` and on elements with `data-a-theme` or `data-a-density`. To re-theme only a part of the page, put the base tokens on such an element.

```html
<section class="a_theme" style="--a_primary_h: 145; --a_primary_s: 63%; --a_primary_l: 29%;">
  <!-- all aloha components here use the green primary color -->
</section>

<div data-a-theme="dark">
  <!-- dark island inside a light page -->
</div>
```

## Focus ring

All components show a two-colored focus ring for keyboard focus (`:focus-visible`): an inner gap and an outer ring. Widths and colors can be overridden globally or on any element. In forced colors mode (Windows high contrast) a system outline is shown instead.

```css
:root {
  --a_focus_width_inside: 2px;
  --a_focus_width_outside: 3px;
  --a_focus_color_inside: var(--a_color_surface);
  --a_focus_color_outside: #6a1b9a;
}

/* only for one component */
.my_search .a_form_control {
  --a_focus_color_outside: var(--a_color_success);
}
```

## Component tokens

Every component describes its tokens at the end of its **SCSS** file inside `:where(…)`. They have no specificity, so a simple class selector in your **CSS** overrides them.

```css
/* all buttons */
.a_btn {
  --a_btn_border_radius: var(--a_border_radius_pill);
  --a_btn_font_weight: var(--a_font_weight_semibold);
}

/* one table */
.my_table.a_table__parent {
  --a_table_th_bg: var(--a_color_primary_bg_subtle);
}
```

## Cascade layers

All styles of **aloha-vue** are in cascade layers. **CSS** of your application that is not in a layer always wins, independent of specificity.

```css
@layer aloha.reset, aloha.tokens, aloha.base, aloha.components, aloha.utilities;

/* your CSS without a layer always wins, no !important needed */
.a_btn_primary {
  --a_btn_bg: rebeccapurple;
}
```

## Global tokens

The current values are read from the page. Derived color tokens exist for every theme color (`primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `success`, `info`, `warning`, `danger`, `light`, `dark`); the table shows `primary` as an example.

| --- | --- | --- |
